chapters.title: Chapter 4601: Re-establishment of Nine Suns Holy Land
paragraphs: Chapter 4601: Re-establishment of Nine Suns Holy Land
“Announce to the public that Ling Han is the son-in-law of our clan. Anyone who wants to harm him is equivalent to making an enemy of our clan.” Chi Taiming’s voice continued to ring out.
The Crystal Saint found this a little strange, and said, “That brat already possesses Saint-level battle prowess, so there should be no one in this world that would dare to trifle with him.”
Thus, what need was there for them to do anything else?
“Heh, so why not do this kind of favor that would cost us nothing?” Chi Taiming asked calmly.
‘F*ck! He’s truly an old fox!’
The Crystal Saint only felt that he wasn’t as shameless as this.

“As long as there are no accidents, this boy will definitely become Emperor!” Chi Taiming continued, “In this way, our Chi Clan would be assured! Furthermore, if we can still get his children, and adopt them into our Chi Clan, then with the bloodline of two great Imperial Clans, just how amazing would their natural talent in cultivation be?”
“It is ultimately possible that there would be a second Great Emperor in our Chi Clan!”
The Crystal Saint nodded. He couldn’t see as far as Chi Taiming, and could only think of the Imperial Scroll, Destructive Energy and Phoenix Wings Divine Flight.
However, would Ling Han not teach these techniques to his own child?
Wasn’t his and Chi Menghan’s child the bloodline of the Donglin Imperial Clan?

Worse come to worst, from the day that the child was born, they would treat him millions and millions of times better, so that he would return to the Chi Clan. In fact, they would even betroth him to a woman of the Chi Clan, so that they could become even closer.
Then, these precious techniques would still fall into the hands of the Chi Clan.
That’s right, that’s right. Previously, his behaviour was really too greedy and inappropriate. No wonder he had chased Ling Han away.
Thus, the older one was, the wiser they were.
Soon, the Chi Clan sent out news, expressing their approval of Ling Han as a son-in-law, and expressing their full support for him.
Instantly, the world shook.
This… was the Donglin Imperial Clan publicly slapping the Ziwei Imperial Clan’s face?
But upon further thought, the actions of the Donglin Imperial Clan were very realistic.
Was Ling Han powerful?
Strong, strong to the point of sweeping aside all opponents at the same cultivation level, capable of fighting.even someone with a higher cultivation level to a tie.
The possibility that this kind of person could become Emperor was much, much too high.
So, who could Chi Menghan be betrothed to what would bring the most benefits to the Chi Clan?
Ling Han or Ziwei Imperial Clan?
Moreover, with Ling Han’s personality, once he became Emperor, it was very likely that he would make the Ziwei Imperial Clan disappear from history.𝓯𝓻𝒆𝙚𝒘𝓮𝙗𝓷𝒐𝓿𝙚𝒍.𝙘𝓸𝙢
Secondly, so what if they offended the Ziwei Imperial Clan?
Was the Donglin Imperial Clan afraid?
Both clans had similar backgrounds, with an Imperial Weapon standing guard, so what was there to be afraid of?
Thus, what did it matter if Donglin Imperial Clan gave Ziwei Imperial Clan a harsh slap?
Moreover, only by doing this, and publicly breaking off relations with the Ziwei Imperial Clan, would they be able to gain Ling Han’s favour.
—Previously, the Donglin Imperial Clan didn’t care about anything else and promised Chi Menghan to Baili Tian. Thus, they had to clearly express their stand on the matter now, right?
All of a sudden, the entire Galaxy Network was discussing this matter heatedly, and guessing how the Ziwei Imperial Clan would react.
Right at this moment, Ling Han and the others returned.
After introducing Chi Menghan to Hu Niu and the empress, Ling Han began to deal with serious matters after they spent a few days together.

Since Ling Han and Brother Monkey had either become a Saint or possessed Saint-level battle prowess, and since the little azure dragon and the large black dog were only one step away from becoming Saints, the matter of the reestablishing the Nine Suns Holy Land naturally had to be brought up the schedule.
Previously, the Nine Mountains Saint was all alone, and it was difficult for him to hold on alone.
But it was different now. There were as many as three cultivators with Saint-level battle prowess!

Thus, unless they could kill Ling Han and the others at the same time, as long as one of them slipped through the net, having become the target of a Saint, what force would be able to survive peacefully?
If they re-established the Nine Suns Holy Land now, Ling Han wasn’t worried that the Imperial Clans would come and cause trouble.
Moreover, just how terrifying was Ling Han’s potential?
As long as there was no guarantee that he could be killed, who would dare make a move on those close to him?
Then there was no need for Ling Han to become Emperor, because once he became a Saint, even a Nine-Star Saint would be terrified, right?
The time was ripe.
Ling Han got in touch with the Nine Mountains Sain, and said that he wanted to rebuild the Nine Suns Holy Land.
This naturally made the old man extremely happy. He immediately rushed over, and discussed the details of the reconstruction with Ling Han.
There were a lot of things to do, such as choosing a location and selecting the leader of the Holy Land.
Time passed quickly. A year later, Ling Han announced to the public that the Nine Suns Holy Land was reopening!
Four Origin Planet was chosen as the location. This was a great planet, but if it was used as a Holy Land sect, it seemed to be a little lacking in resources.
Ling Han didn’t care. He could slowly modify this planet, especially after he became a Saint. Just how powerful would he be by then?
Hence, this was not a problem.
The Master of the Holy Land was… Ling Han!

Additionally, the Nine Mountains Saint was the grand elder, Brother Monkey, the little azure dragon, and the large black dog were the guest elders. In fact, he even sent out an invitation to Ding Shu and the other Genesis World rulers, strongly inviting them to also take the position of guest elders.
However, at present, only Ding Shu and Jing Haoran had replied and expressed their agreement. There was still no news about the others.
This naturally would not have any effect on Ling Han. He had already sent out invitations widely, inviting the various great forces to attend the ceremony.
There were as many people that responded as clouds.

Ling Han had already used his heaven-defying battle merits to prove his strength. It could be said that even if he couldn’t become Emperor in the end, he would still become the most powerful Saint — and there was no other Saint.
This kind of elite, or even a future Great Emperor, since he had invited them, why others not come to show goodwill?
The day of the founding of the Holy Land was set for three years later, giving these guests who had come to attend the ceremony enough time to make arrangements.
On the other hand, they couldn’t just open the Holy Land. Without disciples, what was the point?
There was even less need to worry about this.
With Ling Han as their golden signboard, what need was there for them to be afraid of not being able to recruit outstanding disciples?
Of course, there was no time limit for the recruitment of disciples. It was always ongoing. On the day the Holy Land was established, it should be enough to form a larger scale establishment.
Ling Xi, Fu Tianxing, and so on had all joined and become a disciple of the Nine Suns Holy Land. In future, they could break away from it, but for now, they would just be there for appearances’ sake.
Ling Han, the Holy Land Master, was actually only in name. He was completely focused on cultivating, so how could he possibly bother with such trifling matters?
Thus, the grand elder, the Nine Mountains Saint became busy.

However, after the old man had reached the Saint Tier, his potential had practically been exhausted. Unless he obtained a great opportunity, it should be impossible for him to advance into Two Stars. Thus, with so many years of lifespan remaining, he had to find something to do, right?
Ling Han went to the front lines again, slaughtering Yin souls to increase his cultivation.
However, he was too strong now.
Even if he killed a Venerate Tier-level Yin soul, the rewards he received were pitifully little, and the help it provided to his cultivation was pitifully little.
And in the case of the Yin Saint… just how many Saints were there? Even if there were slightly more Yin Saints, it was still limited.
More importantly, killing Saintly corpses wasn’t beneficial to Ling Han at all. Otherwise, if he went to the Yin River and the sea of blood, he might be able to reap great rewards.
Ling Han was very depressed. Next, was he going to slowly increase his cultivation level?
The young king tiers of today were already close to advancing into Saint Tier. Though his battle prowess was not inferior, there was still a gap of a major tier between them.
Becoming Emperor naturally depended on cultivation level as well. He was definitely too far off!

chapters.title: Chapter 4602: Heading to the edge of the universe
paragraphs: Chapter 4602: Heading to the edge of the universe
Just as Ling Han was worrying about how to increase his cultivation level, Brother Monkey came over.
“Old Sun wants to go to the edge of the universe to find the whereabouts of my ancestor,” Brother Monkey said.
This was something that Brother Monkey had long since decided. As long as he became a Saint, he would go to the edge of the universe to find the whereabouts of the Battle Saint Emperor.
Whether he had lived or died, there had to be a conclusion.
A thought flashed in Ling Han’s head, and he said, “After the reconstruction ceremony of the Holy Land, I will go with you.”
He had just been worrying about the problem of improving his cultivation level, but if he went to the edge of the universe, would he gain something?
It should be known that it was highly possible that the secret of longevity was hidden there, so it would not be strange that there was a lot of Celestial Qi there.
Brother Monkey thought for a moment, then nodded, “All right!”𝕗𝕣𝐞𝐞𝘄𝐞𝚋𝚗𝗼𝘃𝗲𝗹.𝚌𝕠𝚖

Ling Han had long since been anticipating this trip. However, his cultivation level previously had been too weak, and even if he used up his entire lifespan, he may not be able to make it there. Now that he possessed Saint-level battle prowess, he could give it a try.
Thus, the two brothers began to cultivate first, and waited quietly.

When the little azure dragon and the large black dog found out, they naturally clamored to go as well. However, Ling Han set a condition for them—they were not allowed to go unless they became Saints.
It should be known that even the Great Emperors considered that place a dangerous place. Just look at the Battle Saint Emperor and the others. Which one of them had returned?
If he hadn’t died of old age somewhere, he would have definitely been trapped.
Even the Great Emperor would be trapped, so just how terrifying was that place?
Thus, what would Venerates gp there for?
In fact, even Saints were completely unsafe. However, it could not hold up to the fact that both Ling Han and Brother Monkey were outrageously bold.
In the blink of an eye, three years had passed.
The Nine Suns Holy Land reopened, and today would be the day!

As early as a month ago, esteemed guests had already arrived, especially the Donglin Imperial Clan. The Donglin Imperial Clan had given enough face to this son-in-law of theirs, and the Crystal Saint had personally brought the juniors of the clan over to offer congratulations. He had even allowed a few juniors of his clan to join the Nine Suns Holy Land.
When the time came, even more forces would come.
There were innumerable Saint Tier and Venerate Tier-level forces, and there were even a few Imperial Clans that had sent envoys over to deliver generous gifts.

Though they had not sent out a Saint to lead the team, the fact that they were able to attend, and the gifts they had given were also considerably valuable, could be considered to have given Ling Han a lot of face.

These Imperial Clans naturally had never become enemies with Ling Han before, and other Imperial Clans like Ziwei Clan, Golden Cauldron Clan, White Feather Clan, Jade Drop Clan and so on didn’t send anyone over.
—Even their Imperial Son had been killed by Ling Han. This was a great enmity, so how could it be erased so easily?

Thus, these Imperial Clans only had one thought in their minds. They could either kill Ling Han, or push the Imperial Sons of their Clans to speed up their advance, so that they could become Emperor first.
Only one Great Emperor could appear in each era. Thus, no matter how freakish you were, if you were too late, there was still nothing you could do.
This was a grand feast. It was broadcasted live through the Galaxy Network, and not only did it allow the Nine Suns Holy Land to regain its former glory, it even surpassed it countless times over.
Just see how many Saints they had?
Three of them!

Furthermore, Ling Han and Brother Monkey’s potential was too great. They should be able to reach Three Stars, Five Stars, or even higher level of Saint Tier or battle prowess soon. There were also a great many disciples that had enrolled into Nine Suns Holy Land on the spot.
The Nine Mountains Saint was extremely pleased. Right now, he only had one hope, and that was for Ling Han to become Emperor and bring the Nine Suns Holy Land to an unprecedented height.
Ten days later, the feast ended, and the various forces left, one after another.
The Crystal Saint deliberately stayed behind to discuss some matters with Ling Han.
“When are you going to marry Menghan?” he asked directly.
As for that.
Ling Han thought for a moment, “When I become Emperor.”
“No, how can the princess of our Chi Clan follow you for such a long time without a proper status!” The Crystal Saint immediately shook his head.
The two of them argued for a while, and finally decided to set the wedding date on the day that Ling Han would become a Saint.
Not only did Ling Han want to marry Chi Menghan, but he also wanted to marry Song Lan.
This woman was also deeply in love with him. Moreover, he was the one who had snatched her from her wedding and saved her, so he had to take responsibility, right?
Otherwise, everyone knew that Ling Han was the one who had stolen her from her wedding. Would anyone still dare to marry Song Lan?
Ling Han wasn’t in a hurry to set off.
Going to the edge of the universe was a very dangerous and possibly time-consuming matter. He had to make proper arrangements.
He walked around the Holy Land, guiding the cultivation of his disciples.
In truth, the majority of disciples were older than him, but on the path of martial arts, there was no seniority in learning, and those who were capable would be regarded as Master.
Ling Han took some time to refine the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower again. He then instilled the Seven Star Regulations into it, transforming it into a Seven Star Level Spirit Tool.
Unfortunately, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower wasn’t him, so it couldn’t intertwine Regulations and unleash battle prowess above its cultivation level.
Thus, the current Primal Chaos could only be considered the strongest seven-star Spirit Tool.
Ling Han didn’t take it to heart. He had always thought that his own strength was the most important.
On this trip to the edge of the universe, he had to bring the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower with him.
It wasn’t because of the might of the Spirit Tool, but rather because of the sturdiness of the Origin Gold. If it was used as a shield, even Saints wouldn’t be able to break through it.
After making the necessary arrangements, Ling Han and Brother Monkey decided to set off.
Because the little azure dragon and the large black dog hadn’t broken through yet, they naturally couldn’t follow him this time.
This was no joke.
The two of them tore a rip into space, and headed towards the edge of the universe.
Just how large was the universe?
No one knew about this. However, according to the information available, the distance between the two furthest planets would take a Saint about six days to travel.
From the sound of it, this seemed to be very close.
However, the distance from the final planet to the edge of the universe was astonishingly far. Even Saints couldn’t get close to it.
It could be said that the space that planets occupied in the universe was possibly only ten thousandth of the entire universe, or even smaller than that.
To go to the edge of the universe required a huge amount of courage and determination.
Ling Han and Brother Monkey entered into the Void, using Phoenix Wings Divine Flight and advanced rapidly.

Ling Han constructed a Transfer Formation on the final planet. This was a one-time Transfer Formation that expended extremely large amounts of resources. It could only be used once, and would become useless once it was used.
But its effect was that no matter how far away they were, they could be instantly transmitted back.
Ling Han didn’t know how long this trip would take. After all, they couldn’t spend their remaining life on traveling, right?
Hence, the time limit was ten years.
If they still couldn’t reach the edge of the universe in 10 years, then he and Brother Monkey would return through the Transfer Formation.

Time flew by. Every day, Ling Han and Brother Monkey’s daily routine was to travel. One year, two years, three years, the universe was endless and far-reaching. Every time they broke through the Void and came out, all they saw was an ice-cold, dark world.
There were no stars, no light, and nothing else existed.
Staying in this kind of place for too long, any normal person would probably go crazy, right?
Five years, eight years, ten years!

Finally, ten years had passed, but Ling Han and Brother Monkey still hadn’t reached the edge of the universe. They journeyed for another two years, but they still couldn’t see any signs of reaching the end.
Helpless, the two of them could only use the Transfer Formation to return.
Perhaps only Great Emperors had the right to explore the edge of the universe. So what if they were Saints? They didn’t even have the right to reach this place.

Moreover, he was the one who had snatched her from her wedding and saved her, so he had to take responsibility, right?
Otherwise, everyone knew that Ling Han was the one who had stolen her from her wedding.
Would anyone still dare to marry Song Lan?
Ling Han wasn’t in a hurry to set off.
Going to the edge of the universe was a very dangerous and possibly time-consuming matter.
He had to make proper arrangements.
He walked around the Holy Land, guiding the cultivation of his disciples.
In truth, the majority of disciples were older than him, but on the path of martial arts, there was no seniority in learning, and those who were capable would be regarded as Master.
Ling Han took some time to refine the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower again.
He then instilled the Seven Star Regulations into it, transforming it into a Seven Star Level Spirit Tool.
Unfortunately, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower wasn’t him, so it couldn’t intertwine Regulations and unleash battle prowess above its cultivation level.
Thus, the current Primal Chaos could only be considered the strongest seven-star Spirit Tool.
Ling Han didn’t take it to heart.
He had always thought that his own strength was the most important.
On this trip to the edge of the universe, he had to bring the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower with him.
It wasn’t because of the might of the Spirit Tool, but rather because of the sturdiness of the Origin Gold.
If it was used as a shield, even Saints wouldn’t be able to break through it.
After making the necessary arrangements, Ling Han and Brother Monkey decided to set off.
Because the little azure dragon and the large black dog hadn’t broken through yet, they naturally couldn’t follow him this time.
This was no joke.
The two of them tore a rip into space, and headed towards the edge of the universe.
Just how large was the universe?
No one knew about this.
However, according to the information available, the distance between the two furthest planets would take a Saint about six days to travel.
From the sound of it, this seemed to be very close.
However, the distance from the final planet to the edge of the universe was astonishingly far.
Even Saints couldn’t get close to it.
It could be said that the space that planets occupied in the universe was possibly only ten thousandth of the entire universe, or even smaller than that.
To go to the edge of the universe required a huge amount of courage and determination.
Ling Han and Brother Monkey entered into the Void, using Phoenix Wings Divine Flight and advanced rapidly.
Ling Han constructed a Transfer Formation on the final planet.
This was a one-time Transfer Formation that expended extremely large amounts of resources.
It could only be used once, and would become useless once it was used.
But its effect was that no matter how far away they were, they could be instantly transmitted back.
Ling Han didn’t know how long this trip would take.
After all, they couldn’t spend their remaining life on traveling, right?
Hence, the time limit was ten years.
If they still couldn’t reach the edge of the universe in 10 years, then he and Brother Monkey would return through the Transfer Formation.
Time flew by.
Every day, Ling Han and Brother Monkey’s daily routine was to travel.
One year, two years, three years, the universe was endless and far-reaching.
Every time they broke through the Void and came out, all they saw was an ice-cold, dark world.
There were no stars, no light, and nothing else existed.
Staying in this kind of place for too long, any normal person would probably go crazy, right?
Five years, eight years, ten years!
Finally, ten years had passed, but Ling Han and Brother Monkey still hadn’t reached the edge of the universe.
They journeyed for another two years, but they still couldn’t see any signs of reaching the end.
Helpless, the two of them could only use the Transfer Formation to return.
Perhaps only Great Emperors had the right to explore the edge of the universe.
So what if they were Saints?
They didn’t even have the right to reach this place.

chapters.title: Chapter 4603: Assassination by a Saint
paragraphs: Chapter 4603: Assassination by a Saint
After returning to the Four Origin Planet, Ling Han continued his previous routine.
He could guide the disciples of the sect in their cultivation, or become a middleman to earn the difference in quality of Celestial Qi.

Right now, he was in desperate need of Celestial Qi. Merely reaching the nine-star Venerate Tier would require a huge amount of Celestial Qi, and he encountered any trouble causing him to to break through some limits at the fourth pinnacle level, that would be fun.
Hence, if there was a large-scale invasion of Yin souls, he would definitely counterattack, and earn some rewards from heaven and earth.
In the Celestial Qi business, it was still a sure profit. After all, this only needed him to spend a little bit of time, and added with a bit of Celestial medicine, it would be done.
However, the Nine Suns Holy Land didn’t have much of a background at the moment. It didn’t even have the use of an exclusive medicinal planet.
The power structure of the forces in the universe had long since been decided. If they wanted to obtain new territory, there was only one way.
War.

Ling Han believed in the principle of ‘if you don’t trifle with me, I won’t trifle with you’. Thus, he naturally wouldn’t take the initiative to invade other planets. This was a little awkward. Celestial medicines could only be planted on Four Origin Planet.𝗳𝚛𝚎𝚎𝘄𝕖𝕓𝕟𝕠𝚟𝚎𝕝.𝗰𝕠𝐦
Thankfully, he had moved a great many seven-star Great Herbs from the Ziwei Imperial Clan here. After a while, he would be able to reap some rewards.
Furthermore, since they were Great Herbs, they definitely needed an extremely long harvesting cycle, and that was why it was called background.
Relying on earning the quality difference in Celestial Qi, Ling Han’s cultivation level was slowly improving.
He didn’t dare to let others know that he was the one doing this business. Otherwise, forces like the Ziwei Imperial Clan would definitely cause trouble.
Ling Han attempted to truly solve the problem of Celestial Qi.

The Imperial Clan was able to easily obtain Celestial Qi through the Imperial Weapon, hooking it out of the Void and obtaining it. However, there were very few high-level Celestial Qi, after all. Thus, even the Imperial Clans had very few eight-star Celestial Qi, let alone nine-star Celestial Qi.
Ling Han wanted to give it a try.
However, no matter how he tried, he didn’t see any Celestial Qi being drawn over by the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.
This made him understand that the key to attracting Celestial Qi wasn’t the Origin Gold, but the Emperor-level Regulations.
He could only give up and obediently do his business as a middleman, earning the price difference.

And in these twelve years, the whole universe was peaceful, and nothing major had happened. If there was anything serious, it was that the invasion of the Yin souls was still progressing steadily. With the Skeleton Saint Tools clearing the way, the invasion of the Netherworld was unstoppable.
Unless the Pseudo-Emperor made a move, there should be no one at the level of Saint Tier that could stop the Skeleton Saint Tools.
For example, Baili Tian, Yan Dongming, and the other Golden Generations, had any of them truly advanced into Saint Tier?

Right now, it was as if the members of the Imperial Clans had all become extremely low-key. There was very little news about the Golden Generation. In fact, they didn’t even receive any news about the Silver Generation or the ordinary Imperial Sons.
Ling Han didn’t mind. So what if Baili Tian had truly become a Saint? Could it be that he would still be afraid?
Though he had always been the type to tell others to work and do nothing himself, as the Holy land’s Master, he couldn’t just do his own things all the time, right?

On this day, Ling Han came out and strolled around the Holy Land. When he saw disciples cultivating, he went over to take a look. If there was a problem with their cultivation, he would give them some guidance.
Before he knew it, he had arrived at a public square.
Here, there were a dozen over disciples sparring and practicing their sword techniques.
“Holy Land Master!”
“Lord Holy Land Master!”
Seeing Ling Han walk over, these disciples all paid their respects. Some of them even looked fanatical.
This was Ling Han, the strongest Sect Master in history, and also the strongest Venerate in history.
How many people had come because of the name of Ling Han?
However, Ling Han very rarely appeared, and now that they could see him from close quarters, they were naturally all extremely excited.
Ling Han nodded, indicating that there was no need for formalities. He hated this kind of red tape the most.
“Lord Holy Land Master, why don’t you teach us how to practice the sword,” a disciple said. The gaze she directed at Ling Han was filled with sincerity and admiration.
This was a female disciple. Upon a closer look, she was really good-looking, and her figure was even more alluring, causing quite a number of male disciples to be unable to take their eyes off her.
Ling Han smiled, not taking it to heart at all, “Sure.”
The disciples stepped forward to practice, one after another. Some of them followed the rules, while some of them were quite off. They needed Ling Han to correct them.
With a few pointers from him, the others also had great gains, nodding repeatedly.

It was the turn of a male disciple. This was a middle-aged man. Ordinarily speaking, he shouldn’t have been accepted into the Holy Land at such an age, but who asked the Nine Suns Holy Land to be newly reestablished? It needed people of all ages and cultivation levels to fill in the gaps.
At first, this man was still very clumsy, but with Ling Han’s guidance, he improved rapidly. Every time he channeled it again, it was enough to make people exclaim in surprise.
‘Hmm?’
There was killing intent!
Just as Ling Han’s heart clenched, that man suddenly exploded. Boom, a terrifying aura surged out. He was actually a Saint!
F***, a Saint actually impersonated a disciple of the Nine Suns Holy Land?
No, he had suppressed his cultivation level to sneak in!
Shua! The saintly might reverberated through the air as the sword slashed over.
Ling Han humphed coldly, brandishing his fists in response, his expression completely cold.
F*ck, coming to the Nine Suns Holy Land to cause trouble?
Peng!
The Saint’s attack was immediately blocked. However, Ling Han was at a disadvantage due to his power, and he was instantly sent flying.
However, right at this moment, another terrifying aura exploded. It was like the awakening of the Imperial Weapon, displaying its full might!
There was another Saint!
It was the woman who had asked for Ling Han’s guidance from the very beginning.

Right now, she was fully unleashing the might of a Saint. In her hand was a Divine Sword, and it was clear that this was a Saint Tool. It had already awakened, and its might was so great that it could easily obliterate even Four Origin Planet.

Ling Han summoned the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower at the first instant. Weng, this strike landed on the body of the tower. So what if it was a Saint Tool? It couldn’t do anything to the Origin Gold at all.

However, after the two attacks, the aftermath reverberated, causing a massive blow to the entire Nine Suns Holy Land. The disciples that were too close were directly crushed into dust by the terrifying power.
Xiu, xiu! Brother Monkey and the Nine Mountains Saint immediately flew out. When they saw this scene, they were both furious.

“Gegege, as expected of Ling Han. He’s really hard to kill.” The female Saint giggled delicately, and shook with delicately with her laughter. Meanwhile, that male Saint’s eyes were expressionless, as if he had no emotions at all.
Ling Han’s expression was livid. In this one move, a great many disciples of the Nine Suns Holy Land had died!

It should be known that even the Imperial Clans would not dare to come to the Nine Suns Holy Land and start a massacre. That was because unless it was guaranteed that they could kill Ling Han, Ling Han’s revenge would also cause them a headache.
In fact, they even thought further that what if Ling Han became Emperor?
The Great Emperor would begin a reckoning. Which force could escape?

Thus, even if the Ziwei Imperial Clan and the others became enemies with Ling Han, Ling Han wouldn’t be able to massacre the entire Imperial Clan even if he truly became a Great Emperor. They would still be able to leave behind descendants that would rise again in the future.
But if they came to the Nine Suns Holy Land to commit such wanton slaughter, Ling Han would definitely be forced to completely oppose them.

“You’re… from the Battle God Palace, right?” Ling Han said balefully. As Saints, they had deliberately disguised themselves to do such a thing. It was very likely that they were the wretches from the Battle God Palace.

chapters.title: Chapter 4604: Void Imperial Clan
paragraphs: Chapter 4604: Void Imperial Clan

A proud expression appeared on the female Saint’s face, and she said, “You’ve guessed a part of it correctly. We have some relationship with the Battle God Palace, but we’re not members of the Battle God Palace.”
“Then who exactly are you people?” Ling Han’s killing intent flickered, and the Nine Mountains Saint and Brother Monkey’s eyes were also filled with viciousness.
They had already come here to commit murder, so what kind of provocation was this? Naturally, it was a life-or-death enmity.
“Oh, the Battle God Palace is only a force under the rule of our clan,” the female Saint said calmly.𝓯𝙧𝓮𝓮𝒘𝓮𝙗𝙣𝒐𝒗𝒆𝓵.𝓬𝓸𝒎
What kind of astonishing news was this!
Throughout the ages, the Battle God Palace had always been a thorn in the side of every force. They wanted to eradicate it, yet they didn’t know where the lair of the Battle God Palace was.
But now, it was revealed that the Battle God Palace was actually a subordinate force of a larger force?
Hiss!
Was this for real?

Yet Ling Han believed this. That was because ever since Wu Yue had arrived, he had felt that the wealth of the Battle God Palace was not enough to support them in nurturing such a prodigy. Thus, if there was an even larger force behind the Battle God Palace, it naturally could be explained.

However, the Battle God Palace was already a Saint-level force, and there had always been a Killing Saint standing guard here. There had never been any lapses. This kind of organization was also one of the very best among Saint-level forces.
What stronger force could control the Battle God Palace?
There was only one answer.
Imperial Clan!
“Which Imperial Clan’s Saint are you?” Ling Han asked. He stared at the female Saint, not because she was beautiful, but because she was too young.
This flame of life had burned for over 10,000 years, at most. In terms of a Saint’s lifespan of over a million years, this flame of life was truly inconceivably young.

Even if she had become a Saint in 10,000 years, this rate of advancement was still astonishingly fast, what more when the other had not just advanced into Saint Tier, but had rather become a Three Star Saint!

She had reached the level of a Three Star Saint at such a young age, and this naturally required a huge amount of cultivation resources. More importantly, her natural talent was definitely incredible as well. Otherwise, how could she have achieved such a feat just by relying on resources?
The female Saint hesitated for a moment, then replied, “I am the descendant of the Void Great Emperor, Wu Xingtong.”
‘The Void Great Emperor?’
Yi, was there a Void Imperial Clan in the universe?
Ling Han looked towards Brother Monkey, and then glanced at the Nine Mountains Saint. Both of them shook their heads slightly at him, indicating that they had never heard of this.
This was strange. Why had an Imperial Clan that no one had ever heard of suddenly appeared?
Was there really such a Great Emperor that existed in the universe?
If there really was such an Imperial Clan, what need was there for them to be like an assassin’s organization, living so secretly?

“Wu Yue, whom you killed, is one of my younger brothers,” Wu Xingtong said calmly. “Although his cultivation level is higher than yours, and he was still killed by you, it is completely because he is too disappointing, but no matter what, he is still my younger brother!”
Ling Han clenched his fists, and said, “If you want to seek me out for revenge, fine, but why target innocent people?”

“Oh, you’re talking about these ants?” Wu Xingtong shook her head, “I thought that someone like you should only have the supreme peak of martial arts in his eyes, and would not care at all about the life and death of ordinary people.”
“You’re wrong,” Ling Han said darkly. “So, you have to pay with your life.”

“Oh, you think… you can kill me?” Wu Xingtong couldn’t help but laugh in spite of herself, “I am a Three Star Saint. At most, you would only be comparable to a One Star Saint. In front of me, you can only flee for your life.”
There was indeed nothing wrong with this. A Three Star Saint against a One Star Saint, that was an absolutely one-sided domination.
Even if the Nine Mountains Saint and Brother Monkey attacked together, they would still be suppressed.
Of course, the Nine Mountains Saint was still able to revive the Saint Tool. This had been personally refined by the Nine Suns Saint. Its might was astonishing.
Ling Han merely stared at Wu Xingtong, “It doesn’t matter if I can’t kill you now, but I swear that you will definitely die by my hands!”
He said these words very calmly, but there was a powerful confidence in his voice, as if he would definitely be able to do it once he said it.
Wu Xingtong’s heart involuntarily clenched, as if someone had squeezed it heavily.
She couldn’t help but pale slightly.
“Impossible!” “Impossible!”
“Is this Execution of Words1? Although its might is extremely weak, it can only cause a slight effect on me. It can’t hurt me at all.”
“But he only said a few words, and it made me feel a heart-wrenching pain. This is definitely Execution of Words!”
“Heavens, the Regulations of Karma are supreme Regulations that only a Great Emperor can use!”
All of a sudden, her thoughts raced, but her expression had long since returned to normal.
“Since that is the case, I will kill you now, so that you will never have this chance again!” Wu Xingtong declared balefully. This time, she was really filled with killing intent.
That was because this time, she truly felt threatened.
“Impossible!” the Nine Mountains Saint said coldly. He had already activated the Saint Tool.

This caused the expressions of Wu Xingtong and the other male Saint to change drastically. The Nine Suns Saint had once been known as the number one Saint. In fact, he could even exchange blows with Ancestral King Lingtian before he became the Great Emperor. Just how powerful was he?
Thus, the Saint Tool that he had left behind was naturally incredibly awesome.

“Ling Han, no matter how hard you try, you won’t be able to. In this era, hehe, your fate has long since been decided. You can only be a pitiful chess piece.” Wu Xingtong did not start the battle, but rather stretched out her hand to tear open the Void.
“I killed people, and left in such a grand manner, so you can only sit by and watch… Hehe, what do you mean by the strongest king tier? Bullsh*t!” As she said this, she stepped in.
“Haha!” The male Saint also chuckled coldly, and similarly tore a rip into space and left.
Ling Han didn’t move, and he simply hovered in the air.
Strength!
He was still not strong enough. Otherwise, if anyone dared to offend him, he would have directly killed thme with a single palm strike.
And now? He could only watch helplessly as the culprit left.

At first, he had thought that now that he possessed battle prowess of Saint-level, even the great Imperial Clans would not dare to fight him to the death. Thus, he boldly reopened the Nine Suns Holy Land.
However, reality slapped him across the face.
There was no need for the Battle God Palace to fear this kind of threat, because no one knew where the Battle God Palace was.
Ling Han couldn’t find a place to exact revenge even if he wanted to.
And the Void Imperial Clan was even more mysterious. They had hidden themselves behind the Battle God Palace for so many years.
Ling Han’s eyes were filled with fighting spirit. He definitely had to increase his cultivation level as soon as possible.
This was a blow to him, but it was completely impossible to defeat him. It would only make him work even harder.

Ling Han descended, and appeased the disciples beneath him. As for dealing with the funeral matters of those disciples that had died tragically, there was naturally no need for him to do it personally.
He had more important matters to attend to.
The defenses of Four Origin Planet were too weak.
This won’t do!
Ling Han’s group moved out, and began to roam the world, blending into the various Holy Lands, studying their Saint-level formations.

When one had reached such heights, even if he took a Formation Saint as Master, and even if the latter was willing to teach him Saint-level formations, that would be a matter of an unknown number of years later.
Thus, it was better to rely on oneself than on others.
Ling Han studied the formations of the various Holy Lands, turning it into his own understanding, improving his formation skills.
The present him was qualified to study Saint-level formations.

There was only one answer.
Imperial Clan!
“Which Imperial Clan’s Saint are you?” Ling Han asked.
He stared at the female Saint, not because she was beautiful, but because she was too young.
This flame of life had burned for over 10,000 years, at most.
In terms of a Saint’s lifespan of over a million years, this flame of life was truly inconceivably young.

Even if she had become a Saint in 10,000 years, this rate of advancement was still astonishingly fast, what more when the other had not just advanced into Saint Tier, but had rather become a Three Star Saint!
She had reached the level of a Three Star Saint at such a young age, and this naturally required a huge amount of cultivation resources.
More importantly, her natural talent was definitely incredible as well.
Otherwise, how could she have achieved such a feat just by relying on resources?
The female Saint hesitated for a moment, then replied, “I am the descendant of the Void Great Emperor, Wu Xingtong.”
‘The Void Great Emperor?’
Yi, was there a Void Imperial Clan in the universe?
Ling Han looked towards Brother Monkey, and then glanced at the Nine Mountains Saint.
Both of them shook their heads slightly at him, indicating that they had never heard of this.
This was strange.
Why had an Imperial Clan that no one had ever heard of suddenly appeared?
Was there really such a Great Emperor that existed in the universe?
If there really was such an Imperial Clan, what need was there for them to be like an assassin’s organization, living so secretly?
“Wu Yue, whom you killed, is one of my younger brothers,” Wu Xingtong said calmly.
“Although his cultivation level is higher than yours, and he was still killed by you, it is completely because he is too disappointing, but no matter what, he is still my younger brother!”
Ling Han clenched his fists, and said, “If you want to seek me out for revenge, fine, but why target innocent people?”

“Oh, you’re talking about these ants?” Wu Xingtong shook her head, “I thought that someone like you should only have the supreme peak of martial arts in his eyes, and would not care at all about the life and death of ordinary people.”
“You’re wrong,” Ling Han said darkly.
“So, you have to pay with your life.”
“Oh, you think… you can kill me?” Wu Xingtong couldn’t help but laugh in spite of herself, “I am a Three Star Saint.
At most, you would only be comparable to a One Star Saint.
In front of me, you can only flee for your life.”
There was indeed nothing wrong with this.
A Three Star Saint against a One Star Saint, that was an absolutely one-sided domination.
Even if the Nine Mountains Saint and Brother Monkey attacked together, they would still be suppressed.
Of course, the Nine Mountains Saint was still able to revive the Saint Tool.
This had been personally refined by the Nine Suns Saint.
Its might was astonishing.
Ling Han merely stared at Wu Xingtong, “It doesn’t matter if I can’t kill you now, but I swear that you will definitely die by my hands!”
He said these words very calmly, but there was a powerful confidence in his voice, as if he would definitely be able to do it once he said it.
Wu Xingtong’s heart involuntarily clenched, as if someone had squeezed it heavily.
She couldn’t help but pale slightly.
“Impossible!” “Impossible!”
“Is this Execution of Words1?
Although its might is extremely weak, it can only cause a slight effect on me.
It can’t hurt me at all.”
“But he only said a few words, and it made me feel a heart-wrenching pain.
This is definitely Execution of Words!”
“Heavens, the Regulations of Karma are supreme Regulations that only a Great Emperor can use!”
All of a sudden, her thoughts raced, but her expression had long since returned to normal.
“Since that is the case, I will kill you now, so that you will never have this chance again!” Wu Xingtong declared balefully.
This time, she was really filled with killing intent.
That was because this time, she truly felt threatened.
“Impossible!” the Nine Mountains Saint said coldly.
He had already activated the Saint Tool.
This caused the expressions of Wu Xingtong and the other male Saint to change drastically.
The Nine Suns Saint had once been known as the number one Saint.
In fact, he could even exchange blows with Ancestral King Lingtian before he became the Great Emperor.
Just how powerful was he?
Thus, the Saint Tool that he had left behind was naturally incredibly awesome.
“Ling Han, no matter how hard you try, you won’t be able to.
In this era, hehe, your fate has long since been decided.
You can only be a pitiful chess piece.” Wu Xingtong did not start the battle, but rather stretched out her hand to tear open the Void.
“I killed people, and left in such a grand manner, so you can only sit by and watch…
Hehe, what do you mean by the strongest king tier?
Bullsh*t!” As she said this, she stepped in.
“Haha!” The male Saint also chuckled coldly, and similarly tore a rip into space and left.
Ling Han didn’t move, and he simply hovered in the air.
Strength!
He was still not strong enough.
Otherwise, if anyone dared to offend him, he would have directly killed thme with a single palm strike.
And now?
He could only watch helplessly as the culprit left.
At first, he had thought that now that he possessed battle prowess of Saint-level, even the great Imperial Clans would not dare to fight him to the death.
Thus, he boldly reopened the Nine Suns Holy Land.
However, reality slapped him across the face.
There was no need for the Battle God Palace to fear this kind of threat, because no one knew where the Battle God Palace was.
Ling Han couldn’t find a place to exact revenge even if he wanted to.
And the Void Imperial Clan was even more mysterious.
They had hidden themselves behind the Battle God Palace for so many years.
Ling Han’s eyes were filled with fighting spirit.
He definitely had to increase his cultivation level as soon as possible.
This was a blow to him, but it was completely impossible to defeat him.
It would only make him work even harder.
Ling Han descended, and appeased the disciples beneath him.
As for dealing with the funeral matters of those disciples that had died tragically, there was naturally no need for him to do it personally.
He had more important matters to attend to.
The defenses of Four Origin Planet were too weak.
This won’t do!
Ling Han’s group moved out, and began to roam the world, blending into the various Holy Lands, studying their Saint-level formations.

When one had reached such heights, even if he took a Formation Saint as Master, and even if the latter was willing to teach him Saint-level formations, that would be a matter of an unknown number of years later.
Thus, it was better to rely on oneself than on others.
Ling Han studied the formations of the various Holy Lands, turning it into his own understanding, improving his formation skills.
The present him was qualified to study Saint-level formations.

chapters.title: Chapter 4605: Arranging Formations
paragraphs: Chapter 4605: Arranging Formations
Without a teacher, everything could only be comprehended by oneself.
Bit by bit, Ling Han was stealing the experience of his predecessors.
The formations that had been set up were the best teachers, but it was extremely difficult to figure them out.
Sometimes, Ling Han would even have to deliberately stimulate the formation to personally experience the profound secrets within, and the slightest changes.
Thankfully, he had the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower. Otherwise, some Saint-level formations had even reached the might of a nine-star Saint, and could easily kill him.
And just like that, Ling Han ran all over the universe. While studying formation techniques, he did not set aside the matter of cultivation, to capture Celestial Qi that could possibly appear.
A hundred years passed in a flash.
In the universe, a hundred years really wouldn’t make any ripples, and for elites, even if this bit of time wasn’t just a flash, it wasn’t much more than that.
When one had reached the level of Venerate Tier or Saint Tier, if they did not have astounding cultivation resources to spend, their progress would naturally be astonishingly slow.
If he wanted to increase his cultivation level by a minor level, it could easily take thousands or even tens of thousands of years.
Ling Han’s luck was very good. From time to time, he would be able to captureCelestial Qi. Thus, in these hundred years, he had almost reached the end of One Star Venerate Tier.
Furthermore, he had also concluded a pattern.
When he stimulated large amounts of Regulations, the chances of attracting Celestial Qi would increase greatly.
However, what made him the happiest was that he had finally created his own path in formations.
Accommodating the strengths of various formations, forming a single path of its own.
He returned to the Nine Suns Holy Land and began to set up the Great Protective Formation.
During these hundred years, the Nine Suns Holy Land was also preparing, storing a large amount of formation materials.
Thus, once Ling Han returned, he could begin.

This was a completely new formation, and it was completely set up according to Ling Han’s understanding. Thus, when it was set up, Brother Monkey, who had entered to test the waters, was almost blasted into smithereens.
Thankfully, Ling Han had given the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower to him.
“Er, it was a mistake, a mistake. I know what the problem is. I’ll fix it immediately.”
“Hahaha, again, again!”
“I promise there won’t be a next time.”
“Er, this time is not counted.”
After continuous adjustments, this Great Protective Formation was finally formed, and the adjustments were completed.
It could block the attack of a nine-star Saint, and could kill a seven-star Saint!
That was how awesome it was.

Though this formation was used to protect the Four Origin Planet, there were a great many formation foundations that had been set up on the nearby planets, because the energy provided by a single planet was far from enough to block the attack of a Saint, what more kill a Saint.
Thus, this formation also had a fatal flaw. As long as others went to destroy the formation foundations on other planets first, this formation would lose its might.
Thus, Ling Han made some adjustments, allowing these planets to intertwine and protect each other.
As the saying went, a slight change would affect the whole body. This was precisely the logic.
—If a single planet was unable to match the might of a Saint, then what if 100 of them join forces?
Thus, as long as there weren’t multiple planets being bombarded at the same time, this formation could be channeled continuously.
Ling Han was very satisfied. After making a few more adjustments, he began to cultivate in seclusion, attempting to break through to Two Star Venerate Tier.
Of course, this was no problem for him. It was only nine days, and he had already come out of seclusion.
Finally, Two Star Venerate Tier.
Ling Han tested out his own battle prowess. The increase was not as great as he had imagined. It only allowed him to fire out five more Seven Star Regulations with a single strike.
If he continued to increase his cultivation level at this rate, then increasing his cultivation level by two minor levels would be comparable to increasing Saint Tier by one star.
That was awesome enough.

This was because it was far too difficult for Saints to advance a single step. Just take a look at Brother Monkey. He was still a One Star Saint, and he had only just reached the middle stage of One Star Saint Tier. He was still a long way off reaching the late stage, and he was still a long way off from reaching the end of One Star Saint Tier.
However, the little azure dragon and the large black dog had both become Saints, while Chi Menghan had also cultivated to reach nine-star Venerate Tier, and was only a step away from Saint Tier.

Casting one’s gaze across the universe, the Golden Generation elites had most likely all become Saints by now. However, Ling Han was far too freakish, so much so that even the Imperial Son couldn’t bring himself to publicize his achievement of becoming a Saint.
—Just look at Baili Tian; he had still been pummeled by Ling Han.
Although Baili Tian had only been a Half-Saint at that time, according to the current rumors, Ling Han had defeated Baili Tian, who was a Saint.
Thus, if he didn’t cultivate to the level of a three-star or four-star Saint, how could he bring himself to come out and meet others?
At present, the universe was very peaceful, if the invasion of Yin souls could be set aside.
When it came to the invasion of Yin souls, the situation was incredibly grim, because another twelve Skeleton Saint Tools had appeared in the Netherworld, causing their advance to further speed up.
Ling Han knew that behind the momentary silence of the Imperial Clans, an explosion was brewing.
Once they had full confidence that they could kill him, then he was sure that the Imperial Clans would bare their fangs, and ruthlessly pounce towards him.

Thus, Ling Han was extremely careful. He spent very little time on the Four Origin Planet, and this caused the Imperial Clans to feel apprehensive. This was because destroying the Nine Suns Holy Land was completely meaningless. Ling Han was the key.
Inspired by the formation, Ling Han suddenly had an idea. Could he use the formation to capture Celestial Qi?

The reason why Celestial Qi would drop from a high-level dimension to a low-level dimension was very likely because it was attracted by Regulations. The higher the level of Regulations, the higher the success rate of attracting Celestial Qi. This was also why the Imperial Clans could easily capture Celestial Qi.
This was because they had the Imperial Weapon, the Great Emperor Formation, and all of these involved the highest level of Regulations.
Ling Han couldn’t use the Nine Star Regulations, but through formations, Eight Star Regulations wouldn’t be a problem.

He chose an abandoned planet that had no living beings. It was said that a nine-star Veneratehad attempted to break through to Saint Tier here. In the end, he failed. Not only had he died, but the vitality of this planet had also been completely exhausted.
And now? There was not a single person here, nor was there the slightest bit of life, which was just right for Ling Han to live in.
He kept trying, piling up the Eight Star Regulations, and then stood guard at the side, to see whether there was any Celestial Qi that had appeared because of the formation.
Don’t say, this was really effective.
However, this was completely incomparable to the efficiency of the Imperial Clans. There were also very few Eight Star Celestial Qi.
No matter what, it was a good thing to have some gains. Ling Han wouldn’t be picky.

His cultivation speed increased again, but this was naturally in comparison to his previous cultivation rate. If he wanted to reach the end of Two Star Venerate Tier, he would probably need around 40 years.
Originally, when the world was fine, Ling Han would not mind being slower. In any case, he would eventually be able to cultivate to Saint Tier.
After reaching the level of Saint, what was needed was to strengthen the holy flame, which had nothing to do with the Celestial Qi.
And strengthening the holy flame was related to the power of belief and the grasp of Regulations. Ling Han was very confident in each of these two factors.
Thus, all the dilemmas were concentrated here.
How was he supposed to pass through the fourth pinnacle level?

As long as he advanced into Saint Tier, with the almost endless number of creatures in the dimensions in Ling Han’s body, the power of belief he reaped would be enough to make all the Saints in the universe kneel.
Er, he didn’t want to think about something so far ahead.

Not long after, the empress, Hu Niu, Chi Menghan, Song Lan and the other women also arrived. They accompanied Ling Han and lived the most ordinary life. There were no outsiders here, and it was just the few of them.
Life was extremely mundane, and after 40 years, Ling Han finally cultivated to the end of Two Stars.

chapters.title: Chapter 4606: Ancestral King City
paragraphs: Chapter 4606: Ancestral King City
The threshold of Three Stars was still not difficult at all for Ling Han. He easily crossed it.
Sure enough, after reaching Three Star Venerate Tier, he could unleash as many as 30 Regulations with a single strike, increasing the number further by 5 additional Regulations.

What depressed Ling Han was the fact that he seemed to have unleashed his full potential, because even if he prepared and accumulated power, he would not be able to increase the number of Regulations.
His full-power attack was this kind of strength, and so was the burst of strength after accumulating power for a period of time.
Er… alright.
After coming out of seclusion, Ling Han made some detailed queries about the current situation.

Because of the invasion of the Yin souls, the various great forces all set aside their old enmity, and began to cooperate sincerely. One after another, academies of allied forces were established, and they did their best to nurture the younger generation, hoping that more elites would emerge.

Thus, there would be some martial arts competitions from time to time. Firstly, it was to nurture the unyielding character of the younger generation, and increase their actual battle prowess, and secondly, it was also to bestow more rewards, so that they could grow faster.
This could not be given for free. Only when there was competition, would it form a good atmosphere for cultivation, wherein everyone would be pursuing to surpass their peers.

The Nine Suns Holy Land also participated and organized many such martial arts competitions. Of course, though Ling Han was young, he definitely couldn’t participate. F***, why would an elite with Saint-level battle prowess like you participate?
To strike a blow to their pride?
Furthermore, what should be used to reward him?
None of this could attract Ling Han’s attention. He turned his attention to the Imperial Clans.
As expected, it wasn’t that the Imperial Clans didn’t make a move.
They had actually built an Ancestral King City.
What was it for?

They all took out an old item that the Great Emperor of their clan had used years ago. Though many, many years had passed, the Great Emperor was too strong, and his aura did not disperse for a very long time.
Thus, when these old items were placed together, they actually resonated with each other, forming a powerful Imperial Might.

Bathing in this kind of imperial aura, it was natural that there would be people who would feel their hearts tremble in fear, and lose the will to improve from now onwards, but those that could persevere would have astonishing improvement, and their future prospects would be limitless.

In the past, it would have been impossible for such sincere cooperation to appear, but the pressure exerted by the Netherworld was really too great, so the Imperial Clans could only set everything else aside.

Because of this, the Donglin Imperial Clan especially sent an invitation to Ling Han, telling him to go to the Ancestral King City as well. Even if he was still a Venerate, going would definitely be beneficial.

Previously, Ling Han had been on this abandoned planet all this while, so he had not received any notice. It was only now that he took the initiative to contact the Nine Suns Holy Land, and only then did he receive the news.
Then let’s go and take a look.

Because the empress and Hu Niu hadn’t broken through to Saint Tier yet, and Song Lan was still far from reaching Saint Tier, Ling Han had the three of them stay behind to guard the formation. If there was Celestial Qi, they would capture it. In any case, they only needed to send out a spiritual body, and there was no need for the main body to keep an eye on it all day.
Ling Han set off with Chi Menghan. Now, only Chi Menghan had broken through to Saint Tier among the women. Thus, this time, only Chi Menghan was qualified to go to the Ancestral King City.
Moreover, wasn’t the reason why the Donglin Imperial Clan sent an invitation to Ling Han also because of Chi Menghan?
Brother Monkey and the others would go themselves, so there was no need for Ling Han to worry.
The two of them tore a rip into space, and headed towards the Ancestral King City. That was the Heavenly Mother Planet, which was located far away.

It was said that a Great Emperor had once appeared on the Heavenly Mother Planet, but this Great Emperor streaked through the era like a shooting star, and did not leave behind any descendants or heirs.
And a great deal of history had been annihilated in the passage of time. Thus, no one knew what this Great Emperor’s title was.
However, there was really a person known as the Void Great Emperor.

Ling Han had the Donglin Imperial Clan search on his behalf. After flipping through a great many ancient records, it was confirmed that this Ancestral King had indeed existed. However, after this Ancestral King died, the entire Void Imperial Clan strangely disappeared.
There were gaps in history, so the Void Imperial Clan was erased from history.
If it weren’t for the fact that the Donglin Imperial Clan had deliberately flipped through ancient records, this would have been an eternal mystery.

Ling Han was astonished. Yang Yihuan, Di Wuji, and the others were most likely the sons of Great Emperors. They had been sealed by the Great Emperors until this generation—although they had occasionally appeared during this time, they had only walked the Imperial Path and recultivated their cultivation level.
However, in this lifetime, they all released the restrictions on their cultivation level, looking like they were going to fight for the position of Emperor in this era.
This made Ling Han feel curious. Which era couldn’t it be? Why did it have to be in this era?
Moreover, the Imperial Clan that had been living in seclusion for countless years had also suddenly appeared. It was clear that they too wanted to participate in this great era.
Just what was so special about this era?
With this question in mind, Ling Han arrived at the Heavenly Mother Planet.
The Ancestral King City was located in the extreme south of the Heavenly Mother Planet, and was not too far away.

Ling Han wasn’t in a hurry to advance. Instead, he first set up a formation, connecting the hundreds of nearby planets. There were also seven suns among them, and this could bestow enough power on the formation, capable of posing a threat to Five-Star Saints.

It could not be helped. There was not enough time, and not enough ingredients. Furthermore, he could not possibly set it up with great fanfare. Being able to attain such might was already awesome enough.
After doing all this, Ling Han and Chi Menghan set out towards the Ancestral King City.
This was a new city that had just been built not too long ago. However, since it had been built by the great Imperial Clans, it was completed in a short few months.
From afar, this great city was exuding a dazzling light, grand and majestic.
The Imperial Might permeated through the air, causing one to feel suffocated.
They hadn’t even entered the city yet!

If they barged in forcefully, then as long as their divine sense was not strong enough, their willpower would definitely be forcefully erased by the Imperial Might, and they would become a walking corpse.

However, many people clearly knew that they would not have hopes of becoming Emperor, yet yearned to become stronger. Thus, they had also come here. However, they did not enter into the city, but rather set up camp nearby, anticipating what great fortune they would be able to obtain.
Thus, the great city was majestic, grand and imposing, but there were tents everywhere outside the city. A large number of residences had appeared, appearing very chaotic.

There were all kinds of people here. Those with the highest cultivation level had even reached the Venerate Tier, hoping that Imperial Might could help them take that last step. There were also those who had just stepped onto the Celestial Path, and were purely here to admire it.
“Greetings! Greetings!” Ling Han and Chi Menghan were surveying the surroundings, and they didn’t expect someone to approach them in such a sneaky manner.
Ling Han was astonished. He and Chi Menghan had clearly changed their appearances, yet they had still been discovered at the first instant?
But looking at this person… he was very ordinary. He had just advanced into the Core Formation Tier.
“Guys, I have two tickets for the ceremony here. Are you interested?” the man asked mysteriously. He even deliberately looked around, as if he wanted to confirm that no one was eavesdropping.
Oh, so their disguises had not collapsed.
Ling Han breathed a sigh of relief. Every time he disguised himself, his identity would be quickly exposed, which made him a little troubled.
