Yi?
Chi Menghan couldn’t help but turn around to look at Ling Han. She smiled, and the corners of her lips curled up. What she meant was, ‘Why didn’t I know that you were going to lecture on Dao?’
F***, I don’t know either.
Ling Han shook his head with a smile.

sentences.text: Chapter 4606: Ancestral King City
The threshold of Three Stars was still not difficult at all for Ling Han.
He easily crossed it.
Sure enough, after reaching Three Star Venerate Tier, he could unleash as many as 30 Regulations with a single strike, increasing the number further by 5 additional Regulations.

What depressed Ling Han was the fact that he seemed to have unleashed his full potential, because even if he prepared and accumulated power, he would not be able to increase the number of Regulations.
His full-power attack was this kind of strength, and so was the burst of strength after accumulating power for a period of time.
Er… alright.
After coming out of seclusion, Ling Han made some detailed queries about the current situation.
Because of the invasion of the Yin souls, the various great forces all set aside their old enmity, and began to cooperate sincerely.
One after another, academies of allied forces were established, and they did their best to nurture the younger generation, hoping that more elites would emerge.
Thus, there would be some martial arts competitions from time to time.

Firstly, it was to nurture the unyielding character of the younger generation, and increase their actual battle prowess, and secondly, it was also to bestow more rewards, so that they could grow faster.
This could not be given for free.
Only when there was competition, would it form a good atmosphere for cultivation, wherein everyone would be pursuing to surpass their peers.
The Nine Suns Holy Land also participated and organized many such martial arts competitions.
Of course, though Ling Han was young, he definitely couldn’t participate.
F***, why would an elite with Saint-level battle prowess like you participate?
To strike a blow to their pride?
Furthermore, what should be used to reward him?
None of this could attract Ling Han’s attention.
He turned his attention to the Imperial Clans.
As expected, it wasn’t that the Imperial Clans didn’t make a move.
They had actually built an Ancestral King City.
What was it for?
They all took out an old item that the Great Emperor of their clan had used years ago.
Though many, many years had passed, the Great Emperor was too strong, and his aura did not disperse for a very long time.
Thus, when these old items were placed together, they actually resonated with each other, forming a powerful Imperial Might.

Bathing in this kind of imperial aura, it was natural that there would be people who would feel their hearts tremble in fear, and lose the will to improve from now onwards, but those that could persevere would have astonishing improvement, and their future prospects would be limitless.

In the past, it would have been impossible for such sincere cooperation to appear, but the pressure exerted by the Netherworld was really too great, so the Imperial Clans could only set everything else aside.
Because of this, the Donglin Imperial Clan especially sent an invitation to Ling Han, telling him to go to the Ancestral King City as well.
Even if he was still a Venerate, going would definitely be beneficial.
Previously, Ling Han had been on this abandoned planet all this while, so he had not received any notice.
It was only now that he took the initiative to contact the Nine Suns Holy Land, and only then did he receive the news.
Then let’s go and take a look.
Because the empress and Hu Niu hadn’t broken through to Saint Tier yet, and Song Lan was still far from reaching Saint Tier, Ling Han had the three of them stay behind to guard the formation.
If there was Celestial Qi, they would capture it.
In any case, they only needed to send out a spiritual body, and there was no need for the main body to keep an eye on it all day.
Ling Han set off with Chi Menghan.
Now, only Chi Menghan had broken through to Saint Tier among the women.
Thus, this time, only Chi Menghan was qualified to go to the Ancestral King City.
Moreover, wasn’t the reason why the Donglin Imperial Clan sent an invitation to Ling Han also because of Chi Menghan?
Brother Monkey and the others would go themselves, so there was no need for Ling Han to worry.
The two of them tore a rip into space, and headed towards the Ancestral King City.
That was the Heavenly Mother Planet, which was located far away.

It was said that a Great Emperor had once appeared on the Heavenly Mother Planet, but this Great Emperor streaked through the era like a shooting star, and did not leave behind any descendants or heirs.
And a great deal of history had been annihilated in the passage of time.
Thus, no one knew what this Great Emperor’s title was.
However, there was really a person known as the Void Great Emperor.
Ling Han had the Donglin Imperial Clan search on his behalf.
After flipping through a great many ancient records, it was confirmed that this Ancestral King had indeed existed.
However, after this Ancestral King died, the entire Void Imperial Clan strangely disappeared.
There were gaps in history, so the Void Imperial Clan was erased from history.
If it weren’t for the fact that the Donglin Imperial Clan had deliberately flipped through ancient records, this would have been an eternal mystery.
Ling Han was astonished.
Yang Yihuan, Di Wuji, and the others were most likely the sons of Great Emperors.

They had been sealed by the Great Emperors until this generation—although they had occasionally appeared during this time, they had only walked the Imperial Path and recultivated their cultivation level.
However, in this lifetime, they all released the restrictions on their cultivation level, looking like they were going to fight for the position of Emperor in this era.
This made Ling Han feel curious.
Which era couldn’t it be?
Why did it have to be in this era?
Moreover, the Imperial Clan that had been living in seclusion for countless years had also suddenly appeared.
It was clear that they too wanted to participate in this great era.
Just what was so special about this era?
With this question in mind, Ling Han arrived at the Heavenly Mother Planet.
The Ancestral King City was located in the extreme south of the Heavenly Mother Planet, and was not too far away.
Ling Han wasn’t in a hurry to advance.
Instead, he first set up a formation, connecting the hundreds of nearby planets.
There were also seven suns among them, and this could bestow enough power on the formation, capable of posing a threat to Five-Star Saints.
It could not be helped.
There was not enough time, and not enough ingredients.
Furthermore, he could not possibly set it up with great fanfare.
Being able to attain such might was already awesome enough.
After doing all this, Ling Han and Chi Menghan set out towards the Ancestral King City.
This was a new city that had just been built not too long ago.
However, since it had been built by the great Imperial Clans, it was completed in a short few months.
From afar, this great city was exuding a dazzling light, grand and majestic.
The Imperial Might permeated through the air, causing one to feel suffocated.
They hadn’t even entered the city yet!

If they barged in forcefully, then as long as their divine sense was not strong enough, their willpower would definitely be forcefully erased by the Imperial Might, and they would become a walking corpse.
However, many people clearly knew that they would not have hopes of becoming Emperor, yet yearned to become stronger.
Thus, they had also come here.
However, they did not enter into the city, but rather set up camp nearby, anticipating what great fortune they would be able to obtain.
Thus, the great city was majestic, grand and imposing, but there were tents everywhere outside the city.
A large number of residences had appeared, appearing very chaotic.
There were all kinds of people here.
Those with the highest cultivation level had even reached the Venerate Tier, hoping that Imperial Might could help them take that last step.
There were also those who had just stepped onto the Celestial Path, and were purely here to admire it.
“Greetings!
Greetings!” Ling Han and Chi Menghan were surveying the surroundings, and they didn’t expect someone to approach them in such a sneaky manner.
Ling Han was astonished.
He and Chi Menghan had clearly changed their appearances, yet they had still been discovered at the first instant?
But looking at this person… he was very ordinary.
He had just advanced into the Core Formation Tier.
“Guys, I have two tickets for the ceremony here.
Are you interested?” the man asked mysteriously.
He even deliberately looked around, as if he wanted to confirm that no one was eavesdropping.
Oh, so their disguises had not collapsed.
Ling Han breathed a sigh of relief.
Every time he disguised himself, his identity would be quickly exposed, which made him a little troubled.
“What ceremony tickets?” he asked.
The man confirmed that there was no one around to listen, then said quietly, “Lord Ling Han’s lecture on Dao!”
Yi?
Chi Menghan couldn’t help but turn around to look at Ling Han.
She smiled, and the corners of her lips curled up.
What she meant was, ‘Why didn’t I know that you were going to lecture on Dao?’
F***, I don’t know either.
Ling Han shook his head with a smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 4607: Ostentatious deception
paragraphs: Chapter 4607: Ostentatious deception
The matter was very obvious. Someone was impersonating Ling Han, and swindling others.
A smile appeared on Ling Han’s face, and he said, “It’s actually Ling Han? Fine, fine, fine. I want it! I want it!”

The man immediately revealed a proud expression, as if he had long since expected Ling Han’s reaction. He revealed an arrogant expression, “Though Lord Ling Han never charges for his lectures, this is a ticket that I have spent a great many days queuing up to get.”
“Tell me, how much?” Ling Han said, acting rich and imposing.
He had caught a fat sheep.
The man thought for a moment. The price that had originally been decided must be too low.
“Lord Ling Han doesn’t lecture on Dao every day. Instead, it’s because he empathizes with people like us who were born in poverty that he deliberately organized a lecture,” he first emphasized.
What he meant was, even though I have obtained it for free, this opportunity is really too rare. If I give it up to you, I would lose this once in a thousand years opportunity.
Ling Han chuckled and said, “Money isn’t a problem.”
This would make things easier.
“1, 10,000 Dao Stones!” the man gritted his teeth and said loudly.
Judging by his expression, it seemed like this price was really too low.
However, he himself knew that he had initially planned to only demand a thousand Dao Stones.
This time, it had increased tenfold, causing his heart to beat wildly.
Ling Han’s expression instantly darkened, as if he was extremely displeased.
Not good, the price was too high.
‘Sigh, even if he’s a fat sheep, I can’t treat others like fools,’ the man immediately thought.
He was just about to adjust the price, when he saw that Ling Han had already spoken.
“Only 10,000 Dao Stones? Are you looking down on Lord Ling Han?” Ling Han said loudly, his face filled with anger.
Yi?
The man couldn’t help but stare in dumbfounded shock. How could this be?
Are you f****** stupid?
“Then… twenty thousand?” he asked weakly.𝐟𝗿𝐞𝚎𝚠𝐞𝚋𝕟𝐨𝚟𝐞𝕝.𝕔𝕠𝚖
Ling Han glared at him fiercely.
“Thirty, thirty thousand!” That man mustered up his courage.
Pa, Ling Han slapped him across the face, “You actually dare to repeatedly insult Lord Ling Han?”
The man was dumbfounded. F***, he could still be beaten like this?
Was this the strangest reason for him to be beaten in this lifetime?
However, he should have been very angry, but why was there an indescribable chill at the bottom of his heart, suppressing him deeply, so that he could not feel the slightest bit of anger?
“100,000?” He looked at Ling Han, almost about to cry.
“That’s not right!” Ling Han slapped him again, causing the man to spin a few times on the spot.
Wrong again?
The man felt extremely aggrieved. He had never seen such a person before. Why was he so strange?
“Then how much do you think is suitable?” he asked.
Ling Han chuckled and said, “Lord Ling Han’s lecture on Dao is priceless!”
Priceless?
Then how was he supposed to sell it?
The man was speechless, and looked dumbly at Ling Han.
“It’s a priceless item. No matter how much your selling price is, it’s still a kind of blasphemy, understand?” Ling Han said righteously.
Er… the man suddenly understood.
After so much commotion, he hadn’t come across a fat sheep. Instead, he had come across a miser.
However, Ling Han had slapped him twice, and added with the mysterious chill in his heart, he didn’t dare to resist.
“I was wrong. These two tickets are for you,” he said honestly.
“En, that’s more like it.” Ling Han nodded, “Money isn’t a problem, the problem is I don’t have money!”
When these words fell, the man was almost angered to death, but a coldness rose up in his body, and he did not dare make a move.
He was curious. In the past, he had also been a ruthless person. Why did he not even have the courage to fight now?
As he thought this, he still obediently took out two tickets, and handed them over to Ling Han.
He wanted to leave, yet was stopped by Ling Han.
“You, what other commands do you have?” he asked cautiously. For some reason, a voice in his heart told him that he definitely could not offend this person in front of him.
This was his instinct. After so long, this had managed to save his life a great many times.
Hence, he also trusted this kind of instinct very much.
Ling Han shook his head, looking at him like he was an idiot.
“Location, pig!”
“Oh, oh, oh.” The man hurriedly nodded, and handed over the address.
Then, he carefully left. After taking a few steps, he would turn around, fearing that Ling Han would call out to him again, so that he could respond at the first instant.
After the man left, Chi Menghan couldn’t help but ask with a smile, “Is this how you usually tease people?”
“I have nothing else to do anyway,” Ling Han said with a smile.
Chi Menghan only felt that this was very amusing. Among Baili Tian and the other Imperial Sons, which one of them wasn’t extremely proud? Were any of them as interesting as Ling Han?
If they had encountered such a situation, they would definitely move to kill the other person.
Though Ling Han had always been known as the Imperial Son Killer, and the Great Demon, he was definitely not the kind of person to fuss over such trivial matters.
“Let’s go. I have to go and see this Lord Ling Han,” Ling Han said with a smile.
“M-hm.” Chi Menghan nodded.
The two of them followed this address, and saw that there had originally been an empty space here, but now, four walls had been set up with cloth, forming an open-air “place of enlightenment”.
Er, this was the place where Lord “Ling Han” lectured on Dao?
There was also a doorway here, and there were two people standing guard.
Ling Han and Chi Menghan walked over, and after handing over their tickets, they were allowed to pass.
After entering, they discovered that there were already many people seated on the ground, and all of them had heated gazes.
It could be imagined that those who would fall for it were definitely Ling Han’s blind admirers, and that was why they lacked basic judgement.

Ling Han and Chi Menghan also found a place to sit down. They had both changed their appearances, so they naturally didn’t need to worry about being recognized. However, it was natural instinct for anyone to admire beauty. Although Chi Menghan had changed her appearance, she was still extremely beautiful.
Thus, she immediately attracted the attention of many people.

However, though she had restrained the aura of a Saint, she was still an existence that stood at the apex of this world, after all. She had an intimidating aura, and who would really dare to mess around?

The two of them waited quietly. Time slowly passed, and a few more people came from behind. This place was more or less filled to the brim. Finally, a man who seemed to be the person-in-charge walked out.
“Everyone, you’ve all waited!” he said loudly. “So, without wasting words, let us immediately invite our Lord Ling Han!”
Instantly, thunderous applause rang out. Everyone was clapping crazily.
Tsk, so many hardcore admirers.
Chi Menghan glanced at Ling Han, her eyes filled with admiration. This was the man she had chosen. He was interesting, had a conscience, and was also incredibly powerful.
Xiu, a person appeared out of thin air, standing proudly.
“Yi?” A hint of surprise appeared on both Ling Han and Chi Menghan’s faces, because this person really looked like Ling Han.
En, he could no longer be described as similar, but exactly the same.
—To cultivators, it was extremely simple to change their appearance, so disguising themselves as others was naturally a piece of cake.
He had really put in a lot of effort.
A sliver of killing intent appeared on Ling Han’s face. If this “Ling Han” swindled too many people, or even deceived naive young girls, then he would definitely commit murder today.

chapters.title: Chapter 4608: Fake Ling Han
paragraphs: Chapter 4608: Fake Ling Han
On the platform, the fake Ling Han began to lecture on Dao.
Hearing his nonsense, both Ling Han and Chi Menghan looked surprised.
That was because though this person boasted very much, there were still some things that he said that were very logical, and could give others inspiration.
Thus, though he was swindling others, it did not mean that he did not have the slightest ability.
After talking for half a day, the fake Ling Han announced the end of this lecture.
Everyone was reluctant to part with him, and tried their best to persuade him to stay, so that he could talk for a while longer.
“Alright, since everyone is so cordial,” the fake Ling Han said. “I was just planning to take in two disciples, so I wanted to see if there was anyone suitable among you.”
When these words fell, everyone’s eyes instantly shone with a peculiar light.

The fake Ling Han began to walk around in the crowd, talking to people as if he was trying to understand their backgrounds. However, Ling Han and Chi Menghan could see very clearly that the people this guy was talking to were mostly females, and beautiful females at that.
Not long after, he took in a disciple — of course, it was a female disciple.
Then, the fake Ling Han turned around, and appeared in front of Ling Han and Chi Menghan.
When he saw Chi Menghan, the fake Ling Han instantly looked stunned. After a long while, he didn’t retract his gaze, and asked in a perverted voice, “What’s your name?”
Chi Menghan didn’t reply. Instead,s he asked, “What I like most is Lord Ling Han barging into the Donglin Imperial Clan to snatch bride! I wonder if I can meet Celestial Maiden Chi?”
It was quite shameless of her to call herself a celestial maiden.
Ling Han thought internally. Of course, he could not say this out loud. Otherwise, he would definitely have to sleep on his own tonight.

The fake Ling Han was unhurried, and said, “Menghan has something to do, so you definitely won’t be able to see her for the time being. However, if you take me as master, you’ll have many more chances in the future.”
“Really?” Chi Menghan deliberately revealed an excited expression.
“Of course, it’s real.” The fake Ling Han couldn’t help but feel aroused. He stretched out a hand to grab Chi Menghan’s hand.
However, when he touched it, he gritted his teeth. Why was this hand not as delicate and smooth as he had imagined?
Upon another look, this was Ling Han’s hand!
He hurriedly let go. He had touched a man’s hand. Just thinking about it made him feel disgusted.
“I’m not talking to you yet, step aside!” he shouted at Ling Han.
Ling Han smiled and said, “I also have some questions that I want to ask. I’m very interested in the details of Ling Han snatching the bride.”𝐟𝚛𝕖𝚎𝕨𝗲𝐛𝚗𝐨𝐯𝐞𝕝.𝐜𝗼𝗺

“That’s right, that’s right,” the people around them all said. To the general public, something like snatching a bride was something that was most worth talking about. It was something that could be talked about again and again.

“Alright, since everyone is so curious, I’ll relate it again,” the fake Ling Han said with a smile. He began to talk about the story of how “he” had barged into the Donglin Imperial Clan and battled Baili Tian to snatch the bride.
However, he was not a person who had experienced it personally, after all. Perhaps, he had watched it through the livestream of Galaxy Network, so flaws would ultimately be revealed in the details.
Ling Han and Chi Menghan would point out from time to time, yet the fake Ling Han was completely unconcerned, directly rebuking them for remembering wrongly.
When he finished speaking, everyone applauded. No matter how many times they heard this kind of story of a hero rescuing a beauty, they would not get tired of it.

Furthermore, in order to portray the gentle side of Ling Han, he had added a great many words of love. These were all words that Ling Han had “quietly” said to Chi Menghan, and had not been broadcasted live by Galaxy Network.
This naturally satisfied everyone’s curiosity greatly, and they all revealed satisfied expressions.
Chi Menghan couldn’t help but chuckle. She turned to Ling Han and asked, “Why don’t I remember you saying this to me?”
“Er, I don’t remember either.” Ling Han shook his head.
Chi Menghan looked at the fake Ling Han again, and said, “When did you become my husband? Why didn’t I know?”
Yi, what was the meaning of this?
With a thought from Chi Menghan, her appearance immediately changed, and she returned to her original appearance.
“Chi, Chi Menghan!”
“It’s Fairy Chi, Celestial maiden Chi!”
“It really is her!”
Everyone was exclaiming in shock. Following Chi Menghan’s transformation, as well as her vague Saint-level aura, everyone believed her from the bottom of their hearts.
Yi, that was strange.
If this was Chi Menghan, then why was she with an unfamiliar man? Moreover, “Ling Han” actually didn’t recognize her?
The fake Ling Han was also taken aback. He had not thought that he would actually encounter the main character through his ostentatious deception.
He laughed, “I woke up early in the morning, so I forgot to take a dump. Let me excuse myself first.”
“Hold it right there!” Chi Menghan chided. “You still haven’t given me an explanation!”
He could impersonate anyone, but to dare impersonate her man, that was definitely not allowed.
Boom! She unleashed the aura of a Saint as she charged at the fake Ling Han.
Even though it was only an aura, just how powerful was a Saint? It was guaranteed that under the barrage of this aura, the majority of Venerates would have to kneel.
However, the scene that followed gave both Ling Han and Chi Menghan a shock.

chapters.title: Chapter 4609: Bet a galaxy
paragraphs: Chapter 4609: Bet a galaxy
“Let’s battle in the sky.” Ling Han led the way and flew into the sky.

The fake Ling Han, meanwhile, was neither too fast nor too slow. He too rose into the air. He looked at Ling Han, and showed a hint of pride, “With the body of a Venerate, capable of standing against a Saint, you are indeed extraordinary.”
“I don’t want to kill such a prodigy either!”
“I’ll give you a chance. Submit to me, and I can spare your life.”
Ling Han couldn’t help but laugh in spite of himself, “You really know how to daydream.”
His strength had already reached the Saint Tier, and this signified that even a Nine-Star Saint wouldn’t be able to stop him if he wanted to flee.
Thus, the Imperial Clans were extremely wary of him. They didn’t fart even when they saw the Nine Suns Holy Land start up again.
Because if they were unable to kill Ling Han, that would pose an incredibly great threat to themselves.

Unless they were also very ruffian, and no longer cared about the juniors of the Imperial Clan, or had made up their minds to nest in the imperial formation for the rest of their lives, right until Ling Han died of old age.
More importantly, Ling Han had a high chance of becoming Emperor, so what if they hid in the imperial formation?
Xiu, xiu, xiu! At this moment, the Imperial Sons of the Ancestral King City all flew out. They naturally sensed the commotion outside, and would definitely come out to check on the situation.
One of them was Ling Han, and anyone could recognize him with a single glance. However, who was the other?
They didn’t know this person at all.
However, this person was definitely young. At most, he was only over 10,000 years old. He didn’t match any of the current Saints.
“Brother, you’re here!” Brother Monkey also appeared. Beside him were the large black dog and the little azure dragon.
Ling Han smiled and said, “I’m here.”
In that one instant, the Imperial Sons all knew what had happened.
Saints were naturally sensitive to auras. The person who had attacked was the fake Ling Han, and it could not be any more obvious.

All of a sudden, they were all hostile towards this person. He dared to make a move outside the Ancestral King City, and he possessed a Saint-level power at that. He did not have any wariness of this place being outside Ancestral King City at all. This could be seen as a provocation to the Imperial Clans.
Faced with so many Saint-level Imperial Sons, the fake Ling Han was completely unconcerned. He even stretched out a hand to scratch his ear, “Yo, so many people have come.”
“Who are you?” Yan Anming of the Golden Generation asked, his expression baleful and menacing.
Originally, Ling Han’s enemy would be their friend, but you publicly used Saint-level power outside the Ancestral King City. That was going too far.
The fake Ling Han smiled faintly, “My name is Lu Xun.”
Yi, that was it?
Lu Xun? Did anyone know who he was?
“Who cares if you’re Lu Xun or Hai Xun1? Eat my punch first!” Ling Han charged over, throwing a punch.
Boom, this was a battle in space, so Ling Han naturally had no reservations.
Lu Xun smiled faintly, and placed one right hand behind his back. He merely used his left hand to exchange blows with Ling Han.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
The two of them battled fiercely. Lu Xun was calm and composed, appearing to be at ease.
“A Three Star Saint!” Everyone couldn’t help but exclaim in shock.
He was far too powerful! He was actually a Three Star Saint!

Ling Han was indeed freakish. He was clearly only a Three Star Venerate, but his abilities were practically comparable to a Two Star Saint. However, compared with a Three Star Saint, whether it was power or Regulations, he was not just a little bit weaker.
Moreover, Lu Xun could unleash four Eight Star Regulations with a single strike. This was a blatant advantage over Ling Han.
Thus, though he had only used one hand, he had easily blocked Ling Han’s attacks. In fact, he had even gotten the upper hand.
Of course, no one would underestimate Ling Han because of this.
A Three Star Venerate possessed the battle prowess of a Two Star Saint; wasn’t that awesome enough?
Really, if this guy had grown to become a nine-star Venerate, he would really be able to compete with a four-star or five-star Saint.
It should be known that how many Saints were there in this world? And how many of them were high-level Saints?
—If Ling Han became a nine-star Venerate, then the majority of Saints would definitely be no match for him.
Thinking about it this way, just how terrifying was it?
It should be known that it was considerably easier for Venerates to advance one minor level. After all, aside from comprehension of Heavenly Dao, they only needed Celestial Qi, but what about Saints?
Taking a step further was as difficult as ascending the heavens.
Just look, even if it was Brother Monkey, Baili Tian, Yan Anming, and the other young king tiers who had been the first to advance into Saint Tier, which of them had now advanced into Two Stars?
Not even one.
Ling Han should be the strongest of the younger generation.
But the problem here was, another young king tier had actually appeared. He was actually a Three Star Saint!
Hiss, how terrifying.
Where had he popped out from?
The two of them battled fiercely. Ling Han unleashed his full battle prowess, but the gap in strength was too wide. In the end, he was still unable to suppress the other.
He was just about to channel a formation, when he did not expect Lu Xun to send him backwards with a single palm strike, “It’s about time to get down to business.”
‘Business?’
Ling Han did not rush to make a move. He was also curious about Lu Xun’s origins, though he had already guessed half of it.
Lu Xun smiled faintly, and said, “Since everyone is here, you may all come out.”
Yi, who was he talking to?
Right at this moment, multiple figures tore a rip into the Void and appeared.
Yang Yihuan, Feng Miaoling, He Luo, Di Wuji, Tong Ming… Wu Xingtong!
Hiss!
Realization dawned on all the Imperial Sons. These people represented the Netherworld.
It was very strange. Why would living people cooperate with Yin souls? Furthermore, how did they cooperate?
The Living Realm and Netherworld were the most fundamental opposites.

No matter how great the conflict between the Imperial Clans and Ling Han was, after Ling Han achieved Dao, even if they would seek revenge, it was basically impossible for the entire clan to be eliminated.
Every injustice had its perpetrator, and every debt had its debtor. It was impossible that there were no good people in the whole clan.
Would those who could become Emperor not have the slightest tolerance?
However, Yin souls were different.
Once the Netherworld occupied the Living Realm, all of the living creatures would be done for.𝙧𝙚𝙚𝔀𝒆𝓫𝓷𝙤𝓿𝒆𝙡.𝒄𝙤𝓶
The environment of the Netherworld was completely unsuitable for living people to live in. This was the most fundamental opposing environment, and there was absolutely no space for harmony.
Thus, though the Imperial Sons hated Ling Han to death, they still had to unite against the enemy at this moment.
Of course, they were also very confused. Yin and Yang were clearly on opposing sides, so why would Yang Yihuan and the others cooperate with the Netherworld?

Yang Yihuan, Feng Miaoling, He Luo, and the others had already become Saints. However, they were only One Star Saints at this moment. Di Wuji and Tong Ming were Two Star Saints, and only Lu Xun and Wu Xingtong had reached the level of Three Star Saint. White, red, and orange-colored holy flames pulsated in their minds, and could be seen clearly.
Looking at the Golden Generation’s holy flames, all of which were white in color, the gulf between them was quite large.
Lu Xun crossed his arms behind his back, and said to all the Imperial Sons, “I have come today to make a bet with you.”

“What are we betting on?” Yan Anming spoke up on behalf of all the Imperial Sons. Both he and Baili Tian were members of the Golden Generation that had been the first to advance into Saint Tier. Now that Baili Tian was not here, he naturally answered on behalf of the other Imperial Sons.
Lu Xun broke into a grin, “We are betting a galaxy.”
“If you win a single battle, we can return one of the galaxies that we have conquered to you. If you lose a single battle, then withdraw your defenses, and allow an entire galaxy to belong to us.”
What a huge gamble!
A galaxy, not a planet.
Yan Anming immediately shook his head, saying, “There are already two-star or even three-star Saints among you. What’s the worth in competing?”
Those that could advance into Saint Tier, which one of them was not a prodigy among prodigies?

Even the Golden Generation didn’t have much confidence in surpassing their cultivation level to challenge someone stronger than them. Moreover, Lu Xun and the others were most likely the sons of the ancient Great Emperors. Thus, their natural talent was no weaker than theirs.
Then wouldn’t it be a definite loss?

chapters.title: Chapter 4610: Counter Challenge
paragraphs: Chapter 4610: Counter Challenge
Lu Xun smiled slightly, “Don’t worry. If we really fight, we will all suppress our cultivation level, and guarantee a battle of equal cultivation levels.”
“How about it? Do you dare to take the gamble?”
With such words, how could the Imperial Sons not accept?
If they didn’t dare to battle at the same cultivation level, then how could they still have the face to attempt breaking through to become Emperor?
What Great Emperor would be so cowardly?
“Let’s make the bet!” A voice rang out from the Heavenly Mother Planet below, booming loudly and incredibly loud.
Yang Yihuan and the others all wore solemn expressions.
A Seven Star Saint, at least!

They were more powerful than ordinary Saints, yet their battle prowess could only surpass one or two stars at most. If there was a difference of four stars, they wouldn’t be able to match the opponent even if they teamed up. Instead, they would have to flee.
The Imperial Sons all knew that this was a Saint that was overseer of the Imperial Clans. Furthermore, he was not a seven-star Saint, but rather an eight-star Saint.
Xuan Huo Saint, belonging to Red Lotus Imperial Clan.
Since this Saint had already agreed, there was naturally nothing to be afraid of.
“All right, let’s make the bet.” Yan Dongming nodded, “What are the rules?”

“Send whoever you like. In a battle of equal cultivation levels, the loser cannot battle any longer, and the winner can only battle for three rounds, at most.” It was clear that Lu Xun had long since thought this through, and immediately announced the rules of the battles.
All the Imperial Sons nodded. In a battle of equal cultivation levels, if they could not win, then there was really nothing else they could say.
“I’ll go first.” Han Yun from the Jade Drop Imperial Clan stood up first.
“Hehe, I’ll do it.” Yang Yihuan smiled, crossed his arms behind his back, and walked out. His expression was calm, as if he didn’t take Han Yun seriously at all.
“Humph!” This made Han Yun extremely furious.

The two of them immediately started fighting. Han Yun unleashed his full battle prowess at the first instant, and two streaks of eight-star Regulations were fused into his terrifying power, causing his attacks to become incredibly domineering.
Though Yang Yihuan was no longer so sloppy, and had used both hands to fight Han Yun head-on, everyone had a feeling that he had not used his full strength yet.
Gasp! This was a battle between Saints, yet he still dared to hold back?
It should be known just how terrifying the attack of a Saint was. If it landed on a vital point, he would be done for.
Han Yun roared loudly, and Imperial Techniques appeared repeatedly. Meanwhile, he also drew out a Saint Tool, which boosted his battle prowess.
Once the Saint Tool appeared, even Yang Yihuan didn’t dare to be careless. He also drew the Saint Tool.
The two of them battled again, and the intensity of their battle increased further.

However, Yang Yihuan was indeed slightly more skilled. Everyone could clearly see that both of them had used two flashes of eight-star Regulations, but Yang Yihuan was more proficient in using them. In fact, he was even bold and unrestrained, using them in unexpected ways.
In just over a hundred moves, Han Yun had no choice but to withdraw from the battle, and take the initiative to admit defeat.
If they continued fighting, it was possible that he would be severely injured, or even killed.
Although admitting defeat meant losing a galaxy, how could a galaxy compare to his life?
Against Yin souls, Saints were the most important source of power.
In this way, the Living Realm lost one battle first.
Yang Yihuan challenged again, and on the Imperial Sons’ side, Yi Taishu approached, but he was still no match.
After three battles, Yang Yihuan emerged victorious in all of them.
By the fourth battle, Yang Yihuan smiled and retreated, with Feng Miaoling taking his place.
In the end, Feng Miaoling won another three victories.
This!
All the Imperial Sons were dejected. Six battles led to six defeats. Though there was still Yan Dongming among them that had not made a move, Yan Dongming was only slightly stronger than the others.
They were all members of the Golden Generation, so how could there be such a large gap between them?
What could they do?
No one else stepped forward to accept the challenge, which made He Luo feel very bored.
He chuckled, “Yi, where is my opponent?”
This caused all the Imperial Sons to feel very awkward. They were all being trampled over by their enemies, yet they could do nothing at all.
However, if they stubbornly charged forward, not only would they lose face, but they would also lose even more galaxies!
Who would be willing to do something that only had disadvantages?
“Sigh, so boring.” He Luo shook his head, his expression filled with disdain.
This was a blatant provocation, but what could the Imperial Sons do about it?
“I’ll fight you.” At this moment, a voice rang out.
Everyone turned to look. Wasn’t it Ling Han?

An awkward expression instantly appeared on He Luo’s face. If he had a full-out battle with Ling Han, he naturally wouldn’t lose. However, Ling Han was only a f*cking Venerate, and one that was only at three stars at that.
If he lowered his cultivation level to the Venerate Tier, how could he possibly be a match for Ling Han?
This gap was like heaven and earth.
“There’s no need to compete. We’ll consider it as you winning three rounds in a row,” Lu Xun said, very generous.
Even so, they had still obtained three victories, and could obtain three galaxies.
Ling Han pondered for a moment, before saying, “Since you’ve made a wager, I’ll also make a wager next. Do you dare to accept?”
“What wager?” Lu Xun asked, a faint smile on his face.

Ling Han smiled and said, “You guys don’t have to suppress your cultivation level to fight me. If you can defeat me, you’ll be able to obtain 10 galaxies! If you lose, however, you’ll have to hand over 10 galaxies.”
This was a counterattack!
However, the Imperial Sons all shook their heads.
Have you f****** gone mad?
No matter how strong you were, you would only be a Three Star Venerate. At most, your battle prowess would be comparable to a Two Star Saint, but on Lu Xun’s side, there were two Three Star Saints!

Their natural talent in cultivation was even slightly superior to that of the Golden Generation. Thus, the battle prowess of those like Lu Xun and Wu Xingtong could probably reach the level of Five Star Saints.
How are you going to win?
Wasn’t this just delivering the galaxies freely to them?
Could it be that… you are actually an undercover agent of the Netherworld?
“Hahahaha!” Lu Xun laughed loudly, then shook his head, “Can you make the decision?”
This battle involved ten galaxies. Though there were tens of thousands of galaxies in the Living Realm, under the present circumstances, every galaxy could not be lost. The stakes were too high.
“Ling Han, don’t mess around!”
“This is not the time for you to show off!”
All the Imperial Sons rebuked him. What a joke, there was no reason to deliver galaxies to them like this.
“Agreed!” Right at this moment, the voice of the high-level Saint rang out from the Heavenly Mother Planet again. It was extremely loud and clear.
What? The Xuan Huo Saint had actually agreed?
The Imperial Sons were all astounded, unable to believe this.
However, the Saint’s word was like the decree of heaven and earth. If one did not obey, he would be punished by the heaven and earth.
“All right, then let’s battle!” Lu Xun nodded.
“I’ll go first.” He Luo walked out, “I can win a few more battles.”
Previously, he had actually been displeased that Lu Xun had admitted defeat on his behalf.
However, in a battle of equal cultivation levels, he was indeed no match for Ling Han. There was nothing he could do.
Now, however, he was going all out. He naturally had to fight, and personally redeem his pride.
He was the son of a Great Emperor, so how proud was his pride?
Lu Xun thought for a moment, then nodded gladly.
Every time Ling Han lost another battle, they would be able to take another 10 galaxies, so why not?
He Luo’s eyes focused on Ling Han. Boom, a terrifying aura began to seep out of his body, and there was no longer any need to suppress it.
“Die!” He charged out, and as he delivered an attack, three eight-star Regulations shone brilliantly.
What!
All the Imperial Sons paled in shock. A One Star Saint was actually capable of unleashing three flashes of eight-star Regulations?

chapters.title: Chapter 4611: Getting one victory first
paragraphs: Chapter 4611: Getting one victory first

He Luo was He Luo, after all. He was an ancient prodigy, and had been buried for generation after generation. Furthermore, he had continuously walked the Imperial Path. If he was still only capable of being on par with the Golden Generation, how humiliating would that be?
When one had reached the level of Saint, eight-star Regulations wasn’t something that could be unleashed just by accumulating power.
It was all based on his comprehension of the heaven and earth!
However many Regulations you grasped, that was however many Regulations you could unleash. There was no such thing as accumulation.
Being able to become a Saint, how could there be mediocre people? Which one of them was not a prodigy among prodigies?

Ordinarily speaking, a One Star Saint would only be able to grasp one eight-star Regulations. If one’s talent was slightly more impressive, they would only be able to grasp two. However, He Luo had actually unleashed three Regulations with a single strike. This naturally stunned everyone.
This battle prowess was on par with a Two Star Saint of the Golden Generation. Tsk, tsk.
No wonder Han Yun and the others had suffered a terrible defeat previously — how could they not lose?

Ling Han laughed loudly, and greeted the incoming attack with a punch. Thirty Seven Star Regulations intertwined, and the battle prowess they released was not the slightest bit inferior to the Eight Star Regulations.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
The two of them clashed. In terms of Regulations, Ling Han was not inferior at all, but in terms of power, the Venerate was ultimately no match for the Saint.
Thus, Ling Han was at a disadvantage. However, this little bit of gap was still not enough to decide the outcome of the battle. The battle between the two of them was incredibly intense.
They were of the same level in terms of Regulations, and the gap in power wasn’t large to the point of crushing. This would depend on each individual’s impromptu performance.
In everyone’s eyes, it should be He Luo who would emerge victorious.

That was because He Luo had lived far longer than Ling Han. Furthermore, he had walked through Imperial Path many times, and had battled fiercely with prodigies from different eras. In fact, it was possible that the Great Emperors of the past were among them!
Just what kind of astonishing battle experience was this?
On the other hand, what about Ling Han?
No matter how prodigious he was, he had only lived for a few hundred years. Could he compete with He Luo in experience?
Thus, if they battled for too long, both sides would definitely reveal flaws, and He Luo’s ability to grasp flaws would definitely force Ling Han to attack.
In the first round, Ling Han was going to suffer a terrible defeat.

All the Imperial Sons shook their heads. At first, they had thought that Ling Han would be able to win at least one battle. Then, they would take advantage of the opening to call a ceasefire, and in turn, they would be able to win seven galaxies.
But now? They were about to lose thirteen galaxies.
Yang Yihuan and the others all smiled. In their eyes, it was only natural that He Luo would win.
As long as battle prowess was equal, then in terms of battle experience, who could compare to ancient king tiers like them?
But as the battle continued, everyone shockingly discovered that it was actually Ling Han who had the advantage in ability to grasp weaknesses!
How was this possible?

No one’s attack would be perfect. The only difference was how to hide a weak point and not let the other party catch hold of it, or when battle prowess was overwhelming, then it didn’t matter whether there was a weak point or not, and one would be able to crush their opponent directly.
Hence, in a battle on the same level of battle prowess, no one would be able to defeat their opponent head-on. In truth, it was just a clash of grasping and concealing weaknesses.
This was battle experience.
However, He Luo was actually inferior to Ling Han!
How was this possible?
Yang Yihuan and the others were all in disbelief. All of them wore solemn expressions. They couldn’t understand.𝒇𝒓𝙚𝒆𝔀𝓮𝓫𝒏𝓸𝙫𝓮𝓵.𝓬𝙤𝙢
Was there really such a prodigy of battle, whose battle experience of a mere few hundred years had surpassed his opponent who had battle experience of more than ten thousand years?
This!
However, how could they know that Ling Han had indeed only lived for around 200 years in this world? But how long had he lived in the Genesis World?
Though the battle styles in the Genesis World were completely different, the idea of grasping the weak points and hiding weaknesses was the same.
In this battle, everyone could clearly see that Ling Han had clearly hidden his weak points better, and his ability to grasp weak points far surpassed He Luo’s.
If it was not for the fact that He Luo still had an advantage in power, he would probably have long since been defeated by Ling Han.
Even so, he was still at a disadvantage. It was only a matter of time before he lost.
“Ling Han!”
“As expected of the number one Venerate in history, too awesome.”
“Even the Imperial Sons can’t block him. He’s one major tier weaker than He Luo, yet he’s about to turn the tables!”
“Haha, win glory for the Living Realm!”
Of course, it was not just the Imperial Sons here. There were also a great many people from other small forces, and they were all elated when they saw the fierce battle in space.
Previously, the Living Realm had lost consecutive battles, which was a great blow to everyone’s morale. At this most crucial moment, when everyone needed a hero the most, Ling Han stepped out.
After Ling Han gained the upper hand, the pressure he exerted on He Luo became greater and greater, continuously enlarging his advantage.
After He Luo forcibly blocked a few hundred moves, he had no choice but to lower his head and admit defeat.
If this was a mortal duel, he still had a great many powerful moves that he could use, but if it was only a contest, he was not willing to reveal his trump cards.
In truth, Ling Han also had powerful moves that he had yet to use.
He had done it on purpose. That was because if he had revealed his trump cards too quickly, would there still be anyone left willing to fight him?
“Hehe, Brother Ling Ling is indeed powerful!” Di Wuji exclaimed, “Too bad, too bad, you were really born in the wrong era.”
He walked out, and became Ling Han’s second opponent.
Ling Han’s expression became serious. This was a Two Star Saint.
Di Wuji moved. Boom, Regulations intertwined to form a giant black wolf that pounced towards Ling Han.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and beckoned with his hand. Earth Qi surged out, turning into a human figure that greeted the giant wolf’s attack.
Peng!
The giant wolf was too terrifying. With a pounce, the Earth Qi human figure was shattered, and it continued to charge over.
However, with this block, the might of the giant wolf had also been greatly expended. Ling Han threw another punch, and easily dispersed this attack.

“Your battle prowess is only on the level of the strongest One Star Saint. You are definitely no match for me!” Di Wuji stated calmly. His figure charged out. Boom, light interwove behind him, turning into the form of a massive wolf.
Ling Han’s expression was stern. Faced with Di Wuji, whether it was Regulations or power, he was far inferior.
Thus, in a battle with Di Wuji, there was no such thing as grasping or hiding weak points, because the latter’s battle prowess was superior to his.
—Even if there was a flaw in Di Wuji’s attack, so what? He could not grasp it at all.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
Di Wuji’s attack speed became faster and faster. Fighting a Venerate as a Two Star Saint was already humiliating enough. Thus, it was naturally best to end the battle as soon as possible.
Seeing that Ling Han no longer had the ability to counter, everyone shook their heads.
It could not be helped. He was about to lose.
The 10 galaxies that he had just won would have to be returned to the other side.
Everyone felt that it was a pity. However, just how wide was the gap between their cultivation levels?
Even the Golden Generation elites hadn’t been able to win face, yet Ling Han had. What more could they ask for?
Furthermore, if Ling Han could become a Saint… f*ck, wouldn’t all Saints be swept aside by him?
In fact, so what if it was the Skeleton Saint Tool? Was it a match for him?
Perhaps only a Pseudo-Emperor could rival him?
Thinking of this, a great many people started a call for action on the Galaxy Network, wanting to appeal to the Imperial Clans to use all their resources to nurture Ling Han.

As long as Ling Han became a Saint, it would be equivalent to having another Pseudo-Emperor in the Living Realm. At that time, if he joined forces with Buddha Doga, would they still have to worry about not being able to reverse the decline of the Living Realm?

—Even if there was a flaw in Di Wuji’s attack, so what?
He could not grasp it at all.
Hong!
Hong!
Hong!
Di Wuji’s attack speed became faster and faster.
Fighting a Venerate as a Two Star Saint was already humiliating enough.
Thus, it was naturally best to end the battle as soon as possible.
Seeing that Ling Han no longer had the ability to counter, everyone shook their heads.
It could not be helped.
He was about to lose.
The 10 galaxies that he had just won would have to be returned to the other side.
Everyone felt that it was a pity.
However, just how wide was the gap between their cultivation levels?
Even the Golden Generation elites hadn’t been able to win face, yet Ling Han had.
What more could they ask for?
Furthermore, if Ling Han could become a Saint… f*ck, wouldn’t all Saints be swept aside by him?
In fact, so what if it was the Skeleton Saint Tool?
Was it a match for him?
Perhaps only a Pseudo-Emperor could rival him?
Thinking of this, a great many people started a call for action on the Galaxy Network, wanting to appeal to the Imperial Clans to use all their resources to nurture Ling Han.
As long as Ling Han became a Saint, it would be equivalent to having another Pseudo-Emperor in the Living Realm.
At that time, if he joined forces with Buddha Doga, would they still have to worry about not being able to reverse the decline of the Living Realm?

chapters.title: Chapter 4612: Formation Saint
paragraphs: Chapter 4612: Formation Saint
The appeals of these people caused a storm on the Galaxy Network.

More and more people joined in on the appeals. In fact, there was no shortage of elders of the older generation that stepped out to speak, hoping that the Imperial Clans could let go of their prejudices, and under the prerequisite that the Living Realm was facing such danger, they could prioritize the big picture.
Of course, on the other hand, they also advised Ling Han to be magnanimous like a Great Emperor and benevolent to the world, letting bygones be bygones.
The Donglin Imperial Clan responded at the first instant, expressing their willingness to use all the resources in their clan to help Ling Han.
Then, the Donglin Imperial Clan asked the other Imperial Clans one by one whether they were going to follow up or not.
This caused the other Imperial Clans to curse.
Ling Han was your family’s son-in-law, so of course you guys can be so generous, but for the other Imperial Clans, what benefits would that bring?
The things they took out were genuine, but what gains could they obtain?

But now, all the public opinion in the world was leaning towards Ling Han’s side. If the Imperial Clans did not express anything at this time, that would be equivalent to labelling themselves as “disregarding the big picture, being selfish and self-centred”.
If this was any other time, they naturally would not be concerned. The Imperial Clans were a transcendent existence, so who would dare criticize them?
However, things were different now. The Netherworld was invading, and they needed to combine all of their power to resist them.
Oh, your Imperial Clans can be selfish, so what right do you have to make others throw away their lives and shed blood for you?
At this moment, the members of the Imperial Clans all hated the person who had posted the notice on the Galaxy Network. F*ck! If it weren’t for him, would they have been stuck in such a dilemma?
They contacted the Chang Clan, and asked the Chang Clan to investigate who the person who had caused the trouble was. The result… was that it was a large black dog!
The one by Ling Han’s side.

The members of the Imperial Clans were so infuriated that their faces were twisted. Despicable dog, oh, despicable dog. This move was really too vicious. They were clearly filled with hatred, yet they could not show it.
It could not be helped. In order to stabilize the morale of the army, and for the sake of maintaining morale, the various great Imperial Clans announced that they would help Ling Han’s growth.
Of course, they would only help him. As for how far they would help him, that was still up to them to decide.
No matter what, this was already a huge victory.

The large black dog couldn’t help but snicker, exchanging a high-five with the little azure dragon. It was the mastermind, while the little azure dragon was the “accomplice”. The two of them had been pushing the public opinion on the Galaxy Network just now, and it finally had an effect.
However, the battle between Ling Han and Di Wuji was still continuing. It was still Ling Han that was at a disadvantage, and the situation was precarious.
“Little Han, it’s done,” the large black dog said to Ling Han through divine sense.
Ling Han nodded in understanding. He wouldn’t hide his strength anymore.
Boom! Destructive Energy surged, and he immediately launched a counterattack.
Previously, the large black dog had an idea to stimulate public opinion on the Galaxy Network. This naturally required Ling Han’s cooperation — he had to pretend to be weak.
Otherwise, how could there be such a one-sided opinion on the Galaxy Network?
Now, it was time to counterattack.
Destructive Energy could destroy anything, and even the eight-star Regulations could only block it to a limited extent. This allowed Ling Han to just barely compensate for the gap of two Regulations.
It was still not enough.
Again!
He beckoned with his hand, and in the distance, the planets all responded. One after another, Earth Qi flew over, turning into human figures that joined the battle.
In this way, the scales of victory and defeat were finally leaning towards being equally balanced.
It was possible that either of them could win.
This naturally caused everyone great joy. Since the battle was tied now, Ling Han had hopes of winning.
‘Go!’
Whether it was the spectators on the venue or the Galaxy Network, they were all cheering Ling Han on.
This was a contest with the Netherworld, and its significance surpassed that of ordinary battles of courage and ruthlessness. Its significance was too great.
Di Wuji felt immense pressure. Firstly, it was indeed because Ling Han’s counterattack was too strong, and secondly, it was psychological pressure.
If he lost… he would be humiliated!
He could only battle.

Di Wuji summoned the Saint Tool, but Ling Han also had the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower. Though this could only be considered a seven-star Spirit Tool, which was slightly inferior to the Saint Tool, the defenses of the Origin Gold was Great Emperor-level.
Thus, so what if it was a Saint Tool? It couldn’t do anything to Ling Han at all.
After fighting for three days, it was still a tie.
In the end, the battle was forcefully stopped, and Di Wuji was judged to have lost.
Why was it Di Wuji’s loss?
It was very simple. You, a Two Star Saint, were unable to defeat a Venerate, so who would be considered the loser if not you?
Two wins!
In this manner, the Living Realm had won seventeen galaxies.
Everyone was overjoyed. However, the Netherworld’s side still had Lu Xun and Wu Xingtong, two three-star Saints. What were they to do?
Against Di Wuji, Ling Han had obviously used all his trump cards. Even so, they could only fight to a tie. Then, against the stronger Lu Xun and Wu Xingtong, Ling Han would definitely lose.
Then, losing two times in a row would mean paying the price of twenty galaxies. Then wouldn’t that mean losing another three galaxies?
However, could they call a halt now?
Lu Xun revealed a smile, and said slowly, “Ling Han, you are really surprising! However, in front of me, how many moves can you take?”
He raised his hand, and with a light wave, seven eight-star Regulations were instantly activated.
Seven flashes!
Everyone was in despair. Seven streaks! In terms of Regulations, he had suppressed Ling Han by a whole four stars. How could this battle be fought?
Ling Han smiled faintly, “Ten moves, then.”
Ten moves?
Everyone shook their heads. The gap in strength was too wide. Even Ling Han had completely lost all confidence, and thought that he could only withstand ten moves from Lu Xun.
“Haha, you do have some self-awareness.” Lu Xun laughed loudly.
Ling Han waved his hand dismissively, “It seems like you have misunderstood. When I say ten moves, it is you that can block ten moves from me, at most.”
Yi?
All of a sudden, everyone was incredibly shocked.
What was going on?
This was really boasting too much.
There was absolutely no way that you could be a match for Lu Xun, and you actually said that you would deal with him in ten moves. Wasn’t that a joke?
Lu Xun was also slightly surprised. His expression darkened, “This is not funny at all.”
“I don’t find it funny either. I’m just stating a fact,” Ling Han said with a smile. “What is it? Do you think I’m telling you a joke?”
“Humph, you’ll be struck by lightning for showing off!” Lu Xun couldn’t help but mock, “What’s the point? When you’re defeated by me, just how humiliating would that be?”
“Yi, I already said that I can defeat you within ten moves. Where did you get all this nonsense from?” Ling Han was surprised.
“You’re seeking death!” Lu Xun humphed, and charged towards Ling Han.
Boom!

Right at this moment, over a hundred stars in the surrounding universe shot out brilliant pillars of light at the same time. Then, they intertwined, turning into an even thicker pillar of light that shot towards Lu Xun.
At the same time, Ling Han also charged out.
This!
“Formation!”
“Saint-level formation!”
“F***, I forgot something important. Ling Han is still a Formation Master!”
“But when did he advance to the level of Formation Saint?”
Everyone was exclaiming in shock. From a certain aspect, Formation Saints were even more awesome than Saints.

A Saint like you would only be able to match one or two Saints of the same cultivation level, at most, but Formation Saints only had to lay out formations, and they could even trap and kill ten Saints.
This was an unexpected turn of events!

chapters.title: Chapter 4613: Shocking Change
paragraphs: Chapter 4613: Shocking Change
One person, one formation, this combination was too powerful.

Ling Han unleashed all of his ultimate moves at the first instant. The Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, the Destructive Energy, the four pinnacle pillars, and he used all the powerful moves that he could use. Just how terrifying was this power?
Even Lu Xun couldn’t withstand it.

Primarily, it was because this formation was too frightening. Its destructive power was superior to even Ling Han, so he had to split out a large portion of his energy to resist it. This made it difficult for him to take care of both front and back. It should be known that though Ling Han’s battle prowess was inferior to his, who could underestimate the attacks of Saints?
In just nine moves, Lu Xun was forced to flee in a sorry state, and had no choice but to withdraw from the battle.

Saints were hard to kill, and this was based on the prerequisite that they would flee if they were unable to defeat their opponent. If one were to truly battle to the death and not retreat, they would still die very quickly.
True enough, within ten moves.
At this moment, everyone was rendered speechless.
Ling Han wasn’t boasting. He had genuinely defeated Lu Xun in 10 exchanges.
Had he used external power?
Hehe, who made it a rule that Formation Masters couldn’t use formations in battle?
Ling Han’s victory wasn’t due to his full battle prowess, but it was also due to his own strength.
Lu Xun had been defeated!
At this time, even Wu Xingtong didn’t say that she would be fighting. With the cooperation of person and formation, Ling Han was completely capable of sweeping aside all Saints below Five Stars.
Hence, even if she went, it would be pointless. She would only be gifting an additional ten galaxies to the other side.
“Thank you. There are a total of 27 galaxies. Please cooperate with us, and quickly evacuate the troops,” Ling Han said with a smile.
“Humph, how could we go back on our word!” Wu Xingtong humphed, turned around, tore a rip into the Void, and left.
What was the point of staying here? To be laughed at by others?
With her departure, Yang Yihuan and the others also left one after another, all of them looking livid.
Only Feng Miaoling was an exception. She gave Ling Han a look of admiration, causing Ling Han to shiver.
Once these people left, whether it was those in the surroundings, the Heavenly Mother Planet below, or the Galaxy Network, they were all cheering.
Who would have thought that the young king tiers representing the Netherworld would come aggressively, and when the Golden Generation elites were completely defeated, a hero would turn the tide?
At this moment, Ling Han’s status rose endlessly, and he was praised to the height of a hero that saved the world.
Everyone believed that as long as Ling Han became a Saint, he could even resolve the crisis of the invasion of the Netherworld all by himself.

Thus, the public opinion on Galaxy Network became even more intense, requesting the various Imperial Clans to fulfill their promises as soon as possible, and quickly take out their cultivation resources, so that Ling Han could break through to Saint Tier as soon as possible.
Yan Anming and the other Imperial Sons still had to reluctantly ask Ling Han to enter the city. They still had to keep up appearances.
Ling Han didn’t enter the city.
There was a seven-star or even eight-star Saint in there. If he shamelessly ambushed him, it was really possible that he would suffer.

He couldn’t be careless. He was only a three-star Venerate, and his battle prowess was at most comparable to a two-star Saint. Moreover, the Ancestral King City was filled with the aura of a Great Emperor, so Saint Tier-level formations were completely useless.
He didn’t want himself, Brother Monkey, and the others to fall together.
Ling Han didn’t want to enter the city, so Han Yun and the others couldn’t force him either. After exchanging some words, they all took their leave and returned to the Ancestral King City.
Now, in a battle of equal cultivation levels, no one had any extravagant hopes of defeating Ling Han.
Thus, if one wanted to become Emperor, he could only grasp a chance, and that was while Ling Han was still a Venerate Tier.

If one wanted to become Great Emperor, they would have to first advance from Venerate Tier to Saint Tier, then from Saint Tier to Pseudo-Emperor, and from Pseudo-Emperor to become the invincible Great Emperor.
Thus, as long as he managed to become a Pseudo-Emperor first, and complete that final leap, then, no matter how heaven-defying Ling Han was, so what?
In an era, the heaven and earth would only allow one person to become Emperor.
Especially after this battle, the Imperial Sons were even more motivated, and they all went back to cultivating earnestly.
Meanwhile, Ling Han roamed around the vicinity of the Ancestral King City, experiencing the aura of the Great Emperor. This was still of some help to him.
After staying for two days, Ding Shu arrived.
He was very rueful, and said that he had missed the chance to spar with Yang Yihuan and the others, causing Ling Han to be in the limelight all by himself.
Not long after, Jing Haoran, Shui Qingchang, and the others all arrived. The Ancestral King City was still worth a trip.
When Origin also arrived, he suggested that Genesis World leaders like them gather.
This quickly gained everyone’s agreement. After some discussion, they decided to gather outside the Ancestral King City in three days’ time, drink wine and have a nice chat.

Next, it was time for the cruel competition for the throne. Even if Ling Han was peerless in freakishness, becoming Emperor had never been a matter of who was the strongest having the last laugh. The right time, the right place, the right person, none of these variables could be lacking.
It could be said that the seven of them were the most powerful contenders for the throne.
Three days later, Ling Han, Chi Menghan, Brother Monkey, the large black dog, and little azure dragon went to the meeting together.
He wasn’t the first to arrive, but he wasn’t the last either. The people who arrived first were already conversing, discussing cultivation.
Ling Han also joined in. Since they had come first, they could chat first.
Not long after, Heaven Crushing arrived.
This time, six of the seven Genesis World’s Masters had come, and Shui Qingchang was the only one missing.
However, Shui Qingchang wasn’t late either. She arrived at the appointed time, not one second earlier or one second later.
“Haha, how long has it been since we last met?”
“Come, come, come. Don’t say anything. Let’s drink first!”
Everyone raised their cups. As rulers of Genesis Worlds, there was an indescribable intimacy between them.
“Cheers!”
Just as he was about to drink it all in one gulp, Ling Han shockingly discovered that his body was glowing.
Peng, peng, peng! Multiple columns of light shot into the sky, one after another, coming from him, Ding Shu and the others.𝑓𝘳𝘦𝑒𝑤𝑒𝘣𝘯ℴ𝘷𝘦𝓁.𝑐𝑜𝑚
Every Genesis World’s ruler was uncontrollably glowing!
This stunned them all. What were elites most afraid of?
Losing control!
Why had their body suddenly lit up?
What did this signify?
“Yi?” “En?” “Ya?”
They all exclaimed in surprise. Seven pillars of light intertwined, as if connecting their bodies together, allowing them to vaguely glimpse the Genesis World of the others.
The seven of them had a feeling that they were definitely not isolated existences.
It was as if… all the Genesis Worlds were originally one, yet they were forcefully split apart.
Yi, it was not that they had not been together before, but why had they never experienced such a change?
Was it because their strength had advanced into Saint Tier?
Xiu, xiu, xiu! One after another, Saints rapidly appeared in the Ancestral King City.
They naturally saw the intertwining pillars of light, and out of curiosity, came out to check on the situation.
When they saw that this light source was actually Ling Han and his group, they were all confused.
Dignified Saints were actually playing such a childish trick?
Boom!
Right at this moment, the seven pillars of light suddenly fused into one. After soaring into the sky, they then descended vertically, blasting towards the Heavenly Mother Planet.
A shocking scene appeared. It was as if the earth was slowly shedding its outer clothing, and a layer of the earth’s crust was forcibly pushed back, revealing a wall.
And when the earth’s crust had retreated to a certain extent, an entrance was revealed.
This time, everyone was dumbfounded.
What was going on?
There was actually a Mystery Realm on the Heavenly Mother Planet?
