Meanwhile, Ling Han roamed around the vicinity of the Ancestral King City, experiencing the aura of the Great Emperor.
This was still of some help to him.
After staying for two days, Ding Shu arrived.
He was very rueful, and said that he had missed the chance to spar with Yang Yihuan and the others, causing Ling Han to be in the limelight all by himself.
Not long after, Jing Haoran, Shui Qingchang, and the others all arrived.
The Ancestral King City was still worth a trip.
When Origin also arrived, he suggested that Genesis World leaders like them gather.
This quickly gained everyone’s agreement.
After some discussion, they decided to gather outside the Ancestral King City in three days’ time, drink wine and have a nice chat.
Next, it was time for the cruel competition for the throne.
Even if Ling Han was peerless in freakishness, becoming Emperor had never been a matter of who was the strongest having the last laugh.
The right time, the right place, the right person, none of these variables could be lacking.
It could be said that the seven of them were the most powerful contenders for the throne.
Three days later, Ling Han, Chi Menghan, Brother Monkey, the large black dog, and little azure dragon went to the meeting together.
He wasn’t the first to arrive, but he wasn’t the last either.
The people who arrived first were already conversing, discussing cultivation.
Ling Han also joined in.
Since they had come first, they could chat first.
Not long after, Heaven Crushing arrived.
This time, six of the seven Genesis World’s Masters had come, and Shui Qingchang was the only one missing.
However, Shui Qingchang wasn’t late either.
She arrived at the appointed time, not one second earlier or one second later.
“Haha, how long has it been since we last met?”
“Come, come, come.
Don’t say anything.
Let’s drink first!”
Everyone raised their cups.
As rulers of Genesis Worlds, there was an indescribable intimacy between them.
“Cheers!”
Just as he was about to drink it all in one gulp, Ling Han shockingly discovered that his body was glowing.
Peng, peng, peng!
Multiple columns of light shot into the sky, one after another, coming from him, Ding Shu and the others.𝑓𝘳𝘦𝑒𝑤𝑒𝘣𝘯ℴ𝘷𝘦𝓁.𝑐𝑜𝑚
Every Genesis World’s ruler was uncontrollably glowing!
This stunned them all.
What were elites most afraid of?
Losing control!
Why had their body suddenly lit up?
What did this signify?
“Yi?” “En?” “Ya?”
They all exclaimed in surprise.
Seven pillars of light intertwined, as if connecting their bodies together, allowing them to vaguely glimpse the Genesis World of the others.
The seven of them had a feeling that they were definitely not isolated existences.
It was as if… all the Genesis Worlds were originally one, yet they were forcefully split apart.
Yi, it was not that they had not been together before, but why had they never experienced such a change?
Was it because their strength had advanced into Saint Tier?
Xiu, xiu, xiu!
One after another, Saints rapidly appeared in the Ancestral King City.
They naturally saw the intertwining pillars of light, and out of curiosity, came out to check on the situation.
When they saw that this light source was actually Ling Han and his group, they were all confused.
Dignified Saints were actually playing such a childish trick?
Boom!
Right at this moment, the seven pillars of light suddenly fused into one.
After soaring into the sky, they then descended vertically, blasting towards the Heavenly Mother Planet.
A shocking scene appeared.
It was as if the earth was slowly shedding its outer clothing, and a layer of the earth’s crust was forcibly pushed back, revealing a wall.
And when the earth’s crust had retreated to a certain extent, an entrance was revealed.
This time, everyone was dumbfounded.
What was going on?
There was actually a Mystery Realm on the Heavenly Mother Planet?

chapters.title: Chapter 4614: Imperial Treasury?
paragraphs: Chapter 4614: Imperial Treasury?
Ling Han and the others were also very confused.
All of this had exceeded their control.

The pillars of light had appeared on their own volition, and they hadn’t taken the initiative to cause them. Moreover, they hadn’t imagined that the intertwining of the pillars of light would actually open up a Mystery Realm on the Heavenly Mother Planet!
When that passageway appeared, the pillars of light on Ling Han and the others also dimmed, and finally stopped glowing.
This caused the seven of them to be even more dumbfounded. Why could they open this passageway?
There was… a connection between them, but what did it have to do with this place?
“Yi, there’s actually a Mystery Realm here!”
“I didn’t discover it before!”

The Imperial Sons all exclaimed in shock. They had chosen the location of the Ancestral King City here, so they had definitely done an extremely detailed survey before building the city. It could be guaranteed that there was definitely no wall here.
Yet, it had appeared now.
What kind of power was protecting this, that it could actually deceive them?
Even Saints couldn’t see through this power!
“Could it be that it is?” someone exclaimed in shock.
“That Great Emperor!” even more people exclaimed in unison.

There was a legend on the Heavenly Mother Planet that said that a Great Emperor had once appeared here, but as for which one it was, it was already impossible to determine. They had long since been annihilated in the long passage of history.
But now, a mysterious wall had suddenly appeared, so how could they not let their imaginations run wild?
That was because this had managed to deceive even Saints.
All of a sudden, everyone was rubbing their fists in anticipation.
If the inheritance of the Great Emperor was really here, then obtaining it would have too much significance.
Firstly, it was destiny, and secondly, the inheritance of the Great Emperor was too valuable. Who knows, it may be able to change a person’s destiny.
There was no corresponding Imperial Clan to pass down to, which meant that… there was an Imperial Scroll that could be learnt.

The Imperial Scroll was the summary of a Great Emperor’s comprehension of the great dao. It was passed down in a gradual manner, allowing one to begin cultivating from the moment they set foot on the Celestial Path.

It was said that if one could read all the Imperial Scrolls in the world, then even if he did not become Emperor, he would still be able to become the strongest Saint, and sweep aside all opposition in the world.
Furthermore, what if there was an Imperial Weapon?
An ownerless Imperial Weapon! Just the thought of it was enough to make one’s heart beat wildly.

At this moment, no one was curious about how Ling Han and the others had managed to open this Mystery Realm. Their attention had already been completely attracted by the Imperial Scroll and Imperial Weapon.
“Let’s go!” Their eyes were burning.

Setting the Ancestral King City on the Heavenly Mother Planet, and now opening such a Mystery Realm, didn’t that mean that they had gained the favour of the heavens, and even decisions made subconsciously would have be bestowed such great fortune?
Everyone started to walk toward the passageway.
Meanwhile, Ling Han looked at Ding Shu and the others, and said, “Everyone, perhaps we can discover our true origins today.”
“En.” Ding Shu and the others all nodded.
They had come from the Genesis World, and the Genesis World corresponded to a Divine Stone, but where exactly had the Divine Stone come from?
Nurtured by heaven and earth?

In the beginning, Ling Han had indeed thought so. That was until now, that the seven of them resonated, and actually opened the historical site that was suspected to be the site of a Great Emperor. This was strange.
They were definitely related to this Great Emperor.
However, what exactly was this?
They had to go in and take a look.
The seven of them set off, and Brother Monkey and the others followed suit. This was very likely the treasure trove of a Great Emperor. Who could remain calm?

The group entered. This passage was very long, but the speed of Saints were extremely fast. Very soon, they had arrived at the end of the passage, and saw that a flight of stairs had appeared ahead of them, leading underground.
They walked down the stairs.
They had not taken too many steps, when the stairs turned, and they turned with it, continuing downwards.
Continuously turning in this manner, and endlessly descending, after a whole half an hour, there were finally no more stairs ahead of them. Instead, there was an empty plaza.
They raised their heads. Because they were underground, it was naturally impossible to see stars above them, but the top was at least three thousand meters above the ground.
After all, they had walked downwards for a very long time.

The people who had entered earlier were all here. Aside from Saints, there was also a small number of Venerates and Sect Masters. Any one of these people could be called an elite in the outside world, but in this place, everyone had to be very careful.
If this had really been set up by a Great Emperor, then so what if it was Saints? They would still be easily killed.𝕗𝕣𝐞𝐞𝘄𝐞𝚋𝚗𝗼𝘃𝗲𝗹.𝚌𝕠𝚖

They advanced cautiously, and when they arrived at the end of the plaza, they saw that there was actually a great tree there. It had grown to the top, and the crown of the tree was stretched out, enough to cover an area of several thousand meters.
If it was only big, no one would take it to heart. There were many plants that were larger than this tree outside.
However, this great tree was covered with spots of light. Though none of them were very bright, in such a dark place, it was enough to become a torch-like existence.
What kind of tree was this? They had never seen it before.
Everyone slowly approached. If this really was an Imperial Treasury, then how could the tree that could be planted here be an ordinary one?
When they got closer, those spots of light suddenly flickered, as if they had become shooting stars, that shot towards them.
So fast!

The Saints were still able to react in time, and managed to set up a shield of Regulations in time, but the Venerates and Sect Masters were not able to react so quickly. They were hit by a great many spots of light, which then passed through their bodies.
After these spots of light danced in a circle, they returned to the tree, and adorned this towering tree.
Pa, pa, pa, pa, pa! Those who had been pierced by the specks of light all crashed onto the ground, completely lifeless.
What!
Everyone was stunned. What the hell were these specks of light? Why had they pierced through the body, and they were already dead?
Ling Han activated his eye technique and looked over, only to see that the specks of light were actually insects.
What a powerful insect, to actually be able to insta-kill Venerates.

Just now, there had been insects charging towards him, but they were unable to break through his defenses. Clearly, these insects were indeed powerful, but they had not broken through the threshold of Saint Tier.
So, these insects were Half-Saint-level?
One or two was naturally nothing, but with so many of them… this was terrifying.
At a rough glance, there were at least 10,000 or so of them. These Half Saint-level insects were attacking in groups, and even a Nine-Star Saint would have to turn around and flee, right?
That’s not right!
Ling Han immediately shook his head. If these insects were all Half-Saint-level, that would be too inconceivable.
There was no force in the world that could nurture so many Half-Saints.
With just a single tree?
Hehe, no matter how awesome a Celestial Tree was, it was impossible.
Shua, the specks of light danced again, and the insects launched the second wave of attack.
Ling Han pressed down with his palm. Boom! Destructive Energy boiled.
Instantly, wherever the palm strike passed, the spots of light would be instantly extinguished.
These insects were completely no match for Ling Han.

Everyone exclaimed in shock. Then, realization dawned on them. Though these insects had astonishing destructive power, they were not genuine Half-Saints. Otherwise, even if Ling Han possessed the battle prowess of a Two-Star Saint, he could not possibly kill so many Half-Saints with a single strike.
It could only be said that these insects possessed a unique ability that had incredibly shocking penetrating power, and that was why they could insta-kill Venerates.
However, they themselves were quite fragile.
Thinking of this, everyone shook their heads. These Venerates and Sect Masters that had died had really died for nothing.

chapters.title: Chapter 4615: Holy Flame Insects
paragraphs: Chapter 4615: Holy Flame Insects
When they knew that these insects only had extremely strong offensive power, but their defenses were overwhelmingly weak, everyone moved.
With the Saint-level power wreaking havoc, these insects were naturally destroyed in an instant.
What was surprising was that these insects died all over the ground, but not one of them was shattered into dust.

“Actually, their outer shell is tough enough, and even Saint-level power would find it very difficult to destroy them. However, their defenses are extremely low, and the power of the shockwave is enough to crush their fragile physical bodies.”
Everyone had discovered some clues.

This kind of insect was practically the embodiment of all kinds of extremes — super-strong attack power, super-fast speed, super-thick outer shell, yet it had an incredibly fragile physical body. It would die with just a slight shock.
“Yi, I remember now. This is a type of insect that only exists in legends.” An old Saint suddenly clapped his hands, “These are Holy Flame Insects!”
This name was quite appropriate. It possessed the destructive power of a Half-Saint, and would glow like fireflies.
“Hiss!” Being reminded by this old Saint, a considerable number of old Saints similarly looked shocked. They all scrambled out, and were actually collecting the insect corpses.
Everyone faltered upon hearing this. However, since this insect corpse was capable of causing Saints to lose their composure, it was clear that it was extremely valuable.
Thus, without caring about anything else, everyone scrambled out, and joined the gathering team.

However, though there were many of the Holy Flame Insects, they were only so large. A single scoop would be able to gather a whole bunch of them, so how could they hold up to being divided among these Saints? Very soon, not a single one could be seen.
“What exactly is the use of this?” Finally, someone asked.
That’s right, what was the use?

“You profligate brats!” an old Saint said with emotion. He was the Water Moon Saint from the Jade Drop Imperial Clan, and he was already a four-star Saint. “The flames burning in this Holy Flame Insect… is the Holy Flame!”
“Though there is only a sliver, if it is refined, it would still be of great help to us,” the Qiantian Saint of the Blood Flames Imperial Clan also said.
Though there was only a sliver of the holy flame, it was really, really too difficult for a Saint to take another step forwards. Thus, even a sliver of the holy flame was incredibly valuable.

In any case, there had been over 10,000 Holy Flame Insects in the first place. If they were all obtained by one person, it would probably be enough to help a Saint advance to the next minor level of cultivation.
“Oh no, after the insect died, the holy flame was extinguished, and no longer has any effect.” Han Yun looked at the insect corpse in his hand, and couldn’t help but exclaim in frustration.
Everyone also checked their gains one after another. Could they sense a sliver of the power of the holy flame?
Sigh, theyhad been excited for nothing.

However, Ling Han didn’t pay much heed to this. Firstly, he wasn’t a Saint yet, so he didn’t have such a pressing request for the holy flame. Secondly, he was filled with confidence in himself. Even without external help, he could still improve rapidly among Saints.
Thus, he merely stared at that great tree.
Why did the Holy Flame Insects reside on this large tree?
Additionally, how had the Holy Flame Insects matured?

Though the Holy Flame Insects could not really be considered Saint-level living beings, and could not even be considered a Half-Saint, to possess the destructive power of a Half-Saint, and also have a sliver of the holy flame, this was no ordinary matter what.
How had they grown?
It was impossible for it to appear out of thin air and grow up out of thin air.
Thus, there was definitely something special about this tree.
Ling Han sized up the tree trunk and leaves, but couldn’t perceive anything.

Being able to become a Saint, which one of them was not a smart person? They all circled around the great tree, trying their best to recall the information they had read before, and compare it with this.
However, after a long time, no one spoke.

The group of people studied it for a long time, and there were even some who deliberately went out to connect to the Galaxy Network, inviting people from all over the universe to join in on the research.
Ling Han and the others were also discussing.
“If the Holy Flame Insects depend on this great tree to grow, they would either eat the leaves of the great tree, or absorb the sap of the tree.”
“Thus, there must be nutrients that are necessary for their growth inside the great tree.”
“Then—”
Ling Han, Ding Shu and the others all had burning gazes. They moved, and plucked a small branch, which had a few leaves on it.

Though everyone was still studying it, dissatisfied with the way Ling Han and the others had destroyed it, firstly, Ling Han and the others had only plucked a small branch, and secondly, Ling Han and the others were too strong. Even the Golden Generation was unwilling to trifle with them.
Thus, only some people cast a few more glances at them, but no one spoke.
Ling Han and the others first plucked a leaf and studied it carefully, but did not find anything. Looking at the tree branch again, there didn’t seem to be anything special about it.
“Huh? Is our research heading in the wrong direction?” Heaven Crushing asked with a frown.
With a thought from Ling Han, he used his intent as fire to ignite this branch.
With a boom, the branch immediately began to burn.
“These flames!” Ding Shu, Brother Monkey, the large black dog and the others immediately revealed shocked expressions. There was actually saintly power contained within these flames!
F***, this was the holy flame.
How was this possible?
Only Saints could burn the holy flame. Was this a Saint Tree?
That was impossible. Though the Celestial medicine was precious, there was not too little of it either. Which one of them could burn the holy flame?
Have you cultivated to the point of gaining consciousness?
Shui Qingchang hurriedly blew out a breath of air and extinguished the fire.
This was their discovery, and could not be known to others. Otherwise, if they wanted to snatch this great tree again, they would definitely be met with desperate resistance from the masses.
This holy flame could help them increase their cultivation level!
It should be known that the door to becoming Emperor had already been opened. Who could become Emperor was not just a matter of natural talent, but also a matter of who would be able to charge ahead.
Thus, whoever could monopolize this great tree and harvest all of the holy flame might be able to leave others behind on the path of becoming Emperor.
They quietly advanced. With their strength, as long as they felled the great tree and stowed it away, who would be able to stop them from leaving?
At this moment, Ling Han and the others all had a tacit understanding, forming an alliance without saying anything.
—When they seized this great tree, how they would divide it among themselves would be a matter for the future.
Slowly, they had already arrived beneath the great tree.

However, before they could make a move, a person suddenly ran in, and said loudly, “I just received news that an old nine-star Saint has recognized this great tree. This is the Holy Flame Tree, and burning its trunk can form the holy flame!”
With a shua, all the Saints stood up. Then, their eyes focused on Ling Han and the others.
Sigh, could this be considered as having been caught red-handed?

“Hehe!” Since the others also understood the preciousness of this large tree, what need was there for them to be polite? Ding Shu was the first to move, and shot towards the large tree like an arrow, planning to uproot it.
“How dare you!” Instantly, the other Saints all moved, and charged towards Ding Shu.
Ling Han, Brother Monkey, Origin, and the others all moved to intercept.
There was no need to speak of their tacit understanding. Ding Shu would snatch the treasure, and they would intercept the others. When the time came, they would divide the spoils among themselves.
—If they fought internally at this time, it would only decrease their profits, and there might not even be any profit at all.
Boom!
Immediately, a great battle broke out. These were all Saints, and that was boundlessly terrifying.

However, Ling Han didn’t pay much heed to this.
Firstly, he wasn’t a Saint yet, so he didn’t have such a pressing request for the holy flame.
Secondly, he was filled with confidence in himself.
Even without external help, he could still improve rapidly among Saints.
Thus, he merely stared at that great tree.
Why did the Holy Flame Insects reside on this large tree?
Additionally, how had the Holy Flame Insects matured?

Though the Holy Flame Insects could not really be considered Saint-level living beings, and could not even be considered a Half-Saint, to possess the destructive power of a Half-Saint, and also have a sliver of the holy flame, this was no ordinary matter what.
How had they grown?
It was impossible for it to appear out of thin air and grow up out of thin air.
Thus, there was definitely something special about this tree.
Ling Han sized up the tree trunk and leaves, but couldn’t perceive anything.
Being able to become a Saint, which one of them was not a smart person?
They all circled around the great tree, trying their best to recall the information they had read before, and compare it with this.
However, after a long time, no one spoke.

The group of people studied it for a long time, and there were even some who deliberately went out to connect to the Galaxy Network, inviting people from all over the universe to join in on the research.
Ling Han and the others were also discussing.
“If the Holy Flame Insects depend on this great tree to grow, they would either eat the leaves of the great tree, or absorb the sap of the tree.”
“Thus, there must be nutrients that are necessary for their growth inside the great tree.”
“Then—”
Ling Han, Ding Shu and the others all had burning gazes.
They moved, and plucked a small branch, which had a few leaves on it.

Though everyone was still studying it, dissatisfied with the way Ling Han and the others had destroyed it, firstly, Ling Han and the others had only plucked a small branch, and secondly, Ling Han and the others were too strong.
Even the Golden Generation was unwilling to trifle with them.
Thus, only some people cast a few more glances at them, but no one spoke.
Ling Han and the others first plucked a leaf and studied it carefully, but did not find anything.
Looking at the tree branch again, there didn’t seem to be anything special about it.
“Huh?
Is our research heading in the wrong direction?” Heaven Crushing asked with a frown.
With a thought from Ling Han, he used his intent as fire to ignite this branch.
With a boom, the branch immediately began to burn.
“These flames!” Ding Shu, Brother Monkey, the large black dog and the others immediately revealed shocked expressions.
There was actually saintly power contained within these flames!
F***, this was the holy flame.
How was this possible?
Only Saints could burn the holy flame.
Was this a Saint Tree?
That was impossible.
Though the Celestial medicine was precious, there was not too little of it either.
Which one of them could burn the holy flame?
Have you cultivated to the point of gaining consciousness?
Shui Qingchang hurriedly blew out a breath of air and extinguished the fire.
This was their discovery, and could not be known to others.
Otherwise, if they wanted to snatch this great tree again, they would definitely be met with desperate resistance from the masses.
This holy flame could help them increase their cultivation level!
It should be known that the door to becoming Emperor had already been opened.
Who could become Emperor was not just a matter of natural talent, but also a matter of who would be able to charge ahead.
Thus, whoever could monopolize this great tree and harvest all of the holy flame might be able to leave others behind on the path of becoming Emperor.
They quietly advanced.
With their strength, as long as they felled the great tree and stowed it away, who would be able to stop them from leaving?
At this moment, Ling Han and the others all had a tacit understanding, forming an alliance without saying anything.
—When they seized this great tree, how they would divide it among themselves would be a matter for the future.
Slowly, they had already arrived beneath the great tree.
However, before they could make a move, a person suddenly ran in, and said loudly, “I just received news that an old nine-star Saint has recognized this great tree.
This is the Holy Flame Tree, and burning its trunk can form the holy flame!”
With a shua, all the Saints stood up.
Then, their eyes focused on Ling Han and the others.
Sigh, could this be considered as having been caught red-handed?
“Hehe!” Since the others also understood the preciousness of this large tree, what need was there for them to be polite?
Ding Shu was the first to move, and shot towards the large tree like an arrow, planning to uproot it.
“How dare you!” Instantly, the other Saints all moved, and charged towards Ding Shu.
Ling Han, Brother Monkey, Origin, and the others all moved to intercept.
There was no need to speak of their tacit understanding.
Ding Shu would snatch the treasure, and they would intercept the others.
When the time came, they would divide the spoils among themselves.
—If they fought internally at this time, it would only decrease their profits, and there might not even be any profit at all.
Boom!
Immediately, a great battle broke out.
These were all Saints, and that was boundlessly terrifying.

chapters.title: Chapter 4616: Burning the Tree
paragraphs: Chapter 4616: Burning the Tree
Shockingly, this place was also chillingly sturdy. No matter how much Saint-level power blasted at it, it did not move in the slightest.
This made everyone believe that this was definitely the power of a Great Emperor.
Originally, they had thought that they had entered into a Great Emperor Mystery Realm, but they still lacked proof, but now, they were sure of it.
Hiss, this Holy Flame Tree had appeared right at the beginning. Then, just how astonishing would the real treasures hidden by the Great Emperor be?
Everyone came to blows. This was for their own benefit, and everyone was going all out, wanting to take the Holy Flame Tree for their own.
In fact, there was even an eight-star Saint among them!
Eight stars, that was definitely awesome and dazzling, close to being invincible in this world.
If this was any other time, everyone would have to give face to this kind of existence, but now, no one would give way modestly.
Why should they give in to him?
Moreover, no matter how awesome you were, how could you possibly suppress so many Saints at the same time?

Theoretically speaking, three to four Saints would be able to compensate for the difference of one star in battle prowess. In other words, an eight-star Saint would be blocked by at least three seven-star Saints, while it would take nine six-star Saints, and it would take 27 five-star Saints…
Thus, even though the Xuan Huo Saint had a cultivation level of eight stars, he couldn’t suppress everyone here by himself.
Moreover, there was something that could affect the outcome of the battle.
Saint Tool!
With the appearance of the Saint Tool, the strength of each Saint increased, and this further narrowed the gap in battle prowess between them and the Xuan Huo Saint.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
Saint-level power wreaked havoc, and Regulations bloomed like fireworks, embellishing this pitch-black space to an incredibly beautiful extent.
Ling Han and the others joined forces, and their abilities were outstanding.

However, whoever was closest to the Holy Flame Tree would become public enemy number one. Even if Ling Han and the others were freaks, the highest cultivation level among them was only One-Star Saint, so how could they withstand the mad barrage of attacks from a large group of Three-Star and Four-Star Saints?
The battle royale was incredibly intense. There were too many Saints. If they did not clear the area first, who knew how long this kind of battle would continue for.
However, the various Imperial Clan elites were all unconcerned. This was because they had already sent out a message asking the Saints of their clans to act.
When a Nine-Star Saint arrived, and if necessary, he would even bring out the Imperial Weapon. What could he not suppress?
At that time, everyone would quiet down and slowly discuss how to distribute this Holy Flame Tree.
Of course, it would be even better if they could obtain it now, as they could enjoy it alone.
“If this continues, we might be kicked out of the game,” Ling Han communicated through divine sense.
“That’s right, what do we do?” The little azure dragon grimaced.

Though he was also the son of a Great Emperor, his old man had long since died, and there was no Imperial Weapon passed down through the generations, nor was there any powerful force for him to use. If it was a competition of backgrounds, he was at a great disadvantage.
“Little Han, use the Strange Shadow Steps to sneak over and steal it,” the large black dog suggested.
Ling Han instantly rolled his eyes, and said, “Steal my a*s! The shockwaves from the battle are so intense right now, so any one of them can easily send me flying.”
Er, this wouldn’t work again.
Brother Monkey didn’t say anything. He was only responsible for battle. When it came to such a tiring job as thinking, it was better to leave it to others.
A thought flashed in Ling Han’s head, and he said, “Why don’t we burn it down? All of you can go and absorb the holy flame, however much there is.”

Though this way, everyone would be able to obtain the holy flame, it was still better than having the nine-star Saints from the Imperial Clans arrive, in which case, they would not be able to gain the slightest bit, right?
Moreover, this was only the beginning. How many more treasures would there be after this?
Once they were kicked out, they would have no chance at all.
“But you haven’t reached the Saint Tier yet, brat, so you won’t be able to absorb the holy flame,” the large black dog immediately said.
This was a great disadvantage, because Ling Han couldn’t get the slightest bit of benefit.
“It’s fine.” Ling Han smiled confidently.
Before the large black dog and the others could persuade him further, Ling Han had already activated his divine sense to ignite the large tree.
Previously, it was easy to ignite a branch, but in the case of a great tree… it was too colossal, and required exponential amounts of divine sense.
Ling Han’s divine sense had long since reached perfection, majestic and vast, but now, it was also incredibly straining, unable to ignite the great tree even after a long time.
That was because he was not a true Saint. Otherwise, with the help of the holy flame, it would be much simpler for him to ignite the great tree.
“Burn!” Ling Han roared. Boom! His Spiritual Power transformed into blades that scraped against the Holy Flame Tree at an astonishing speed.
100, 1000… When there was enough Spiritual Power, the Holy Flame Tree finally burst into flames and started to burn.
“What!”
“Why is the Holy Flame Tree burning?”
All the Saints were shocked, but they immediately stopped fighting. They all sat down in cross-legged positions, absorbing the holy flame.

That was because once this great tree started to burn, it was like a wildfire starting at the prairie. Its speed was astonishingly fast, and in an instant, it was burning from top to bottom. It was completely impossible to extinguish the flames.
Thus, the only thing they could do now was absorb as much of the holy flame as possible, and use it for themselves.
Brother Monkey, Chi Menghan, the large black dog, and the others were all prepared. They immediately sat down to extract the power of the holy flame.
All of a sudden, no one was standing — aside from Ling Han.
Ling Han was still a Venerate. The holy flame was completely useless to him, and aside from him, the other Sect Masters and Venerates had all been killed by the Holy Flame Insects.
He did not waste time waiting foolishly. Instead, he arrived at the end of the plaza. There was another passage here.
I’ll take my leave first.
Ling Han smiled. He couldn’t obtain the benefits of the holy flame, but being able to be in the lead could also be considered a benefit.
He strode forwards, and entered into the passage.
This passage was very dark, and also very long. As he walked in, the light sound of his footsteps was also very loud, echoing in Ling Han’s ears.
After walking for a long time, the path ahead suddenly became clear again.
There was another plaza. However, this time, there weren’t any large trees in the plaza. Instead, there was a palace standing at the end of the plaza.
Was this where the Great Emperor had lived when he was alive?
Ling Han walked over, only to see that the doors were tightly shut.

He stretched out his hand to push, and as all the power surged out, the great doors also slowly opened. Zhi, as if sealed history was about to reappear in the world, the sound of the doors opening was incredibly loud.
Low-key, low-key.
Ling Han thought to himself, and strode into the palace.
Yi?
Ling Han raised his head, and saw that a large hole had been blasted into the top of the palace.
This was inconceivable to him.
A hole had actually been blasted into the residence of a Great Emperor?
Who was so bold, and also so powerful?
Even if the Great Emperor’s palace wasn’t protected by Great Emperor-level formations, after being bathed in the aura of the Great Emperor for so long, what power could break through it?
“Could it be that some Imperial Clan brought an Imperial Weapon with them?” Ling Han guessed. If it weren’t for the Imperial Weapon, this couldn’t have possibly been done.
“But which Imperial Clan is so outrageously bold?”
Ling Han withdrew his gaze, and continued onwards.
However, this place was filled with traces of battle, which caused extremely serious damage.
Ling Han tried to launch an attack as well, but he only knocked down a wall.

chapters.title: Chapter 4617: Imperial Statue
paragraphs: Chapter 4617: Imperial Statue

“As expected, the structures here are extremely sturdy. Furthermore, after so many years, the aura of the Great Emperor must have subsided considerably. Thus, this palace hall must have been even sturdier in the past.”
“These traces of battle… should have been left behind by Saints.”
“Could it be that some Imperial Clan brought an Imperial Weapon with them and sent out all the Saints of their clan to attack this place when this Great Emperor wasn’t here?”
Ling Han thought as he walked. This was perhaps the most astonishing discovery in history. There was actually a force that dared to attack the residence of the Great Emperor!
No one would believe this, right?
Even if they took advantage of the fact that the Great Emperor was not here, and forcibly conquered this place, wouldn’t they be afraid that the Great Emperor would call them to account afterwards?
Or perhaps it was only after the death of that Great Emperor that forces had invaded?
En, it should be the latter possibility that was more likely. Otherwise, it would be too inconceivable.

Ling Han searched around in the palace, but the damage here was too severe. Only the frame of the palace was still there. As for other things, it was really difficult to find anything complete that could be used to prove the identity of that Great Emperor.

After exiting the palace, he saw another plaza ahead of him. However, this plaza wasn’t empty anymore. Instead, there was a stone statue erected there, but it was incomplete. The part above the head and neck was gone.

This stone statue was extremely tall, measuring around 300 meters in height. It was clearly male, and it could be clearly seen that he was wearing a long robe. Even though it was only a statue, it still displayed his ethereal and otherworldly aura.
Was it that Great Emperor of the past?
Ling Han raised his head to look. Unfortunately, the sculpture didn’t have a head, so there was still no comparison.

“The other parts of the statue are all here, yet the head is missing. I can’t help but suspect that this is deliberate.” Ling Han withdrew his gaze, and murmured, “Does this mean that no one can guess the identity of that Great Emperor, or do they hate this Great Emperor so much that they could not even bear to see his stone statue?”
He walked to the foot of the statue, and stretched out a hand to touch it. Suddenly, images rushed towards his mind.
This was a scene of worship from all living beings.

In the past, countless believers had come here, and worshipped this stone statue on this plaza. The power of faith of all living beings condensed, transmigrating through millions and millions of years without dying.
“Power of belief.”

Ling Han nodded. What depressed him was the fact that these believers were too devout. They did not dare to raise their heads, and lowered their gazes. Thus, Ling Han was still unable to find out the appearance of that Great Emperor through these images.
“Are you trying to drive me to my death with anxiety?”
Ling Han retracted his hand. This was also his first time experiencing the power of belief, which made him sigh in realization.
“Yi?” He was surprised, because when he withdrew his hand, he discovered that the power of belief had not dispersed, but was rather adhering to his hand.
Strange.
The power of belief could only be used by Saints. No matter how freakish Ling Han was, his cultivation level was still low, so how could he channel it?
It was just like using your hand to scoop up water. No matter how big your palm was, the water would still flow through your fingers, and would not be able to stay in your grasp at all.
But now, Ling Han could sense that his connection with the power of belief had not been severed. In fact… he could use it.
He would give it a try.

Ling Han delivered a palm strike. Boom, the power of belief of all living beings was boosted. Aside from launching 30 Seven Star Regulations, there was actually another Eight Star Regulation that appeared.
In other words, with the help of the power of belief, he had actually increased his battle prowess by one star.
“Tsk!”
“No wonder the Saints collect the power of belief. Even if they can ignite the holy flame themselves, they still have to nurture believers.”
“This is indeed a great boost to battle prowess.”
“However, it’s clear that only Saints who possess Regulations can wield the power of belief, so why can I do the same?”

Ling Han stimulated the dimensions in his body. He was the Genesis World’s leader, and with a single thought, he immediately attracted the worship of millions of people. That was the incredibly devout power of belief.
However, Ling Han discovered that this was not the slightest bit helpful to his battle prowess.
Even though it was only a wisp.
Thus, he was still unable to channel the power of belief.

“The reason why I was able to unleash my might just now was because of this stone statue.” Ling Han placed his hand on the stone statue again. With a thought, he waved his hand, and as expected, an eight-star Regulation appeared.
And after this time, he discovered that he had actually established a very weak relationship with the stone statue. It was as if there was a bridge between the two of them that connected them.
It was also because of this that he was still able to channel the power of belief after taking a few steps back.
“I can now confirm that there is definitely a connection between me and this Great Emperor.”
“But what exactly is it?”
“Not just me, but also Ding Shu and the other Genesis World Masters!”
Ling Han felt a headache coming on. Just what kind of connection was this?

After thinking for a while, he continued onwards. There was another building at the end of the plaza, but compared to the palace, this was much more shabby. It was only a very ordinary small courtyard.
The front of the courtyard was surrounded by a bamboo fence. First, there was a small vegetable garden, followed by three single-storey houses.
Now, the vegetable garden had long since been abandoned. There weren’t even any weeds growing, and all that was left was desolate land.
Ling Han pushed open the bamboo fence, passed through the vegetable garden, and walked into those three single-storey houses.
This was really too ordinary. Everything was ordinary.
Ling Han circled around, and discovered that there was another backyard.
He walked in, and discovered that a small training ground had been built in this backyard. There was a very large sandpit.
“Yi?”
Ling Han faltered for a moment. This was because he suddenly saw the figure of a child walking past him.
This gave him a scare.
He had to be seeing things!
Just how powerful was he now? Saint-level!
But even so, he did not even know when a person had appeared by his side. How could this not be frightening?
However, Ling Han immediately came to a realization. This wasn’t a person, but rather an illusion.
The child walked into the sandpit and began to practice martial arts.
He practiced for several hours, and only when the sun had risen into the sky did he hear a voice call out, “Taiyu, it’s time for lunch.”
The child immediately retracted his fists and feet, then returned to his room.
When he passed by Ling Han, the child suddenly paused, and glanced at where Ling Han was. A suspicious expression appeared on his face, and he then walked back in.
‘F*ck! He didn’t see me, did he?’
However, this was an illusion from who knew how many years ago. Everyone in the scene was clearly an existence in a memory, so how could he have discovered him?
A thought involuntarily flashed through his mind.
A Great Emperor!
Only a Great Emperor would possess such Mystical Powers that ordinary people could not even imagine.
An extremely ordinary small courtyard had appeared here, so how could it not be strange?
However, if this was where the Great Emperor had lived since childhood, then it could be explained.
Ling Han couldn’t help but shuffle his feet and enter the room.
This time, he shockingly discovered that the appearance of the room had completely changed.

Er, the house was still the same, but the furnishings and furniture had become considerably newer. Furthermore, at a table, there was presently an older person and younger person seated, eating, exuding vitality.

The younger one was naturally the child who had been practicing martial arts just now, while the older one was a pretty woman who looked to be less than thirty years old. Occasionally, she would carry food for the child, her eyes filled with gentleness.
“Mother, can we treat this Big Brother to a meal?” At this moment, the child suddenly asked.

He walked to the foot of the statue, and stretched out a hand to touch it.
Suddenly, images rushed towards his mind.
This was a scene of worship from all living beings.
In the past, countless believers had come here, and worshipped this stone statue on this plaza.
The power of faith of all living beings condensed, transmigrating through millions and millions of years without dying.
“Power of belief.”
Ling Han nodded.
What depressed him was the fact that these believers were too devout.
They did not dare to raise their heads, and lowered their gazes.
Thus, Ling Han was still unable to find out the appearance of that Great Emperor through these images.
“Are you trying to drive me to my death with anxiety?”
Ling Han retracted his hand.
This was also his first time experiencing the power of belief, which made him sigh in realization.
“Yi?” He was surprised, because when he withdrew his hand, he discovered that the power of belief had not dispersed, but was rather adhering to his hand.
Strange.
The power of belief could only be used by Saints.
No matter how freakish Ling Han was, his cultivation level was still low, so how could he channel it?
It was just like using your hand to scoop up water.
No matter how big your palm was, the water would still flow through your fingers, and would not be able to stay in your grasp at all.
But now, Ling Han could sense that his connection with the power of belief had not been severed.
In fact… he could use it.
He would give it a try.
Ling Han delivered a palm strike.
Boom, the power of belief of all living beings was boosted.
Aside from launching 30 Seven Star Regulations, there was actually another Eight Star Regulation that appeared.
In other words, with the help of the power of belief, he had actually increased his battle prowess by one star.
“Tsk!”
“No wonder the Saints collect the power of belief.
Even if they can ignite the holy flame themselves, they still have to nurture believers.”
“This is indeed a great boost to battle prowess.”
“However, it’s clear that only Saints who possess Regulations can wield the power of belief, so why can I do the same?”
Ling Han stimulated the dimensions in his body.
He was the Genesis World’s leader, and with a single thought, he immediately attracted the worship of millions of people.
That was the incredibly devout power of belief.
However, Ling Han discovered that this was not the slightest bit helpful to his battle prowess.
Even though it was only a wisp.
Thus, he was still unable to channel the power of belief.
“The reason why I was able to unleash my might just now was because of this stone statue.” Ling Han placed his hand on the stone statue again.
With a thought, he waved his hand, and as expected, an eight-star Regulation appeared.
And after this time, he discovered that he had actually established a very weak relationship with the stone statue.
It was as if there was a bridge between the two of them that connected them.
It was also because of this that he was still able to channel the power of belief after taking a few steps back.
“I can now confirm that there is definitely a connection between me and this Great Emperor.”
“But what exactly is it?”
“Not just me, but also Ding Shu and the other Genesis World Masters!”
Ling Han felt a headache coming on.
Just what kind of connection was this?
After thinking for a while, he continued onwards.
There was another building at the end of the plaza, but compared to the palace, this was much more shabby.
It was only a very ordinary small courtyard.
The front of the courtyard was surrounded by a bamboo fence.
First, there was a small vegetable garden, followed by three single-storey houses.
Now, the vegetable garden had long since been abandoned.
There weren’t even any weeds growing, and all that was left was desolate land.
Ling Han pushed open the bamboo fence, passed through the vegetable garden, and walked into those three single-storey houses.
This was really too ordinary.
Everything was ordinary.
Ling Han circled around, and discovered that there was another backyard.
He walked in, and discovered that a small training ground had been built in this backyard.
There was a very large sandpit.
“Yi?”
Ling Han faltered for a moment.
This was because he suddenly saw the figure of a child walking past him.
This gave him a scare.
He had to be seeing things!
Just how powerful was he now?
Saint-level!
But even so, he did not even know when a person had appeared by his side.
How could this not be frightening?
However, Ling Han immediately came to a realization.
This wasn’t a person, but rather an illusion.
The child walked into the sandpit and began to practice martial arts.
He practiced for several hours, and only when the sun had risen into the sky did he hear a voice call out, “Taiyu, it’s time for lunch.”
The child immediately retracted his fists and feet, then returned to his room.
When he passed by Ling Han, the child suddenly paused, and glanced at where Ling Han was.
A suspicious expression appeared on his face, and he then walked back in.
‘F*ck!
He didn’t see me, did he?’
However, this was an illusion from who knew how many years ago.
Everyone in the scene was clearly an existence in a memory, so how could he have discovered him?
A thought involuntarily flashed through his mind.
A Great Emperor!
Only a Great Emperor would possess such Mystical Powers that ordinary people could not even imagine.
An extremely ordinary small courtyard had appeared here, so how could it not be strange?
However, if this was where the Great Emperor had lived since childhood, then it could be explained.
Ling Han couldn’t help but shuffle his feet and enter the room.
This time, he shockingly discovered that the appearance of the room had completely changed.
Er, the house was still the same, but the furnishings and furniture had become considerably newer.
Furthermore, at a table, there was presently an older person and younger person seated, eating, exuding vitality.
The younger one was naturally the child who had been practicing martial arts just now, while the older one was a pretty woman who looked to be less than thirty years old.
Occasionally, she would carry food for the child, her eyes filled with gentleness.
“Mother, can we treat this Big Brother to a meal?” At this moment, the child suddenly asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 4618: The childhood of a Great Emperor
paragraphs: Chapter 4618: The childhood of a Great Emperor
Ling Han was given a fright. Had he been discovered?
The woman was surprised, and asked, “Taiyu, what are you talking about?”
“There’s a Big Brother standing over there,” the child said, pointing at Ling Han.
Er!
Ling Han sighed. A Great Emperor was a Great Emperor, after all. Even if this was a memory image left behind from countless years ago, it was actually capable of reacting to him, a spectator.
You are awesome.
“There’s no Big Brother Just eat obediently,” the woman said gently. “When your father comes back, I’ll cook some meat stew for you.”
“En!” The child nodded vigorously, appearing to be very happy.
After the meal, the child went back to practicing martial arts. He obviously could still see Ling Han, but did not say anything else.
Time passed very quickly. When it was close to evening, a man stumbled over. The moment he entered, peng, he collapsed loudly onto the ground.
“Mingtong!” The woman hurriedly rushed over and helped the man up.
Ling Han saw very clearly that there was a very deep wound on the man’s chest.

This was a memory image, and Ling Han was also unable to sense the aura of this man. Though he was also unable to determine the latter’s cultivation level, from every move he made, he should not have stepped onto the Celestial Path yet.
If mortals suffered such severe injuries, their only fate would be death.
“The Zhang Clan discovered me, and I ledt them to circle around in the mountains, temporarily breaking away from them. Hurry up and take Taiyu away!” the man said darkly.
“No, let’s go together!” the woman hurriedly said.
“Father!” The child also heard the commotion. He stopped practicing martial arts and ran over.
“I will only be a burden to you. Don’t worry about me!” The man said harshly, “For Taiyu’s sake, you must leave!”
“Mingtong!” The woman’s tears fell like rain.
Though the child did not know what had happened, the present scene also made him feel that things were not good, and he was so anxious that he was breaking out in a cold sweat.
Right at this moment, a commotion was heard from afar.
Ling Han looked into the distance, only to see a group of people rushing over.
“It’s too late!” the man said through gritted teeth. He pushed himself up with all his might, and said, “I’ll fight them to the death!”
Yet the woman gritted her teeth, and said to the child, “Xuan Taiyu, promise Mother, immediately hide under the bed. No matter what happens, you can’t come out!”
“Mother—”
“Agree to Mother!”
“All right.” The child nodded, wiped away his tears, and hid under the bed.
The man looked at the woman, his expression filled with reluctance, as well as a resoluteness to go all out.
“Die!”
The two of them charged out, immediately attracting the attention of that group of people, who set off in pursuit of them.
It wasn’t long before the couple were caught up to and killed in battle.
However, this group of people did not leave. Instead, they turned back, and searched the room. Very soon, they found the child.

“Haha, there’s also a little b@stard!” The man leading them smirked coldly, “That couple fought to the death, unwilling to be captured, and we thought that we wouldn’t be able to complete our mission. I didn’t expect that there would be another little bAstard, and it just so happened that we could bring him back.”
“Retreat.”
This group of people left, and tied the child onto the back of a horse.
“Father, Mother!” the child cried, as he waved at Ling Han, as if asking for his help.
This was only an image, so Ling Han naturally couldn’t help him. He could only watch him leave.
Sigh, this Great Emperor seemed to have had a very tragic childhood.
It was unknown how he had managed to escape from his enemy, and cultivated all the way to become a Great Emperor, invincible in his generation.

However, his childhood was still a painful memory that had left behind traces that could not be erased. That was why after he became Emperor, he deliberately built a small courtyard that was the same as his childhood, and plucked out this memory.
Sigh, this was also the limit of what the Great Emperor could do. There was no way he could return to the past to save his parents.

That was because his childhood experience was an indispensable trajectory in his life to becoming Emperor. Otherwise, he would have to walk a completely different path of life, and naturally could not possibly become Emperor.
Since that was the case, how could he change the past?
This was the pattern of karma, and even the Great Emperor could not change this.
“This Great Emperor’s name is Xuan Taiyu!”
Ling Han nodded. It was easy now that he knew the name. He would look for information after he left, and there would definitely be some clues.
He had to leave.
He was just about to leave, when his heart skipped a beat. It was as if he had developed some kind of indescribable connection with this room.
Yi?
He discovered that a rock had suddenly appeared on the table.𝑓𝘳𝑒𝑒𝓌𝘦𝘣𝘯ℴ𝑣𝘦𝑙.𝘤𝑜𝑚
Rocks again?

He gritted his teeth. The Genesis World was inside the Divine Stone, and the Genesis World definitely had a deep connection with Xuan Taiyu, and now a rock had popped out. No matter how he thought about it, it had to be related, right?
Why was he fixated on rocks?
Ling Han walked over and examined it carefully.
This stone looked ordinary, and it was extremely ordinary. However, Ling Han could guarantee that this table had definitely been clean before. This stone hadn’t existed.
It could be said that this was a gift from the Great Emperor.
How could a gift from a Great Emperor be ordinary?
But could it be that he wanted to gift him a second Genesis World?
Ling Han looked at it for a while, then stretched out his hand.
The moment his hand touched the rock, boom, instantly, images rushed towards him.

That was a terrifying battle scene, but the scene was flashing too quickly. He could not capture the exact details of the battle at all. He could only confirm that both sides of the battle were incomparably powerful beings.
Was Xuan Taiyu battling with his opponent?
It wasn’t long before the speed of the images slowed down. However, Ling Han also missed the images from before. He couldn’t figure out what the message was.
After watching for a while, Ling Han discovered that this scene was actually reversed. It should have started from the end of Xuan Taiyu’s life.
Right now, Xuan Taiyu was still at the Great Emperor Tier. He shuttled through space, and it was as if he were searching for something.
The Great Emperor was too fast. With a single step, the great golden path could instantly reach any corner of the universe. Even if it was at the edge of the universe, it was still very easy.

Ling Han saw that Xuan Taiyu had once been to the edge of the universe. There was a massive dark abyss there, and its depth was unknown. However, just as Xuan Taiyu was about to enter, a streak of light flew out, so fast that even the Great Emperor couldn’t stop it in time.
Xuan Taiyu immediately chased after it, but the scene came to an abrupt stop.
Whether he had caught up or not, this was definitely in the previous scene, and naturally could not be seen now.
Next, Xuan Taiyu tore a rip into space and arrived on a platform. A pair of ancient doors stood erect, exuding an incredibly ancient aura.

“Humph, since there is a fourth door in the Celestial Path, yet does not give anyone the possibility of passing through at all, what is the point of setting it up?” Xuan Taiyu said coldly. He shot out a punch at the primitive great doors. Peng, with a single blow, the great doors were shattered.
Xiu, Xuan Taiyu left, and the scene changed again.
Ling Han couldn’t help but feel extremely shocked, because the broken primitive stone door was too familiar.
Wasn’t this the fourth door that he had passed when he had leaped over the Celestial Gate?
As it turned out, this had actually been damaged by Xuan Taiyu!
Otherwise, the primitive Celestial Gate wouldn’t have been able to be breached at all.
So awesome! Really awesome!

chapters.title: Chapter 4619: Hand over the Imperial Scroll and Imperial Weapon
paragraphs: Chapter 4619: Hand over the Imperial Scroll and Imperial Weapon
Ling Han couldn’t help but feel rueful. The fact that he could cultivate to this height was definitely thanks to Xuan Taiyu.
Firstly, the Genesis World was closely related to Xuan Taiyu.
Without the Genesis World, Ling Han would have a great many limits that he could not break.
Secondly, the primitive stone doors at the first barrier of the Celestial Path was actually broken by Xuan Taiyu.

If this weren’t the case, it was very likely that no one would be able to leap over this kind of stone door. After all, Xuan Taiyu had also said that it was Heavenly Dao that was deliberately making things difficult for him. It was an impossible task.
This had nothing to do with natural talent, determination, and so on. It simply could not be done.
Thus, after Xuan Taiyu became Emperor, he directly destroyed the primitive Celestial Gate.
This was the first step of the Celestial Path, and also the most important step. If they could not establish a strong, solid foundation, how could they talk of breaking through the limits?
There had been so many Great Emperors in the past, yet only Xuan Taiyu alone had done this. Just for this fact alone, Ling Han was impressed!
Going against Heavenly Dao, Xuan Taiyu would definitely suffer a backlash.
Perhaps, now that no one in the world knew of this Great Emperor Xuan Taiyu, it could be related to Heavenly Dao, and they had deliberately buried this Great Emperor’s outstanding reputation.
After all, there was no eternal existence. No matter how glorious the legend was, it could still possibly be erased.
Shua, in his mind, the scene was still changing.
At this time, Xuan Taiyu was no longer a Great Emperor, but had become a Saint.
He competed with many prodigies of the same generation, displaying the demeanor of an invincible king tier.
Yi?
Ling Han suddenly faltered, because he saw a familiar figure.
Ge Qianqiu!

This was a mysterious elite he had encountered on the Island of the Sky. At that time, Ling Han had been attracted by the Natural-born Stone Spirit, and ventured deep underground. In the end, he had met this person.
It was also because of Ge Qianqiu that Ling Han found out about the Primordial Source Clay. It could seal one’s vitality and allow them to awaken after millions and millions of years.
Hiss, this guy was actually in the same generation as Xuan Taiyu!
This time, Ling Han was really shocked. He had not thought that he would actually see Ge Qianqiu in Xuan Taiyu’s memories.

Furthermore, Ge Qianqiu could be considered Xuan Taiyu’s strongest opponent, because in this kind of memory, Xuan Taiyu and Ge Qianqiu exchanged blows the most. In fact, it was not Xuan Taiyu that had always won.
However, in the end, it was Xuan Taiyu who had the last laugh.

“Old Man Ge!” Ling Han murmured in his mind. “If we meet again, I’ll have to ask him which era Great Emperor Xuan Taiyu is from. Why does this Great Emperor have an unclear relationship with me, Ding Shu, and the others?”
Subsequently, the images became slower and slower. The closer he was to the early stage of Xuan Taiyu’s life, the fewer memories there would be.
Very quickly, the scene suddenly disappeared.
Ling Han suddenly opened his eyes.
It was over.
Yi?
On the table, that rock had already turned into ash, but Ling Han had a feeling that something seemed to have fused into his body, causing an indescribable change to take place in his inner world.

However, this change was too subtle. For the moment, Ling Han couldn’t say what it was, but he believed that it was like a seed had been planted. Not long after, it would break out of the ground and bring about an earth-shattering change.
“Also, my connection with this place has become stronger again.” Ling Han waved his hand, and five eight-star Regulations appeared.
Five flashes!

That was because he had a stronger connection with that decapitated stone statue. With a single thought, the power of belief would be endlessly used by him, helping him to unleash astonishing battle prowess.

And this was still because the stone statue had already been destroyed, and had not been replenished with power of belief for who knew how many years. On the other hand, it was only slowly seeping away. Thus, the fact that it could still increase Ling Han’s battle prowess by five stars of Saint-level could be considered incredibly awesome.

“Unfortunately, I didn’t get the Imperial Scroll, nor did I get the Imperial Weapon.” Ling Han shook his head. The previous scenes were too fast, and when he could see clearly, Xuan Taiyu hadn’t experienced any great battles, and had to use the Imperial Weapon.
Moreover, the Great Emperor was invincible in this era, so did he still need the Imperial Weapon to help him in battle?
The existence of the Imperial Weapon was more of an inheritance that could eternally stabilize the fortune of an Imperial Clan.
“No matter what, I seem to have gained something.”
Though he temporarily did not understand what that was.
Ling Han exited the small courtyard. Through the damaged stone statue, he had already completely grasped this place. He could confirm that there was nothing else here.

“If I don’t mind extracting the power of belief from the stone statue in a destructive manner, I can even battle against or even kill a nine-star Saint,” Ling Han murmured. “However, this way, the remaining power of belief in the stone statue will definitely dissipate completely.”
“That doesn’t matter. In any case, I don’t live here.”
He was just about to leave, when he saw a large number of Saints approach him.
It was Brother Monkey, Ding Shu and the Imperial Sons.
Realization dawned on Ling Han. By the looks of it, the Holy Flame Tree had already finished burning, so these people had begun to explore again.
Though the Holy Flame Tree was overwhelmingly awesome, there were really too many Saints here. Thus, after some dividing, everyone would have improved, but not by much.
There was nothing that could be done. There was not enough to go around.
“Ling Han!” When they saw him, everyone exclaimed in shock.
“Humph, where do you think you’re going?” Yan Anming asked coldly.
Ling Han couldn’t help but smile, and said slowly to him, “Is this your attitude towards a hero?”
Hero?

Yan Anming was just about to reprimand, but upon further thought, it was true. The Golden Generation had all been defeated in front of Yang Yihuan and the others. One galaxy after another, they had lost, right until Ling Han stepped out, and only then did they manage to turn the tide. Instead, they had won 27 galaxies for the Living Realm.
This kind of merit could be said to shake the heavens.
In comparison, what was he, Yan Anming, worth? He only had the body of a Saint, yet what had he done for the Living Realm?
Yan Anming was rendered speechless. At present, Ling Han was worshipped by everyone in the world, and had risen to the height of a savior. The only one who could compare to him was Buddha Doga.
He resolutely didn’t tangle with Ling Han. It wasn’t like he didn’t know that Ling Han was famous for having a sharp tongue.
“You should have obtained the treasures left behind by the Great Emperor, right?” he asked.
When these words fell, all the Saints’ eyes focused on Ling Han.
So what if they were Saints? Faced with the inheritance of a Great Emperor, their hearts still beat faster.
To say nothing of becoming Emperor, just reading a different Imperial Scroll might be enough to help them advance another level on the path of a Saint.
Ling Han chuckled, and his eyes swept over everyone. Aside from Brother Monkey, the large black dog and the others, there was a sliver of greed in everyone’s expressions.
He shook his head, “If I said no, you guys wouldn’t believe me either, right?”

Of course, this was the residence of the Great Emperor. Whether it was the Imperial Weapon or the Imperial Scroll, they were definitely hidden here, and not only was Ling Han the first to enter, he was clearly planning to leave.
Hence, if it was claimed that Ling Han had not gained anything, who would believe it?
—Without any gains, why would you leave?
“Hand over the Imperial Scroll and the Imperial Weapon!” an old Saint commanded.
Because he was a Four-Star Saint, and had a crushing advantage in terms of abilities, he naturally had the right to speak in this manner.
