It simply could not be done.
Thus, after Xuan Taiyu became Emperor, he directly destroyed the primitive Celestial Gate.
This was the first step of the Celestial Path, and also the most important step.
If they could not establish a strong, solid foundation, how could they talk of breaking through the limits?
There had been so many Great Emperors in the past, yet only Xuan Taiyu alone had done this.
Just for this fact alone, Ling Han was impressed!
Going against Heavenly Dao, Xuan Taiyu would definitely suffer a backlash.
Perhaps, now that no one in the world knew of this Great Emperor Xuan Taiyu, it could be related to Heavenly Dao, and they had deliberately buried this Great Emperor’s outstanding reputation.
After all, there was no eternal existence.
No matter how glorious the legend was, it could still possibly be erased.
Shua, in his mind, the scene was still changing.
At this time, Xuan Taiyu was no longer a Great Emperor, but had become a Saint.
He competed with many prodigies of the same generation, displaying the demeanor of an invincible king tier.
Yi?
Ling Han suddenly faltered, because he saw a familiar figure.
Ge Qianqiu!
This was a mysterious elite he had encountered on the Island of the Sky.
At that time, Ling Han had been attracted by the Natural-born Stone Spirit, and ventured deep underground.
In the end, he had met this person.
It was also because of Ge Qianqiu that Ling Han found out about the Primordial Source Clay.
It could seal one’s vitality and allow them to awaken after millions and millions of years.
Hiss, this guy was actually in the same generation as Xuan Taiyu!
This time, Ling Han was really shocked.
He had not thought that he would actually see Ge Qianqiu in Xuan Taiyu’s memories.
Furthermore, Ge Qianqiu could be considered Xuan Taiyu’s strongest opponent, because in this kind of memory, Xuan Taiyu and Ge Qianqiu exchanged blows the most.
In fact, it was not Xuan Taiyu that had always won.
However, in the end, it was Xuan Taiyu who had the last laugh.
“Old Man Ge!” Ling Han murmured in his mind.
“If we meet again, I’ll have to ask him which era Great Emperor Xuan Taiyu is from.
Why does this Great Emperor have an unclear relationship with me, Ding Shu, and the others?”
Subsequently, the images became slower and slower.
The closer he was to the early stage of Xuan Taiyu’s life, the fewer memories there would be.
Very quickly, the scene suddenly disappeared.
Ling Han suddenly opened his eyes.
It was over.
Yi?
On the table, that rock had already turned into ash, but Ling Han had a feeling that something seemed to have fused into his body, causing an indescribable change to take place in his inner world.
However, this change was too subtle.
For the moment, Ling Han couldn’t say what it was, but he believed that it was like a seed had been planted.
Not long after, it would break out of the ground and bring about an earth-shattering change.
“Also, my connection with this place has become stronger again.” Ling Han waved his hand, and five eight-star Regulations appeared.
Five flashes!
That was because he had a stronger connection with that decapitated stone statue.
With a single thought, the power of belief would be endlessly used by him, helping him to unleash astonishing battle prowess.
And this was still because the stone statue had already been destroyed, and had not been replenished with power of belief for who knew how many years.
On the other hand, it was only slowly seeping away.
Thus, the fact that it could still increase Ling Han’s battle prowess by five stars of Saint-level could be considered incredibly awesome.
“Unfortunately, I didn’t get the Imperial Scroll, nor did I get the Imperial Weapon.” Ling Han shook his head.
The previous scenes were too fast, and when he could see clearly, Xuan Taiyu hadn’t experienced any great battles, and had to use the Imperial Weapon.
Moreover, the Great Emperor was invincible in this era, so did he still need the Imperial Weapon to help him in battle?
The existence of the Imperial Weapon was more of an inheritance that could eternally stabilize the fortune of an Imperial Clan.
“No matter what, I seem to have gained something.”
Though he temporarily did not understand what that was.
Ling Han exited the small courtyard.
Through the damaged stone statue, he had already completely grasped this place.
He could confirm that there was nothing else here.
“If I don’t mind extracting the power of belief from the stone statue in a destructive manner, I can even battle against or even kill a nine-star Saint,” Ling Han murmured.
“However, this way, the remaining power of belief in the stone statue will definitely dissipate completely.”
“That doesn’t matter.
In any case, I don’t live here.”
He was just about to leave, when he saw a large number of Saints approach him.
It was Brother Monkey, Ding Shu and the Imperial Sons.
Realization dawned on Ling Han.
By the looks of it, the Holy Flame Tree had already finished burning, so these people had begun to explore again.
Though the Holy Flame Tree was overwhelmingly awesome, there were really too many Saints here.
Thus, after some dividing, everyone would have improved, but not by much.
There was nothing that could be done.
There was not enough to go around.
“Ling Han!” When they saw him, everyone exclaimed in shock.
“Humph, where do you think you’re going?” Yan Anming asked coldly.
Ling Han couldn’t help but smile, and said slowly to him, “Is this your attitude towards a hero?”
Hero?
Yan Anming was just about to reprimand, but upon further thought, it was true.
The Golden Generation had all been defeated in front of Yang Yihuan and the others.
One galaxy after another, they had lost, right until Ling Han stepped out, and only then did they manage to turn the tide.
Instead, they had won 27 galaxies for the Living Realm.
This kind of merit could be said to shake the heavens.
In comparison, what was he, Yan Anming, worth?
He only had the body of a Saint, yet what had he done for the Living Realm?
Yan Anming was rendered speechless.
At present, Ling Han was worshipped by everyone in the world, and had risen to the height of a savior.
The only one who could compare to him was Buddha Doga.
He resolutely didn’t tangle with Ling Han.
It wasn’t like he didn’t know that Ling Han was famous for having a sharp tongue.
“You should have obtained the treasures left behind by the Great Emperor, right?” he asked.
When these words fell, all the Saints’ eyes focused on Ling Han.
So what if they were Saints?
Faced with the inheritance of a Great Emperor, their hearts still beat faster.
To say nothing of becoming Emperor, just reading a different Imperial Scroll might be enough to help them advance another level on the path of a Saint.
Ling Han chuckled, and his eyes swept over everyone.
Aside from Brother Monkey, the large black dog and the others, there was a sliver of greed in everyone’s expressions.
He shook his head, “If I said no, you guys wouldn’t believe me either, right?”
Of course, this was the residence of the Great Emperor.
Whether it was the Imperial Weapon or the Imperial Scroll, they were definitely hidden here, and not only was Ling Han the first to enter, he was clearly planning to leave.
Hence, if it was claimed that Ling Han had not gained anything, who would believe it?
—Without any gains, why would you leave?
“Hand over the Imperial Scroll and the Imperial Weapon!” an old Saint commanded.
Because he was a Four-Star Saint, and had a crushing advantage in terms of abilities, he naturally had the right to speak in this manner.

chapters.title: Chapter 4620: One Against Ten
paragraphs: Chapter 4620: One Against Ten
Ling Han smiled and said, “Even if I truly obtained the Imperial Scroll and the Imperial Weapon, why would I hand them over?”

“Firstly, this is a crucial period in the resistance against the Netherworld. The Imperial Scroll can increase everyone’s strength, so you shouldn’t be so selfish. You should view things for the benefit of the whole universe,” the old Saint said.
“Secondly, you already have a piece of Origin Gold, so it would be meaningless for you to obtain another Imperial Weapon.”

Even if it was the Great Emperor, he could only unleash the full might of a single Imperial Weapon at one time. Thus, possessing two such weapons couldn’t increase one’s battle prowess. What was the use of being greedy?

Ling Han couldn’t help but laugh heartily. “Going by that logic, shouldn’t it be you people who should hand over the Imperial Scroll? Come, you can set everyone an example and benefit the people of the universe!”
The old Saint was instantly enraged.
How could this be compared?
The inheritance of the Great Emperor here was an ownerless object, but what about the Imperial Clan?

That was a whole clan. If they handed over the Imperial Scroll, would the Imperial Clan still be able to stand high and mighty? Furthermore, the one only needed to cultivate the corresponding Imperial Scroll to be able to wield the Imperial Weapon. Then wouldn’t that cause the Imperial Clan to lose the most important foundation?
How could an ownerless object be compared?
“Ling Han, don’t pester endlessly and confuse the concept,” the old Saint chided.
Yi, it was similarly handing over the Imperial Scroll, and if I don’t, I am pestering endlessly?
‘Tsk, tsk, tsk. I haven’t asked you to hand over the Imperial Weapon yet.’

“Ling Han, you are too selfish!” Han Yun also stepped out, “This is the inheritance of the Great Emperor, and should belong to everyone in the universe, yet you are selfishly taking it for yourself. How could you not know that what is important is the good of the universe!”
“That’s right!” Another Imperial Son stepped out, “Ling Han, in the face of great righteousness, you must stand firm!”
“Don’t be blinded by your own selfish desires!” A third Imperial Son also stepped out.

“Tsk!” Brother Monkey couldn’t hold it in any longer. He drew out his metal rod and waved it in the air. Then, he pointed at the Saints from afar, “Old Sun is really disgusted by you hypocritical guys to death. Come, whoever wants Old Sun’s brother’s stuff, just come up. See if Old Sun won’t beat you into mush!”
The large black dog and little azure dragon didn’t speak, but they silently stood by Ling Han’s side, expressing their support through their actions.
Chi Menghan naturally wouldn’t back down. She similarly stood beside Ling Han, and drew a dagger. A saintly might appeared faintly.
However, five Saints were pitifully few in front of so many Saints.
Meanwhile, Ding Shu and the others took a few steps back. This was a statement of their stand. They would not make a move to deal with Ling Han, but they would not help either.
They would sit by and watch, maintaining a neutral stance.

With their identities, being able to maintain neutrality was actually already helping Ling Han. After all, they were all rulers of Genesis Worlds, so even if they weren’t freakish like Ling Han, their abilities were still far superior to the Golden Generation. How could they be underestimated?
“Brother Monkey, Old Black, you guys step back first.” Ling Han turned his head and said to the four people beside him, “Let me go first. When I can’t hold on any longer, you guys go first.”
Yi?
Brother Monkey and the others were all curious. Faced with so many Saints, Ling Han actually still insisted on a battle?
However, they were all very familiar with Ling Han. Since he said so, he must have considerable confidence.
“All right!” Brother Monkey and the others all stepped back slightly.
Ling Han cracked a smile, looked at those Golden Generations, and said calmly, “Anyone not convinced? Come, I’ll beat you until you’re convinced.”
“Ling Han, you are too arrogant!” The members of the Golden Generation were all furious.
In a one-on-one battle, you are indeed freakish, but your battle prowess would only be three or four stars, at most. How could you possibly be able to block the combined forces of a few Saints?

“Humph, everyone attack together!” Han Yun waved his arm and shouted. “This time, it’s for the safety of our Living Realm. We definitely can’t allow this selfish person to take the Imperial Scroll and flee.”
“All right!” Several Imperial Sons nodded.
Ling Han couldn’t help but chuckle, saying, “I’ve never seen anyone as shameless as you people.”
“Charge!” Han Yun took the lead, and seven Imperial Sons had already charged over together.

Boom, boom, boom! Saint-level attacks were far too terrifying. They could obliterate a planet in just a few exchanges. However, this was the Great Emperor Mystery Realm, where the Regulations of the Great Emperor had transformed into defenses. Saint-level power couldn’t penetrate these defenses at all.
Thus, the energy of this sealed off space surged madly. Every power was capable of easily tearing apart a planet, yet was wreaking havoc here.
Fortunately, all of the people here were Saints. Otherwise, they would have definitely been smashed into smithereens by the shockwave.

Ling Han was indeed very strong. With 30 Seven Star Regulations intertwined together, he could match three Eight Star Regulations, which was equivalent to a three-star Saint’s battle prowess. Added with Destructive Energy and the like, his battle prowess could be further boosted, reaching the level of Four Stars.
However, Han Yun and the others weren’t weak either.

Each person could blast out two flashes of eight-star Regulations, and added with the help of the Saint Tool, it was no issue for battle prowess to surge up to three stars. Thus, in a one-on-one battle, they were definitely no match for Ling Han.
If it was seven against one?
Then, sorry.

For Saints, the gap of one star of battle prowess would need three to four Saints to make up for it. Thus, if the seven Saints joined forces, it was equivalent to increasing their battle prowess by two stars of battle prowess.
As a result… Ling Han was at a disadvantage in a battle of five stars against four stars.

Thankfully, Ling Han had also grasped Phoenix Wings Divine Flight. This movement technique was too kickass. Even if he was ganged up on by the seven Saints, he would still be able to easily tear a hole in their siege and escape.
Thus, though Ling Han’s battle prowess was far inferior, there was no danger to his life.
But no matter what, he was still at a disadvantage.
“Phoenix Wings Divine Flight is indeed the number one movement technique in the world!”
“If I can obtain it…”
A great many people looked envious. This was the Imperial Technique of the True Phoenix, and the inheritance had originated from the heaven and earth. It was overwhelmingly awesome.
Otherwise, Ling Han would have definitely been ganged up on and killed long ago.
Saints were extremely difficult to kill, and this was based on the fact that they were hellbent on fleeing.
Ling Han hadn’t summoned the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower yet, because he didn’t need to.
A mere seven Saints were completely not enough to pose a threat to his life, so there was naturally no need for him to use the Pseudo-Imperial Weapon.
“Against this kind of selfish person, there is no need for any rules!” Another Imperial Son declared. Then, shamelessly, he drew out his Saint Tool, and joined the battle.
“That’s right. For the sake of the universe, so what if we bear infamy?” The ninth Golden Generation charged out.
“I believe that future generations will redeem our name!” The tenth Golden Generation also joined the battle.
Ten against one!
This time, even if Ling Han had the world’s number one movement technique, it was still barely enough.
After all, he was only a Venerate, and not a true Saint.
He moved with great difficulty, but the space left for him became smaller and smaller.
Han Yun and the others sealed off the space with Regulations, continuously compressing Ling Han’s space of movement.
When Ling Han no longer had any space to dodge, he could only face the Imperial Sons head-on, and fight the ten Saints all by himself. Was there any need to speak of the result?
Chi Menghan couldn’t help but feel worried. Her fists were already clenched tightly.
“Sister-in-law, don’t worry,” the large black dog said with a smile. “Little Han has never fought a battle that he’s not confident in, so don’t worry.”
Actually, Chi Menghan also believed in Ling Han, but seeing how intense the battle was, she couldn’t help but worry.
More importantly, how was Ling Han going to turn the tables?

chapters.title: Chapter 4621: Destroy you all
paragraphs: Chapter 4621: Destroy you all
It had to be admitted that Ling Han had created too many miracles.
When he was only a Sect Master, he was already capable of defeating all Venerates. After becoming a Venerate, he possessed strength that could match Saints. He was a freak.

Thus, even if Ling Han was at a disadvantage right now, and no one could imagine that he had any chance of turning the tables, as long as he hadn’t admitted defeat or been defeated, everyone would still feel uncertain.
Perhaps… he was going to perform another miracle.
However, he really should not have any more trump cards left.
This was a Great Emperor Mystery Realm, so it was impossible to use the ley lines. In other words, this crippled Ling Han’s strongest ability in formations.
Thus, everyone wracked their brains, but still could not think of any possibility for Ling Han to turn the tables.
This time, he should really be at his wit’s end.
The ten Saints continued to increase pressure, wanting to deal with Ling Han as soon as possible.

Firstly, it was for the sake of obtaining the treasure trove of the Great Emperor as soon as possible, and secondly, these 10 Saints had actually failed to take down a Venerate after so long. How humiliating!
“Ling Han, you had best admit defeat obediently!” Han Yun said with a smile. At this moment, he finally felt like everything was under control.
Who knows, he might even be able to take advantage of the opening to kill Ling Han.
Thinking of this tempting possibility, he couldn’t help but help but feel a killing intent rise up in his heart.
Ling Han shook his head with a smile, “Do you guys think that this is my full battle prowess?”
He channelled the four pinnacle pillars, and instantly, a space under his absolute control was created.
Within the range covered by the four pinnacle pillars, he was the ruler of everything.
Weng!

To his surprise, he discovered that the dimensions in his body were actually cooperating with the four pinnacle pillars. Endless power of life surged out, further increasing the might of the four pinnacle pillars.
This had not happened before.
Could it be that this was the effect of the Divine Stone that he had absorbed?
After he absorbed it, there was not the slightest bit of change. He could barely sense any changes, but at this moment, Ling Han was certain that this was the effect of that stone.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
The attacks shot over, yet were unable to break through the space that the four pinnacle pillars had stretched out.
All the Saints were rendered speechless with shock.

They had all come up from the Fourth Extreme, so they naturally knew that the four pinnacle pillars could hold up the sky, and could boost battle prowess or defense. However, Ling Han was too terrifying. He had directly set up an absolute domain that even the power of Saints could not break through. This was something that they could not imagine at all.
To say nothing of them, even Ling Han hadn’t expected this.
However, he naturally could only be happy about this.
“Bunch of trash, I’ll crush you all!” Ling Han laughed loudly, and charged towards the ten Saints with the four pinnacle pillars.
Boom!
The attacks of the 10 Saints were completely useless against the space created by the four pinnacle pillars.
Of course, Ling Han also felt that the life force in his body was rapidly being consumed. The price of showing off like this was exorbitant.

But others did not know. They only saw that Ling Han had completely ignored the attacks of the ten Saints, causing their scalps to go numb, and they really wanted to grab their heads and exclaim in shock.
With a thought from Ling Han, he opened a hole in the space created by the four pinnacle pillars, and instantly, Han Yun had entered inside.
It was impossible for him to defeat all 10 Saints in one go. Thus, since he had an absolute defense, he naturally had to defeat them one by one.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
On the outside, the attacks of the nine Saints continued, but they were all blocked by the four pinnacle pillars. And within, Ling Han and Han Yun were fighting one-on-one.
“Come, I’ll give you a chance to defeat me,” Ling Han said calmly. He was calculating in his mind. The power of living beings in the dimensions could still be maintained for about three minutes.
Thus, he could still act cool for three minutes. He had to defeat Han Yun within this time limit.
It was no big deal.
Meanwhile, Han Yun was dumbfounded. How had the situation become like this?
How could he possibly win against Ling Han alone?
It was clear that he was surrounded by companions, yet he felt incredibly lonely.
“Useless trash!” Ling Han sneered, and charged over.
Peng!

What kind of battle prowess did he have? In the first place, he was already superior to Han Yun, and at this moment, Han Yun had completely lost his fighting spirit, so he was naturally even more outmatched.
In just a few dozen moves, Han Yun was completely unable to fight back. If the battle continued, he would definitely die.
That was because he was completely unable to break through the blockade formed by the four pinnacle pillars.
This caused a chill to rise up in the hearts of all the Saints.

It should be known that Saints were very difficult to kill. This was a publicly acknowledged fact. Thus, if one could not kill a Saint, it was best not to offend him too deeply. Otherwise, if he was targeted by a Saint every day, that would really be extremely terrible.
But now?
Ling Han was actually capable of trapping a Saint!
He was only a Venerate. If this guy became a Saint, then wouldn’t he be able to kill any Saint he wanted?
How could the Saints not feel a chill in their hearts?
Saints were transcendent beings, and even One Star Saints didn’t need to fear nine-star Saints at all. Even if they couldn’t defeat them, they could still flee. They had a wide path of retreat.
Hiss!
“Humph, selfish person, you still dare to commit violence?” The Qiantian Saint humphed coldly, brandishing his Saint Tool as he charged over.
Boom!
With a loud bang, the four pinnacle pillars instantly crumbled.
Though this was awesome, its might was not without limits. After all, Ling Han was only a Three Star Venerate.
Han Yun could be said to have escaped from the clutches of death, and hurriedly slipped back into the ranks of the Imperial Clan elites. Now, he did not dare to battle Ling Han again.
Ling Han frowned and said, “Old geezer, do you still have any shame?”
“Insignificant brat, you actually dare to insult me!” The Qiantian Saint brandished his Saint Tool, and struck out at Ling Han.
A Four-Star Saint added with a Saint Tool, his battle prowess was at least five stars.
Boom!
With this strike, Ling Han was instantly sent flying. He was completely outmatched.
It could not be helped. In terms of power, he was far too inferior.
If a Saint was shameless, he was invincible in this world!
The Qiantian Saint attacked madly with an advantage of at least two stars of battle prowess. Though Ling Han tried his best to parry, there was nothing he could do.
The four pinnacle pillars were also useless. The gulf between their battle prowess was far too great, and they were completely unable to block a single strike from the Qiantian Saint.
This time, Ling Han should have lost all hope.
No one could think of any other trump card that Ling Han could have up his sleeve. He was really at the end of his rope.

But how had the Imperial Clans treated him?
Since you guys are so shameless, then I will kill all of you and turn the world upside down!
With a thought from Ling Han, he stimulated the power of belief on the stone statue, allowing it to enter his body.
“Scram!” he shouted loudly, and shot out a fist, directly facing the Qiantian Saint.
F***, where did you get such courage from?

If they were so determined to seek death, Saints could also die very quickly.

Peng!

It had to be admitted that Ling Han had created too many miracles.
When he was only a Sect Master, he was already capable of defeating all Venerates.
After becoming a Venerate, he possessed strength that could match Saints.
He was a freak.

Thus, even if Ling Han was at a disadvantage right now, and no one could imagine that he had any chance of turning the tables, as long as he hadn’t admitted defeat or been defeated, everyone would still feel uncertain.
Perhaps… he was going to perform another miracle.
However, he really should not have any more trump cards left.
This was a Great Emperor Mystery Realm, so it was impossible to use the ley lines.
In other words, this crippled Ling Han’s strongest ability in formations.
Thus, everyone wracked their brains, but still could not think of any possibility for Ling Han to turn the tables.
This time, he should really be at his wit’s end.
The ten Saints continued to increase pressure, wanting to deal with Ling Han as soon as possible.
Firstly, it was for the sake of obtaining the treasure trove of the Great Emperor as soon as possible, and secondly, these 10 Saints had actually failed to take down a Venerate after so long.
How humiliating!
“Ling Han, you had best admit defeat obediently!” Han Yun said with a smile.
At this moment, he finally felt like everything was under control.
Who knows, he might even be able to take advantage of the opening to kill Ling Han.
Thinking of this tempting possibility, he couldn’t help but help but feel a killing intent rise up in his heart.
Ling Han shook his head with a smile, “Do you guys think that this is my full battle prowess?”
He channelled the four pinnacle pillars, and instantly, a space under his absolute control was created.
Within the range covered by the four pinnacle pillars, he was the ruler of everything.
Weng!
To his surprise, he discovered that the dimensions in his body were actually cooperating with the four pinnacle pillars.
Endless power of life surged out, further increasing the might of the four pinnacle pillars.
This had not happened before.
Could it be that this was the effect of the Divine Stone that he had absorbed?
After he absorbed it, there was not the slightest bit of change.
He could barely sense any changes, but at this moment, Ling Han was certain that this was the effect of that stone.
Hong!
Hong!
Hong!
The attacks shot over, yet were unable to break through the space that the four pinnacle pillars had stretched out.
All the Saints were rendered speechless with shock.
They had all come up from the Fourth Extreme, so they naturally knew that the four pinnacle pillars could hold up the sky, and could boost battle prowess or defense.
However, Ling Han was too terrifying.
He had directly set up an absolute domain that even the power of Saints could not break through.
This was something that they could not imagine at all.
To say nothing of them, even Ling Han hadn’t expected this.
However, he naturally could only be happy about this.
“Bunch of trash, I’ll crush you all!” Ling Han laughed loudly, and charged towards the ten Saints with the four pinnacle pillars.
Boom!
The attacks of the 10 Saints were completely useless against the space created by the four pinnacle pillars.

The price of showing off like this was exorbitant.
But others did not know.
They only saw that Ling Han had completely ignored the attacks of the ten Saints, causing their scalps to go numb, and they really wanted to grab their heads and exclaim in shock.

Thus, since he had an absolute defense, he naturally had to defeat them one by one.
Hong!
Hong!
Hong!

And within, Ling Han and Han Yun were fighting one-on-one.

He was calculating in his mind.
The power of living beings in the dimensions could still be maintained for about three minutes.
Thus, he could still act cool for three minutes.

It was no big deal.
Meanwhile, Han Yun was dumbfounded.
How had the situation become like this?
How could he possibly win against Ling Han alone?
It was clear that he was surrounded by companions, yet he felt incredibly lonely.
“Useless trash!” Ling Han sneered, and charged over.

chapters.title: Chapter 4622: Kill All
paragraphs: Chapter 4622: Kill All
Eight-star Regulations!
Ling Han could actually channel eight stars Regulations?
Hold on, he had become a Saint?
That’s not right. Just now, he had clearly shot out four pinnacle pillars, which clearly meant that he was still a Venerate.

Moreover, after becoming a Saint, when the holy flame burned, no matter what, there would still be a sliver of aura surging, but on Ling Han, there really was not the slightest bit of Saint-level aura.
If it was claimed that Ling Han was a Saint, no one would believe it.
However, since he wasn’t a Saint, how could he use eight-star Regulations? Moreover, it wasn’t just one, but five!
Boom! With a single strike, the Qiantian Saint was instantly sent flying, his Saintly blood spraying through the air.
This was a Four-Star Saint! Now, even he was no match for Ling Han?
Ling Han took advantage of his victory to follow up with a barrage of punches.
Kill, kill, kill, these hypocrites, what was the point of them living?

The present him was equivalent to being able to unleash eight flashes of eight-star Regulations, which was far superior to the Qiantian Saint. Even if the latter had a Saint Tool in his hands, he was still no match, and in Ling Han’s hands, he was like a toy.
This rendered Ding Shu and the others speechless. One had to realize that when Ling Han had battled Yang Yihuan and the others, he clearly hadn’t possessed such battle prowess.
Only a few days had passed, so how could Ling Han’s strength have increased so explosively?
“Enough!” The Xuan Huo Saint moved. He raised a palm and delivered a palm strike at Ling Han.
He was an eight-star Saint, and he had mastered as many as 12 eight-star Regulations. Thus, just how terrifying was the power of his casual attack?
Ling Han didn’t dare to face it head-on, and hurriedly dodged. Otherwise, it would really be a suicidal action.
Boom!
This strike was like a river, forcibly splitting the underground space into two.
Ling Han stood on one side, while the Qiantian Saint stood on the other.
The might of a single strike was actually so terrifying.

The Qiantian Saint was utterly humiliated. He was a Saint of the older generation, and had lived for hundreds of thousands of years. Yet, he had almost been beaten to burst by a Venerate that had yet to become a Saint. How could he accept this?
Everyone sighed ruefully. Could it be that the level of Ling Han’s counterattack had already leaped from the level of the Golden Generation to the level of the Saints of the older generation?
It should be known that after the Qiantian Saint, it was Xuan Huo Saint and the other eight or nine-star Saints’ turn. These were also the supreme elites that the various Imperial Clans had.
“You want a beating too?” Ling Han stared at Xuan Huo Saint, his eyes filled with killing intent.
At this moment, he didn’t want to feign civility with the Imperial Clans anymore.
He was too displeased. He just wanted to kill someone.
The Xuan Huo Saint couldn’t help but shiver in anger. He was an eight-star Saint, so how long had he been alive for?
To say nothing of newly advanced Saints like the Golden Generations and the others, even the Qiantian Saint would have to pay his respects when he saw him.
Now that Ling Han was treating him with such disdain, he was naturally filled with killing intent.
“You’re seeking death!” he humphed, and stretched out a hand to grab Ling Han.
This place was a cage, and it was the best opportunity to kill Ling Han.
—If this young prodigy was not eliminated, would the Golden Generation have any chance of becoming Emperor?
“Old b@stard, I will beat out all your teeth!” Ling Han humphed lightly. Who cares!
‘Come!’

He extracted the power of belief from the damaged stone statue at all costs. After this, the stone statue would be completely destroyed, and could no longer be used. However, being boosted by such a majestic power of belief, Ling Han’s battle prowess would also reach a terrifying level.

Weng, multiple streaks of golden light appeared, enshrouding Ling Han. They intertwined to form what looked like Battle Armor, and there were seals flickering within the golden light, densely packed together.
“Power of belief!”
“Heavens, how could there be such pure, dense power of belief?”
“A Saint would definitely not be able to condense this kind of power of belief!”
Everyone exclaimed in shock, as if they had seen a ghost.
“I understand!”
“I understand as well!”
A considerable number of people immediately nodded repeatedly, realization dawning on their faces.𝘧𝘳𝘦ℯ𝓌𝘦𝒷𝘯𝑜𝑣𝘦𝓁.𝒸𝘰𝓂
“No wonder Ling Han can use the eight-star Regulations, because he has the blessing of the power of belief.”
“But the problem is, without becoming a Saint, how can one use the power of belief?”
“This is probably his freakishness.”

“No, no, no. Previously, when he was fighting Yang Yihuan and the others, it was obvious that he was still unable to use the power of belief. Furthermore, this power of belief is too dense and too pure. It is not something that a Saint can condense at all!”
“It’s the Great Emperor!”
“This guy has really obtained the inheritance of the Great Emperor!”
Everyone no longer had any doubts. Ling Han must have obtained the treasures left behind by the Great Emperor. Otherwise, how could he suddenly be able to use the power of belief?
Peng!
The Xuan Huo Saint’s attack landed on Ling Han’s golden armor, yet it was completely ineffective. It was as if it had been absorbed.
Ling Han threw another punch. It was clearly still very far away, but a golden streak shot out, as if it was a God Tool, slashing towards the Xuan Huo Saint.
Gods!
Everyone could clearly see that this whip was actually formed from nineteen streaks of eight-star Regulations.
His lifespan was nearing its end; how was he supposed to block this?
The Xuan Huo Saint also paled in fright. After becoming a Saint for so many years, this was definitely the greatest danger he had ever encountered.
Nineteen flashes of eight-star Regulations were enough to kill any Saint.
He hurriedly fled, not daring to face it head-on.
“Old b@stard, where do you think you’re going!” Ling Han chased after him. He didn’t care about anything else, and started a massacre.
You guys want to kill me? Fine, I’ll send you on your way first!
“So what if it is the Imperial Clans?”
“Die!”
The Xuan Huo Saint ran as fast as he could, yet there were far too many Imperial Sons here. Which of them was faster than Ling Han?
Boom, the golden ribbon swept past. This was a web of nineteen eight-star Regulations, which was indescribably terrifying.
Pa! Pa! Pa!
In this Great Emperor Mystery Realm, even Saints were unable to tear a rip into space and flee. They were trapped, and instantly, a considerable number of Imperial Sons were killed.
“That’s right. So what if you’re a member of the Imperial Clan? You think your d*ck is larger?” the large black dog shouted.
This!
As the Saints fled for their lives, they were also muttering in their minds. This dog was truly despicable. He was far too crude and vulgar.
Ling Han almost laughed out loud in anger. F***, he was just killing in all directions, so don’t suddenly ruin the atmosphere at this time.
But in the next instant, he once again turned into a god of death, and began a mad massacre.
With the blessing of the power of belief, he was completely invincible.
“Ling Han, you’ve gone crazy!”
“We are all the main force of resistance against the Yin souls. If you massacre us like this, you will push the Living Realm into an abyss of no return!”
“Stop!”
The Saints all shouted loudly, wanting to use righteousness to force Ling Han to stop.

Meanwhile, Ling Han laughed loudly, and said, “How laughable! Speaking of resisting the invasion of the Netherworld, how can your combined merits compare to mine? In terms of future potential, you people aren’t even worthy of being mentioned in the same breath as me!”
“When you guys were fighting just now, why didn’t you mention the Netherworld?”
“Bunch of selfish people, what’s the point of living?”
“All of you, die!”
Ling Han attacked mercilessly.
How many Yin souls had he killed?
With the boost of Destructive Energy, aside from Ding Shu and the others, who else was qualified to compare to him?
And as long as he became a Saint, he would definitely be able to possess the power of Pseudo-Emperor. At that time, when all the Saints were added together, would they be as useful as him alone?
‘So, since you people want to kill me regardless of the big picture, why should I be trapped and helpless?’

chapters.title: Chapter 4623: The Saints’ Death Day
paragraphs: Chapter 4623: The Saints’ Death Day
This day could be called the Saints’ Death Day.
A large number of Saints were mercilessly killed by Ling Han. Practically all the Golden Generation Saints were killed, and only a limited few managed to escape.
“Ling Han, you will be punished by the heavens!” the Xuan Huo Saint shouted.

“Humph, what right do you have to represent the Heavenly Dao?” Ling Han charged out from underground, the power of belief continuously surging into his body. He had a shield of power of belief, and even an eight-star Saint would not be able to break through it.
Moreover, he could unleash 19 eight-star Regulations with a single strike. So what if he was a nine-star Saint? Would he be able to withstand such an attack?
At this moment, Ling Han was absolutely invincible among Saints.
If the Pseudo-Emperor didn’t appear, who could compete with him?
Right until they charged out of the outermost wall, did the power of belief finally separate from Ling Han.
He couldn’t borrow any more power.
Ling Han remained calm and collected. There was still a remnant golden shield on him, and it was completely capable of scaring people.
All the Saints were already terrified by him, so who else dared to step forward?
“Let’s go,” Ling Han whispered.
The large black dog understood his meaning. Ling Han was already putting on a strong front, and now he was just bluffing.
“Brats, not one of you can fight. Grandpa Dog won’t play with you guys anymore.” It tore open space, and everyone prepared to retreat.
Hu!
Seeing that they were about to leave, the remaining Saints all gasped for breath.
Thankfully, they were still alive.
However, only an instant later, realization dawned on them.
F***, with Ling Han’s personality, in a situation when he had the absolute advantage, would he just run like that?
Thus, there was only one possibility.
That was, Ling Han was already spent, and it was impossible for his battle prowess to recover.
However, there was already a rip torn in the Void, and Ling Han and the others could leave with a single step. It was already too late to stop them.
This was the Ancestral King City, yet Ling Han had unleashed a massacre. In a single battle, more than thirty Saints had died, and the majority of them were Golden Generation Saints.
What kind of concept was this?

The Golden Generation were the most talented clansmen of the Imperial Clans. Even though they were only One Star Saints at this moment, as long as they were given enough time, they could basically reach the height of eight or nine stars in the future.
But now?
Ling Han had almost massacred all of them, and there were practically not many left.
This was really a life-or-death enmity!

Ge Qianqiu!

Who else could it be but Ge Qianqiu?
“Hehe, that’s me.” Ge Qianqiu was dressed in coarse hemp clothing, and looked extremely plain and ordinary.
“Ling Han!” the large black dog urged. To say nothing of the fact that a Nine-Star Saint could appear at any moment, they were no match even for the remaining Saints here.
Ling Han smiled, “It’s fine.”

F***, who was Ge Qianqiu? In the past, he was someone that could contend with a Great Emperor. Even if he had not become Great Emperor in the end, he must still be astonishingly strong. At least, he was sure to be a Nine Star Saint.

They believed in Ling Han.
Ling Han looked towards Ge Qianqiu, and took the initiative to ask, “Senior Ge, have you come for Xuan Taiyu, the Great Emperor Xuan?”
He didn’t know Xuan Taiyu’s title, so he could only address him by surname.
Ge Qianqiu revealed a smile, “You have indeed obtained Xuan Taiyu’s inheritance!”

“Actually, it’s nothing much,” Ling Han said honestly. It was just a single rock, though it had strengthened his inner world, and caused it to have some kind of indescribable resonance with the four pinnacle pillars. Besides that, it was only some historical information.
However, the latter was not beneficial for increasing his strength.
Ge Qianqiu sighed, “I know that it would be abnormal if you could obtain some kind of treasure.”
Yi, it sounded like this old man seemed to know about what had happened back then.
“Senior, may I know what era the Great Emperor Cuan belonged to?” Ling Han asked curiously, because this was also closely related to him.

Wasn’t this underestimating the Imperial Clans?

Fine, since you’re not leaving, then don’t leave.

Ge Qianqiu?
Hehe, this was an unknown Saint, so what need was there for him to take him to heart?

Gods!
Instantly, everyone felt their scalps go numb. A dignified eight-star Saint was actually no match for this mysterious old man?
This… was a nine-star Saint!
Who would have thought that this old geezer that had randomly popped out would actually be the practically greatest level of strength in the world, a nine-star Saint?

The Xuan Huo Saint also gritted his teeth. He had been no match for this attack, but he hadn’t suffered any injuries either. However, how could he be so unlucky? He had actually encountered a nine-star Saint!
It should be known that not every Imperial Clan possessed such an existence. Added together, there would not be more than the sum of the fingers on two hands.

There was no need to think about the Holy Lands, unless it was something like the Nine Suns Saint, an existence that had been able to contend with the Great Emperor in the past. Otherwise, without the help of the Imperial Scroll, how could one possibly cultivate to nine stars?
Thus, Xuan Huo Saint was extremely astonished when he discovered that Ge Qianqiu was actually a nine-star Saint.
However, he did not lose his temper. Instead, a cold smirk appeared at the corners of his lips.
This was because the eight-star and nine-star Saints from the Imperial Clans were rushing over.
—Even if the nine-star Saint did not arrive, four to five eight-star Saints working together would be enough to stand against a nine-star Saint.
Xiu, xiu, xiu! Space was continuously torn apart, and multiple white-haired Saints walked out.
These were really the old Saints. All of them had lived for at least 700,000 years, and were close to the end of their lives.
However, even if they still had 10,000 years to live, that was still an incredibly long time. It was enough time for them to render fear in others.
“Friend, you can leave now,” a nine-star Saint said.
He was an old Saint of the Baili Clan, and his title was Three Waters.
Ge Qianqiu couldn’t help but smile, “If I want to leave, I will. If I want to stay, I will. Who needs approval?”
How domineering!
Everyone sighed internally. A nine-star Saint was indeed awesome. Even in the face of so many high-level Saints, he was still completely unfazed.
Meanwhile, Ling Han knew this better than anyone else. This person had competed with the Great Emperor before, so how could he not be domineering?
It could be said that the fact that Ge Qianqiu hadn’t become Emperor was perhaps not because his natural talent was inferior, but rather because he had been slightly unlucky.

The Three Waters Saint couldn’t help but raise his white brows. If time had been reversed by two to three hundred years, at that time, Buddha Doga, the Master of Yin River, and the others had not appeared, nine-star Saints were definitely the strongest in the world.
And now, he had encountered provocation.
“You’re seeking death!” He moved, and grabbed out at Ge Qianqiu. His demonic palm blotted out the skies, enshrouding Ling Han, the large black dog and the others.

chapters.title: Chapter 4624: Pseudo-Emperor Ge Qianqiu
paragraphs: Chapter 4624: Pseudo-Emperor Ge Qianqiu
Just how terrifying was the attack of a Nine-Star Saint?

In an era when there was no Emperor in the world, this was practically the strongest battle prowess in the universe. With a single palm strike, it was guaranteed that he would be able to directly shatter a star.
Who could stop him?

All the Imperial Clans smirked coldly. Previously, they had not been able to do anything to Ling Han, because Ling Han already possessed the power of a Saint. If he wanted to flee, he could. Even a Nine-Star Saint would not be able to stop him.
But this time, Ling Han was actually so stupid as to stay behind.
Hehe, did he think that old geezer would be able to block a nine-star Saint?
Even if he could, so what? How many nine-star Saints and eight-star Saints were there here?
The combined efforts of these supreme elites of the current era had already sealed off the space. There was absolutely no way that Ling Han could tear a rip into the Void and flee.
Thus, this group of people were now trapped.
Just wait for death.
Ge Qianqiu shook his head, and casually waved his palm, saying, “Get lost!”
His words were equivalent to law!
Peng! The Three Waters Saint was sent flying with a single strike, and he instantly disappeared into space, becoming a tiny dot in the distance.
‘Holy f*ck!’
In an instant, everyone was dumbfounded.
What was going on here?
What kind of battle prowess was this?
‘F*ck!’
Even Ling Han hadn’t expected this. At first, he was stunned, then realization dawned on him.
This old man was a Pseudo-Emperor!

Otherwise, Old Man Ge’s natural talent in cultivation would be extremely awesome, just like Ling Han, possessing Pseudo-Emperor-level battle prowess when he was only a Saint. Otherwise, how could he have sent a nine-star Saint flying with a single palm strike?
As a kickass big shot that could compete with Xuan Taiyu, there didn’t seem to be any problem for him to become a Pseudo-Emperor, right?
Just like how Buddha Doga had fought with the Ancestral Buddha for the throne. In the end, he had also become the Pseudo-Emperor, and had even lived a second life.
At this moment, the entire universe was completely silent.
Pseudo-Emperor!
When there was no Emperor in the world, this was the true supreme elite.
The Imperial Clans?
Hehe, even with the protection of the Imperial Formation and the Imperial Weapon, they would probably only be able to just barely hide in the ancestral grounds, living in a state of anxiety, right?
With the word ‘Emperor’, it meant invincibility.
“Greetings, Lord Pseudo-Emperor!” Soon, one after another, people paid their respects to Ge Qianqiu.
In the cultivation world, respect for strength was the most important. So what if he was a Saint? In front of a Pseudo-Emperor, he was trash.
Just think about Buddha Doga. Just how many Saints had he killed?
In front of the Pseudo-Emperors, Saints didn’t even have the chance to escape.

More and more people bowed their heads and paid their respects to Ge Qianqiu, though none of them knew the exact origins of this old man. Only those who had participated in the trip to the Island of the Sky would have some slight information about this old man.
Ge Qianqiu waved them off casually, “Step down. This old man wants to discuss some matters with young friend Ling.”

He was still as calm as always, not putting on any airs at all, but since he had already shown the battle prowess of a Pseudo-Emperor, then his words were like law decrees that everyone had to obey strictly?
Did he really think that a Pseudo-Emperor was all that amicable?
Which person who could cultivate to this cultivation level was not resolute and decisive?

All the Saints retreated, especially those eight-star and nine-star Saints from the Imperial Clans. They had come excitedly, yet left with their tails between their legs. This was really a slap to their faces.
They all sighed ruefully. Was Ling Han that hard to kill?
Previously, when Saints and even Venerates couldn’t even be bothered to look directly at Ling Han, Buddha Doga showed his concern for Ling Han, and even helped him resolve a few dangerous situations.
It should be known that if it was not for the fact that they were wary of Buddha Doga, they would have long since sent elites to kill Ling Han.
But now?
Another Ge Qianqiu appeared, and he was also extremely friendly towards Ling Han.
At this moment, would the Imperial Clans still dare to attack Ling Han?

At the very least, it was impossible that high-level Saints would be mobilized to bully the weak. Otherwise, if Ge Qianqiu was angered… hoho, if a Pseudo-Emperor had killing intent, just how terrifying would that be?
Could even the Imperial Formation block the Pseudo-Emperor?
No one knew.

Firstly, there were really too few Pseudo-Emperors, and secondly, no Imperial Clan would be so foolish to really offend a Pseudo-Emperor, so no one knew how long the Imperial Formation could block a Pseudo-Emperor for.
It could be one year or ten years, or it could be endless, or it could only be one day or half a day.
“Are we just going to allow this boy to grow just like that?”
“He killed the most outstanding Imperial Sons of our clans!”
“But… what can be done?”

All the Saints were also helpless. There was no one in this world that would just suffer a beating without fighting back. However, even if they fought back, they still had to abide by the rules. If they bullied the weak with their superior strength, they would definitely become a topic of gossip. Most importantly, there were even two Pseudo-Emperors keeping an eye on them!

Though neither Buddha Doga nor Ge Qianqiu had said anything about whether or not they were allowed to make a move on Ling Han, but just based on the attitude that they showed towards Ling Han, what Imperial Clan would dare to mess around?
The problem was that Ling Han was too freakish. In a battle of equal cultivation levels, who could be a match for him?
In fact, even lower level Saints could only be swept aside.

If it was a fair battle, and Ling Han was severely wounded or even killed in fact, then it was guaranteed that Buddha Doga and Ge Qianqiu would have nothing to say. And if it was a fair battle, then there were two indicators. The first was that their cultivation levels were equal. This was naturally a fair battle.
And there was another… that was of the same age.𝙛𝒓𝓮𝒆𝔀𝒆𝙗𝓷𝒐𝙫𝒆𝙡.𝒄𝓸𝓶
Could they find someone like that?

All the Saints shook their heads. Ling Han was invincible among his peers, and had even swept aside all king tiers under 10,000 years old. Finding an opponent that could fight him fairly was really as difficult as ascending the heavens.
“Er… are we still going to give him the resources that we agreed on?” a Saint asked.
When these words fell, the Saints were naturally even more vexed.

F***, this was a moral kidnapping, causing them to promise Ling Han cultivation resources, but this guy had just gone on a killing spree, killing a great many Imperial Sons, and they still had to “reward” this enemy with cultivation resources?
Wouldn’t they go crazy from anger?
Initially, they naturally ignored this matter. Who asked them to be the victims?
However, with the addition of Ge Qianqiu… they were stuck in a dilemma.
Pseudo-Emperor!
“We wil!” an old Saint said, pinching his nose.
“We’ve already said it. It’s impossible that we won’t give them, but try to give as little as possible.”
“That’s the only way.”
All the Saints looked livid. They were Imperial Clan elites, and it had always been them that would be bullying others. When had they ever suffered such a vexation?
It couldn’t be helped. Who asked Ling Han to have Pseudo-Emperors on his side?

On Ling Han’s side, Old Man Ge casually strolled around the Heavenly Mother Planet. Ling Han followed behind him. Meanwhile, Brother Monkey, the large black dog, and the others tactfully didn’t follow.
“Do you have a lot of questions?” the old man suddenly asked.
Ling Han nodded honestly and without reservations. He did indeed have too many questions.
“Ask away. I’ll tell you everything I know,” Ge Qianqiu said with a nod.
That’s nice; he could finally solve too many unsolved mysteries.
However, Ling Han faltered for a moment. Because he had too many questions, he didn’t know where to begin at this moment.
After a long while, he asked, “Why has Senior not made a move all this while?”
If a Pseudo-Emperor made a move, what was the Skeleton Saint Tool worth?
Ge Qianqiu sighed, “That’s because of the balance.”
“Because of those existences in the Yin River, Blood Sea, and other danger zones?” Ling Han asked.

Pseudo-Emperor!
“We wil!” an old Saint said, pinching his nose.
“We’ve already said it.
It’s impossible that we won’t give them, but try to give as little as possible.”
“That’s the only way.”
All the Saints looked livid.
They were Imperial Clan elites, and it had always been them that would be bullying others.
When had they ever suffered such a vexation?
It couldn’t be helped.
Who asked Ling Han to have Pseudo-Emperors on his side?
On Ling Han’s side, Old Man Ge casually strolled around the Heavenly Mother Planet.
Ling Han followed behind him.
Meanwhile, Brother Monkey, the large black dog, and the others tactfully didn’t follow.
“Do you have a lot of questions?” the old man suddenly asked.
Ling Han nodded honestly and without reservations.
He did indeed have too many questions.
“Ask away.
I’ll tell you everything I know,” Ge Qianqiu said with a nod.
That’s nice; he could finally solve too many unsolved mysteries.
However, Ling Han faltered for a moment.
Because he had too many questions, he didn’t know where to begin at this moment.
After a long while, he asked, “Why has Senior not made a move all this while?”
If a Pseudo-Emperor made a move, what was the Skeleton Saint Tool worth?
Ge Qianqiu sighed, “That’s because of the balance.”
“Because of those existences in the Yin River, Blood Sea, and other danger zones?” Ling Han asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 4625: Twelve Lands of Death
paragraphs: Chapter 4625: Twelve Lands of Death
“That’s right.” Ge Qianqiu nodded, “If we don’t make a move, they won’t either. This is a fragile balance, but for the moment, it won’t be broken.”

Ling Han nodded in understanding. These rulers of danger zones pushed for the Yin souls to invade, so they definitely couldn’t sit by and watch. It was just that it wasn’t time for them to enter the arena yet.
At that time, it would definitely be a terrifying battle. It was unknown whether the Living Realm would be able to continue existing.
“Who exactly are these rulers of these lands of death?” Ling Han asked.

Ge Qianqiu pondered for a moment before replying, “Actually, I’m not sure either. This is because I’m not qualified to participate in such battles. When the ruler of the sea of blood and the others invaded, I was only a Saint. Only Xuan Taiyu faced them alone.”
Hold on!
Ling Han faltered for a moment before asking, “The rulers of these lands invaded a long time ago?”
“That’s right.” Ge Qianqiu nodded.
Ling Han was slightly confused, and he asked, “Even the Great Emperor is unable to kill them?”

The invasion had definitely been pacified. Otherwise, the Living Realm would have long since ceased to exist. However, the problem was that even the Great Emperor was unable to kill these rulers of these lands of peril. F***, these guys were really too awesome, weren’t they?
The appearance of the Great Emperor was synonymous with invincibility. He would be able to suppress an era, right until he died of old age.

Ge Qianqiu shook his head, “When these rulers of the Lands of Death battle, they have the support of the Land of Death behind them. No matter how heavy their injuries are, they can immediately heal. Furthermore, though I had not witnessed it at that time, I am sure that they are all Pseudo-Emperors. In fact, they are just a sliver away from becoming Emperor.”
“There are a total of 12 such rulers of the Twelve Lands of Death, and together with countless Yin Saints, they ganged up on Xuan Taiyu.”

“Although Xuan Taiyu finally pacified the invasion, he also suffered serious injuries. To say nothing of not being able to live a second life, in fact, not long after the battle ended, he couldn’t control his injuries and forcibly collapsed.”
Although the old man’s words were simple, incomparably tragic scenes appeared in Ling Han’s mind.
Xuan Taiyu, this Great Emperor… could practically be said to have died in battle!
The invincible Great Emperor had actually died in battle?
How could this be believed?
How could anyone accept this?

Pseudo-Emperors, no matter how awesome they were, they still had the word “Pseudo” in it. Could twelve Pseudo-Emperors compensate for the gap in power? Even if they were practically immortal existences.
Furthermore, twelve?
Ling Han counted, and there seemed to be only six danger zones that had appeared now, right? Did that mean that there were still six danger zones that had yet to appear?
Hold on, Yang Yihuan, Feng Miaoling, and the others all corresponded to a particular Land of Death, right?
So, now, there were actually seven danger zones that had already appeared?

“Senior, could these rulers of the Lands of Death be the sons of Great Emperors?” Ling Han asked. That was because he was certain that those like Di Wuji and Tong Ming were definitely the sons of Great Emperors.

Ge Qianqiu nodded, “This old geezer also has that deduction, but also can’t quite figure it out. The Demon Wolf Imperial Clan and Black Sunflower Imperial Clan clearly already exist in this world, so why would there suddenly appear an inheritance from a Land of Death?”
Moreover, they had actually caused serious damage to Pseudo-Emperors or even a Great Emperor, and even the Great Emperor was unable to kill them?
Ling Han still felt like he was in a dream.
Could it be that Xuan Taiyu hadn’t stabilized his cultivation level of Great Emperor at that time, and his cultivation level hadn’t reached the level of a true Great Emperor?
“Senior, which era did the Great Emperor Xuan belong to?” Ling Han asked.
Ge Qianqiu smiled, and said slowly, “The one closest to the present generation.”𝑓𝘳𝘦𝑒𝑤𝑒𝘣𝘯ℴ𝘷𝘦𝓁.𝑐𝑜𝑚
What!
Ling Han suddenly recalled that a great battle had once erupted in tens of millions of years, causing a lapse in history.
Could it be?

“At that time, Xuan Taiyu had just become Emperor, and he hadn’t even forged an Imperial Weapon yet, much less created an Imperial Scroll, when the rulers of the Twelve Lands of Death started a great war,” Ge Qianqiu said.
“I believe that if Xuan Taiyu was given a few hundred years’ time, the outcome of the battle would be completely different.”
The old man sighed, appearing very regretful.
He and Xuan Taiyu could be considered lifelong rivals, but at the same time, they were also friends who appreciated each other’s talent.
No wonder.
At least, it could just barely explain Xuan Taiyu’s death in the end. This Great Emperor didn’t even leave behind an inheritance.

“Young friend Ling, in this generation, it will be up to you.” Ge Qianqiu looked at Ling Han smilingly, “The rulers of the Lands of Death are restless again. I guess that in the battle with Xuan Taiyu, they too suffered a massive blow, and have been recuperating all this while. And now, they are about to recover completely.”
“When that time comes, that scene from tens of millions of years ago will repeat itself.”
The pressure was huge.
Ling Han smiled, and said, “Senior is already a Pseudo-Emperor, so your hopes of becoming Emperor should be far above mine.”
Yet Ge Qianqiu shook his head, “I have already fought for it once. Without good fortune on my side, no matter how many times I try, there is no way I can become Emperor.”
Going by that theory, Buddha Doga couldn’t possibly become Emperor, right?
They only had two Pseudo-Emperors on their side, while the Netherworld had twelve on their side. What kind of gaping gulf was this?
Ling Han nodded. He had to become Emperor!

Although Ge Qianqiu was a Pseudo-Emperor, he had already lost the possibility of taking one step further. The only thing he could do now was impede the Lords of the Lands of Death, preventing them from making a move on Ling Han, giving Ling Han time and space to grow.
“Go on,” Ge Qianqiu said. “This old geezer wants to reminisce about my old friend.”
“All right.”
Ling Han returned to meet up with Brother Monkey and the others. He first returned to Nine Suns Holy Land.
When he returned, he related his conversation with Ge Qianqiu. Everyone was stunned, and similarly felt a mountain of pressure.
Pseudo-Emperor … as many as twelve! In fact, these Pseudo-Emperors were strong to the point of being able to take down a Great Emperor.
“So the weakening of the North Heavenly Realm is actually due to the great war between Xuan Taiyu and these rulers of the Lands of Death!” Realization dawned on all of them.

The overall level of cultivation of the North Heavenly Realm was lower than other Heavenly Realms. It was said that this had begun tens of millions of years ago. Now that they made a comparion, the answer to this mystery was naturally clear.
Because of the invasion of the Yin souls, it greatly affected the fortune of the North Heavenly Realm. It was despised by Heavenly Realm, so the world of cultivation naturally did not prosper.
“We have to hurry up and cultivate.”
The situation was too tense. Once the Lords of the Twelve Lands of Death recovered from their injuries, and launched an all-out invasion, how would they be able to stop it?
In the past, they had been blocked because a Great Emperor had sacrificed himself. Now, there was no Great Emperor in this world, so how could they be blocked with just two Pseudo-Emperors?
Afterward, there was still good news, because the cultivation resources of the various Imperial Clans were gradually delivered.
However, there was naturally no holy flame inside, so it was impossible for Brother Monkey and the others to benefit.
Moreover, this was originally meant to be gifted to Ling Han — though the members of the various Imperial Clans were all very reluctant.
Ling Han began to refine these resources, and there was still a question in his mind.
That was the Divine Stone.
After the other Great Emperors died, they wouldn’t leave behind any Divine Stone or whatnot, that could actually form an inner world.
Moreover, taking into account Ding Shu and the others, there were a total of seven Genesis Worlds.
This was too strange.
Ling Han didn’t tell Ge Qianqiu, nor did he ask him about it, because the latter definitely wouldn’t know either.

chapters.title: Chapter 4626: Empress
paragraphs: Chapter 4626: Empress
Ling Han suddenly recalled that in Xuan Taiyu’s memories, he had seen him go to the edge of the universe. In that large fissure, a streak of light had once flown out at an incredibly fast speed.

It was clear that Xuan Taiyu had set off in pursuit, but it was unclear whether he had managed to catch up or not. That was because that was a scene that had flashed past even earlier. It was too fast, and even he had not managed to glimpse it.
So, was this possibly related to the Divine Stone?
Ling Han felt that there was still a need for him to make a trip to the edge of the universe.
Of course, he couldn’t do that now. He had already tried it out with Brother Monkey, but the speed of Saints was still too slow.
However, if he became a Saint, that might not be the case.

If they went to the edge of the universe, firstly, they would have to explore the secrets of that place, and secondly, what if the Battle Saint Emperor and the others had not died, but were merely trapped? Then, if they helped them escape, wouldn’t pacifying the chaos caused by the rulers of the Twelve Lands of Death be a piece of cake?
Even if only the Ancestral King Lingtian and the Battle Saint Emperor appeared, wouldn’t they be able to deal with them?
Ling Han nodded. This was at least a sliver of hope.
He focused on concocting alchemical pills, and ingesting them.
A great volume of Celestial Qi was consumed, and his cultivation level finally began to grow rapidly.

After the limit of three stars, the door to four stars was pushed open without any difficulty. He continued to advance triumphantly, right until he reached the peak stage of four stars, and then took another step, reaching the level of five stars.
However, by this time, he had also used up all his cultivation resources.
After all, only the Donglin Imperial Clan had spared no expense, sending over an ocean’s worth of cultivation resources. However, the other Imperial Clans were only doing this for show.
Sigh, after all was said and done, the Imperial Clans were still selfish.

Ling Han was actually thinking that if some Imperial Clan fully supported him on this matter, even if he wouldn’t repay evil with kindness, he would at least give them face in future and not seek them out for an accounting.
However, the Imperial Clans still had their own plans.
—Who said that you, Ling Han, would definitely be able to become Emperor?

What if their Imperial Son could take this step first? To say the least, wasn’t there still Ding Shu, Origin and the other supreme prodigies? Though they couldn’t compare to Ling Han, they were still very awesome.
So, why did they have to help their enemy grow?
Ling Han nodded. Those Imperial Clans who had completely lost all hope of becoming Emperor should now begin investing in Ding Shu and the others.
He could feel the pressure of time.
Ding Shu and the others were also the Genesis World’s leaders, and their freakish talent was only slightly inferior to his. It was completely possible for them to become Emperor.𝗳𝐫𝚎𝗲𝚠𝚎𝗯𝕟𝐨𝘃𝚎𝗹.𝗰𝗼𝗺
Thus, he had to hurry.
The problem was that the cultivation of a Venerate definitely needed Celestial Qi, and something like Celestial Qi really couldn’t be rushed.
Although the Donglin Imperial Clan had promised that they would definitely give Celestial Qi to Ling Han as long as they obtained it, this would still need time.
Three years, five years, or ten years?

It should be known that Ding Shu and the others also had the Genesis World, and possessed an endless supply of power of belief. Furthermore, they themselves had heaven-defying aptitude, so their improvement in Saint Tier was definitely astonishingly fast.
Ling Han started to run all over the universe.
He was looking for a suitable planet to set up a great formation to hook the Celestial Qi.
The more such formations were, the more Celestial Qi they could obtain.
Heaven does not disappoint those who work hard. He had really found some, and laid out multiple super great formations, communicating with the high-level dimensional space to extract Celestial Qi.
However, without an Imperial Weapon as the formation eye, the efficiency wasn’t high. Moreover, they couldn’t extract high-quality Celestial Qi.
It was better than nothing. Furthermore, Ling Han could also concoct the Nine Emperors Ten Leaves Pill, which could elevate Celestial Qi by one grade.
All of a sudden, another fifty years passed.

Yang Yihuan and the others had not gone back on their word. They had long since handed over the 27 galaxies. However, only a few years had passed, and these galaxies were once again conquered by the Netherworld. Wherever the Skeleton Saint Tool passed, there was practically no one that could match it.
And now, yet another large area of the Living Realm had fallen.
Some Imperial Clans were even planning ahead, using their great power to move the ancestral planet, heading towards the edge of the universe.
In any case, space was astonishingly large, and there were too many depths.

Unfortunately, even the power of Saints had a limit. At most, they could only move a single planet. Otherwise, with how big the universe was, they were completely capable of playing hide and seek with the Netherworld.
Ling Han cultivated to the end of the fifth minor level of the Fourth Extreme. Very easily, he charged up to six stars.
Good news came one after another. The empress and Hu Niu had respectively become Saints!
This made Ling Han overjoyed, and his only regret was that he was actually still a Venerate. He was falling further and further behind.
However, what could he do? A Venerate relied on the Celestial Qi to cultivate, so he could only take things slowly.
A few days later, the large black dog suddenly came to visit.
“You don’t visit unless there’s something important. Old Black, what’s the matter this time?” Ling Han asked.
“Hehe, that’s a good thing!” the large black dog said. He deliberately kept Ling Han in suspense, and didn’t say it immediately.
“Oh, what good thing?” Ling Han played along.
Only then did the large black dog say, “Recently, a huge piece of news has exploded. An ancient treasure trove of a Great Emperor has appeared.”
Ling Han was unmoved. Hadn’t he gone to Xuan Taiyu’s ancestral site before?

“Little Han, how could this be the same?” The large black dog immediately said, “There is no treasure at all at the place of the Great Emperor Xuan. However, this ancient treasure trove of a Great Emperor is different. It is deliberately left behind by a Great Emperor to their descendants.”
“Then tell me,” Ling Han said with a smile.

“This Great Emperor’s title is Qingzhu!” the large black dog said. “It’s rumored that this Great Emperor ascended Dao from an ordinary bamboo stalk. Moreover, this is an Empress! At that time, her bamboo sword swept through the world, and no one could rival her. She ascended to the throne with her greatest talent.”
“Empress Qingzhu has never been married before, so she naturally didn’t have any descendants.”

“In Empress Qingzhu’s last years, she no longer appeared in public. Thus, after she died, no one knew where she placed her inheritance. In fact, no one knew if it had actually been passed down to the next generation.”

“However, according to a maid by Empress Qingzhu’s side, the Empress glimpsed a terrifying future in her later years, and that was why she didn’t appear in public anymore. She was making arrangements to deal with that terrifying future.”
“Say, isn’t this targeting the invasion from the rulers of the Lands of Death?”
“It is said that this ancient trove has the weapon of the Empress, that bamboo sword that has fought all over the universe!”
“That was created by the Empress from a part of her body. Even among Imperial Weapons, it is still an incredibly powerful existence.”
The large black dog rubbed his hands together, “This must be the Imperial Weapon that was prepared for Grandpa Dog!”

Ling Han smiled. There was already no shortage of Saints in the Nine Suns Holy Land. In fact, they even had anImperial Scroll as their inheritance. If there was any shortcoming, it was that they were missing an Imperial Weapon.
With the Imperial Weapon standing guard, that was the strongest force in the world, capable of both attack and defense.
“Alright, then let’s try our luck,” he said. In any case, extracting Celestial Qi would be fine as long as one left behind a spiritual body.
“Then hurry up. Grandpa Dog heard that many people have already left,” the large black dog urged.

This time, Ling Han naturally brought the empress and Hu Niu with him. However, in the case of Song Lan, she was still very far from reaching Saint Tier. In fact, it was possible that she would never reach Saint Tier in this lifetime, so she naturally stayed behind to guard home.
Just how quick was the speed of a Saint?
However, what surprised Ling Han was that the ancient treasure trove of the Empress was actually not within the four Heavenly Realms. Instead, it was leaning towards the edge of the universe.
