He had really found some, and laid out multiple super great formations, communicating with the high-level dimensional space to extract Celestial Qi.
However, without an Imperial Weapon as the formation eye, the efficiency wasn’t high.
Moreover, they couldn’t extract high-quality Celestial Qi.
It was better than nothing.
Furthermore, Ling Han could also concoct the Nine Emperors Ten Leaves Pill, which could elevate Celestial Qi by one grade.
All of a sudden, another fifty years passed.
Yang Yihuan and the others had not gone back on their word.
They had long since handed over the 27 galaxies.
However, only a few years had passed, and these galaxies were once again conquered by the Netherworld.
Wherever the Skeleton Saint Tool passed, there was practically no one that could match it.
And now, yet another large area of the Living Realm had fallen.
Some Imperial Clans were even planning ahead, using their great power to move the ancestral planet, heading towards the edge of the universe.
In any case, space was astonishingly large, and there were too many depths.
Unfortunately, even the power of Saints had a limit.
At most, they could only move a single planet.
Otherwise, with how big the universe was, they were completely capable of playing hide and seek with the Netherworld.
Ling Han cultivated to the end of the fifth minor level of the Fourth Extreme.
Very easily, he charged up to six stars.
Good news came one after another.
The empress and Hu Niu had respectively become Saints!
This made Ling Han overjoyed, and his only regret was that he was actually still a Venerate.
He was falling further and further behind.
However, what could he do?
A Venerate relied on the Celestial Qi to cultivate, so he could only take things slowly.
A few days later, the large black dog suddenly came to visit.
“You don’t visit unless there’s something important.
Old Black, what’s the matter this time?” Ling Han asked.
“Hehe, that’s a good thing!” the large black dog said.
He deliberately kept Ling Han in suspense, and didn’t say it immediately.
“Oh, what good thing?” Ling Han played along.
Only then did the large black dog say, “Recently, a huge piece of news has exploded.
An ancient treasure trove of a Great Emperor has appeared.”
Ling Han was unmoved.
Hadn’t he gone to Xuan Taiyu’s ancestral site before?
“Little Han, how could this be the same?” The large black dog immediately said, “There is no treasure at all at the place of the Great Emperor Xuan.
However, this ancient treasure trove of a Great Emperor is different.
It is deliberately left behind by a Great Emperor to their descendants.”
“Then tell me,” Ling Han said with a smile.
“This Great Emperor’s title is Qingzhu!” the large black dog said.
“It’s rumored that this Great Emperor ascended Dao from an ordinary bamboo stalk.
Moreover, this is an Empress!
At that time, her bamboo sword swept through the world, and no one could rival her.
She ascended to the throne with her greatest talent.”
“Empress Qingzhu has never been married before, so she naturally didn’t have any descendants.”
“In Empress Qingzhu’s last years, she no longer appeared in public.
Thus, after she died, no one knew where she placed her inheritance.
In fact, no one knew if it had actually been passed down to the next generation.”
“However, according to a maid by Empress Qingzhu’s side, the Empress glimpsed a terrifying future in her later years, and that was why she didn’t appear in public anymore.
She was making arrangements to deal with that terrifying future.”
“Say, isn’t this targeting the invasion from the rulers of the Lands of Death?”
“It is said that this ancient trove has the weapon of the Empress, that bamboo sword that has fought all over the universe!”
“That was created by the Empress from a part of her body.
Even among Imperial Weapons, it is still an incredibly powerful existence.”
The large black dog rubbed his hands together, “This must be the Imperial Weapon that was prepared for Grandpa Dog!”
Ling Han smiled.
There was already no shortage of Saints in the Nine Suns Holy Land.
In fact, they even had anImperial Scroll as their inheritance.
If there was any shortcoming, it was that they were missing an Imperial Weapon.
With the Imperial Weapon standing guard, that was the strongest force in the world, capable of both attack and defense.
“Alright, then let’s try our luck,” he said.
In any case, extracting Celestial Qi would be fine as long as one left behind a spiritual body.
“Then hurry up.
Grandpa Dog heard that many people have already left,” the large black dog urged.
This time, Ling Han naturally brought the empress and Hu Niu with him.
However, in the case of Song Lan, she was still very far from reaching Saint Tier.
In fact, it was possible that she would never reach Saint Tier in this lifetime, so she naturally stayed behind to guard home.
Just how quick was the speed of a Saint?
However, what surprised Ling Han was that the ancient treasure trove of the Empress was actually not within the four Heavenly Realms.
Instead, it was leaning towards the edge of the universe.

chapters.title: Chapter 4627: Liu Xinhe
paragraphs: Chapter 4627: Liu Xinhe
Of course, the ancient treasure trove of the Empress was far from reaching the edge of the universe. Ling Han and the others had only travelled for half a month, and they had already arrived here.
There should have been no planets here for a long time, but now, a extinguished sun had suddenly appeared there.

On this dimmed sun, a large bamboo forest soared into the sky. Every single one of them was thirty thousand meters tall. One was purple-gold in colour, one was dark green in colour, and one was crimson in colour… they were all of different colours, and had an unusual kind of beauty to them.
Although it was a little strange for a bamboo forest to grow on a sun, it seemed reasonable to think that this was the inheritance of Empress Qingzhu.
“Let’s go.”
Everyone descended, arriving on this extinguished sun.
Instantly, they felt a colossal pressure.
This was Imperial Might!
Everyone could feel that their strength had been suppressed. In fact, they couldn’t even tear open space.
In front of the Great Emperor, so what if he was a Saint? Could he act so wantonly?
Everyone walked slowly. They did not know where the Empress’s treasure trove was. In any case, they had no sense of direction, so they would just walk around casually.
The bamboo forest filled the skies, each of them exuding a faint light, interweaving with this pitch-black universe.
As they walked, everyone discovered that they had actually lost their way.
They were Saints, yet they had actually lost their way. Wasn’t this the biggest joke in the world?
But in truth, this had indeed happened.
It must be the doing of a Great Emperor. Only a Great Emperor would be able to easily play around with a Saint.
They flew up, and arrived in space.
This was not difficult at all. A bamboo forest that was brightly coloured was right in front of their eyes.
They descended again. Then, as they walked, they once again lost their sense of direction.
Everyone decided to move separately.
This place was too big, and it was difficult to determine the direction. There was no need for so many people to gather together. It was completely a huge waste of manpower.
However, the empress, Hu Niu, and Chi Menghan didn’t separate from Ling Han. Instead, they moved together.
The four of them strolled in the bamboo forest. Occasionally, there would be bamboo leaves floating down. It was actually quite romantic.
“Niu wants to eat meat!” After walking for a while, Hu Niu quit.
She refused to leave, determined to eat.
Towards this beautiful wife that was still like a child, Ling Han naturally would not reprimand her. He too sat down, drew out some food, and began to cook.
Not long after, an alluring fragrance wafted out.

Ling Han presently possessed Saint-level battle prowess, so the ingredients he had gotten were naturally top-notch as well. The meat was Holy Beast meat, and there was also tens of millions of years old ginseng on top of it. Not only was the fragrance tempting, it could also spread to very far places.
Hu Niu’s eyes lit up as she stared at the food. It was as if she were about to drool.
No matter how strong she was, no matter whether she was a mother or a great-grandmother, the habit of loving food would never be changed.

“So fragrant, so fragrant!” At this moment, a figure walked out of the bamboo forest. He was tall and slender, and his jet-black hair was unbound. It fluttered lightly in the breeze, and he had an indescribable elegance.
“I have fine wine here. Can we share a meal?”
Hu Niu immediately defended her food, “This is Niu’s, you guys are not allowed to fight over it!”
She glared at the uninvited guest, looking like she was ready to make a move at any moment.
Ling Han couldn’t help but laugh in spite of himself. Cultivators fought for treasures, and only Hu Niu fought for food.
In her eyes, how could the allure of treasure be as great as food?𝙛𝓻𝒆𝒆𝒘𝙚𝓫𝙣𝙤𝒗𝙚𝓵.𝙘𝙤𝙢
It was precisely because of this that Hu Niu was so cute.

Ling Han looked towards that person. This was a Saint, but looked to be only in his twenties. His flame of life was also incredibly vigorous. At most, it had been burning for over ten thousand years. For a Saint, this was really too young.
“It’s fine as long as there’s wine. Please sit!” he said with a smile.
Hu Niu was instantly displeased. He was snatching Niu’s food!
However, Ling Han took out raw meat and seasonings again, and began to cook again, causing Hu Niu’s displeasure to immediately disappear.
Ling Han knew Niu well!
That young Saint was also very surprised. He had not thought that Ling Han would take out another portion of ingredients to cook in order to take care of Hu Niu’s emotions.
Interesting.
He smiled slightly, “I am Liu Xinhe.”
Ling Han looked at him. This young man actually gave him a feeling of danger, and through his eye technique, he could clearly see that this was a Three Star Saint.
A Three Star Saint was actually capable of making him feel such a strong sense of danger?
“I am Ling Han,” he nodded.
“Oh, so you are Ling Han?” Liu Xinhe looked slightly surprised, then laughed in spite of herself, “Haha, they have long since given me the information, but I have always forgotten to read it.”
‘Them?’
A thought suddenly occurred to Ling Han, “Brother Liu is from an Imperial Clan?”
“The Seven Luminaries Imperial Clan,” Liu Xinhe didn’t hide the fact.
Yi?
Wasn’t the Golden Generation of the Seven Luminaries Imperial Clan called Liu Yuan?
Moreover, Liu Xinhe was around 10,000 years old. He definitely couldn’t be the Golden Generation. The gulf between them was far too great.
Moreover, even if Liu Yuan had reached the level of Three Star Saint, he could not possibly give Ling Han such a strong feeling of danger.
Thus, Liu Yuan was definitely inferior to this person.
And here was the problem.
The Golden Generation was one of the most outstanding members of the Imperial Clan in history, yet now, an even more talented person had appeared. How could Ling Han not find this strange?
However, Ling Han didn’t ask. This might involve the secret of the Liu Clan, and even if he asked, he might not tell him.
“Yi, isn’t the strongest successor of your Liu Clan Liu Yuan?” Hu Niu was not the scheming type, and asked as she ate.
Alright, Ling Han couldn’t help but laugh.
As Liu Xinhe drew out a wine pot and wine cup, pouring some for Ling Han, she said slowly, “I don’t know about that either. He probably bestowed that title on himself, right?”
This was equivalent to no answer.
Not long after, new food was also prepared.
Ling Han cut open the dried meat, and shared it with Liu Xinhe, the empress and the others. They all began to eat.
“Good wine!” Ling Han took a sip of wine, and couldn’t help but praise in spite of himself.

He already possessed Saint-level abilities, and there was already no wine that could make him taste the alcohol. All of it was too light, but this wine was incredibly fragrant, and with a single sip, it penetrated straight into his bones.
He had a feeling that if he drank to his heart’s content, he would even become drunk.
This was really inconceivable.
As they ate meat, they continued to drink wine, chatting with each other about various topics.
After eating for half an hour, the fine wine and delicacies were all gone.
Liu Xinhe took out tea leaves, and took out a teapot. He began boiling on the spot.

After a while, the water boiled. He steeped some tea for everyone, one after another, and threw in a few tea leaves. There was pitifully little, but the fragrance of the tea assailed their noses, intoxicating them.
Even Hu Niu, who didn’t like to drink tea, sniffed, feeling great craving.
“What tea is this?” Ling Han asked.
“I plucked it from a Saint Tree. There should only be one in this world, right?” Liu Xinhe said casually.
This was precious.
Ling Han and the others all tasted it. As expected, the tea’s fragrance was strong, lingering in their mouths for a long time.
After another long while, the five of them finished their tea.
“Alright, it’s time to get down to business.” Liu Xinhe smiled.
“Come battle.” Ling Han stood up.

chapters.title: Chapter 4628: Contending for a great opportunity
paragraphs: Chapter 4628: Contending for a great opportunity
The empress and Chi Menghan were both astonished. Hadn’t these two been exchanging toasts and being polite just then? Why had they suddenly come to blows?

However, Ling Han knew that Liu Xinhe represented the Seven Luminaries Imperial Clan. Although he and the Seven Luminaries Imperial Clan weren’t mortal enemies, there was still some animosity between them. Thus, this battle was inevitable.
The empress and the others retreated, leaving enough space for Ling Han and Liu Xinhe.
They knew their man well. Since he said he was going to battle, this battle definitely had to happen.

This was a sun that had been extinguished, and there were no living beings here at all. Thus, there was no need to worry that Saints would start a battle, and destroy the heavens and earth. Furthermore, this was the treasure trove of a Great Emperor, so even if Saints wanted to destroy it, they would have to have the strength.
Liu Xinhe moved, and attacked Ling Han. As he delivered his attack, seven streaks of eight-star Regulations surged.

This was a three-star Saint, and he was actually able to unleash seven flashes of eight-star Regulations with a single strike. This guy was truly powerful, and this might not even be his ultimate battle prowess.
However, Ling Han was now a six-star Venerate.
He could unleash 45 Seven Star Regulations with a single strike, and as they intertwined, they could just barely be considered as five Eight Star Regulations.
Though he was still a whole three Regulations behind, he still had a great many ultimate moves.
The four pinnacle pillars spread out, and Ling Han instantly formed an absolute domain.
As long as the four pinnacle pillars didn’t break, he wouldn’t be injured.
Boom!
The attack landed, and Ling Han was completely unscathed. Instead, he charged forwards with his fists raised, launching an explosive attack at Liu Xinhe.

“Yi, there is actually such four pinnacle pillars?” Liu Xinhe looked surprised. Though he knew that the four pinnacle pillars possessed the ability to defend and attack, he had never heard of such absolute defense.
“However, I don’t believe that there is an invincible defense in this world!” He humphed coldly, and delivered another attack.
A terrifying scene appeared. He actually shot out nine eight-star Regulations.
What!
To say nothing of the empress and the others, even Ling Han was slightly astonished. He hadn’t expected Liu Xinhe to be this powerful.
This kind of talent was not inferior to Lu Xun and the others!
It should be known that Lu Xun and the others were the sons of Great Emperors, and were definitely not weaklings like the so-called Golden Generation.
Boom! With a single strike, cracks instantly appeared on the four pinnacle pillars.
With a thought from Ling Han, a powerful Spiritual Power surged out, and those cracks immediately disappeared.
He already had a guess, and said, “You are not from this era!”
Liu Xinhe smiled slightly, but did not deny it, “That’s right.”
“You’re… the son of the Seven Luminaries Ancestral King!” Ling Han continued.
‘What?’
This surprised the empress and the others. If it was not a Pseudo-Emperor, no one could seal themselves, because they could not make the Primordial Source Clay take effect.
Thus, they had never imagined that Liu Xinhe could actually be the son of a Great Emperor!

Liu Xinhe was also startled. He had not thought that Ling Han would be so bold in guessing, but he immediately smiled, “That’s right. I am the fourth son of Seven Luminaries Ancestral King, and also the youngest son.”
Looks like he was the only one favoured. Otherwise, why was he the only one sealed by the Primordial Source Clay?
Hold on!
“It can’t be that your family still has siblings waiting to come out into the world, right?” Ling Han asked.

Liu Xinhe laughed loudly, then shook his head, “I am the only one who has been arranged to live in this lifetime, and take a gamble on that great fated opportunity. As for the others… Sigh, they have long since disappeared in the long passage of history.”
Even the Great Emperor was not immortal, what more mortals.
Yet Ling Han’s heart skipped a beat, “Fighting for what great opportunity?”𝓯𝓻𝓮𝙚𝙬𝓮𝙗𝒏𝙤𝒗𝙚𝙡.𝒄𝒐𝓶

He had always wondered why Lu Xun, Yang Yihuan, and the other ancient king tiers, sons of Great Emperors had to appear in this era. Moreover, they had all come out at the same time. What exactly was the reason for this?
Now, he guessed that this was the “great opportunity” that Liu Xinhe had spoken of. However, what was this great opportunity?
Liu Xinhe smiled slightly, “As for that, it is best to keep it a secret for the moment.”
Ling Han gave a loud shout, and Phoenix Wings Divine Flight was unleashed. He used all kinds of ultimate moves.

Peng, peng, peng! Energy spread out in all directions, but when it landed on the bamboo forest in the surroundings, whether it was the barrage of power or the Regulations, they were all easily absorbed by the bamboo. At most, it would only make the bamboo stalks brighter. As for the rest… there was no change at all.
As expected of something set up by a Great Emperor.
Liu Xinhe attacked aggressively, using his full power. He was an existence that could deliver nine eight-star Regulations with a single strike. Just how terrifying was that?
Crushing!
However, Ling Han’s toughness was really too good. Though he was at a disadvantage, he kept seizing the chance to counterattack, and was not completely on the back foot.
Unfortunately, formations couldn’t be used here, causing Ling Han to lose a trump card.
After battling for half a day, Liu Xinhe suddenly stopped.
“Why aren’t you fighting anymore?” Ling Han asked. “I haven’t lost yet!”

Liu Xinhe shook his head, “My family begged me for a long time, and only then did I agree to make a move. However, that was all. I did not say that it had to be a life-and-death battle.” He broke into a smile, “Now that we have fought, I have also fulfilled their request.”
Beg?

This was really a good use of the word. Though this guy looked young, and had indeed only lived for about ten thousand years, he was a true king tier from ancient times. No matter which member of the Liu Clan, they would have to address him as Fourth Elder.
However, Ling Han kept feeling that these words were filled with a pretentious air.
“How many ancient Imperial Sons like you are there?” Ling Han asked.

Liu Xinhe stroked his chin, “There should be quite a number. For the sake of this era, there would definitely be a great many Great Emperors that would make arrangements, and leave behind one or two of their most outstanding descendants to appear in this era, so that they could compete.”
See, this guy was showing off, wasn’t he? “Most outstanding descendant”, wasn’t that just praising himself?
Ling Han didn’t expose him. Showing off wasn’t a crime, as long as one had abilities.
“Then, shall we meet again?” Ling Han asked.
“We’ll meet again.” Liu Xinhe nodded, then turned and left.
“What a strange guy,” Hu Niu walked over and said as she looked at where Liu Xinhe had already disappeared. At the same time, she didn’t forget to replenish herself with snacks.
“That’s right, what a strange guy!” Ling Han nodded, his eyes filled with fighting spirit.
In this life, it was destined to be filled with fierce competition.
To say nothing of the Genesis World’s Masters, the descendants of Great Emperors had all popped up now. They all had outstanding natural talent, and had a chance of becoming Great Emperor.
With so many people competing for the only position of Great Emperor, just how intense would it be?
Furthermore, they could contend for the throne in every era, so why did they have to emerge in this lifetime?
Thus, the position of Great Emperor in this lifetime was definitely different from before.
However, the Great Emperor was already invincible in the world, so how could he be any different from the rest?
“Immortality?” This word suddenly skipped through Ling Han’s mind.
Aside from immortality, how else could the Great Emperor of this era be different from the rest?
If he had not guessed wrongly, then it could be explained why so many sons and daughters of Great Emperors had awakened in this lifetime.
Immortality meant being unaging, eternally illuminating history!
That could be called the Number One Emperor of All Eternity, not suppressing an era, but suppressing the whole Timestream.
The empress, Hu Niu, and Chi Menghan were all given a fright. If news of this got out, it would definitely shake the world.

This guy was truly powerful, and this might not even be his ultimate battle prowess.
However, Ling Han was now a six-star Venerate.
He could unleash 45 Seven Star Regulations with a single strike, and as they intertwined, they could just barely be considered as five Eight Star Regulations.
Though he was still a whole three Regulations behind, he still had a great many ultimate moves.
The four pinnacle pillars spread out, and Ling Han instantly formed an absolute domain.
As long as the four pinnacle pillars didn’t break, he wouldn’t be injured.
Boom!
The attack landed, and Ling Han was completely unscathed.
Instead, he charged forwards with his fists raised, launching an explosive attack at Liu Xinhe.
“Yi, there is actually such four pinnacle pillars?” Liu Xinhe looked surprised.
Though he knew that the four pinnacle pillars possessed the ability to defend and attack, he had never heard of such absolute defense.
“However, I don’t believe that there is an invincible defense in this world!” He humphed coldly, and delivered another attack.
A terrifying scene appeared.
He actually shot out nine eight-star Regulations.
What!
To say nothing of the empress and the others, even Ling Han was slightly astonished.
He hadn’t expected Liu Xinhe to be this powerful.
This kind of talent was not inferior to Lu Xun and the others!
It should be known that Lu Xun and the others were the sons of Great Emperors, and were definitely not weaklings like the so-called Golden Generation.
Boom!
With a single strike, cracks instantly appeared on the four pinnacle pillars.
With a thought from Ling Han, a powerful Spiritual Power surged out, and those cracks immediately disappeared.
He already had a guess, and said, “You are not from this era!”
Liu Xinhe smiled slightly, but did not deny it, “That’s right.”
“You’re… the son of the Seven Luminaries Ancestral King!” Ling Han continued.
‘What?’
This surprised the empress and the others.
If it was not a Pseudo-Emperor, no one could seal themselves, because they could not make the Primordial Source Clay take effect.
Thus, they had never imagined that Liu Xinhe could actually be the son of a Great Emperor!
Liu Xinhe was also startled.
He had not thought that Ling Han would be so bold in guessing, but he immediately smiled, “That’s right.
I am the fourth son of Seven Luminaries Ancestral King, and also the youngest son.”
Looks like he was the only one favoured.
Otherwise, why was he the only one sealed by the Primordial Source Clay?
Hold on!
“It can’t be that your family still has siblings waiting to come out into the world, right?” Ling Han asked.
Liu Xinhe laughed loudly, then shook his head, “I am the only one who has been arranged to live in this lifetime, and take a gamble on that great fated opportunity.
As for the others…
Sigh, they have long since disappeared in the long passage of history.”
Even the Great Emperor was not immortal, what more mortals.
Yet Ling Han’s heart skipped a beat, “Fighting for what great opportunity?”𝓯𝓻𝓮𝙚𝙬𝓮𝙗𝒏𝙤𝒗𝙚𝙡.𝒄𝒐𝓶
He had always wondered why Lu Xun, Yang Yihuan, and the other ancient king tiers, sons of Great Emperors had to appear in this era.
Moreover, they had all come out at the same time.
What exactly was the reason for this?
Now, he guessed that this was the “great opportunity” that Liu Xinhe had spoken of.
However, what was this great opportunity?
Liu Xinhe smiled slightly, “As for that, it is best to keep it a secret for the moment.”
Ling Han gave a loud shout, and Phoenix Wings Divine Flight was unleashed.
He used all kinds of ultimate moves.
Peng, peng, peng!
Energy spread out in all directions, but when it landed on the bamboo forest in the surroundings, whether it was the barrage of power or the Regulations, they were all easily absorbed by the bamboo.
At most, it would only make the bamboo stalks brighter.
As for the rest… there was no change at all.
As expected of something set up by a Great Emperor.
Liu Xinhe attacked aggressively, using his full power.
He was an existence that could deliver nine eight-star Regulations with a single strike.
Just how terrifying was that?
Crushing!
However, Ling Han’s toughness was really too good.
Though he was at a disadvantage, he kept seizing the chance to counterattack, and was not completely on the back foot.
Unfortunately, formations couldn’t be used here, causing Ling Han to lose a trump card.
After battling for half a day, Liu Xinhe suddenly stopped.
“Why aren’t you fighting anymore?” Ling Han asked.
“I haven’t lost yet!”
Liu Xinhe shook his head, “My family begged me for a long time, and only then did I agree to make a move.
However, that was all.
I did not say that it had to be a life-and-death battle.” He broke into a smile, “Now that we have fought, I have also fulfilled their request.”
Beg?
This was really a good use of the word.
Though this guy looked young, and had indeed only lived for about ten thousand years, he was a true king tier from ancient times.
No matter which member of the Liu Clan, they would have to address him as Fourth Elder.
However, Ling Han kept feeling that these words were filled with a pretentious air.
“How many ancient Imperial Sons like you are there?” Ling Han asked.
Liu Xinhe stroked his chin, “There should be quite a number.

For the sake of this era, there would definitely be a great many Great Emperors that would make arrangements, and leave behind one or two of their most outstanding descendants to appear in this era, so that they could compete.”
See, this guy was showing off, wasn’t he?
“Most outstanding descendant”, wasn’t that just praising himself?
Ling Han didn’t expose him.
Showing off wasn’t a crime, as long as one had abilities.
“Then, shall we meet again?” Ling Han asked.
“We’ll meet again.” Liu Xinhe nodded, then turned and left.
“What a strange guy,” Hu Niu walked over and said as she looked at where Liu Xinhe had already disappeared.
At the same time, she didn’t forget to replenish herself with snacks.
“That’s right, what a strange guy!” Ling Han nodded, his eyes filled with fighting spirit.
In this life, it was destined to be filled with fierce competition.
To say nothing of the Genesis World’s Masters, the descendants of Great Emperors had all popped up now.
They all had outstanding natural talent, and had a chance of becoming Great Emperor.
With so many people competing for the only position of Great Emperor, just how intense would it be?
Furthermore, they could contend for the throne in every era, so why did they have to emerge in this lifetime?
Thus, the position of Great Emperor in this lifetime was definitely different from before.
However, the Great Emperor was already invincible in the world, so how could he be any different from the rest?
“Immortality?” This word suddenly skipped through Ling Han’s mind.
Aside from immortality, how else could the Great Emperor of this era be different from the rest?
If he had not guessed wrongly, then it could be explained why so many sons and daughters of Great Emperors had awakened in this lifetime.
Immortality meant being unaging, eternally illuminating history!
That could be called the Number One Emperor of All Eternity, not suppressing an era, but suppressing the whole Timestream.
The empress, Hu Niu, and Chi Menghan were all given a fright.
If news of this got out, it would definitely shake the world.

chapters.title: Chapter 4629: Baili Haojie
paragraphs: Chapter 4629: Baili Haojie
Immortality.
From the moment one was born, who would not pursue immortality?
However, immortality was contrary to the Heavenly Dao. Even the invincible Great Emperor would disappear in the passage of time. There was no existence in this world that could be immortal.
But if that was not the case, what kind of great opportunity would be even greater than becoming Emperor?
—If it was becoming an ordinary Emperor, it was possible for one to become Emperor in any era.

It could be imagined that if it was not for the fact that the Great Emperor could not seal themselves away, it was believed that there would be a great many Great Emperors appearing in this era, fighting over the fated opportunity to attain immortality.
“I don’t know if being born in this era is a blessing or a curse!” Ling Han exclaimed.

In this era, there may be heaven-defying fated opportunities for immortality, but this kind of fated opportunity was destined to only belong to a small number of people. In fact, there was only one person. To the people of the world, they would only be experiencing the storm of intense competition among elites that would amount to nothing.
For example, Ling Han suspected that the invasion of the Netherworld had something to do with immortality.
Otherwise, he really couldn’t think of any reason for Yin souls to interfere.
“No matter what, I have to increase my strength first!” Ling Han immediately strengthened his resolve. At this time, it was useless no matter how hard he thought about it.
Only strength was the true way to go.
The four of them continued onwards, but this bamboo forest seemed to have no end. No matter how they walked, they could not reach the end, or discover the ancient treasure trove of the Empress.
Was this a test from the Great Emperor for future generations?
Ling Han no longer walked casually, but rather observed more closely.
Since the Empress had left behind her inheritance, it was definitely not something that could not be resolved.
Was it the vein-like patterns on the bamboo?
Ling Han looked closely. Every bamboo had veined patterns on them, but they were all different.
However, after studying it for a long time, he came up empty.
Had he gone in the wrong direction?
He observed the planting locations of each bamboo stalk again, trying to find a pattern. However, after more than ten days, he still had no choice but to give up.
—He couldn’t even finish walking through this bamboo forest, so how could he summarize the pattern?
Ling Han racked his brains, but there were too many possibilities. Where exactly should he start?
Hua, the wind blew, and the leaves moved. There was a mysterious rhythm to it.
Yi?
Ling Han’s eyes lit up. Could it be this?
He looked up, capturing the movement of the bamboo leaves. That seemed to conform to some kind of logic, and was incredibly mysterious.
He couldn’t help but begin to simulate the rhythm, and instantly discovered that this was actually a formation technique!
“En?” Before he could study it in depth, he sensed that someone was approaching.
He looked to his left and saw a man in a crimson robe striding over.
This man was very young, and looked to be only in his twenties. However, there was a holy flame flickering in his mind, and it was green in colour at that.
A Five-Star Saint!
However, this person was at most 10,000 years old.
What a young king tier!
A thought flashed through Ling Han’s mind. The son of a Great Emperor!
Here was another one. Previously, it was Liu Xinhe. Who was it this time?
“Ling Han?” The other spoke first. Though there was a questioning tone in his voice, there was more certainty, as well as a pride that came from deep within his bones.
He was like a True Dragon that roamed the Nine Heavens, and would occasionally look down on the ants on the ground.
Ling Han smiled calmly, “I am Ling Han, and who are you?”
“Me?” A haughty expression appeared on the man’s face, and he said, “I’m Baili Haojie, Great Emperor Ziwei’s eldest son!”
Sure enough, he was the son of a Great Emperor!
This era was really lively. King tiers from various eras appeared one after another.
Ling Han looked at him coldly. This was a member of the Baili Clan, and the enmity between him and the Baili Clan was the deepest. Looks like this could not be resolved peacefully.
“Oh, do you want a battle?” Ling Han smiled faintly.
Meanwhile, Baili Haojie shook his head proudly, “You are unworthy!”

He was the son of the Great Emperor, and he was also a Five Star Saint. In the past, he had also been an existence that no one could match, even if everyone in the whole world fought him. Now, the gap in their cultivation levels was so wide, so he naturally had a very high opinion of himself, and did not take Ling Han seriously at all.
Ling Han wasn’t angered, and he simply shook his head, saying, “You’ve slept for too long, haven’t you? You’re already unable to keep up with the trends!”
“No matter what, you are still a mere Venerate!” Baili Haojie smirked coldly, and stretched out a hand to grab Ling Han.

He was a Five-Star Saint, and his battle prowess was even more terrifying. His power took the form of a giant hand, which was entwined by ten eight-star Regulations, exuding an endlessly terrifying aura.
In fact, this was only a casual attack from him, but the gap in cultivation level was too wide. This kind of casual attack also possessed the might to crush Ling Han.
Ling Han didn’t take it head-on. With a tap of his foot, he rapidly retreated.

“To dare humiliate our Baili Clan, who gave you the courage?” Baili Haojie took advantage of his victory to follow up with another strike. Boom, a terrifying storm was created in the bamboo forest, sweeping towards Ling Han.

The gap in battle prowess was really too wide. Even if Ling Han used the four pinnacle pillars, he still wouldn’t be able to match the other. It would only cause the four pinnacle pillars to shatter at the first instant.
Thus, the only option now was to dodge.𝚏𝗿𝗲𝐞𝚠𝕖𝐛𝗻𝗼𝐯𝕖𝚕.𝚌𝗼𝗺
“Don’t you claim to be the number one prodigy in the universe?” Baili Haojie sneered. “What is it? You don’t even dare to take a single strike from me?”
“I am 9783 years old now, and can completely be considered to be of the same age level as you, so I can’t be considered to be bullying the weak!”
“Is that all the courage you have?”
He mocked Ling Han to the extreme, as if he wanted to provoke Ling Han into a bout of youthful rashness, and couldn’t hold himself back from confronting him head-on.
But how could Ling Han possibly fall for it?

Baili Haojie was a Five Star Saint, and this was already terrifying enough. Merely in terms of cultivation level, there were pitifully few people in the world that were superior to him, what more when his natural talent was outstanding, and his battle prowess had surpassed ten stars. Just how terrifying was that?
Ling Han wasn’t stupid.
He used Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, and began to roam around in battle with Baili Haojie, neither too fast nor too slow.

This Phoenix Wings Divine Flight was indeed worthy of being the number one movement technique in the world. Though Ling Han’s strength was far inferior, he already possessed a battle prowess of Saint-level, and with his use, his fiery wings flapped, easily and calmly.
Baili Haojie was indeed strong, but if every attack did not hit its target, what was the use?
“Ling Han, do you only know how to run?” Baili Haojie began to mock him again.
“Aren’t you known as the strongest prodigy?”
“Come, let me see how much strength you actually have.”
Ling Han smiled faintly, and said, “If you would suppress your own cultivation level and battle me at the same cultivation level, see if I won’t push you to the ground and make you call me grandpa!”
Baili Haojie flew into a rage.
If he was told to call him grandpa, then wouldn’t that mean that even Great Emperor Ziwei would have to call him father?
“How dare you! You actually dare to look down on a Great Emperor!” he said balefully.
Ling Han scoffed, “You are the son of a Great Emperor, and your cultivation level is so much higher than mine. Don’t you find it embarrassing?”
“Humph, I am the same age as you, so what is there to be embarrassed about?” Baili Haojie asked calmly.

“Haha, you are an ancient person from who knows how many years ago. You should have long since turned into dust, and ran into this era to snatch the great fortune from the later generations. Who knows how thick-skinned you can be!” Ling Han scoffed.
“Detestable!” Baili Haojie roared, his black locks billowing in the wind. He was truly enraged.
As the son of a Great Emperor, when had he ever been scolded like this?
He increased the intensity of his attacks, and began to use the eight-star Regulations to restrict space.
No matter how awesome your movement technique is, I will completely seal off space with the eight-star Regulations, and let’s see how much more you can do.
This was an attempt to cut off Ling Han’s path of retreat.

chapters.title: Chapter 4630: Ambush
paragraphs: Chapter 4630: Ambush
If this were any other place, Baili Haojie would have been able to seal off the entire planet with eight-star Regulations with a few casual moves.
However, was just any other place?
This bamboo forest was the handiwork of a Great Emperor. The Eight Star Regulations would be greatly suppressed here. Thus, the space that Baili Haojie could control was also very limited.
—No matter how prodigious you were, how could a Saint compare to a Great Emperor?
Thus, it was extremely easy for Ling Han to deal with it.
He only had to retreat, and get out of this area.
Baili Haojie followed, but he had to channel the eight stars Regulations to control the new area. What harm would it do to Ling Han?
One pursued, while the other fled. Though Baili Haojie had the complete advantage in the situation, he was completely unable to turn it into a victory.
Saints were hard to kill, and this was not just empty words. Even ordinary Saints were like this, what more Ling Han, who had grasped the Phoenix Wings Divine Flight.
In fact, he wasn’t even worried about the empress and the others. These three women were also Saints, and they had also mastered the Phoenix Wings Divine Flight. So, what did they have to fear?
“Ling Han, do you really not have the courage to fight?” Baili Haojie shouted angrily. Though he was completely on the upper hand, this kind of battle made him feel very repressed, and too awkward.
Ling Han laughed loudly, “Baili brat, do you dare to fight me at the same cultivation level? I can give you a handicap of two hands.”
F***, if it was two hands, would you still have a third hand?
Baili Haojie was enraged. This was really an incomparable contempt for him.
“Humph! I’m a Five-Star Saint, so why should I lower myself and suppress my cultivation level to battle you?” He naturally wouldn’t agree to this.
“If you don’t dare, then don’t say it in such a nice way!” Ling Han said with a smile. It was just a verbal battle; who would be afraid of who?

Of the two of them, one wanted the other to turn around and fight, while the other demanded a battle of equal cultivation levels, and it was impossible for either of them to satisfy the other, so there was naturally no conclusion to this battle.
Weng!
Right at this moment, a sheet of golden light materialized, transforming into a gigantic golden cauldron that ruthlessly smashed toward Ling Han.
This just happened to block Ling Han’s path!
Ambush.

At this moment, it was already too late for Ling Han to dodge. Even if he had Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, it was useless. After all, Phoenix Wings Divine Flight was only the fastest in the world, but no matter how fast it was, there had to be a limit.
He immediately unleashed the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower to protect his entire body.
Peng!

The golden cauldron crashed into the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, sending it flying. The Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower crashed into a bamboo stalk, but the bamboo stalk’s body was incredibly tough, and it sent the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower flying back.
In this way, after shooting between the bamboo stalks dozens of times, this power was finally exhausted. Only then did the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower stop.
Ling Han stood still, and with a ‘wa’, he threw up blood madly.

Even if the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower was indestructible, the power of the shockwaves still couldn’t dissipate, making him feel extremely uncomfortable. It was as if all his organs had been knocked over.
Looking again, there were small pieces in the blood. They were clearly pieces of his internal organs.
The timing of the ambusher’s attack was too good. Furthermore, his strength was also strong enough. Otherwise, it would still be insufficient to force Ling Han to this extent.
After making his move, the ambusher also slowly walked out.
This was another young king tier. He was dressed in a golden robe, and exuded an aura of might and dignity.
“And who are you?” Ling Han asked, as he channeled Ten Cultivation Technique, trying his best to heal his injuries.
Even Baili Haojie was slightly surprised, but he thought for a moment, “Golden Cauldron Technique? Are you from the Golden Cauldron Imperial Clan?”
In the era of the Great Emperor Ziwei, he had traveled the world and challenged prodigies from all walks of life. Among them was the Imperial Son of the Golden Cauldron Imperial Clan.

This Golden Cauldron Technique was their signature move. However, the Imperial Son of the Golden Cauldron Imperial Clan was no match for this person in terms of mastery of this Imperial Technique Technique.
“Shi Tianlu,” the golden-robed young man replied calmly.
He didn’t deny his origins of the Golden Cauldron Imperial Clan, so that naturally meant tacit agreement.
Moreover, the Golden Cauldron Technique was their signboard. Since he had used it, there was no way he could deny it even if he wanted to.
“Brother Shi isn’t from this era, right?” Baili Haojie continued to attack Ling Han as he conversed with Shi Tianlu.

With his strength, he was completely capable of multitasking, because he didn’t need to use his full strength against Ling Han. It was just that Ling Han’s speed was too fast, and he couldn’t catch up to him.
“Same to you! Same to you!” Shi Tianlu was expressionless.
Clearly, they had all guessed each other’s identities. They were both the sons of Great Emperors, and had been personally sealed by the Great Emperors, so that they could revive in this era.
Thus, Ling Han was their common enemy. However, removing the factor of Ling Han, they were also competitors. The opportunity of this era could only be obtained by one person.
This great opportunity was too great. They would definitely fight tooth and nail for it. In fact, they would not regret even if they died in battle.
There was no way they could become friends!𝗳𝚛𝗲𝕖𝚠𝚎𝚋𝗻𝗼𝕧𝗲𝐥.𝚌𝚘𝐦

“Ling Han, where else can you run off to?” Baili Haojie was clearly much more talkative. As he pursued Ling Han, he used words to disturb Ling Han, “With two sons of Great Emperors hunting you down, you can actually die a worthy death.”

Ling Han laughed loudly, “Why don’t you stick out your dog’s head, and allow me to cut it off? It should be known that the person who kills you is a future Great Emperor, so you can also die a worthy death!”
Tit for tat.

Baili Haojie’s expression was slightly ugly. If there were no outsiders, he would not have been so angry either. However, Shi Tianlu was just beside him, and had heard him clearly, which made him feel slightly embarrassed and angry.
“Stubborn tongue!” he humphed coldly, and then did not say anything else. He merely attacked fiercely.
He finally realized that in terms of bickering, he was no match for Ling Han.
This was really strange. This guy was at most three to four hundred years old, but why was his ability to curse and battle so strong?
Even if he had to curse in every battle since birth, there was no way he could have cultivated such a sharp tongue, right?
It was naturally impossible for him to know that Ling Han actually came from the Genesis World. In that world, how many years had he lived for?
With a depraved friend like the large black dog, how could his verbal attacks not be awesome?
Shi Tianlu was completely unconcerned about identity, and joined forces with Baili Haojie, their attacks swift and fierce.
True, he had even done the matter of an ambush, so what did he have to be afraid of?
However, faced with Ling Han, who would only flee and not fight, to say nothing of two people hunting him down, even if it was two million, it would be the same.
—If you can’t catch up, no matter how strong you are, or how many people you have, what use would it be?
Ling Han circled around, and with the thickness and expansiveness of this bamboo forest, successfully shook off the two Imperial Sons.
He healed his injuries at the first instant.
Previously, he had been hunted down, and he could only focus on fleeing. There was no time for him to recover at all.
“How shameless!” he muttered. His injuries this time were still quite heavy. After all, he had been struck by the sons of Great Emperors.

Thankfully, Shi Tianlu’s cultivation level was inferior to Baili Haojie, and was a Four-Star Saint. Otherwise, his injuries would have been even more severe, and it was not impossible that he would have even been killed.
Ten Cultivation Technique channelled over and over again, and his injuries finally began to slowly recover.
“You two b@stards, when I become a Saint, I will also let you have a taste of being hunted down.”

sentences.text: Chapter 4630: Ambush
If this were any other place, Baili Haojie would have been able to seal off the entire planet with eight-star Regulations with a few casual moves.
However, was just any other place?
This bamboo forest was the handiwork of a Great Emperor.
The Eight Star Regulations would be greatly suppressed here.
Thus, the space that Baili Haojie could control was also very limited.
—No matter how prodigious you were, how could a Saint compare to a Great Emperor?
Thus, it was extremely easy for Ling Han to deal with it.
He only had to retreat, and get out of this area.
Baili Haojie followed, but he had to channel the eight stars Regulations to control the new area.
What harm would it do to Ling Han?
One pursued, while the other fled.
Though Baili Haojie had the complete advantage in the situation, he was completely unable to turn it into a victory.
Saints were hard to kill, and this was not just empty words.
Even ordinary Saints were like this, what more Ling Han, who had grasped the Phoenix Wings Divine Flight.
In fact, he wasn’t even worried about the empress and the others.
These three women were also Saints, and they had also mastered the Phoenix Wings Divine Flight.
So, what did they have to fear?
“Ling Han, do you really not have the courage to fight?” Baili Haojie shouted angrily.
Though he was completely on the upper hand, this kind of battle made him feel very repressed, and too awkward.
Ling Han laughed loudly, “Baili brat, do you dare to fight me at the same cultivation level?
I can give you a handicap of two hands.”
F***, if it was two hands, would you still have a third hand?
Baili Haojie was enraged.
This was really an incomparable contempt for him.
“Humph!
I’m a Five-Star Saint, so why should I lower myself and suppress my cultivation level to battle you?” He naturally wouldn’t agree to this.
“If you don’t dare, then don’t say it in such a nice way!” Ling Han said with a smile.
It was just a verbal battle; who would be afraid of who?

Of the two of them, one wanted the other to turn around and fight, while the other demanded a battle of equal cultivation levels, and it was impossible for either of them to satisfy the other, so there was naturally no conclusion to this battle.
Weng!
Right at this moment, a sheet of golden light materialized, transforming into a gigantic golden cauldron that ruthlessly smashed toward Ling Han.
This just happened to block Ling Han’s path!
Ambush.
At this moment, it was already too late for Ling Han to dodge.
Even if he had Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, it was useless.
After all, Phoenix Wings Divine Flight was only the fastest in the world, but no matter how fast it was, there had to be a limit.
He immediately unleashed the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower to protect his entire body.
Peng!

The Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower crashed into a bamboo stalk, but the bamboo stalk’s body was incredibly tough, and it sent the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower flying back.
In this way, after shooting between the bamboo stalks dozens of times, this power was finally exhausted.
Only then did the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower stop.
Ling Han stood still, and with a ‘wa’, he threw up blood madly.
Even if the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower was indestructible, the power of the shockwaves still couldn’t dissipate, making him feel extremely uncomfortable.
It was as if all his organs had been knocked over.
Looking again, there were small pieces in the blood.
They were clearly pieces of his internal organs.
The timing of the ambusher’s attack was too good.
Furthermore, his strength was also strong enough.
Otherwise, it would still be insufficient to force Ling Han to this extent.
After making his move, the ambusher also slowly walked out.
This was another young king tier.
He was dressed in a golden robe, and exuded an aura of might and dignity.

chapters.title: Chapter 4631: Purple Bamboo Forest
paragraphs: Chapter 4631: Purple Bamboo Forest
After spending a whole two months’ time, Ling Han finally recovered from his injuries.
Though he had lost contact with the empress, the large black dog, and the others, Ling Han was not the slightest bit worried.
If a Saint wanted to flee, who could stop him?
Moreover, they had all cultivated the Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, so they wouldn’t need to be afraid even if they came across a nine-star Saint.
And in these two months’ time, Ling Han had not been idle either.
As he healed his injuries, he was also observing the movement of the bamboo leaves. There was a special rhythm to them. Previously, he had sensed it, but was interrupted by Baili Hao.
In these two months, he had let go of his worries, and observed carefully. His gains were extremely great.
“How strange. When I was injured, I actually managed to capture at least three times more Celestial Qi than usual.” Ling Han gritted his teeth, “What kind of trait of mine is this?”
If the large black dog was here, he would definitely point out without reservation that this trait was “cheap”!
Only if he was injured would a certain ability be activated.
“However, this may also be because of this bamboo forest.”
Ling Han pondered for a moment. This bamboo forest was extremely strange. Thus, it was possible that it could attract Celestial Qi over. This had been set up by a Great Emperor.
“Looking from the sky, in terms of color, there are a total of ten areas of bamboo forest.”
“However, after going around in circles, I still only saw nine areas of bamboo forest. I haven’t been able to set foot in that purple-gold area.”
“Furthermore, even if one aims accurately from the skies to land there, they would not be able to land in that area.”
“Hence, my target should be there.”

Ling Han revealed a confident smile. In these two months, he had observed the movement of the bamboo leaves. There was a rhythm to it, allowing him to understand a sliver of the profound secrets of the bamboo forest.
This was a formation.
He began to advance. Occasionally, he would turn left, and sometimes, he would turn right. There was actually a sliver of charm in his movements.
“Follow the wind, follow the movements of the leaves.”
Ling Han roamed freely in this bamboo forest. The color of the bamboo forest kept changing. It was azure green, light silver, and dark blue. Finally, a purple-gold color appeared.
He entered into this area that he had never set foot in before.
Instantly, a completely different feeling rose up in Ling Han, as if this bamboo forest did not belong to the world from before.
“Celestial Qi!” A look of pleasant surprise appeared on his face. He had just entered here, and he had actually captured a Celestial Qi.
Xiu, in the blink of an eye, he had caught another.
He looked around in surprise, and saw that there were multiple streaks of Celestial Qi entwined around the purple bamboo.
Heavens, just how much Celestial Qi was there here?
Ling Han’s heart involuntarily thumped. He was rich, he was rich!
Realization dawned on him. How could the Imperial Clans be able to extract Celestial Qi so easily?
Wasn’t it because of the Imperial Weapon?
The Imperial Weapon contained the Nine Star Regulations. For Celestial Qi, this was extremely attractive.
Thus, it was completely effortless for the Imperial Weapon to obtain Celestial Qi. After millions and millions of years, their wealth was incredibly deep.
It should be known that it was not that Empress Qingzhu did not have an Imperial Weapon.
According to legends, she extracted a section of her own bamboo body and used it to forge the supreme Imperial Weapon, to pass down to her descendants.
With the Imperial Weapon standing guard here, how much Celestial Qi could it accumulate after countless years?
They were all here.𝘧𝑟𝑒𝑒𝘸𝘦𝘣𝑛𝑜𝘷𝑒𝓁.𝘤𝘰𝓂
No wonder it had become much easier to capture Celestial Qi previously. This was the reason.
Ling Han raised his hand and continuously absorbed the Celestial Qi, stuffing it all into the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.
This was a Pseudo-Imperial Weapon, so it was naturally no issue for it to preserve Celestial Qi.
This was a great harvest.
Ling Han was overjoyed. How many minor levels could this help him advance?
Three, five?
A nine-star Venerate… was assured!

Ling Han broke into a grin. Previously, he had still been wondering when he would be able to thrash Baili Haojie and Shi Tianlu. Now, a great amount of Celestial Qi was delivered to his doorstep, for him to reap the harvest.
He walked around here and collected all the Celestial Qi.
However, he did not discover anything else.
In the inheritance of the Empress, was there only some Celestial Qi?

Ling Han did not believe it. Though this was an astonishing amount of cultivation resources, any Imperial Clan would have this kind of wealth, or even surpass it. Hence, if it was claimed that Empress Qingzhu had laid out her plans millions and millions of years ago, and only left behind a great amount of Celestial Qi, that could not be justified, right?
“Perhaps I still have to wait a little longer.”
“I’ll cultivate while concocting alchemical pills.”
“As long as one’s abilities have improved, what can’t be resolved?”
This place was extremely safe, and for the moment, it was likely that no one would be entering this place.
Ling Han calmly concocted alchemical pills. Every time he concocted a Nine Emperors Ten Leaves Pill, he would consume one. At the first instant, he would turn his resources into cultivation.
In this manner, three months later, he had cultivated to the limit of six stars.
Ling Han broke through to seven stars without any hesitation. Two days later, a seventh seal appeared on each of the four pinnacle pillars, which meant that he had become a Seven Star Venerate.
At this time, others finally came in.

There were quite a few of them. There was Ding Shu and the other Genesis World rulers, as well as Baili Haojie and the other sons of Great Emperors. In fact, even Yang Yihuan and the others, who represented the sons of fallen Great Emperors, had appeared.

They had also grasped the pattern of the bamboo leaves and entered here. However, because the Celestial Qi had all been taken away by Ling Han, they naturally couldn’t discover anything unusual. They were all very curious.
—It was not easy for them to come here, but why was this place no different from the other regions?
They searched carefully, not missing even a single leaf. Perhaps Empress Qingzhu had left a clue on one of the leaves?
Ling Han didn’t participate. There were so many people now, and they were all gathered together. No matter who deciphered the secret, they definitely wouldn’t be able to enjoy it alone.
Hence, he could just wait, and reap the fruits of their labour.
Most importantly, he had also tried before, and had indeed not discovered anything special.
He continued to concoct alchemical pills. Though there was a lot of Celestial Qi, Ling Han still felt that it could not be wasted.
After a few days, he shockingly discovered that this bamboo forest had actually enlarged.
It was not just a feeling, but rather real.
It was not just him. The others had also noticed, and were all discussing spiritedly.
Now, everyone could confirm that if there really was an ancient treasure of the Empress, it must be in this bamboo forest.
However, it hadn’t manifested yet, so it might need time.
Then they’ll just wait.
For Ling Han, this was something that he could not ask for more. It was just right for him to concoct alchemical pills and increase his cultivation level.
This bamboo forest was constantly expanding at a very fast speed, and Ling Han’s cultivation level was also steadily and rapidly increasing as a large amount of Celestial Qi was refined.
Four months had passed, and the Purple Bamboo Forest had completely conquered this extinguished sun. Looking down from space, this was a purple-gold world.
Ling Han also woke up from his seclusion. He had taken another step forward.
Eight-star Venerate!
He was getting closer and closer to igniting the holy flame and becoming a Saint.
“Little Han, save me!” Right at this moment, an extremely tragic voice rang out.
The large black dog?
Anger instantly appeared on Ling Han’s face. Who was hunting the large black dog?
He immediately dashed out, following the sound.
“Little Han!” Very soon, the cry rang out again.
Ling Han let out a battle cry in response. Then, he continued to charge towards the source of the sound.
In a short while, he saw a large black dog rushing towards him.
“Hurry up and save Grandpa Dog!”

chapters.title: Chapter 4632: Continuing the path ahead
paragraphs: Chapter 4632: Continuing the path ahead
Just as the large black dog was about to reach him, Ling Han suddenly stopped in his tracks. Not only did he retreat, but he even launched a palm strike. Boom! Destructive Energy blazed.
Peng!
The large black dog was instantly hit. A hole appeared on the left side of its chest, and it went right through to the other side of its body.
However, the large black dog didn’t look shocked or furious. He simply looked at the wound, and said slowly, “How did you see through it?”
This wasn’t the large black dog at all!
Ling Han smiled faintly. The large black dog had grasped Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, so if he really encountered danger, how could he not use it?

However, in the eyes of others, with such a precious movement technique like the Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, who wouldn’t keep it for themselves if they mastered it? Would they teach it to outsiders?
Thus, though this person had copied the large black dog’s appearance very well, he had overlooked an extremely important factor.
No one could be blamed for this. Who would be as generous as Ling Han?
How could his friendship with Brother Monkey, the large black dog, and the others be imagined by others?
“Are you Baili Haojie, or Shi Tianlu?” he asked instead of answering.
His figure swayed, and turned into a young man, but he was neither Shi Tianlu nor Baili Hao. Instead, he was a complete stranger.
“I am Tao Kan!” This young man declared proudly.
Meanwhile, Ling Han shook his head, saying, “Instead of being a human, you insist on pretending to be a dog. I think the kinds of activity you are up to are also the activities of dogs and thieves.”

Tao Kan was instantly enraged, and brandished his palm to attack. Boom, the might of the holy flame surged out. Shockingly, he was also a Five Star Saint, and as many as thirteen Eight Star Regulations appeared.
“I am the son of the Red Lotus Holy Emperor, and you actually dare insult me?”
Sure enough, this was the son of another Great Emperor.

At first, he had thought that after the Golden Generation was completely humiliated, the Imperial Clans would withdraw from the competition for the position of new Emperor. He had not thought that they would actually still have such a trump card and an ancient Imperial Son would be able to appear.
The true Imperial Son was indeed awesome, completely not inferior to Yang Yihuan, Lu Xun and the others.
Moreover, these Imperial Sons were extremely shameless.
Baili Haojie was a Five-Star Saint, but he insisted that he was in the same age range as Ling Han. Meanwhile, Shi Tianlu was even more sinister. He had actually ambushed Ling Han half-way.
This Tao Kan was not much better either. He pretended to be the large black dog to lure him out.
These Imperial Sons were completely unaffected by their status. In order to achieve their goals, they were willing to resort to any means.
“Since you’ve chosen to become a b*tch, don’t even think about establishing a plaque of chastity!” Ling Han laughed loudly, leaping out to dodge.
It was true that he was shameless, but it was also true that he was powerful, and had a crushing advantage.
Tao Kan was even more enraged, and chased after Ling Han to attack him.
However, no matter how strong his battle prowess was, in terms of movement technique, it was useless no matter how strong he was.
Phoenix Wings Divine Flight was number one in the world.
Ling Han didn’t engage in battle. The gulf between their battle prowess was far too great, so what was the point of engaging in a battle where there was absolutely no chance of victory?
He activated his movement technique and left.
“Since you like to pretend to be a dog so much, I will take you in as my pet dog in future, so that you can wag your tail and beg for mercy by my side.”
He left, but his voice remained, lingering endlessly.
Peng! Peng! Peng!

Tao Kan was so infuriated that he blasted the surrounding bamboos madly, but this was set up by a Great Emperor. Not only had he not been able to break a single bamboo, he had instead caused these bamboos to light up one after another, and begin their counterattack.
Even if Tao Kan was the son of a Great Emperor and a Five Star Saint, so what? In an instant, his body was pierced through by several streaks of light.
Thankfully, his abilities were strong enough, after all. This was not enough to kill him. After resting for ten days to half a month, he would still be able to recover completely.
After Ling Han fled, he once again settled down and focused on concocting alchemical pills.
He was freakish, and was even in fact heaven-defying. However, in the end, he was still limited by his cultivation level.

Right now, the mainstream level of the younger generation had already reached the level of Saint Tier. Meanwhile, he was still at the Venerate Tier. Although he possessed the battle prowess of a Saint, he was still no match for an ancient Imperial Son.
If he wanted to stand against them, or even in fact kill these people, he would have to break through to Saint Tier.
Thus, the first thing he had to do was reach the nine-star Venerate Tier.

Ling Han continued to refine the Celestial Qi. There was nothing much to say about the Fourth Extreme. There was no such thing as enlightenment, and his cultivation level suddenly soaring several levels.
What he needed was the Celestial Qi, which could be used to construct the four pinnacle pillars, and prop up his celestial body. Only then would he be qualified to light the holy flame.
The Celestial Qi in the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower was decreasing, while Ling Han’s cultivation was steadily increasing.
Another half year passed, and Ling Han finally reached the end of the eight-star Venerate Tier.
After only three days, he had already shot up to nine stars, and stood at the highest peak of Fourth Extreme.
If he advanced another step further, he would be able to ignite the holy flame.
The number of Celestial Qi began to decrease sharply again. When there was only one fifth left, Ling Han’s Celestial Qi finally reached the limit of nine stars.
Now, he could ignite the holy flame and attempt to break through to Saint Tier.
However, Ling Han hesitated.
This was because he discovered that he still had room for improvement. He didn’t feel the pressure that the limit of his cultivation level exerted on him at all.
If he were to ignite the holy flame now, perhaps it would be harmful instead, because his Fourth Extreme had not matured to the true limit.
Then let’s just wait for a while longer.
Ling Han said to himself. What he pursued was actually not cultivation level, but strength.
Since he could continue to increase his strength, why did he have to rush to become a Saint?
His target was to be the strongest.
He clearly knew that there was still room for improvement, yet did not make the attempt. This naturally was not in line with his path.
However, he didn’t know how many minor levels he would have to break through this time.
Sect Master-level was fifteen stars, then Venerate Tier-level wouldn’t be fifteen stars as well, right?
“I feel that this should be related to the number of Regulations I have grasped.”
“The limit of Regulations should only be 99.”
“Thus, if I could grasp 99 Seven Star Regulations, I would definitely be at the true end of Fourth Extreme.”
“No matter what, since I haven’t reached perfection, I definitely can’t break through so easily.”
Ling Han attempted to break through to ten stars.
Here was the problem.
How was he supposed to break through to ten stars?

When he was at the level of Sect Master,, he had been trapped by the shackles of heaven and earth. This, on the other hand, gave him a beacon of guidance, and all he had to do was resist the shackles with all his might.
Moreover, no matter how hard he tried, it was impossible for him to break through to the pinnacle level of the Fourth Extreme, so he could be at ease and make a bold attempt.
But now, he was not being targeted by heaven and earth, and could completely attempt to light up the holy flame. This was an even easier path to take.
Ling Han felt that as long as he was the slightest bit careless, it was possible that his attempt to break through to 10 Stars would become the act of lighting up the holy flame.
What could he do?𝚏𝐫𝚎𝗲𝕨𝐞𝐛𝕟𝚘𝐯𝚎𝗹.𝕔𝐨𝗺
He calmed down for a moment, and thought clearly in his heart.
If one wanted to break through to the 10 Stars, they would have to know what kind of cultivation level 10 Stars was.
“The symbol of the Fourth Extreme is the seal on the four pinnacle pillars. Every additional one represents the advancement of a step of a minor level.”

“However, the seal is only a form of manifestation. It’s not that this seal has appeared, and that’s why one has ascended to a higher level. Instead, it’s only after one has ascended to a higher level that a seal has manifested.”
“Now, I have reached nine stars, and have absolutely no idea what ten stars means. How am I supposed to continue onwards?”
“Then, let’s change our way of thinking.”
“If I forcefully inscribe the tenth seal on the pinnacle pillar, will it stimulate a change in my cultivation level?”
Ling Han felt that this idea was feasible.
Most importantly, this was a cultivation level that no one had ever set foot in. He could only cross the river by feeling the stones, and try it out step by step.

chapters.title: Chapter 4633: Tenth Seal
paragraphs: Chapter 4633: Tenth Seal
Now that he had an idea, Ling Han could begin his attempt.
He first had to inscribe seals on the four pinnacle pillars, thereby boosting the advancement of his cultivation level.
However, what seal would he have to inscribe on the four pinnacle pillars?
This was a problem.
Just mess around?
Of course not. This was trying to break through his limits.
“After all is said and done, Regulations is the highest.”
“I will inscribe the Regulations!”

He began to extract the seven-star Regulations, then marked the four pinnacle pillars. Of course, he would definitely only choose one of the four pinnacle pillars at this moment. He wouldn’t have such a big appetite to mark all four pillars at the same time.
However, the four pinnacle pillars were like Origin Gold, and he was unable to inscribe any mark on them at all.
Then what could he do?
This was a line of thought that Ling Han had come up with with with great difficulty. Aside from this, he could think of no better idea.
“If one Regulation is not enough, then two, or three!”

“I have intertwined Regulations, which is comparable to Eight Star Regulations, and theoretically speaking, the level of Eight Star Regulations is higher than the level of the four pinnacle pillars. It should be able to leave behind marks.”
At present, Ling Han could channel 60 Seven Star Regulations. He unleashed them all at once, intertwining to form a Divine Sword, which began to move around on the four pinnacle pillars.
However, it was useless.
The four pinnacle pillars were extremely hard, and even the sword of Regulations couldn’t damage them.

It should be known that when Ling Han had set out the four pinnacle pillars, this absolute domain was not something that could be penetrated by Saints of the same strength at all. This also meant… that even he himself would not be able to damage it.
This… formed an unsolvable cycle.
With the increase of his strength, the defenses of the four pinnacle pillars would also rise accordingly. Thus, he would never be able to damage his own four pinnacle pillars.
Then wouldn’t I only be able to cultivate to nine stars?
Ling Han scratched his head. This was a little awkward. He clearly felt that he still had room for improvement. He was unwilling to advance into Saint Tier just like that.
“Let’s try Destructive Energy!”

Ling Han steeled his heart. Destructive Energy was already in its complete state. He was certain that even a Pseudo-Emperor could not hold up to being blasted by him. Even the Pseudo-Emperor would die with grudges.
With the destructive power of the Destructive Energy, what need was there for him to fear that he would not be able to inscribe marks on the four pinnacle pillars?
The question was, would it cause too much damage, and break the four pinnacle pillars?
Then he would have really gone too far.
Ling Han carefully channeled the Destructive Energy, which turned into something like a needle. Then, he stabbed it towards the four pinnacle pillars.
He had to be extremely cautious. The destructive power of this kind of high-level energy was really too great.
Weng!
When the Destructive Energy touched the four pinnacle pillars, the four pinnacle pillars also burst out with astonishing light, facing off against the spike of Destructive Energy.
Ling Han had a feeling that if he forcibly used the two to collide, then either the spike of Destructive Energy would be broken, or the pillar would crumble. There was no third possibility.
He stopped. If the spike of Destructive Energy broke, that was fine. In any case, there was no loss, but if the pillar crumbled, that would be a great loss.
What could they do?
Ling Han was dumbfounded. Even the Destructive Energy had been unsuccessful. What other method could he have?
He could only break through to Saint Tier?
Ling Han shook his head. Before trying out all the possibilities, he didn’t want to give up.
Thus, he emptied his mind and lay on the ground, pondering.
Two days later, he thought of the last possibility.
Power of belief.
When one had cultivated to the end of the nine-star Venerate Tier, they would be able to light up the holy flame with the power of Regulations or the power of belief, and become a Saint.

The starting fuel for the holy flame was the four pinnacle pillars. When all the four pinnacle pillars were burnt to nothing, the holy flame would blaze fiercely, signifying that one had truly advanced into Saint Tier.
Then, what if he used the power of belief as a pen to mark the pillar?
Was this possible?
‘Come, let’s give it a try.’

With a thought from Ling Han, the living beings in the millions and millions of dimensions in his body immediately responded, sending a weak power of belief to him. However, countless weak streaks of power of belief fused together, forming a powerful force.
However, if he did not become a Saint, this could not be called the power of belief, which could not help Ling Han increase his battle prowess.
However, Ling Han didn’t want to use it to battle either.
He turned this power into a sharp blade, and using Regulations as a blueprint, began to carve on the pillar.
With a single slash, a light mark immediately appeared on the pillar.
It was possible!

Ling Han couldn’t help but feel overjoyed. Even if he had really branded a seal, it did not mean that he would definitely be able to advance into 10 Stars. However, at least, he now had a direction to work towards, and had also improved.
Continue.
The power of belief blade continued to carve, and the mark on the pinnacle pillar gradually became deeper and more complicated.
One Regulation, two Regulations, three Regulations… Ling Han inscribed all 60 Regulations that he had grasped on the pinnacle pillar. This took a total of 17 days.
However, when he put away the “pen”, he did not sense anything strange.
Was it not the right path?
Ling Han’s heart did not waver. Immediately, he calmed his heart and spirit, and branded the mark on the second pinnacle pillar.
This time, it was faster, because he had experience.
Only fourteen days later, he was done.
However, there was still no unusual movement.
Again.
Another 13 days passed, and the third pinnacle pillar had also been branded.
Again, nothing happened.
Ling Han took a deep breath. It was time to look at the last one.
Begin.
He was completely focused, and did not have the slightest bit of negative emotion.
Another twelve days later, the last pinnacle pillar had also been marked completely.
He was still missing the last stroke.
Ling Han hesitated slightly, then swiped the blade of power of belief.
Success!

Weng, all of a sudden, the four pinnacle pillars began to tremble violently. Then, the tenth mark on the pillars immediately shone brightly. Boom, four beams of majestic light shot out from the top of Ling Han’s head.
One was directed towards the sky, one towards the ground, one towards the front, and one towards the back.
Heaven, earth, future, and past.

In this moment, Ling Han’s mind was filled with innumerable enlightenment. It was as if he was overseeing the universe, the center of time, and could reach all corners of the universe with a single hand. The past and future were all within his grasp.
Boom, his aura began to boil. The breakthrough of his cultivation level had begun!

He couldn’t help but look pleasantly surprised. As expected, his train of thought wasn’t wrong. Branding a new mark on the four pinnacle pillars could lead to the improvement of his cultivation level.
Hong long long, heaven and earth also responded immediately, and countless tribulation clouds gathered densely, gathering over in a dark mass.
The heaven’s calamity was coming.
In these millions and millions of years, had anyone ever broken through the limit of the Fourth Extreme?
This was an epoch-making feat, and even the heaven and earth were moved.
He was too strong, that even the heaven and earth would have to slay him.
Xiu, xiu, xiu! Multiple figures shot over. The commotion caused by Ling Han was too great, so it naturally attracted those close and far away.
—Most importantly, everyone had nothing else to do now.
“Ling Han!”
“He has broken through?”
“Hiss, this guy is about to become a Saint?”
“That’s not right. Becoming a Saint could not possibly attract the heaven’s calamity, either. It would only be an internal demon.”
Everyone was astounded. Becoming a Saint would indeed have a test from heaven and earth, but that was only a test by an internal demon, and now it was a test from the heaven’s calamity.
What evil deeds have you committed, to actually draw the fury of heaven and earth?
