It was time to look at the last one.
Begin.
He was completely focused, and did not have the slightest bit of negative emotion.
Another twelve days later, the last pinnacle pillar had also been marked completely.
He was still missing the last stroke.
Ling Han hesitated slightly, then swiped the blade of power of belief.
Success!
Weng, all of a sudden, the four pinnacle pillars began to tremble violently.
Then, the tenth mark on the pillars immediately shone brightly.
Boom, four beams of majestic light shot out from the top of Ling Han’s head.
One was directed towards the sky, one towards the ground, one towards the front, and one towards the back.
Heaven, earth, future, and past.
In this moment, Ling Han’s mind was filled with innumerable enlightenment.
It was as if he was overseeing the universe, the center of time, and could reach all corners of the universe with a single hand.
The past and future were all within his grasp.
Boom, his aura began to boil.
The breakthrough of his cultivation level had begun!
He couldn’t help but look pleasantly surprised.
As expected, his train of thought wasn’t wrong.
Branding a new mark on the four pinnacle pillars could lead to the improvement of his cultivation level.
Hong long long, heaven and earth also responded immediately, and countless tribulation clouds gathered densely, gathering over in a dark mass.
The heaven’s calamity was coming.
In these millions and millions of years, had anyone ever broken through the limit of the Fourth Extreme?
This was an epoch-making feat, and even the heaven and earth were moved.
He was too strong, that even the heaven and earth would have to slay him.
Xiu, xiu, xiu!
Multiple figures shot over.
The commotion caused by Ling Han was too great, so it naturally attracted those close and far away.
—Most importantly, everyone had nothing else to do now.
“Ling Han!”
“He has broken through?”
“Hiss, this guy is about to become a Saint?”
“That’s not right.
Becoming a Saint could not possibly attract the heaven’s calamity, either.
It would only be an internal demon.”
Everyone was astounded.
Becoming a Saint would indeed have a test from heaven and earth, but that was only a test by an internal demon, and now it was a test from the heaven’s calamity.
What evil deeds have you committed, to actually draw the fury of heaven and earth?

chapters.title: Chapter 4634: Four Great Emperors
paragraphs: Chapter 4634: Four Great Emperors
There were a total of two possibilities for triggering a heaven’s calamity.

Firstly, he had committed a heinous crime, and even the heaven and earth could no longer bear to watch, and wanted to erase him with the heaven’s calamity. Secondly, he was too strong, and had surpassed the limit of the corresponding cultivation level. He had broken the balance, and the heaven and earth would also send down the heaven’s calamity.
But the two were different.

In the case of the former, no matter how strong the victim of the tribulation was, it would be useless. That was because the heaven’s calamity would get stronger and stronger, and would only stop when the victim of the tribulation had been killed.
In this world, who could be stronger than Heavenly Dao?
Even the Great Emperor couldn’t. Otherwise, the Great Emperor wouldn’t have died of old age.
If it was the latter, however, there was still a chance of survival.
As long as he could survive a wave of heaven’s calamity, the heaven and earth would “admit” that he indeed had the right to be this strong, and would no longer target him.
Ling Han… probably didn’t commit any heinous crimes, right?
On the other hand, he had fought against the Netherworld, and killed who knew how many Yin souls. It was only possible that he had great merits.
Thus, the only possibility now was the latter.
Hiss, what kind of limit had this guy broken through, to actually be able to attract a heaven’s calamity?
It should be known that not everyone was qualified to be struck by the heaven’s calamity.
In truth, those that could attract the heaven’s calamity were all prodigies among prodigies, and there were not many that could be found in a whole era.

How could the Saints not be stunned? That was because as long as Ling Han could survive the heaven’s calamity without dying, he would become much stronger. This was something that was self-explanatory.
“Die!”
“We definitely cannot allow him to succeed.”
“En, this boy is already freakish enough. If he was allowed to successfully break a certain limit, just how strong would he be then?”

The Imperial Sons all looked at each other, and charged out. There were the few remaining Golden Generations, as well as the ancient Imperial Sons, and they were completely unconcerned about bullying the weak with numbers.
Boom!
All of a sudden, one attack after another was as dazzling as fireworks, blasting towards Ling Han.
Even a Nine-Star Saint would frown upon seeing such an attack, and retreat quickly.
“How dare you!” Brother Monkey, the large black dog, the empress, and the others all moved to intercept them.

However, firstly, how many of them were there? Secondly, none of them had advanced into Two Stars, so how could they possibly block the attacks of Baili Haojie, Shi Tianlu and the other ancient Imperial Sons?
Fortunately, it wasn’t that Ling Han didn’t have any reaction. With a battle cry, Phoenix Wings Divine Flight was unleashed and he rapidly left.
“You won’t be able to escape!” The Saints from the Imperial Clans all charged over to attack Ling Han.
Kuang, at this moment, the heaven’s calamity also joined in on the excitement, delivering an attack towards Ling Han.
Weng, weng, weng, weng! Four bolts of lightning descended, turning into four young people respectively.
“Fa-Father!” The few ancient Imperial Sons were immediately stunned, and called out to the four youngsters, almost falling to their knees.
This was clearly their father, the ancient Great Emperor!
Shouldn’t they have died long ago?
No!
Everyone immediately saw clearly that these four Great Emperors were not their true selves, but rather formed from lightning.
Shua, shua, shua! The four Great Emperors formed of lightning immediately charged towards Ling Han.
Peng!
With a single punch, Ling Han was sent flying.
Hiss, these four Great Emperors were shockingly One Star Saints.
Ordinary One Star Saints were completely no match for Ling Han. However, it was a different story for Great Emperors, even if they were only formed by Heavenly Dao out of lightning.
The Great Emperors’ souls would return to the heavens, their spirits fusing with the heaven and earth. Thus, the Heavenly Dao was completely capable of perfectly manifesting the Great Emperors.
This was not the Great Emperors when they were young, but rather the Great Emperors that had lowered their cultivation level from their imperial position. The two were completely incomparable.

When it was Great Emperors when they were young, even Ge Qianqiu and the Nine Suns Saint could stand shoulder to shoulder with them. There were wins and losses, but for those who had lowered their own cultivation level from the position of Emperor, Ge Qianqiu and the Nine Suns Saint couldn’t compare at all.
Even if they could only unleash a sliver of Imperial Might, that was still superior to the whole universe.
Furthermore, these Lightning Great Emperors had an advantage in terms of cultivation level. They were One Star Saints.
Furthermore, there were four of them!
How was he supposed to block this kind of heaven’s calamity?
The speed of the four Great Emperors of Lightning was astonishingly fast. After one of them shot out a punch, the other three used movement techniques to give chase.
So what if Phoenix Wings Divine Flight was the number one movement technique in the world? Ling Han was facing a Great Emperor!
Xiu, xiu, xiu! Three golden paths spread out, and the three Great Emperors arrived in front of Ling Han in a single stride, their attacks slashing out successively.
It was too fast!
Ling Han hurriedly unleashed his four pinnacle pillars. He could only take this attack head-on.
Peng, peng, peng! The attacks arrived, and cracks immediately appeared on the four pinnacle pillars. Then, they shattered with a bang.
The remaining power swept past, and Ling Han was once again sent flying.
In front of the four Great Emperors of Lightning, Ling Han actually couldn’t even fight back.
Everyone was watching dumbfounded. The Heavenly Dao would actually send down such a tribulation. This, who in this world could withstand it?
Unless it was also a Great Emperor that had severed his own cultivation level, only then would he be able to match this.
However, they would only be able to match this. It was impossible for them to win.
An Imperial Son still wanted to take advantage of this, and moved to attack. However, he saw another bolt of lightning strike down, turning into a Great Emperor that was attacking him.
This time, it was not a One Star Saint, but rather a Nine Star Saint!
How could the Imperial Son withstand this? In a few moves, he exploded, turning into a shower of blood.

Thankfully, a Saint could be revived with a drop of blood, and the heaven’s calamity didn’t kill him completely. It stopped after beating him to burst. Otherwise, this Imperial Son would definitely have been killed by the heaven’s calamity.
In this way, no one dared to move.
The Heavenly Dao was issuing a punishment, and no one could interfere?
—You want to stand shoulder to shoulder with the Heavenly Dao? This was naturally a great disrespect.
“Red Lotus Holy Emperor!”
“Golden Cauldron Ancestral King!”
“Jade Drop Ancestral King!”
“The Thousand Spirit Great Emperor!”
Everyone was whispering the names of the four Great Emperors, their voices filled with reverence and respect.
Every single Great Emperor was an elite that had suppressed an era, and was definitely deserving of respect.

Now, though the four Great Emperors only had the cultivation level of a One Star Saint, they were still superior to Ling Han in terms of power and Regulations. Furthermore, there were four of them. How was Ling Han supposed to block this?
“He’s dead for sure!”
“Haha, to actually have such a heaven’s calamity, no one would be able to survive.”
“How could the limits of heaven and earth be so easily broken!”
All the Saints smirked coldly. They had not thought that Ling Han, whom they could not kill no matter what, would ultimately die in the hands of the heaven’s calamity.
Thinking about it, it was indeed ironic. Why would Ling Han be targeted by the Heavenly Dao?
Because he was too freakish.

Ling Han’s freakish talent was the reason why the members of the Imperial Clans saw him as a thorn in their side. Because if he didn’t die, the chances of others becoming Emperor would be pitifully small, but also because he was too freakish, he was actually going to be killed by the Heavenly Dao.
How could this not be ironic?

However, everyone couldn’t help but feel admiration in their hearts. This kind of freak was really terrifying. Not only had no one achieved such feats that he had before, perhaps it would never happen again.
“What do we do? What do we do now?” The large black dog couldn’t maintain his composure any longer, and he couldn’t help but tug at his beard.
In the past, no matter what, it had always been filled with confidence in Ling Han.
However, this time was different.
Four Great Emperors!
For those that could become Emperor, which one of them was not the strongest of their generation?
Now that four invincible beings had joined forces to attack Ling Han alone, how could Ling Han block them?
Who would still have the confidence?

The empress, Hu Niu, and Chi Menghan were even more anxious. They held hands, and if it wasn’t for the fact that no one could help in the case of the heaven’s calamity, they would have definitely rushed forwards.
What could they do?

chapters.title: Chapter 4635: Defeating the heaven’s calamity
paragraphs: Chapter 4635: Defeating the heaven’s calamity
If anyone still had any confidence in Ling Han, it would definitely be himself.
He had the heart to become a Great Emperor, so how could he think that he was inferior to the previous Great Emperors?
What a joke!
In truth, the accomplishments that he had achieved all the way here, even the Great Emperors of the past could not compare.

If it was not for the fact that these four Lightning Great Emperors in front of him possessed a sliver of Imperial Might, so what if they were One Star Saints? Ling Han was completely capable of killing them.
“Do you really think that I’m afraid of you guys?” Ling Han shouted loudly, and began his counterattack.

Right now, he was a nine-star Venerate, and he could unleash 60 seven-star Regulations with a single strike. Combined together, this was equivalent to six eight-star Regulations. Just how astonishing was this?

Previously, someone had speculated that when he had reached the nine-star Venerate Tier, he would be able to match a four-star or five-star Saint. In truth, this was still underestimating him. Going by the calculation of the lowest battle prowess, he could even match a six-star Saint.
Of course, there were still the sons of Great Emperors like Lu Xun and Shi Tianlu. Their battle prowess far surpassed their peers, and that was a different story.
Could there be a second Venerate like this in the world?
Ling Han channeled the Destructive Energy, and confronted the four Great Emperors head-on.
Peng!
He was sent flying by the Red Lotus Holy Emperor, but under the violent punch, the Red Lotus Holy Emperor’s figure actually dimmed slightly.
Destructive Energy was something that could destroy anything!
So what if you are the manifestation of the Heavenly Dao? I will still destroy you.
However, it was only slightly weaker. If he were really to be completely destroyed, he would have to throw at least a few hundred or a few thousand punches.
“Wa!” Ling Han also threw up blood madly. This was a head-on confrontation with a Great Emperor.
Possessing a sliver of Imperial Might, this was too terrifying.
Cracks appeared on Ling Han’s tough physique, and blood gushed out.
This was a completely unfair battle. Just how powerful was the Great Emperor? There was no one in this world that could match him.
Ling Han had no choice but to summon the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower. Even the four pinnacle pillars couldn’t block the mad barrage of attacks from the four Great Emperors.
He took a look. Thankfully, the activation of the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower didn’t draw the heaven’s calamity to increase its might.

It was very simple. Ling Han had nurtured the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower from beginning to end, and no one else had participated. This could be considered a part of Ling Han. Thus, taking it out and using it did not break the rules of the heaven’s calamity.
Peng! Peng! Peng!

However, it was useless even if he summoned the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower. The Great Emperors were too powerful, blocking the Origin Gold with their bare hands, blasting the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower madly, and due to the rebound, Ling Han was also very injured, though it wasn’t as tragic as being directly hit.
Ling Han wasn’t just taking a beating. He was still successful.
Under the influence of Destructive Energy, even the Great Emperor would be wounded!
He focused his attacks on the Red Lotus Holy Emperor. Rather than wounding his fingers, it would be better to sever one of his fingers!

“Wa!” He threw up blood madly, his whole body covered with blood. His injuries were extraordinarily severe, but correspondingly, the figure of the Red Lotus Holy Emperor was also becoming dimmer and dimmer.
“No!” Imperial Son Tao Kan’s face was filled with disbelief.
His “father” was actually going to be defeated by Ling Han, even if it was only a human figure formed from lightning.
However, the Great Emperor should have been invincible under all circumstances.
To him, it was as if the heaven and earth were about to collapse.
However, what use was it no matter how loud he shouted?
After exchanging several hundred blows, the Red Lotus Holy Emperor was already so dim that he could barely be seen. He sent out another palm strike, and his whole person disappeared on its own.

Everyone nodded. These Great Emperors were all formed from lightning, and the source of their power was also lightning. Every attack they delivered would consume some of their power. Actually, there was no need for Ling Han to counterattack. As they fought, they would eventually die by themselves.
Going by that theory, Ling Han didn’t need to counterattack at all. He only needed to defend himself, and wait for these Great Emperors of Lightning to dissipate on their own.
When this thought arose, everyone shook their heads.
If he merely defended and did not attack, he would only be beaten to death!
Just how powerful was the attack of the Great Emperor? Merely defending and not attacking? Heh, what a joke.
After dealing with the Red Lotus Holy Emperor, Ling Han’s pressure instantly lessened.
He started to target Golden Cauldron Ancestral King, trading injury for injury.

If his opponent was really a manifestation of the Great Emperor, Ling Han wouldn’t have been able to do this. This was because the attacks of true Great Emperors would be more variable, and they would also heal their injuries. Thus, there was no need for them to worry about expending all of their power.
But now? Hehe.
After paying the price of having one of his arms destroyed, the Ancestral King Golden Cauldron was also shattered.

Shi Tianlu’s expression was dark. F***, though this was not his real father, in everyone’s hearts, they probably thought that Ling Han had defeated the Ancestral King Golden Cauldron who had lowered his level to a One Star Saint.
The Great Emperor had been invincible all his life, yet now, Ling Han had actually left a stain on his reputation?
Shi Tianlu could not tolerate this.
However, the heaven’s calamity couldn’t be interefered with, and he could only sit by and watch.
Ling Han attacked the Jade Drop Ancestral King again.𝕗𝕣𝐞𝐞𝘄𝐞𝚋𝚗𝗼𝘃𝗲𝗹.𝚌𝕠𝚖

With one less Great Emperor, the pressure on him was lighter, but this did not mean that the battle would not be intense. On the contrary, Ling Han paid the price of losing another leg, and finally, the Jade Drop Ancestral King was ground to death.
The Saints of the Han Clan naturally all looked livid. Their Great Emperor had also been “slain”, which made them feel that the Jade Drop Imperial Clan’s fortune had been weakened by a layer.
Finally, it was the Thousand Spirit Great Emperor.
Ling Han used all his remaining power, exchanging blows with the Thousand Spirit Great Emperor.
He couldn’t delay it any longer, as his injuries were too severe.
After only 100 exchanges, the Thousand Spirit Great Emperor’s body also started to shudder.
His energy was also about to be exhausted, and would return to heaven and earth.
Ling Han continued to press his advantage, attacking aggressively, killing the Thousand Spirit Great Emperor as well.
The Saints of the Cheng Clan were naturally extremely unhappy, their expressions extremely dark.
In the skies, the thunderclouds gradually dissipated.
The heaven’s calamity had passed.
All the Saints were stunned and filled with killing intent. This kind of heaven’s calamity was still unable to kill Ling Han?
He was too freakish.
“Die!”
All the Saints charged out. Taking advantage of this opening, it was a great opportunity to kill Ling Han.
“Don’t attack!” Ling Han sent a mental message to Brother Monkey and the others through divine sense, while he directly used Phoenix Wings Divine Flight to flee.
If the empress and the others made a move, they would only be seeking death.
Even if he was only left with one leg now, when the fiery wings spread out, it was not restricted by his body, so his speed was still extraordinarily fast.
The Saints chased for a while, yet had no choice but to stop.
They couldn’t catch up.
Ling Han, who possessed Saint-level power, was no longer someone that they could gang up on and kill.
Otherwise, during the re-establishment of the Nine Suns Holy Land, would these Imperial Clan elites sit by and watch?
Wasn’t it because Ling Han was already extremely, extremely difficult to kill, so they had no choice but to endure?
After Ling Han broke free from the Saints, he hurriedly descended, and began to heal his injuries.
This time, his injuries were truly severe.

In order to kill the lightning figures of the four Great Emperors, he had paid the price of two arms and one leg. Though he had the Saintly medicine in his possession, which could regrow his severed limbs, with such heavy injuries, it was still a massive blow to his life force.
“Fortunately, I killed countless Yin souls previously, and the heaven and earth essence replenished some life force for me. Otherwise, this injury would really be difficult to heal.”
Ling Han channeled the Ten Cultivation Technique, and together with the Great Herbs, he hoped to recover as soon as possible.

He buried himself into the ground. The aura of the Empress permeated the air here, so it was impossible for Saints to release their divine sense here. Thus, unless these Saints dug into the ground to search, he would be absolutely safe.

He was sent flying by the Red Lotus Holy Emperor, but under the violent punch, the Red Lotus Holy Emperor’s figure actually dimmed slightly.
Destructive Energy was something that could destroy anything!
So what if you are the manifestation of the Heavenly Dao?
I will still destroy you.
However, it was only slightly weaker.
If he were really to be completely destroyed, he would have to throw at least a few hundred or a few thousand punches.
“Wa!” Ling Han also threw up blood madly.
This was a head-on confrontation with a Great Emperor.
Possessing a sliver of Imperial Might, this was too terrifying.
Cracks appeared on Ling Han’s tough physique, and blood gushed out.
This was a completely unfair battle.
Just how powerful was the Great Emperor?
There was no one in this world that could match him.
Ling Han had no choice but to summon the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.
Even the four pinnacle pillars couldn’t block the mad barrage of attacks from the four Great Emperors.
He took a look.
Thankfully, the activation of the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower didn’t draw the heaven’s calamity to increase its might.
It was very simple.
Ling Han had nurtured the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower from beginning to end, and no one else had participated.
This could be considered a part of Ling Han.
Thus, taking it out and using it did not break the rules of the heaven’s calamity.
Peng!
Peng!
Peng!
However, it was useless even if he summoned the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.

The Great Emperors were too powerful, blocking the Origin Gold with their bare hands, blasting the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower madly, and due to the rebound, Ling Han was also very injured, though it wasn’t as tragic as being directly hit.
Ling Han wasn’t just taking a beating.
He was still successful.
Under the influence of Destructive Energy, even the Great Emperor would be wounded!
He focused his attacks on the Red Lotus Holy Emperor.
Rather than wounding his fingers, it would be better to sever one of his fingers!
“Wa!” He threw up blood madly, his whole body covered with blood.
His injuries were extraordinarily severe, but correspondingly, the figure of the Red Lotus Holy Emperor was also becoming dimmer and dimmer.
“No!” Imperial Son Tao Kan’s face was filled with disbelief.
His “father” was actually going to be defeated by Ling Han, even if it was only a human figure formed from lightning.
However, the Great Emperor should have been invincible under all circumstances.
To him, it was as if the heaven and earth were about to collapse.
However, what use was it no matter how loud he shouted?
After exchanging several hundred blows, the Red Lotus Holy Emperor was already so dim that he could barely be seen.
He sent out another palm strike, and his whole person disappeared on its own.
Everyone nodded.
These Great Emperors were all formed from lightning, and the source of their power was also lightning.
Every attack they delivered would consume some of their power.
Actually, there was no need for Ling Han to counterattack.
As they fought, they would eventually die by themselves.
Going by that theory, Ling Han didn’t need to counterattack at all.
He only needed to defend himself, and wait for these Great Emperors of Lightning to dissipate on their own.
When this thought arose, everyone shook their heads.
If he merely defended and did not attack, he would only be beaten to death!
Just how powerful was the attack of the Great Emperor?
Merely defending and not attacking?
Heh, what a joke.
After dealing with the Red Lotus Holy Emperor, Ling Han’s pressure instantly lessened.
He started to target Golden Cauldron Ancestral King, trading injury for injury.
If his opponent was really a manifestation of the Great Emperor, Ling Han wouldn’t have been able to do this.
This was because the attacks of true Great Emperors would be more variable, and they would also heal their injuries.
Thus, there was no need for them to worry about expending all of their power.
But now?
Hehe.
After paying the price of having one of his arms destroyed, the Ancestral King Golden Cauldron was also shattered.
Shi Tianlu’s expression was dark.
F***, though this was not his real father, in everyone’s hearts, they probably thought that Ling Han had defeated the Ancestral King Golden Cauldron who had lowered his level to a One Star Saint.
The Great Emperor had been invincible all his life, yet now, Ling Han had actually left a stain on his reputation?
Shi Tianlu could not tolerate this.
However, the heaven’s calamity couldn’t be interefered with, and he could only sit by and watch.
Ling Han attacked the Jade Drop Ancestral King again.𝕗𝕣𝐞𝐞𝘄𝐞𝚋𝚗𝗼𝘃𝗲𝗹.𝚌𝕠𝚖
With one less Great Emperor, the pressure on him was lighter, but this did not mean that the battle would not be intense.
On the contrary, Ling Han paid the price of losing another leg, and finally, the Jade Drop Ancestral King was ground to death.
The Saints of the Han Clan naturally all looked livid.
Their Great Emperor had also been “slain”, which made them feel that the Jade Drop Imperial Clan’s fortune had been weakened by a layer.
Finally, it was the Thousand Spirit Great Emperor.
Ling Han used all his remaining power, exchanging blows with the Thousand Spirit Great Emperor.
He couldn’t delay it any longer, as his injuries were too severe.
After only 100 exchanges, the Thousand Spirit Great Emperor’s body also started to shudder.
His energy was also about to be exhausted, and would return to heaven and earth.
Ling Han continued to press his advantage, attacking aggressively, killing the Thousand Spirit Great Emperor as well.
The Saints of the Cheng Clan were naturally extremely unhappy, their expressions extremely dark.
In the skies, the thunderclouds gradually dissipated.
The heaven’s calamity had passed.
All the Saints were stunned and filled with killing intent.
This kind of heaven’s calamity was still unable to kill Ling Han?
He was too freakish.
“Die!”
All the Saints charged out.
Taking advantage of this opening, it was a great opportunity to kill Ling Han.
“Don’t attack!” Ling Han sent a mental message to Brother Monkey and the others through divine sense, while he directly used Phoenix Wings Divine Flight to flee.
If the empress and the others made a move, they would only be seeking death.
Even if he was only left with one leg now, when the fiery wings spread out, it was not restricted by his body, so his speed was still extraordinarily fast.
The Saints chased for a while, yet had no choice but to stop.
They couldn’t catch up.
Ling Han, who possessed Saint-level power, was no longer someone that they could gang up on and kill.
Otherwise, during the re-establishment of the Nine Suns Holy Land, would these Imperial Clan elites sit by and watch?
Wasn’t it because Ling Han was already extremely, extremely difficult to kill, so they had no choice but to endure?
After Ling Han broke free from the Saints, he hurriedly descended, and began to heal his injuries.
This time, his injuries were truly severe.
In order to kill the lightning figures of the four Great Emperors, he had paid the price of two arms and one leg.
Though he had the Saintly medicine in his possession, which could regrow his severed limbs, with such heavy injuries, it was still a massive blow to his life force.
“Fortunately, I killed countless Yin souls previously, and the heaven and earth essence replenished some life force for me.
Otherwise, this injury would really be difficult to heal.”
Ling Han channeled the Ten Cultivation Technique, and together with the Great Herbs, he hoped to recover as soon as possible.
He buried himself into the ground.
The aura of the Empress permeated the air here, so it was impossible for Saints to release their divine sense here.
Thus, unless these Saints dug into the ground to search, he would be absolutely safe.

chapters.title: Chapter 4636: The Imperial Weapon appears
paragraphs: Chapter 4636: The Imperial Weapon appears
Three years passed.
Ling Han’s injuries were really too severe. He had forcibly lost three limbs, and being able to recover in three years was already an incredibly fast speed.
Peng, he broke out of the ground.
The newly grown arms and left leg were both bare, and the skin was like top grade jade, possessing a warm hue.
“Now, I’m a true 10-star Venerate!”
Ling Han waved his arm. Boom! A terrifying power reverberated, and 70 Seven Star Regulations surged.

The present him had finally reached the level of a One Star Saint in terms of power. There was no longer any need for him to clearly have the advantage in battle prowess, but still be blasted off his feet in a fight with a One Star Saint.
Of course, compared to a Two Star or Three Star Saint, his power was still inferior.
However, this didn’t matter. Power was only secondary to Saints, and Regulations was the true power.
“I wonder how the situation is now.”
Ling Han murmured. His figure moved, and he began to search this extinguished sun, wanting to know the latest situation.
After circling around, he discovered that this star was still the same. Nothing special had happened.
Was the time not up yet?
But this was just right. Ling Han continued to concoct alchemical pills. He still had some Celestial Qi that he had yet to refine.

All of a sudden, another year had passed. Ling Han had already concocted all the Celestial Qi into alchemical pills, and ingested and refined all of them. However, his cultivation level had only reached the late stage of 10 Stars, and was still a bit away from the peak stage.
“It’s truly as difficult as ascending the heavens to advance another level.”

Ling Han sighed ruefully. Thankfully, it was much easier to obtain Celestial Qi here. He would not waste any time staying here, and in the boundless distance, Song Lan was still collecting Celestial Qi for him. Though there was not much, it was better than nothing.
He quietly found the empress and the others, and they all reunited. When their conversation came to the topic of the heaven’s calamity, everyone still felt lingering fear.
Time passed easily, and another half year’s time had passed, and change had finally taken place.
The Purple Bamboo Forest began to recede.
Previously, it had expanded to cover the entire planet, but now, it was shrinking towards an area.
Once the bamboo forest retreated, everyone naturally appeared.
“Yi!” They discovered that Yang Yihuan, Lu Xun, and the other fallen Imperial Sons had also arrived here at some unknown time.
“What are you all here for?” Baili Haojie spoke up, his voice booming, carrying an interrogative tone.
Only the son of a Great Emperor like him would dare to do so. Otherwise, even the Golden Generations would not be worthy in front of Lu Xun and the others.
“The ancient treasure trove of the Empress is obtained by those who are fated,” Lu Xun said calmly. In front of Baili Haojie, his bearing did not weaken in the slightest.
“Are you even worthy?” Shi Tianlu scoffed, not giving them any face at all.
Among the sons of Great Emperors, which one of them wasn’t a supremely proud person?
“Hehe, we are all sons of Great Emperors, so what is there for you to be so proud of?” A black-robed young man stepped out, a red flame pattern engraved on his robes.
“Who are you?” Shi Tianlu asked calmly.
“The son of Ancestral King Fire Clouds, Lin Dong,” the black-robed young man said calmly.
What!
Everyone was shocked. The Fire Cloud Imperial Clan?
Wasn’t the Fire Cloud Imperial Clan already passed down? Why was there another fallen Imperial Son now?
After the Demon Wolf Imperial Clan and the Black Sunflower Imperial Clan, a third Imperial Clan with two heirs appeared.
If one delved deeper, one could sense there was something off.

Because whether it was the Demon Wolf Imperial Clan or the Black Sunflower Imperial Clan, or the Fire Cloud Imperial Clan, none of them had an ancient Imperial Son that had revived, because they did not exist at all!
—They had long since fallen, and collaborated with the Netherworld.

Thus, while Imperial Sons from Imperial Clans such as Golden Cauldron Imperial Clan and Ziwei Imperial Clan and so on were all killed or crippled but once the ancient Imperial Son appeared, he immediately turned the tides. At least for now, these Imperial Sons all belonged to the highest grade.
Ling Han, Ding Shu and the others were all no match!
However, the Imperial Clans that had a Fallen Imperial Son were in trouble. The ancient Imperial Son was standing on the opposing side, and now faced with this, how could they bear it?
“Come battle!” Shi Tianlu immediately charged out, battling fiercely with Lin Dong.
After a short period of probing, the two Imperial Sons immediately unleashed their full battle prowess, both wanting to defeat the other.
The difference was too great.

Aside from the most ancient period when the heaven and earth was first created, and there were a great many Divine Beasts standing side by side, after that, there would only be one Great Emperor in each era.
As the saying went, Great Emperors would never have a chance to meet another.
The Great Emperor was like this, and so was the Imperial Son. Theoretically speaking, there was no chance for them to exchange blows.
However, the appearance of the Primordial Source Clay made the impossible possible.
Now, the two sons of Great Emperors were exchanging blows, and from a certain aspect, it could also be considered as the battle between the two Great Emperors.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
However, for the descendants of these Great Emperors to all be sealed, so which one of them wasn’t a supreme prodigy?
Thus, in the intense battle between Imperial Sons, neither was weaker than the other, and it was difficult to decide who was stronger.
At the same time, the bamboo forest was still shrinking. Finally, it turned into a thin bamboo stalk that was no more than two feet long, dark green in colour.
Boom, a frightening might reverberated out, causing both Shi Tianlu and Lin Dong to stop.
This was Imperial Might!𝗳𝚛𝗲𝕖𝕨𝕖𝗯𝚗𝚘𝕧𝕖𝗹.𝗰𝗼𝕞
Everyone couldn’t help but turn their gazes to the only thin bamboo stalk.
According to legends, Empress Qingzhu extracted a portion of her own body and forged it into an Imperial Weapon. Could it be that it was this bamboo stalk?
Imperial Weapon!
Even if most of the people here were Imperial Clan elites, and there was no shortage of children of Great Emperors, when they saw the Imperial Weapon, they all looked excited.
This was a weapon that belonged solely to the Great Emperor.
Even if every Imperial Clan had an Imperial Weapon, that belonged to the whole clan, not a particular individual.
Now, this was the inheritance of the Empress. It was an ownerless item, and whoever obtained it would own it!
An Imperial Weapon that could be enjoyed by oneself. What difference did this have with a Great Emperor?
Thus, obtaining the Imperial Weapon not only allowed one’s abilities to skyrocket, but also represented that one was destined and blessed by fortune.

Immediately, powerful Saints rushed forwards. There were Nine Star Saints, as well as the sons of Great Emperors like Baili Haojie. However, they had just taken a few steps forwards, when Imperial Might diffused into the surroundings, causing their skin to crack, and blood to gush out.
Their figures slowed down, but in front of the Imperial Weapon, who would be willing to give up? They were still advancing with great difficulty.
However, no matter how strong a Saint was, he could only take a few steps forwards, and then his feet would not be able to move.
The Imperial Might permeated through the air. It was too terrifying. If one advanced another step further, his body would definitely explode.
So what if you were a Saint, no matter how strong you were, in front of Imperial Might, you were nothing but trash.
“No!”
“We can’t retrieve it like this at all!”
“Return to the clan and ask for the Imperial Weapon!”

At present, the Imperial Weapon couldn’t be brought alongside with them, because the invasion of Yin souls was completely supported by the Imperial Weapon. Otherwise, what could stop the progress of the Skeleton Saint Tool?
Thus, the Imperial Weapon was naturally at the front lines. However, in order to obtain a new Imperial Weapon, any clan would be willing to temporarily transfer the Imperial Weapon over.
This was the most precious treasure in the world.
Immediately, a few Saints tore a rip into the Void and left. If they went back and returned, it would only take a month’s time, at most.
Meanwhile, Ling Han’s mind whirred.
Was the Imperial Weapon set up by the Empress?
Impossible!
What Great Emperor did not have an Imperial Weapon?
Thus, if it was said that leaving behind an Imperial Weapon would solve the great crisis of this lifetime, that was impossible.

chapters.title: Chapter 4637: Stone door
paragraphs: Chapter 4637: Stone door
Ling Han didn’t attempt it.
It was very obvious that the Imperial Weapon was already showing its might. Though it was only exuding a slight bit of Imperial Might, this was still not something that any Saint could match.
He roamed around on this extinguished sun, wanting to discover something, but he did not find anything.
About a month later, the Saints that had gone to ask for the Imperial Weapon returned.

The first to return was the Blood Flame Imperial Clan, who summoned a blood-red heavenly saber. That was the Imperial Weapon that the Blood Flame Ancestral King had used years ago. Boom, it was activated by a Saint, and instantly, Imperial Might blazed.
Ling Han and the others hurriedly retreated. If this Blood Flame Imperial Clan took advantage of the opening to attack them, then when the Imperial Might arrived, who could block it?
One had to guard against despicable people.
However, after the Blood Flame Saber revived, that emerald green bamboo also glowed, exuding a similarly mighty imperial might.
The Blood Flame Imperial Clan’s Saint used the Imperial Weapon as protection, and headed towards the green bamboo.
However, he could only advance halfway, and there was no way for him to continue.
The might of the Imperial Weapon was too strong, and he could not take another step further.
This caused everyone to frown. He had actually mobilized the Imperial Weapon, yet was still unable to retrieve it?
Then what could be done?
Less than half a day later, another Saint brought an Imperial Weapon with him.
This was the Demon Ox Imperial Clan.
The two Imperial Clans that had Imperial Weapons discussed for a while, and decided to work together to obtain the inheritance of the Empress.
They would retrieve it first, and as for how it would be distributed afterwards, that was a matter for later. They had to get hold of the treasure first, before they could discuss the future.
They both revived the Imperial Weapon before continuing to advance.
The green bamboo immediately revived on its own, similarly emanating Imperial Might, resisting the two great Imperial Weapons.

In a battle of two against one, the green bamboo would definitely be at a disadvantage. However, the revived Imperial Weapon was like a Great Emperor. As long as the Imperial Weapon was not destroyed, how could it be retrieved by a Saint?
This made everyone feel exasperated.

At first, they had thought that if they used two Imperial Weapons to grind down on it, they would definitely be able to exhaust all the energy in the green bamboo. Then, it would be much easier to collect it.
However, the energy in the green bamboo seemed to be endless, and could not be exhausted no matter what.
Everyone couldn’t help but admire the strength of the Great Emperor. Even the arrangements made millions and millions of years ago were so awesome.
More and more Saints returned with the Imperial Weapon, but the situation was still the same. The revived Imperial Weapon was too terrifying. It was not something that any Saint could obtain.
However, the Imperial Weapons couldn’t stay here forever. Without the Imperial Weapons to suppress the front lines, the Skeleton Saint Tool would truly have no opposition.
Thus, since it was useless even if they brought the Imperial Weapons, the Saints could only send the Imperial Weapons back.
With the inheritance of the Empress before them, no one was willing to give it up.
How exactly were they supposed to retrieve it?
Another few days later, a massive tremor suddenly took place on this extinguished sun. Then, a massive stone door appeared in the distance.
Yi?
Everyone looked at the Imperial Weapon here, then looked at the stone door in the distance. For a moment, they didn’t know what to choose.𝐟𝕣𝕖𝐞𝐰𝕖𝚋𝐧𝗼𝚟𝐞𝕝.𝗰𝐨𝐦
After the change, perhaps it would be very easy to obtain the Imperial Weapon, but it was also possible that the stone door ahead was the key?
Yet Ling Han did not hesitate in the slightest. He communicated a message through divine sense to Brother Monkey, the empress and the others, and was already the first to move.
If the Empress was willing to easily gift the Imperial Weapon, then one of them would have long since obtained it.
It was obviously impossible.
Thus, the key was definitely that stone door that had just appeared.
There were many people who had the same thoughts as him, and they all rushed over.

With how fast a Saint was, even if they were suppressed by the Imperial Might here, and could not unleash their full speed, it was only a matter of one or two steps, and they had all arrived in front of the stone door.
The massive stone doors didn’t connect heaven and earth, but they were still 300 meters tall. They were simple and unadorned, exuding a primitive aura.
The stone door was tightly shut. From both sides, it looked the same. The door was completely flat, and there were no designs engraved on it. It appeared very plain.
Immediately, an Imperial Son walked out, arrived in front of the stone door, and stretched out a hand to push it open.
‘Hmm?’
With a push from him, the stone door actually did not move in the slightest.

This stunned everyone. This was a Golden Generation. Though his natural talent in martial arts could no longer be considered the strongest, he still belonged to the top tier. He actually did not manage to push open the stone door. This was a little exaggerated.
Could it be that they would have to send out a Great Emperor?
That Golden Generation roared loudly, and suddenly channelled his full power. Hong long long, the stone door instantly let out a loud bang, and was pushed open bit by bit.
When he pushed it open to a certain extent, they saw that the Golden Generation’s entire body had suddenly disappeared, and he had fallen in headfirst. Then, he could no longer be seen.
The stone door was still tightly shut, as if nothing had happened.
Was this a blessing or a curse?
Perhaps, one would be able to obtain the inheritance of the Empress after entering, but perhaps, supreme killing intent was hidden within, and those who trespassed would die.
“Let’s go,” Ling Han said. He didn’t believe that the Empress had spent so much effort to set soemthing up just to kill them millions and millions of years later.
Brother Monkey, the empress and the others followed behind.
Ling Han went to push open the doors first. Boom, a powerful force surged out, but the doors did not move in the slightest.
That was awkward.
Ling Han channeled Regulations again. This time, the stone door finally released a cracking sound, and then slowly opened.
He breathed a sigh of relief. As it turned out, he needed to use Regulations. Merely Saint-level power was not enough.
When he pushed open the stone doors to a certain extent, he felt a force pulling him in. It was incredibly huge, and immediately pulled him through the stone doors.
Yi, he had entered into a passage that was exuding a green halo, but he did not see that Golden Generation from before ahead of him.
He looked back, but did not see the stone door.
He understood now. Pushing open the stone doors, he had entered into another world.
So, was this where the true inheritance of the Empress lay?
Ling Han waited for a moment, yet he didn’t see the empress, Brother Monkey, or anyone else enter.
Logically speaking, the empress and the others wouldn’t hesitate at all. They would definitely follow him at the first instant.
Thus, Ling Han was also certain that the path that each person entered was independent of the rest.
This was the Empress’ test.

His fist shot over aggressively.

Without intertwining Regulations, one would not be able to unleash battle prowess that surpassed cultivation level. Thus, so what if there were 30 Regulations? They were easily shattered by Ling Han again.

However, it was useless.

About a month later, the Saints that had gone to ask for the Imperial Weapon returned.
The first to return was the Blood Flame Imperial Clan, who summoned a blood-red heavenly saber.
That was the Imperial Weapon that the Blood Flame Ancestral King had used years ago.
Boom, it was activated by a Saint, and instantly, Imperial Might blazed.
Ling Han and the others hurriedly retreated.
If this Blood Flame Imperial Clan took advantage of the opening to attack them, then when the Imperial Might arrived, who could block it?
One had to guard against despicable people.
However, after the Blood Flame Saber revived, that emerald green bamboo also glowed, exuding a similarly mighty imperial might.
The Blood Flame Imperial Clan’s Saint used the Imperial Weapon as protection, and headed towards the green bamboo.
However, he could only advance halfway, and there was no way for him to continue.
The might of the Imperial Weapon was too strong, and he could not take another step further.
This caused everyone to frown.
He had actually mobilized the Imperial Weapon, yet was still unable to retrieve it?
Then what could be done?
Less than half a day later, another Saint brought an Imperial Weapon with him.
This was the Demon Ox Imperial Clan.
The two Imperial Clans that had Imperial Weapons discussed for a while, and decided to work together to obtain the inheritance of the Empress.
They would retrieve it first, and as for how it would be distributed afterwards, that was a matter for later.
They had to get hold of the treasure first, before they could discuss the future.
They both revived the Imperial Weapon before continuing to advance.
The green bamboo immediately revived on its own, similarly emanating Imperial Might, resisting the two great Imperial Weapons.
In a battle of two against one, the green bamboo would definitely be at a disadvantage.
However, the revived Imperial Weapon was like a Great Emperor.
As long as the Imperial Weapon was not destroyed, how could it be retrieved by a Saint?
This made everyone feel exasperated.
At first, they had thought that if they used two Imperial Weapons to grind down on it, they would definitely be able to exhaust all the energy in the green bamboo.
Then, it would be much easier to collect it.
However, the energy in the green bamboo seemed to be endless, and could not be exhausted no matter what.
Everyone couldn’t help but admire the strength of the Great Emperor.
Even the arrangements made millions and millions of years ago were so awesome.
More and more Saints returned with the Imperial Weapon, but the situation was still the same.
The revived Imperial Weapon was too terrifying.
It was not something that any Saint could obtain.
However, the Imperial Weapons couldn’t stay here forever.
Without the Imperial Weapons to suppress the front lines, the Skeleton Saint Tool would truly have no opposition.
Thus, since it was useless even if they brought the Imperial Weapons, the Saints could only send the Imperial Weapons back.
With the inheritance of the Empress before them, no one was willing to give it up.
How exactly were they supposed to retrieve it?
Another few days later, a massive tremor suddenly took place on this extinguished sun.
Then, a massive stone door appeared in the distance.
Yi?
Everyone looked at the Imperial Weapon here, then looked at the stone door in the distance.

If the Empress was willing to easily gift the Imperial Weapon, then one of them would have long since obtained it.
It was obviously impossible.
Thus, the key was definitely that stone door that had just appeared.
There were many people who had the same thoughts as him, and they all rushed over.

With how fast a Saint was, even if they were suppressed by the Imperial Might here, and could not unleash their full speed, it was only a matter of one or two steps, and they had all arrived in front of the stone door.

They were simple and unadorned, exuding a primitive aura.
The stone door was tightly shut.
From both sides, it looked the same.
The door was completely flat, and there were no designs engraved on it.
It appeared very plain.

chapters.title: Chapter 4638: Driven Away
paragraphs: Chapter 4638: Driven Away
The situation finally changed when the attack of the light figure reached 99 Seven Star Regulations.
This had reached the battle prowess of a One Star Saint.
The quality was inferior, but quantity would make up for it.
However, Ling Han’s 10 low-level Regulations would be equivalent to one high-level Regulations, but without the intertwining of Regulations, he would need about 100.
A One Star Saint!

It was still insufficient in front of Ling Han, but for a Venerate, to say nothing of a One Star Saint, even the power of a Half-Saint would be unstoppable. How many people in this world would be able to pass this stage?
Ling Han snapped his fingers, and pa, this shadowy figure of light immediately crumbled.
It was still very easy.
He took another step forward. Weng! Light and shadow took form. This time, it wasn’t Venerate Tier-level anymore. Instead, it was a genuine Saint.
Two-star level.
So what?
Ling Han casually blasted it aside, not stopping in his tracks.

But the strength of the shadowy figure was also becoming stronger and stronger, from Two Stars to Three Stars, Three Stars to Four Stars. With every one that was destroyed, it would become slightly stronger.
When a Seven Star Saint appeared, Ling Han would also have to face him seriously.
On the level of Regulations, his opponent was no longer inferior to him.
However, Ling Han still had Destructive Energy, four pinnacle pillars, murderous aura attacks, and even a Pseudo-Imperial Weapon. How many stars could this increase his battle prowess by?
At most, he would only have to expend a little more effort, and Ling Han would still sweep aside all opposition, advancing aggressively.
An eight-star Saint would still be killed!
Next, a Nine-Star Saint appeared.
Of course, this kind of Nine-Star Saint was too weak. In reality, which one of those that could charge up to become a Nine-Star Saint would only have mastered nine Eight Star Regulations?
This was the manifestation of the power of the Great Emperor, gradually increasing its strength. It was understandable.
Faced with a nine-star Saint, Ling Han appeared to be struggling.
This was the suppression of a gap of two Regulations.
Moreover, Ling Han wasn’t a true Saint after all, so he was naturally at a disadvantage.
He had no choice but to unleash the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower to grind his opponent to death.
Next… was the 10-star Saint.
No, no, no, there was no overall level of cultivation like this. This was still a nine-star Saint, but the number of Regulations it could use had increased from nine to ten.
There was only a slight difference of Regulations, but his battle prowess had increased explosively.
Ling Han was extremely strained. He fought with all his might, and after paying the price of being riddled with wounds, he finally killed his opponent.
He breathed a sigh of relief and sat down on the spot, using the Ten Cultivation Technique to heal his injuries.
He sat there for two days.
Thankfully, as long as he did not move, no new shadowy figures of light would appear.
He stood up, his fighting spirit blazing.
Again!
He took a step forwards, and as expected, a new shadowy figure of light appeared. With a single strike, eleven eight-star Regulations shone brilliantly.
Ling Han faced it head-on, but this time, the gap was really too wide. Under the crushing pressure of raw strength, even he could do nothing.
He had no choice but to retreat. Instantly, the shadowy figure of light disappeared.
After recovering for a while, Ling Han walked forwards again, and the shadowy figure of light reappeared.
He was no match for him.
Ling Han could only retreat again.
Time and time again, this shadowy figure with eleven stars of battle prowess had become Ling Han’s blockade, continuously hindering his progress, unable to break through.
Ling Han didn’t try again. Before his strength increased, there was no possibility of him being a match at all.
Thus, he could only stop here.
Had he failed this challenge?
Otherwise, shouldn’t there have been some voice that would say something to him?
But here, there was only silence.
What was going on here?
‘Hmm?’
Ling Han noticed that the brightness of the passageway was slightly dimmer than before.
This was not an illusion. Another day later, the passage had clearly darkened again.
A thought flashed in Ling Han’s head. Could this be a kind of countdown?
Before the passageway was completely destroyed, this would be considered as the time to pass the test, and the results would definitely depend on how far one had advanced.

This would depend on one’s ability to battle above one’s cultivation level, and as for Ling Han… he was definitely number one in the world. Even if a Great Emperor revived, he would have to step aside.
“Then, I’ll definitely get first place.”
“Since the Empress has foreseen a terrifying future, it should be the present invasion of the Netherworld. Thus, to resolve this, an invincible king tier must be nurtured.”
“My tier surpassing ability is number one, which means that no matter what cultivation level I am in, I can sweep aside all my peers.”
“Going by that deduction, I should be the one to obtain the ancient treasure trove.”
“It’s just that I don’t know what kind of plan the Empress has prepared.”
Ling Han was extremely curious, but all he could do now was wait.
With every passing day, the passageway would dim slightly. When the fourteenth day arrived, practically thw whole passage had dimmed.
Another day passed, and Ling Han suddenly felt his eyes light up. He had already returned to that extinguished sun, and in front of him was the Emerald Bamboo Imperial Weapon.
Beside him was the Golden Generation that had entered first.
Upon seeing him, the Golden Generation revealed an awkward expression. He nodded at Ling Han, and a smile appeared on his face.

Ling Han also smiled. This was the Imperial Son of the Saintly Heaven Imperial Clan. Previously, there had not been any animosity between them. Thus, though he would not be warm towards him, it was not to the extent that he would turn hostile, or even actually make a move to cause injury.
A while later, Brother Monkey, the empress and the others appeared, one after another.
As expected, everyone’s challenge time was the same, and the order of entry was also the order of exit.
As more and more Imperial Sons appeared, many people’s eyes were focused on Ling Han.
By now, everyone naturally knew what the test behind the stone door was, and in terms of tier surpassing battle prowess, who could compare to Ling Han?
Then, the inheritance of the Empress was going to be taken by Ling Han?

It should be known that Empress Qingzhu had deliberately made arrangements for this. Thus, her inheritance was definitely not limited to something like the Imperial Weapon, Imperial Scroll, and so on. There must be other treasures. Otherwise, how could the great calamity that would befall all eternity be resolved?
These treasures all belonged to Ling Han alone?
This guy was already freakish enough, and he was going to become even stronger?
Then what was the point of letting others continue?
“Kill him!”
“At the very least, we have to chase him away.”
The Imperial Sons exchanged looks. Even a fallen Imperial Son like Yang Yihuan revealed a baleful expression, focusing his gaze on Ling Han.
The two sides that should have been completely hostile were now showing signs of joining forces because of Ling Han.
—Before the great temptation of becoming Emperor, one could let go of all grievances.
Xiu!
Right at this moment, the ground suddenly split apart, and a pillar of light shot into the sky.
What was going on?
Hiss, the inheritance of the Empress was about to appear!
Everyone understood. They all shouted loudly, and charged towards Ling Han.
There was no time. They had to kill Ling Han or chase him away.𝗳𝗿𝐞𝕖𝘄𝗲𝕓𝗻𝚘𝚟𝕖𝐥.𝚌𝕠𝕞
There was no shortage of Five Star Saints like Baili Haojie among them. One-on-one, they were enough to suppress Ling Han, what more when there were so many of them working together?
What could Ling Han do?
He could only flee.
He used the Phoenix Wings Divine Flight. He traversed everywhere, but he only flew in this area and did not leave.
The inheritance of the Empress was about to appear, so how could he possibly leave?
“You’re not leaving? Then die!”

All the Imperial Sons smirked coldly. They had used Regulations to seal off space, and Ling Han’s space of movement would be further and further compressed. If he still continued to battle, his only fate would be death.

chapters.title: Chapter 4639: Seed of the Holy Flame
paragraphs: Chapter 4639: Seed of the Holy Flame
Ling Han could do nothing, so he could only expand the range of his movements.

Brother Monkey and the others couldn’t help much either. They were all One Star Saints, and even if their natural talent wasn’t inferior to the ancient Imperial Sons, there was still a huge gap of so many minor levels between them. Thus, they were naturally overwhelmed.
Xiu, the pillar of light soared into the sky, but very soon, as if it had spat out all its energy, it began to withdraw.
The inheritance of the Empress was about to appear?
All the Saints kept Ling Han out, while preparing themselves to make a move to snatch it at any time.
The pillar of light instantly dimmed. Then, a purple dot of light suddenly rushed out from where the pillar of light had disappeared, turning into a shooting star. Its speed was indescribable.
Was this the inheritance of the Empress?
No matter what it was, they had to grab hold of it first.
All the Saints hurriedly moved, but the purple light spot was incredibly agile, and its speed was also very fast. None of the Saints managed to succeed in their attack.
However, the Saints used the Regulations as a net, and forcibly restricted space, causing the speed of the purple speck of light to finally slow down.
At this moment, the Saints could also clearly see that this purple dot of light was actually a seed!
Yi?
Seed? Could this be a supreme treasure?
After this thought flashed through their minds, the Saints showed no signs of stopping.
They would snatch it first. Even if it was trash, they would have to obtain it first.
“Haha, this is mine now!” Baili Haojie stretched out a hand, and grabbed hold of the purple seed.

Firstly, he was lucky. When the seed’s speed slowed down, it just happened to be by his side. Secondly, he was strong enough, because there were actually others beside him. It was just that they could not snatch it ahead of him.
He was extremely pleased with himself. This was clearly destiny.
“No!” he suddenly roared loudly, and a streak of purple light actually shot out from the top of his head.
What else could it be but that purple seed?
Who would have thought that a great Saint would actually be unable to detain a seed?
Xiu, this time, the purple seed had a clear target.
Ling Han!
It continued to speed up, heading towards Ling Han.
If it’s not yours, you can’t keep it no matter what. If it’s yours, even if you don’t want it, it will still deliver itself to your doorstep.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and stretched out a hand to grab it.
Xiu, the purple dot of light sank into his palm, then quickly came to his mind, and settled down.
Images spread out in Ling Han’s mind. This was about the origins of this seed.
Ling Han saw a supreme Empress standing proudly in space. There was an emerald green halo around her, which made her appear both mighty and heroic, as well as indescribably beautiful.
And in front of her, there was a massive crack.
F***, this was the great fissure at the edge of the universe!
Ling Han had seen this large crack in Xuan Taiyu’s vision before, and now, he saw it in Empress Qingzhu’s memories.

By the looks of it, the ancient Great Emperors had all ventured to the edge of the universe before. However, the Battle Saint Emperor, the Ancestral King Lingtian, and the others had all entered this place in their later years, never to appear again.

Subsequently, Ling Han saw Empress Qingzhu enter into this large fissure, but the image was extremely blurry. He could not see clearly at all, and the image was still flickering. After a while, Ling Han finally caught a blurry image.
—In Empress Qingzhu’s hand, there was a purple seed.
It was the one in his mind.
As it turned out… this seed actually originated from the edge of the universe.
This was incredible!

It should be known that even the Great Emperors had gone to the edge of the universe to search for a way to achieve immortality, and clearly, the so-called edge of the universe was only a general term. The true destination of the Great Emperors was this spatial fissure!
In this scene, Ling Han could even see that the Empress was riddled with wounds, and the right side of her chest had even been pierced through!
That was the Empress, the strongest existence in the universe, and she was actually injured?
Furthermore, her injuries were so severe!
Hiss, it could be seen just how great a price the Empress had paid for this purple seed.
No wonder the Great Emperors only came here to adventure in their old age, seeking the path to immortality.
It was too dangerous. Even the Great Emperors could possibly die.
At this moment, the scene dimmed, and a thought was transmitted into Ling Han’s mind.
“This is the Seed of the Holy Flame, and it has existed since the creation of heaven and earth.”
“Using this to burn the holy flame, and ultimately become Great Emperor, one would be qualified to become the strongest Great Emperor in history!”
“I have foreseen a great catastrophe that would occur millions and millions of years later. Though I have planned ahead, the future is filled with variables, so there is only so much I can do.”
“Thou shalt work hard, and strengthen thyself.”
Then, Ling Han received a secret technique that was used to control the Imperial Weapon.
The Clear Bamboo Sword, the Imperial Weapon used by Empress Qingzhu!
In Empress Qingzhu’s blurry memories, Ling Han saw that after this Empress journeyed to the edge of the universe, she passed away not long after, and returned to the heavens as a green bamboo.

It was clear that she had been severely wounded during her journey to the edge of the universe. In fact, she had even wounded her foundations as a Great Emperor. Otherwise, with her power as a Great Emperor, it wouldn’t have been a problem for her to live a second life as long as she could find supreme treasures.
This Empress had never married, nor had she left behind any descendants. In fact, she hadn’t even created the Imperial Scroll.
Because the Imperial Scroll was only taught to future generations, did a Great Emperor himself need the Imperial Scroll?
He was capable of all that he had learnt!
Thus, the Empress only passed down her method of controlling the Imperial Weapon, and did not teach him her own Imperial Technique.
Ling Han knew that the Empress had other considerations.
—If one wanted to become a Great Emperor, he would have to walk his own path, and to imitate others, no matter how strong he was, there was no way he could become a Great Emperor.
Thus, the Empress hoped that Ling Han could walk his own path without being affected, and did not pass on the slightest bit of her own path.
Such a great person was worthy of admiration.
As the saying went, when one passed, their name would be left behind. Without an immortal life, leaving behind one’s inheritance would naturally be the best choice.
Yet the Empress was disdainful of this.
This was the generosity of a Great Emperor.
Ling Han’s eyes suddenly snapped open.
These words took a long time to say, but in truth, they had all streaked through Ling Han’s mind, and only less than a second had passed.
“Hand it over!” The Imperial Sons all attacked Ling Han as if they had gone mad.
Putting everything else aside, merely looking at how the purple seed could actually run out of Baili Hao’s body on its own, it was clear how amazing this thing was.
How could the inheritance left behind by the Empress be ordinary?
Boom, boom, boom! As the Saints attacked, they spread out, surrounding Ling Han and the others.
Flee?
Impossible!
So what if Phoenix Wings Divine Flight was fast? It couldn’t penetrate the Regulations.
“Hand over the seed, or die!” an old Saint said. He humphed, and drew out a jade vial. Weng, a frightening might overflowed, and even the heaven and earth paled in comparison.
Imperial Might!
Gods, this was actually an Imperial Weapon!

Who would have thought that after the failed attempt to seize the green bamboo, the Imperial Weapon would be returned, and continue to resist the Skeleton Saint Tool, that there was actually an Imperial Clan that kept the Imperial Weapon by their side secretly.
This was the Treasure Vial Imperial Clan.
Obviously, they had long since made up their minds. No matter who obtained the inheritance of the Empress, they would seize it by force with the Imperial Weapon.
The Imperial Weapon had already awakened and enveloped the entire planet. If anyone dared to act rashly, they would immediately suffer a head-on attack from the Imperial Weapon!
How were they supposed to resolve this dilemma?

chapters.title: Chapter 4640: Come on!
paragraphs: Chapter 4640: Come on!
The Imperial Weapon locked onto him, and even the Nine-Star Saints broke out in a cold sweat.

Who would have thought that the Treasured Vial Imperial Clan would actually have a trump card up their sleeve? Moreover, they had secretly activated the Imperial Weapon while the Saints were attacking Ling Han.
Now, wherever the Imperial Weapon pointed, who wouldn’t feel apprehensive?

“Hand over the inheritance of the Empress, or your only fate would be death!” the Saint from the Treasure Vial Imperial Clan shouted. He believed that the inheritance of Empress Qingzhu was definitely hidden in that purple seed.

Thus, he was only threatening Ling Han. That was because under the barrage of attacks from the Imperial Weapon, Ling Han’s form and spirit would definitely be destroyed. It was guaranteed that not a single scrap would be left behind, and the inheritance of the Empress would definitely be gone as well.
What could they do?

Brother Monkey, the empress, and the others all looked at Ling Han. Tearing a rip into space to leave required time. Though it was short, it was enough time for the Imperial Weapon to strike down and erase everything.
Could it be that they really had to hand over the inheritance of the Empress?
The problem was, would the Treasure Vial Imperial Clan keep their promise?

At present, it was only coercion, and they could make the Treasure Vial Imperial Clan hold back due to wariness, but once the inheritance was handed over, would the Treasure Vial Imperial Clan still have any qualms?
It should be known that Ling Han had always been a thorn in the side of the Imperial Clans. If he did not die, what Imperial Son would dare say that he could become emperor?
Yet Ling Han smiled, and said calmly, “I don’t believe you!”
‘You don’t believe me?’
What right do you have not to believe me?
The might of the Imperial Weapon could obliterate all matter, and even a nine-star Saint would have to die in resentment. Where did you get such courage from?

“Ling Han, don’t think that just because you have the inheritance of the Empress, I don’t dare to make a move!” the old Saint from the Treasure Vial Imperial Clan said balefully. He was an eight-star Saint with the title of Bright Minister. Even if he didn’t use the Imperial Weapon, he could still suppress Ling Han.
However, Saint against Saint, even if Ling Han wanted to flee, he wouldn’t be able to stop him. He wouldn’t be able to kill him with a single strike.
However, the Imperial Weapon was different. Once it revived, as long as it locked onto its target, aside from the Pseudo-Emperor, who could escape?
In other words, unless a Pseudo-Emperor arrived, no one would be able to save Ling Han.
Why was Ling Han so certain?
“Come on then!” Ling Han crooked a finger at him, looking like he was provoking someone.
F***, had this guy gone mad?
The Imperial Weapon was pointing at you, and you still dare to act arrogant and provoke it?

“Humph! Worse come to worst, no one can obtain the inheritance of the Empress!” the Bright Minister Saint said coldly. Even if he destroyed the inheritance of the Empress, that would still be better than falling into Ling Han’s hands. Otherwise, who would be able to compete with him for the imperial throne?
“Die!”
He gave a loud shout. Boom, the treasure bottle suddenly exploded with an endless burst of Imperial Might. A pillar of light shot out from the bottle’s mouth, charging towards Ling Han.
The awakening of the Imperial Weapon was equivalent to the reincarnation of a Great Emperor. Who could stop it?
There was none!
Even a Pseudo-Emperor couldn’t do it.
Everyone shook their heads. Ling Han was definitely done for.

This was good too. Though the inheritance of the Empress was also gone, but with this as the price, it was not too much of a loss to erase a competitor that had the highest chance of becoming Emperor.
The light of the treasure bottle assailed, capable of crushing everything.
Peng, light exploded, endlessly dazzling.
However, everyone shockingly discovered that the treasure bottle’s light had actually been blocked.
What!
This caused everyone’s scalps to go numb. Ling Han was going to defy the heavens! He could even withstand the might of the Imperial Weapon!

However, after only an instant, everyone discovered that this wasn’t because Ling Han was heaven-defyingly powerful, but rather because there was a dark green bamboo floating above his head. It was only two feet long, yet it was exuding a terrifying imperial might.
This was Empress Qingzhu’s Imperial Weapon!
—Previously, Ling Han had been arguing verbally with the Bright Minister Saint, but his true motive was actually to drag out time, so he could grasp the technique to control the Clear Bamboo Sword.
Though he only had a slight grasp of it now, it was enough for him to awaken the Imperial Weapon, and there was no need for him to be very proficient.
Now, when an Imperial Weapon faced another Imperial Weapon, what did Ling Han have to fear?
“Come on then!” Ling Han smiled calmly.
‘Holy f*ck!’
At this moment, everyone was speechless.
With the Imperial Weapon in hand, the world belonged to him!
Unless the Great Emperor revived, who would still be able to face Ling Han head-on?

Even if it was a Pseudo-Emperor, he would still have to exhaust Ling Han’s power first, so that he would no longer be able to awaken the Imperial Weapon. Only then would he be able to make a move on Ling Han. Otherwise, even a Pseudo-Emperor would also have to die!
The strongest trait of the Imperial Clan was that they had the Imperial Weapon on standby, but now?
Ling Han also had an Imperial Weapon. The real Imperial Weapon, and not a Pseudo-Imperial Weapon like the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.

The Bright Minister Saint was also rendered speechless. Though his own battle prowess was superior to Ling Han’s, in front of Great Emperor-level power, his measly abilities were completely negligible.
Thus, as long as Ling Han could awaken the Imperial Weapon, there would be no solution.
Ling Han turned his gaze to Lu Xun and the other fallen Imperial Sons, then looked at Baili Haojie and the other ancient Imperial Sons, his killing intent brimming.
“Retreat! Retreat! Retreat!”

Cold sweat broke out on the backs of these Imperial Sons. The Imperial Weapon had shown its might. No matter how prodigious they were, so what? They would be blasted into smithereens with a single strike.
They all tore a rip into space and fled.
What was the point of staying any longer? The inheritance of the Empress had already been obtained by Ling Han.

The Bright Minister Saint was also rendered speechless. He had the Imperial Weapon, and so did Ling Han. This was the strongest Spirit Tool in the universe. It was also because of this that the individual battle prowess gap between the wielders to become negligible.
He was an eight-star Saint, so what did it matter that his abilities were superior to Ling Han?
There was absolutely no chance for him to show off, all right?
He glared hatefully at Ling Han. He had really not thought that Ling Han had obtained the inheritance of the Empress, and even the Imperial Weapon was under his control!
It didn’t make sense. The Imperial Weapon wasn’t left for the clansmen, and it was actually passed on to an outsider. Had this Empress lost her mind?
“Let’s go!” He made a prompt decision. After tearing a rip into space, he left with the other Saints of the clan.
In this way, only Ling Han, the empress, Brother Monkey, and a few others were left here.
“Haha!” They all laughed loudly. In terms of strength, which one of those like the Bright Minister Saint and the others was not stronger than them?
In fact, they only had to mobilize Baili Haojie, or Lin Dong, and that would be enough to sweep aside all opposition, but now? It was the Imperial Sons that were fleeing in disarray.
This was naturally a massive victory.
“We should also leave.”
Ling Han and the others returned to the Four Directions Planet. After settling down, he told them about the purple seed.
“Seed of the Holy Flame!”
“The most powerful Great Emperor!”

Everyone exclaimed in shock. This was something that the Empress had obtained from the edge of the universe. In fact, in fact, for the sake of this seed, the Empress had suffered severe injuries, and very soon, died, and did not live a second life.
Thus, just how astonishing was the value of this seed?
Meanwhile, Brother Monkey’s expression was solemn. Empress Qingzhu had been severely injured for the sake of this seed, so what about the Battle Saint Emperor?
Could it be that he had long since encountered a mishap?
Unfortunately, with the power of a Saint, he was completely unable to fly across the vast universe. At present, he could only feel anxious.
At the very least, one had to become a Pseudo-Emperor to qualify to approach the edge of the universe.

Brother Monkey had a target again, but advancing one step further in Saint Tier was really too difficult. Even if he was very motivated, he still had to take it one step at a time, and take things slowly.

Everyone went to cultivate, and as their cultivation level became higher and higher, this sense of urgency also became stronger and stronger. Now, it was up to who would be the first to become a Pseudo-Emperor, and they would be able to seize the first opportunity, squeezing into the true sequence of becoming Emperor.
Ling Han also began to cultivate in seclusion. However, his goal was to study the Seed of the Holy Flame.
However, his consciousness couldn’t enter the seed at all. After studying it for a while, he could only give up.
