At present, he could only feel anxious.
At the very least, one had to become a Pseudo-Emperor to qualify to approach the edge of the universe.
Brother Monkey had a target again, but advancing one step further in Saint Tier was really too difficult.
Even if he was very motivated, he still had to take it one step at a time, and take things slowly.
Everyone went to cultivate, and as their cultivation level became higher and higher, this sense of urgency also became stronger and stronger.
Now, it was up to who would be the first to become a Pseudo-Emperor, and they would be able to seize the first opportunity, squeezing into the true sequence of becoming Emperor.
Ling Han also began to cultivate in seclusion.
However, his goal was to study the Seed of the Holy Flame.
However, his consciousness couldn’t enter the seed at all.
After studying it for a while, he could only give up.

chapters.title: Chapter 4641: A great ocean in space
paragraphs: Chapter 4641: A great ocean in space
This seed was profound and unfathomable.
Though it was only the size of a soybean, if it was magnified 10,000 times, one could clearly see the mysterious veined patterns on it, as if the secrets of the universe was engraved on it.
Ling Han didn’t dare to nurture this seed either. Once it sprouted, wouldn’t he become a Saint?
Right now, he didn’t want to become a Saint.
His target was the pinnacle of Fourth Extreme.
Ling Han returned to harvest a batch of Celestial Qi. Then, using the Clear Bamboo Sword as the formation eye, he continued to collect them.
This efficiency was completely different.
This was an Imperial Weapon, and it contained the Nine Star Regulations. It had an indescribable absorption effect on Celestial Qi, making them very easy to grasp.
A smile appeared on Ling Han’s face. This could increase his efficiency tenfold.
Originally, he would have to wait about a hundred years to be able to fully cultivate a minor level, but now, he only needed a short ten years!

Calculating, he was presently a 10-star Venerate, and if it was like when he was a Sect Master, 15 Stars was the pinnacle level, then he still needed to increase his cultivation level by five minor levels. In total, he would need… 50 years!
Fifty years, he only needed fifty years.

For Venerate Tier, being able to increase cultivation level by one minor level in a few hundred years was already considered fast. Being able to increase cultivation level by five minor levels in these fifty years, how astonishingly fast was that?

Ling Han nodded in understanding. No wonder the Imperial Son’s cultivation had advanced so quickly. He had the support of the Imperial Clan behind him, and as long as his comprehension ability was enough, it was truly easy for him to increase his cultivation level.

He was filled with anticipation. Fifty years later, he would be able to cultivate to the end of the Venerate Tier, and then accelerate the growth of the first Seed of the Holy Flame in history. Then, just how far would his battle prowess soar?
Was this kind of Saint strong enough to insta-kill anything and everything?

Though Ling Han had obtained the inheritance of Empress Qingzhu, and seemed to have obtained some kind of super great opportunity, after all, even Saints could not detain the Seed of the Holy Flame, and this was something that the Saints had witnessed with their own eyes.
However, the members of the Imperial Clans actually held back, and did not send anyone to threaten Ling Han to hand over the Seed of the Holy Flame.
It was not that they did not want to, but rather that they did not dare.
What did the Imperial Clan rely on the most? The Imperial Weapon!
Now, however, Ling Han also possessed an Imperial Weapon.
Thus, what did it matter that the Imperial Clan sent a Saint over with an Imperial Weapon?
What did Ling Han have to fear?
Imperial Weapon against Imperial Weapon, it would only result in both sides coming off damaged at most.
You see, was there a time when the Imperial Clans would become hostile and fight one another to the death?
There was none!
Because they all had Imperial Weapons that restricted each other, they naturally wouldn’t engage in battles that would damage foundations.

The present Nine Suns Holy Land had an Imperial Weapon, Imperial Scroll and Saints. Aside from being slightly lacking in formations, there was actually no difference between them and an Imperial Clan.
And in terms of the number of Saints, hoho, the Nine Suns Holy Land would be able to completely surpass any Imperial Clan.
Of course, the cultivation levels of the Saints were still a little low, and they were all One Star Saints.
However, given enough time, with the natural talent of Brother Monkey, the empress and the others, it would not be difficult for them to cultivate to seven, eight, or even nine-star Saints.
Their difficulty should be the barrier of Pseudo-Emperor Tier.
“Yi?”
On this day, Ling Han was concocting an alchemical pill when he suddenly saw a large sea floating over from the sky.
This!
Even if Ling Han was knowledgeable and experienced, he was still quite shocked.
This great ocean was incredibly far away from him, and was still in space. However, because it was too big, Ling Han was still able to catch sight of it even though they were so far apart.
There was actually a great ocean floating in space; this was too inconceivable, wasn’t it?
Could it be that some Mystery Realm had appeared?
However, this speed was so fast!
In merely the blink of an eye, this great ocean had enlarged a bit more, which showed how much distance had been closed in between them.
Xiu, xiu, xiu! Brother Monkey, the empress and the others also saw it, and leaped over.
“Which Mystery Realm has appeared?” the large black dog asked curiously.
“Let’s go and take a look!” Ling Han said. Then, with a step, he had already arrived outside the Four Origin Planet.
The empress and the others all came over, and from here, they could see that this great ocean was even more boundless.
Gods, if the Four Origin Planet was thrown in, it would only be a small island, at most.
Everyone was stunned. This was really shocking.

In the great ocean, waves crashed into the skies, but there was clearly no land blocking the edges, yet not a single drop of seawater seeped out. No matter how the waves crashed into the skies, every drop would ultimately return to the great ocean.
“What kind of Mystery Realm is this? Sea Mystery Realm?” the large black dog mocked from the sidelines.
Of course, this sea had also been discovered by others, and they broadcasted it live on the Galaxy Network.
Instantly, a great many Imperial Clan elites moved out.
Perhaps there would be a supreme great opportunity!
As for why this great opportunity had taken the initiative to seek out Ling Han, they did not care.
In short, Ling Han had already obtained enough opportunities. He couldn’t continue to become stronger.
However, no matter how fast a Saint was, they would still need time. Right now, only Ling Han and the others were facing the rapidly approaching sea.

In just the time for a few breaths, this great ocean had appeared in the galaxy where the Four Origin Planet was located, and with how wide this great ocean was, it instantly drowned a great many nearby galaxies, and they could no longer be seen.
Hiss!
There were so many galaxies, and just how many living beings were in them, and they had all died just like that?

It was soundless and had no prior signs. At most, only a limited number of people managed to escape using the Transfer Formation. The others were all swallowed by the seawater along with the Transfer Formation.
Ling Han and the others exchanged looks, and a chill rose up in their hearts. Moreover, Four Origin Planet lay behind them.
However, the sea finally stopped, just thirty thousand meters in front of Ling Han and the others, as if it had a life of its own.
In an instant, a figure dashed out of the sea and appeared in front of Ling Han and the others.
This was a tall, slender man. He was dressed in a tight-fitting black outfit, and there was an octopus painted on his chest. However, it was golden, and actually gave off a sacred feeling.
“Greetings, everyone.” This man looked to be in his early twenties, at most. The flame of life had only been burning for over ten thousand years, but he was shockingly a Four-Star Saint!
F***, was it an ancient Imperial Son?
A thought flashed in Ling Han’s head. Ge Qianqiu had said before that there were a total of Twelve Lands of Death and their masters in this world, so could it be that this was one of them?
He looked at this black-robed young man, and asked darkly, “Who are you?”
“Me?” The black-robed young man smiled slightly, “My surname is Zhang, and my name is Zhang Yu.”
“Octopus!” Hu Niu couldn’t help but pout. “Can’t be eaten, so what is the point of being named after seafood!1”
Everyone’s expressions became awkward. The tense atmosphere just now seemed to have been instantly reversed.
“Which Imperial Clan are you from?” Ling Han asked.
“My father is the Sea Emperor!” Zhang Yu smiled slightly.
Sea Emperor?
Was this also a Great Emperor?

Emperors and Ancestral King. Those whose name had these words within were all of the same level, and though there were also those who bit off more than they could chew and called themselves “Sword Emperor”, “Saber Emperor” and so on, they would basically be beaten to death very soon.
This was a taboo.

“Brother Zhang, why have you come so aggressively?” Ling Han asked coldly. The other had steered such a great ocean here, swallowing who knew how many galaxies along the way, so how could he possibly have a good expression?
Moreover, if he belonged to one of the Twelve Lands of Death, he would be a force from the Netherworld, so there was even less need for him to be reserved.

chapters.title: Chapter 4642: Demanding
paragraphs: Chapter 4642: Demanding
In space, multiple figures tore a rip into space and appeared. Every single one of them was exuding a frightening aura, like they were Demon Gods.
The Saints had arrived.
There were those from the Imperial Clans, and there were also those from the Holy Lands. They had all seen the live broadcast on the Galaxy Network, and rushed over at the first instant.
These were those that were the closest to them. It was sure that there would be other Saints appearing, one after another, and there would be even more of them.
They all thought that this great ocean was some kind of Mystery Realm.
Strictly speaking, the Land of Death could also be considered a Mystery Realm, but in this place, there were basically no great opportunities, only death.
When these Saints saw Zhang Yu, they were all stunned.
Where had he popped out from?
Previously, they had been completely focused on their journey, and had not had the time to pay attention to Galaxy Network’s live broadcast.

However, as long as they connected to the Galaxy Network again, they would soon be able to find out the reason — it was not everyone in the Imperial Clans did not use the connection device, but among the core members, there was definitely none.
It didn’t matter. It was fine as long as one person connected it. He turned on the projection function, and then replayed it. Everything became clear.
Yi, this man actually walked out of the great ocean?
All the Saints were surprised. What the hell was this great ocean? Why was it floating in space?

Though he was surrounded by the Saints, Zhang Yu did not take it to heart at all. He looked calm and composed. He looked at Ling Han, and said with a smile, “I heard that Brother Ling has obtained a seed, and would like to ask Brother Ling Ling to part with it.”
Ling Han’s heart jolted.
For the sake of this seed, Empress Qingzhu had barged into the great crack at the edge of the universe by herself, and paid the price of being severely injured and unable to live a second life.
And why had she done that?

Because this Empress had foreseen a frightening future, she had made arrangements, wanting to create an invincible Great Emperor in this era, capable of sweeping aside all opposition in the world, and resolve the crisis.
From the look of things now, this crisis was the invasion of the Netherworld on the surface, but in truth, the mastermind behind it was the Masters of the Twelve Lands of Death.
No matter how one looked at it, this Zhang Yu, as well as this great sea, was a matching description for a Land of Death.
Thus, the rulers of the Twelve Lands of Death was also very wary of Empress Qingzhu’s trump card, and deliberately mobilized a Land of Death, wanting to snatch this seed.
In this way, the threat to them was naturally eliminated.
Ling Han shook his head, “Why should I part with it?”
Zhang Yu smiled, “As long as Brother Ling is willing to hand over that seed, I can satisfy whatever request you have.”
“For example, Imperial Scroll, if one scroll is not enough, you can have two scrolls, or even three or four scrolls.”
“Imperial Weapon is fine too!”
“Or perhaps, an exquisite beauty!”
What!
When the Saints in the surroundings heard this, they all trembled in excitement.𝑓𝑟𝑒𝘦𝓌𝑒𝑏𝑛𝑜𝘷𝑒𝘭.𝒸𝘰𝑚
He was offering even an Imperial Scroll? Furthermore, it was not just one or two, but he was actually offering three or even four just like that?
‘F*ck! Just how many Imperial Clans have you robbed?’
After a moment of excitement, the Saints’ first reaction was that this person was boasting. What force would be able to grasp more than one Imperial Scroll?
Ling Han thought for a moment, then said, “All right. As long as you can satisfy one condition of mine, it is not impossible for me to part with it.”
“Please speak, Brother Ling.” Zhang Yu smiled calmly.
“Tell the masters of the Twelve Lands of Death to commit suicide, and I’ll hand that seed over to you,” Ling Han said.
This was obviously something that could not be accepted. Thus, Zhang Yu’s expression that had been smiling all this while finally changed.
He withdrew his smile, revealing a baleful and arrogant expression.
“Brother Ling, up until now, I have been speaking nicely,” he said calmly.
“Yi, you speak as if I have scolded you.” Ling Han shrugged his shoulders.
“This person has persecutory delusions, right?” the large black dog asked from the sidelines.
“You’re sick, you have to be treated!” the little azure dragon continued.
“Ang!” The perverted pig was exasperated. Uncle Pig had been throwing himself into a pile of women, and what was the meaning of you guys dragging Uncle Pig up here?
What a bunch of b@stards.
Zhang Yu instantly looked furious. How could these guys in front of him be so despicable? With just a few words, they had provoked him to the point of fuming.
“You guys, don’t be shameless!” He raised his voice.
All around them, the Saints all felt sympathy.
Ling Han, the large black dog, and the others were the type to drive others to die out of fury from their insults.
‘You should have long since prepared yourself. When it’s time to make a move, don’t waste words. There’s only one word for it: do it!’
However, this guy was actually also a Fallen Imperial Son like Yang Yihuan, He Luo, and the others. This naturally caused all the Saints to feel a sense of unity against a common enemy.

—Aside from a minority that was completely disregarding the bigger picture, even the Imperials knew that the conflict between them and Ling Han was an internal affair, while the conflict with the Netherworld was irreconcilable.
“Face is earned, not given by anyone,” Ling Han said with a smile.
“Who do you think you are? Do you want us to give you face?” the large black dog scoffed.
“F*ck!” The little azure dragon gave him the middle finger.
Zhang Yu could no longer hold back, and moved directly, charging towards Ling Han and the others.

Boom! A devastating might surged into the surroundings. He was a Four-Star Saint, and he was more so the son of a Great Emperor. Thus, his natural talent in cultivation was astonishingly powerful. With a single strike, 12 eight-star Regulations surged into the surroundings.
Even Ling Han wouldn’t be able to withstand it. They all used Phoenix Wings Divine Flight to rapidly retreat.
“I gave you face, yet you refuse. All of you, die!” Zhang Yu chased after them.
“Humph, this is the Living Realm!” A Saint stepped out, greeting Zhang Yu’s attack.
Boom!
He had actually blocked Zhang Yu, and was not at a disadvantage at all.
This stunned everyone. This person was clearly only a Four-Star Saint, yet was actually so strong!
“Luo Yang, son of the Great Emperor of the Saintly Heaven Imperial Clan!” It wasn’t long before someone revealed the identity of this Saint.
So that was the case.
Everyone nodded. They were both the sons of Great Emperors, so who would be weaker than the other?
The two Imperial Sons were locked in an intense battle. At this moment, to say nothing of deciding the victor, it was impossible to determine who had the upper hand.
All the Saints smirked coldly. A mere Imperial Son actually dared to boast shamelessly?
Did he really think that the people of the Living Realm were made of paper?
“How incredibly foolish!” Zhang Yu smirked coldly, and waved his hand, “Come!”
Weng, weng, weng! A terrifying scene appeared. Multiple figures flew out of the sea, densely packed together.
Saintly corpses!
Heavens, what kind of number was this?
Why was it this move again?
The sea of blood, the Yin River… their main method of attack was the corpses of Saints.
But even though this move was old-fashioned, it had been tested time and time again.
Just ask, who in the world could match the sea of corpses of Saints?
Aside from Great Emperors, only Pseudo-Emperors would be capable.
Instantly, all the Saints retreated.
They couldn’t face this head-on, or they would definitely die!

Even Luo Yang didn’t step forward to battle anymore. With his battle prowess, he wouldn’t be afraid of the corpses of Saints even if it were one-on-one or one-on-ten. However, how could it be just one-on-ten now?
One against a hundred, one against a thousand, ten thousand… no matter how strong his battle prowess was, he was no match.
Zhang Yu looked coldly at Ling Han, “You refuse a toast, and insist on drinking a forfeit! Hand over the seed, or I will destroy this planet below!”

Even if they were members of the Imperial Clans, they would not threaten others like this, because they were not all alone either. If they were targeted by a Saint, they would only be able to cower. Who would dare to run out of the protection of the Imperial Formation?
However, those who had come from desperate straits were unafraid.
Firstly, they were all Saints, and their abilities were astonishingly strong, and even if they were no match, how easy would it be for a Saint to escape?
Secondly, who would dare charge into a Land of Death?
Thus, Zhang Yu could threaten Ling Han like this.

Uncle Pig had been throwing himself into a pile of women, and what was the meaning of you guys dragging Uncle Pig up here?
What a bunch of b@stards.
Zhang Yu instantly looked furious.
How could these guys in front of him be so despicable?
With just a few words, they had provoked him to the point of fuming.
“You guys, don’t be shameless!” He raised his voice.
All around them, the Saints all felt sympathy.
Ling Han, the large black dog, and the others were the type to drive others to die out of fury from their insults.
‘You should have long since prepared yourself.
When it’s time to make a move, don’t waste words.
There’s only one word for it: do it!’
However, this guy was actually also a Fallen Imperial Son like Yang Yihuan, He Luo, and the others.
This naturally caused all the Saints to feel a sense of unity against a common enemy.

—Aside from a minority that was completely disregarding the bigger picture, even the Imperials knew that the conflict between them and Ling Han was an internal affair, while the conflict with the Netherworld was irreconcilable.
“Face is earned, not given by anyone,” Ling Han said with a smile.
“Who do you think you are?
Do you want us to give you face?” the large black dog scoffed.
“F*ck!” The little azure dragon gave him the middle finger.
Zhang Yu could no longer hold back, and moved directly, charging towards Ling Han and the others.
Boom!
A devastating might surged into the surroundings.
He was a Four-Star Saint, and he was more so the son of a Great Emperor.
Thus, his natural talent in cultivation was astonishingly powerful.
With a single strike, 12 eight-star Regulations surged into the surroundings.
Even Ling Han wouldn’t be able to withstand it.
They all used Phoenix Wings Divine Flight to rapidly retreat.
“I gave you face, yet you refuse.
All of you, die!” Zhang Yu chased after them.
“Humph, this is the Living Realm!” A Saint stepped out, greeting Zhang Yu’s attack.
Boom!
He had actually blocked Zhang Yu, and was not at a disadvantage at all.
This stunned everyone.
This person was clearly only a Four-Star Saint, yet was actually so strong!
“Luo Yang, son of the Great Emperor of the Saintly Heaven Imperial Clan!” It wasn’t long before someone revealed the identity of this Saint.
So that was the case.
Everyone nodded.
They were both the sons of Great Emperors, so who would be weaker than the other?
The two Imperial Sons were locked in an intense battle.
At this moment, to say nothing of deciding the victor, it was impossible to determine who had the upper hand.
All the Saints smirked coldly.
A mere Imperial Son actually dared to boast shamelessly?
Did he really think that the people of the Living Realm were made of paper?
“How incredibly foolish!” Zhang Yu smirked coldly, and waved his hand, “Come!”
Weng, weng, weng!
A terrifying scene appeared.
Multiple figures flew out of the sea, densely packed together.
Saintly corpses!
Heavens, what kind of number was this?
Why was it this move again?
The sea of blood, the Yin River… their main method of attack was the corpses of Saints.
But even though this move was old-fashioned, it had been tested time and time again.
Just ask, who in the world could match the sea of corpses of Saints?
Aside from Great Emperors, only Pseudo-Emperors would be capable.
Instantly, all the Saints retreated.
They couldn’t face this head-on, or they would definitely die!
Even Luo Yang didn’t step forward to battle anymore.
With his battle prowess, he wouldn’t be afraid of the corpses of Saints even if it were one-on-one or one-on-ten.
However, how could it be just one-on-ten now?
One against a hundred, one against a thousand, ten thousand… no matter how strong his battle prowess was, he was no match.
Zhang Yu looked coldly at Ling Han, “You refuse a toast, and insist on drinking a forfeit!
Hand over the seed, or I will destroy this planet below!”
Even if they were members of the Imperial Clans, they would not threaten others like this, because they were not all alone either.
If they were targeted by a Saint, they would only be able to cower.
Who would dare to run out of the protection of the Imperial Formation?
However, those who had come from desperate straits were unafraid.
Firstly, they were all Saints, and their abilities were astonishingly strong, and even if they were no match, how easy would it be for a Saint to escape?
Secondly, who would dare charge into a Land of Death?
Thus, Zhang Yu could threaten Ling Han like this.

chapters.title: Chapter 4643: Sea Emperor
paragraphs: Chapter 4643: Sea Emperor
What could they do?
This was an incredibly realistic threat.
If Ling Han didn’t hand over the seed, the sea of corpses of Saints would be mobilized. It was guaranteed that Four Origin Planet wouldn’t even be left with scraps.
Imperial Weapon?
The Imperial Weapon could indeed block the sea of corpses of Saints, but the problem was, how long could it last?
Otherwise, Tong Ming wouldn’t have been able to kill so many Saints back then.
Ling Han also frowned. Though he had set up a Saint-level formation, how long could it last under the barrage of the sea of corpses of Saints?
However, the Seed of the Holy Flame had already fused with him, so it was impossible for him to take it out.
To say the least, even if it could be taken out, what kind of terrifying chain reaction would it cause if it was handed over?
The Empress had died because of this, which showed just how important this matter was. How could he surrender it to the ruler of a Land of Death?
Then what exactly should he do?
If only Buddha Doga and Ge Qianqiu could make it here.

“If you’re hoping for Buddha Doga and Ge Qianqiu, then don’t have any hopes.” Zhang Yu gave Ling Han another blow. “These two have already been invited for tea by the other two Lords. It’s impossible for them to arrive.”
In other words, the other rulers of the Lands of Death had made their move!
Now, was there still hope?
“I’ll count to three. At that time, I’ll wave my hand and urge these Saint corpses to attack,” Zhang Yu said calmly.
As the Imperial Son, he was actually going to do such threatening words, which made him very displeased.
However, it couldn’t be helped. That seed was too important.
“No, we definitely can’t hand over the seed!” An Imperial Clan Saint stepped out, and it was still Luo Yang.
“That’s right. We definitely can’t!” Another Saint stepped out, and it was still the son of a Great Emperor.
As expected, the sons of Great Emperors had their focus on the bigger picture. At this time, they definitely could not just sit by and watch.
Though they did not know what use this so-called seed could have, with how serious the Netherworld was, it must be of great importance.

With how incompatible the Living Realm and Netherworld were now, they definitely couldn’t allow the seed to fall into the hands of the rulers of the Lands of Death. Otherwise… the world would truly be in danger.
One after another, the sons of Great Emperors stepped out. At this time, others could just be concerned about themselves and not interfere, but the sons of Great Emperors could not.
Their vision went further than that.
Zhang Yu couldn’t help but sneer, “Since you guys are so stubborn, then die!”
He waved his hand, and instantly, the Saint corpses moved, surging like a tide.
This was too terrifying.

The battle prowess of Saint corpses was limited. The majority were One Star or Two Stars, and occasionally, there would be Three Stars or Four Stars. Five Stars belonged to the category of rare, but an abundance of ants could bite an elephant to death!
Moreover, how could these be mere ants? They were clearly fierce wolves.
The sea of corpses moved, and the Saints instantly entered into a tough battle.

It was too difficult. There were too many corpses in the sea, and what was the most despairing thing? After these corpses were shattered, they only had to be thrown back into that great ocean, and very soon, they would be able to reform their bodies, and become a “healthy man” again. There was absolutely no need for a long time to recover.
This was an endless battle; who could withstand it?
“Quick, organize a retreat.” Ling Han made arrangements.
Obviously, the Four Origin Planet couldn’t possibly be saved. Thus, the only thing they could do now was to evacuate all the living creatures on the Four Origin Planet and abandon this planet.

The Transfer Formation was activated, and people left in waves. However, the number of living beings on a planet was astonishing, and the Transfer Formation could only send a very limited number of people away every time. To completely empty a planet, it wouldn’t be possible without several hundred or several thousand years.
Meanwhile, the Saints were continuously retreating. How could they block the surging sea of corpses?
Ling Han had already activated the Imperial Weapon, and the Saint-level formation was also channeling, killing the Saint corpses and reducing the pressure on the Saints.

“Hehe, do you think that you are the only one with an Imperial Weapon?” Zhang Yu smirked coldly. He too drew out a purple hammer, and struck out at Ling Han. Kuang, a bolt of lightning immediately struck over.
Nine-star Regulations!
Among Imperial Weapons, which one would be weaker than another?
The Clear Bamboo Sword was immediately restrained by this purple hammer, and no longer had the time to attack the Saint corpses.

Right now, he could only rely on the Saint-level formation to unleash its might. More importantly, there were many nearby planets that had been engulfed by the sea, so they could no longer provide power for the Saint-level formation. As a result, its might was greatly reduced, and the threat it posed to the Saint-level sea of corpses was limited.
“You are already at the end of your rope, and you still want to resist stubbornly?” Zhang Yu smirked coldly.
At this point, he still wanted to turn the tables?
“Hehe, young friend seems to have encountered some difficulty!” Right at this moment, an old voice rang out.
Shua, another person had appeared in the galaxy at some unknown time.
This was an old man. He was dressed in coarse hemp clothing, and his attire was extremely plain.
“Yi!” Ling Han swept a glance over, and couldn’t help but be startled.
This was the person who had given him the Time Wine on the Imperial Path.
The old man who guarded the tomb!
He had actually exited the Imperial Path—uh, this wasn’t strange, but he would actually appear at this time?
“Who are you?” Zhang Yu was startled. How could this old geezer appear and disappear so mysteriously? Even he did not know how he had suddenly appeared here.
However, the tomb-keeper completely ignored Zhang Yu. It was as if the latter was just some random person, and he couldn’t even be bothered to give him a second look.
He looked towards that great ocean, and said calmly, “It’s time to stop!”
He was talking to… the ruler of the Land of Death!
Hiss, this meant that Zhang Yu was not qualified to converse with him.
“Damn it!” Zhang Yu’s expression was dark. He was the son of a Great Emperor. When the Sea Emperor ruled the world, he was the Second in the World. When had he ever been ignored like this?
With a wave of his hand, a large number of Saint corpses instantly charged toward the old man who had guarded the tomb.
The tomb-keeper merely waved his hand lightly, and instantly, masses of Saint corpses collapsed, directly exploding into dust.
Gods!
Seeing this scene, all the Saints felt their scalps go numb.
This person… could it be that he was a Great Emperor?
With a light wave of his hand, all 100 Saints were annihilated!

No, no, no, this couldn’t possibly be a Great Emperor. If a new Great Emperor appeared, the heaven and earth would be filled with strange phenomena, so how could it be that there would be no reaction at all?
If it had to be said that it was the Great Emperor from the last era or the era before last?
That was even more impossible. No Great Emperor could live for so long.
Hence—
“Pseudo-Emperor!” All the Saints exclaimed in shock.
The Nine-Star Saint wasn’t this strong, and it was also impossible for a Great Emperor to appear. Thus, this Lord could only be a Pseudo-Emperor.
Setting aside the rulers of the Lands of Death, this was the third Pseudo-Emperor from the Living Realm.
The appearance of the Pseudo-Emperor naturally increased everyone’s confidence greatly.
There was hope, there was finally hope.

The tomb-keeper waved his hand a few times, clearing the sea of corpses of Saints in the surroundings. He crossed his arms behind his back, and still did not cast a second look at Zhang Yu. Instead, his eyes were focused on the great sea, “Sea Emperor, you can stop now.”
W-what?
Hearing the tomb-keeper’s words, all the Saints felt their limbs go cold.
Sea Emperor?
A Great Emperor!
How was this possible!
The sea surged, and waves rose even though there was no wind, setting off shocking waves. Endless seawater soared into the sky, turning into a massive human face.
“Qian Yanghao, are you still not dead?” A voice filled with authority rang out. It actually came from that human face that was formed from seawater.
A smile appeared on the elder’s face, and his expression was filled with age. “You’re not dead yet, so how can I dare to die?”

chapters.title: Chapter 4644: Truth!
paragraphs: Chapter 4644: Truth!
Sea Emperor? Sea Emperor!
The minds of all the Saints were buzzing, and there was nothing they could hear or feel.
Was there anything more terrifying than this?
The ruler of this great ocean was actually a Great Emperor!
‘Is this fake?’
How was this possible!
The tomb-keeper, Qian Yanghao, was definitely a Pseudo-Emperor. This battle prowess could not possibly be faked. Thus, even a Pseudo-Emperor had said so, so how could it possibly be faked?
But… this was a Great Emperor!
How could everyone not feel despair?
It was publicly acknowledged that a Great Emperor was invincible in the world. What did a living Great Emperor signify?
Who could match him?
So what if it was a Pseudo-Emperor? In front of a true Great Emperor, that was only a slightly stronger ant.
Then what was the point of fighting? In front of a Great Emperor, no matter how much effort they put in, it would all be in vain.
Hold on!
Everyone suddenly recalled that wasn’t it allowed to become Emperor in this era? Any sign was proof of this.
But it should be known that there was Great Emperors would never see another Great Emperor. Since there was a Great Emperor alive, how could there possibly be another Great Emperor alive?
So, this Sea Emperor wasn’t a true Great Emperor?
Had he severed his cultivation level?

Otherwise, firstly, it was impossible that there had been signs of a Great Emperor appearing in the world, and secondly, since the Great Emperor alone was capable of sweeping aside all opposition in the world, what need was there for the Netherworld to mobilize some Skeleton Saint Tool?
Moreover, in front of a Great Emperor, what was a Pseudo-Emperor worth?
Thinking of this, everyone finally felt slightly at ease. Perhaps, the situation was not so hopeless.
“I will definitely protect this boy!” Qian Yanghao stated calmly, but his tone was incredibly firm, “If you make a move now, just how much battle prowess would you have?”
“It’s more than enough to kill you,” the face said. Its tone was calm, but it seemed to carry the willpower of the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths, convincing others.

“The Great Emperor has mastered the Regulations of Karma, and his words are law!” All the Saints’ hearts were throbbing madly. Even if that Sea Emperor had not appeared, every word and action he spoke made them think of a Great Emperor.
Yet Qian Yanghao was incredibly calm, “If you want to kill me, you would have to pay a huge price as well, so let me ask if you dare!”
The Sea Emperor was silent. After a while, the face suddenly turned into seawater, and fell back into the great ocean.
“Let’s go!” With a wave of Zhang Yu’s hand, the sea of Saint corpses instantly returned.
Then, that great ocean began to traverse the universe again, heading towards an endless distance.
The crisis had finally been resolved.
“Senior!” Ling Han looked towards Qian Yanghao, his heart filled with tumultuous waves, as well as countless questions.
Qian Yanghao nodded, and grabbed Ling Han. Xiu, a great golden path spread out beneath his feet, and he instantly disappeared with Ling Han in tow.
This speed was really too fast, and even the Saints could only stare in dumbfounded shock. There was absolutely no way they could catch up to him.
Far away, Qian Yanghao stopped, bringing Ling Han with him as they landed on a barren star.
“You have many questions,” Qian Yanghao said.
“That’s right.” Ling Han nodded. There were too many, all right?
“Ask away,” Qian Yanghao said very casually.
“The masters of the Twelve Lands of Death… are all Great Emperors?” Ling Han asked. When he said this, his heart was also tense.
Qian Yanghao smiled, and looked at Ling Han, “If I said yes, would you run away in fear?”
Ling Han thought for a moment, and a smile also appeared at the corners of his lips, “No!”
His fighting spirit would only soar!
So what if they were Great Emperors? As long as he became Great Emperor, he would be the strongest Great Emperor in history.
This was his confidence.
Qian Yanghao laughed loudly, and clapped a hand on Ling Han’s shoulder, “Brave boy, it was not in vain that I moved to save you! Fine, the answer is yes.”
Though Ling Han had long since prepared himself, he still mocked internally.
These were the 12 Great Emperors! How was he supposed to block them?
Yi, no wonder Xuan Taiyu had died, being ganged up on by twelve Great Emperors. They weren’t Pseudo-Emperors.
It was no wonder that the Empress Qingzhu was willing to sacrifice herself to set up these arrangements. If it was mere Pseudo-Emperors, what need was there for her to go so far?
“Senior, which era are you from?” Ling Han asked. It was obvious that this person had been here since much earlier than Ge Qianqiu.
Qian Yanghao thought for a moment, then replied, “A very, very long time ago.”

This was equivalent to not saying anything, but even if it was an era that belonged to a Great Emperor, or an era that was sandwiched between two Great Emperors, so what? It did not have much meaning.
“The masters of the Twelve Lands of Death. Do they want immortality?” Ling Han asked. Aside from this, he couldn’t think of any other possibility.
Qian Yanghao nodded, “Immortality must be part of it, but they are still chasing after something, and this is something that I do not know either.”

“But the Great Emperors can only live a second life, at most. Once he dies, his soul will merge with the heaven and earth, so how could they possibly live until now?” Ling Han asked. This was something that he couldn’t figure out no matter what.
Similarly, there was no one that could connect the rulers of the Lands of Death with Great Emperors, and that was also because this was theoretically impossible.
Qian Yanghao’s eyes were focused on the universe, looking at that incredibly far place.
After a while, he said, “These Great Emperors should have obtained some kind of secret technique from the great fissure at the edge of the universe.”
It was the edge of the universe again!
“Senior, why is there a large crack there?” Ling Han asked.
Meanwhile, Qian Yanghao said slowly, “This would have to begin with the birth of the universe.”
And it involved something so long ago?
“According to legends, our universe was only a sphere when it was first born. It was incredibly tiny, but it was also extraordinarily heavy.”
“One day, a small crack appeared on this sphere. Then, endless matter gushed out of it, expanding endlessly. Hence, you can see the current universe.”𝗳𝗿𝐞𝕖𝘄𝗲𝕓𝗻𝚘𝚟𝕖𝐥.𝚌𝕠𝕞
“And that large fissure at the edge of the universe is that fissure on the sphere.”
Ling Han was dumbfounded. This was the truth behind the birth of the universe?
If it weren’t for the fact that this was said by a Pseudo-Emperor, he definitely wouldn’t believe it.

“The universe has already stabilized by now. However, the secret of the birth of the universe is hidden in that crack, and there are still heaven-defying treasures hidden there,” Qian Yanghao said. “Thus, it is not impossible to obtain the technique of ‘immortality’ from within.”
“However, the art of immortality that the Great Emperors in those Lands of Death obtained is really too strange.”

“According to this old man’s deductions, this secret technique involves the Netherworld. Moreover, although it can allow them to struggle at death’s door until now, it has a huge effect on their battle prowess.”
Ling Han nodded in understanding. If this weren’t the case, how could Xuan Taiyu have been able to resolve the perilous situation with his own power?
Who would be weaker than the other among those who could become Emperors?

When it came to specific details, even Qian Yanghao was unclear. In his era, though there was no Emperor in the world, because the old Emperor had just died, the heaven and earth did not allow a new Emperor to appear.
Thus, he could only cultivate to the level of Pseudo-Emperor, and could not take another step further.

But in his later years, he encountered the emergence of a ruler of a Land of Death, who had massacred innumerable living beings. He battled fiercely with him, and confirmed that the latter’s identity as a Great Emperor of the past.
Though the strength of this ruler of the Land of Death had declined greatly, he was still stronger than him. In the end, it ended with Qian Yanghao being outmatched and fleeing.
After that, Qian Yanghao began to gather information about the rulers of the Lands of Death. In the end, he found out part of the truth.
In order to battle with these rulers of the Lands of Death again, Qian Yanghao resolutely buried himself in the Imperial Path, and reappeared in this era.

Everyone suddenly recalled that wasn’t it allowed to become Emperor in this era?
Any sign was proof of this.
But it should be known that there was Great Emperors would never see another Great Emperor.
Since there was a Great Emperor alive, how could there possibly be another Great Emperor alive?
So, this Sea Emperor wasn’t a true Great Emperor?
Had he severed his cultivation level?

Otherwise, firstly, it was impossible that there had been signs of a Great Emperor appearing in the world, and secondly, since the Great Emperor alone was capable of sweeping aside all opposition in the world, what need was there for the Netherworld to mobilize some Skeleton Saint Tool?
Moreover, in front of a Great Emperor, what was a Pseudo-Emperor worth?
Thinking of this, everyone finally felt slightly at ease.
Perhaps, the situation was not so hopeless.
“I will definitely protect this boy!” Qian Yanghao stated calmly, but his tone was incredibly firm, “If you make a move now, just how much battle prowess would you have?”
“It’s more than enough to kill you,” the face said.
Its tone was calm, but it seemed to carry the willpower of the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths, convincing others.
“The Great Emperor has mastered the Regulations of Karma, and his words are law!” All the Saints’ hearts were throbbing madly.
Even if that Sea Emperor had not appeared, every word and action he spoke made them think of a Great Emperor.
Yet Qian Yanghao was incredibly calm, “If you want to kill me, you would have to pay a huge price as well, so let me ask if you dare!”
The Sea Emperor was silent.
After a while, the face suddenly turned into seawater, and fell back into the great ocean.
“Let’s go!” With a wave of Zhang Yu’s hand, the sea of Saint corpses instantly returned.
Then, that great ocean began to traverse the universe again, heading towards an endless distance.
The crisis had finally been resolved.
“Senior!” Ling Han looked towards Qian Yanghao, his heart filled with tumultuous waves, as well as countless questions.
Qian Yanghao nodded, and grabbed Ling Han.
Xiu, a great golden path spread out beneath his feet, and he instantly disappeared with Ling Han in tow.
This speed was really too fast, and even the Saints could only stare in dumbfounded shock.
There was absolutely no way they could catch up to him.
Far away, Qian Yanghao stopped, bringing Ling Han with him as they landed on a barren star.
“You have many questions,” Qian Yanghao said.
“That’s right.” Ling Han nodded.
There were too many, all right?
“Ask away,” Qian Yanghao said very casually.
“The masters of the Twelve Lands of Death… are all Great Emperors?” Ling Han asked.
When he said this, his heart was also tense.
Qian Yanghao smiled, and looked at Ling Han, “If I said yes, would you run away in fear?”
Ling Han thought for a moment, and a smile also appeared at the corners of his lips, “No!”
His fighting spirit would only soar!
So what if they were Great Emperors?
As long as he became Great Emperor, he would be the strongest Great Emperor in history.
This was his confidence.
Qian Yanghao laughed loudly, and clapped a hand on Ling Han’s shoulder, “Brave boy, it was not in vain that I moved to save you!
Fine, the answer is yes.”
Though Ling Han had long since prepared himself, he still mocked internally.
These were the 12 Great Emperors!
How was he supposed to block them?
Yi, no wonder Xuan Taiyu had died, being ganged up on by twelve Great Emperors.
They weren’t Pseudo-Emperors.
It was no wonder that the Empress Qingzhu was willing to sacrifice herself to set up these arrangements.
If it was mere Pseudo-Emperors, what need was there for her to go so far?
“Senior, which era are you from?” Ling Han asked.
It was obvious that this person had been here since much earlier than Ge Qianqiu.
Qian Yanghao thought for a moment, then replied, “A very, very long time ago.”
This was equivalent to not saying anything, but even if it was an era that belonged to a Great Emperor, or an era that was sandwiched between two Great Emperors, so what?
It did not have much meaning.
“The masters of the Twelve Lands of Death.
Do they want immortality?” Ling Han asked.
Aside from this, he couldn’t think of any other possibility.
Qian Yanghao nodded, “Immortality must be part of it, but they are still chasing after something, and this is something that I do not know either.”
“But the Great Emperors can only live a second life, at most.
Once he dies, his soul will merge with the heaven and earth, so how could they possibly live until now?” Ling Han asked.
This was something that he couldn’t figure out no matter what.
Similarly, there was no one that could connect the rulers of the Lands of Death with Great Emperors, and that was also because this was theoretically impossible.
Qian Yanghao’s eyes were focused on the universe, looking at that incredibly far place.
After a while, he said, “These Great Emperors should have obtained some kind of secret technique from the great fissure at the edge of the universe.”
It was the edge of the universe again!
“Senior, why is there a large crack there?” Ling Han asked.
Meanwhile, Qian Yanghao said slowly, “This would have to begin with the birth of the universe.”
And it involved something so long ago?
“According to legends, our universe was only a sphere when it was first born.
It was incredibly tiny, but it was also extraordinarily heavy.”
“One day, a small crack appeared on this sphere.
Then, endless matter gushed out of it, expanding endlessly.
Hence, you can see the current universe.”𝗳𝗿𝐞𝕖𝘄𝗲𝕓𝗻𝚘𝚟𝕖𝐥.𝚌𝕠𝕞
“And that large fissure at the edge of the universe is that fissure on the sphere.”
Ling Han was dumbfounded.
This was the truth behind the birth of the universe?
If it weren’t for the fact that this was said by a Pseudo-Emperor, he definitely wouldn’t believe it.
“The universe has already stabilized by now.
However, the secret of the birth of the universe is hidden in that crack, and there are still heaven-defying treasures hidden there,” Qian Yanghao said.
“Thus, it is not impossible to obtain the technique of ‘immortality’ from within.”
“However, the art of immortality that the Great Emperors in those Lands of Death obtained is really too strange.”
“According to this old man’s deductions, this secret technique involves the Netherworld.
Moreover, although it can allow them to struggle at death’s door until now, it has a huge effect on their battle prowess.”
Ling Han nodded in understanding.
If this weren’t the case, how could Xuan Taiyu have been able to resolve the perilous situation with his own power?
Who would be weaker than the other among those who could become Emperors?
When it came to specific details, even Qian Yanghao was unclear.
In his era, though there was no Emperor in the world, because the old Emperor had just died, the heaven and earth did not allow a new Emperor to appear.
Thus, he could only cultivate to the level of Pseudo-Emperor, and could not take another step further.
But in his later years, he encountered the emergence of a ruler of a Land of Death, who had massacred innumerable living beings.
He battled fiercely with him, and confirmed that the latter’s identity as a Great Emperor of the past.
Though the strength of this ruler of the Land of Death had declined greatly, he was still stronger than him.
In the end, it ended with Qian Yanghao being outmatched and fleeing.
After that, Qian Yanghao began to gather information about the rulers of the Lands of Death.
In the end, he found out part of the truth.
In order to battle with these rulers of the Lands of Death again, Qian Yanghao resolutely buried himself in the Imperial Path, and reappeared in this era.

chapters.title: Chapter 4645: Betrayal
paragraphs: Chapter 4645: Betrayal
Ling Han was deeply impressed by Qian Yanghao.
In his era, he should have been an invincible existence. The rulers of the Land of Death would only truly appear in this era, so Qian Yanghao was completely capable of living freely and proudly.
However, he resolutely sealed himself away, and came to this era.
“In Senior’s era, there was no opportunity for ‘immortality’. Why did the ruler of a Land of Death appear?” Ling Han was curious. This was a suspicious point.

Qian Yanghao nodded, “That is why I say that the technique of immortality that these rulers of the Lands of Death have obtained is strange! According to my observations, when the Sea Emperor appeared, his purpose was to absorb the Qi of life.”
“Thus… the so-called immortality of these rulers of the Lands of Death is based on extracting the Qi of life.”
Ling Han nodded. Since this was the deduction of a Pseudo-Emperor, it should be correct.

“This old man’s path is already severed. Next, it’s all up to you.” Qian Yanghao smiled, and patted Ling Han’s shoulder lightly, “Go on, cultivate well. This old man will help you detin those Lands of Death as much as possible, buying time for your growth.”
“Thank you, Senior.” Regarding this, Ling Han could only accept and thank him.

At present, he was still unable to oppose the Lands of Death. Even Qian Yanghao could only threaten them with “mutual destruction”. In fact, he would die, and the rulers of the Lands of Death would only suffer severe injuries.
After all, they had once been Great Emperors!
Even if they could not easily make a move now because of their immortality, and even if their strength was greatly damaged, that starving camel was still bigger than a horse.
Wasn’t it clear that Xuan Taiyu had died very quickly?
This Great Emperor… was the first in history to destroy the primitive Celestial Gate!
Qian Yanghao left, and Ling Han also returned to the Four Origin Planet.
Although a Pseudo-Emperor would protect him in secret, there were really too many rulers of the Lands of Death.
There were as many as twelve of them!
Thus, Ling Han set up another formation on the Four Origin Planet, continuously extracting the power of the planet and turning it into power, pushing this planet towards the edge of the universe.
Ling Han recounted the origins of the rulers of the Lands of Death, causing everyone to be extremely stunned.
As it turned out, these were actually twelve Great Emperors!
This was really a fact that could drive one to despair. One Great Emperor was enough to suppress the Nine Heavens and Ten Lands; there were a total of 12 of them!

“There’s no need to be so nervous.” Ling Han comforted everyone, “The Heavenly Dao has its limits. Only one Great Emperor can appear in a single era. The fact that these rulers of the Lands of Death can live until now, and exist side by side, only means that their cultivation level must have been weakened.”
Everyone nodded. This was very logical.

However, no matter how weak it was, it would at least be Pseudo-Emperor-level, and would be stronger than normal Pseudo-Emperor-level, infinitely close to the level of a real Great Emperor. Otherwise, Xuan Taiyu would not have died at that time.
Hold on, in the era of Xuan Taiyu, there was no opportunity for immortality, so why did the Masters of the Twelve Lands of Death appear?
Could it be!
Ling Han thought of himself, Ding Shu as well as the other Genesis World rulers. They were different from the rest, and furthermore, they were inextricably linked to Xuan Taiyu.
He then recalled that Xuan Taiyu had gone to the great crack at the edge of the universe, and was chasing after something.
That had to do with Genesis World. Additionally, the rulers of the Twelve Lands of Death were also looking for this item, and that was why they had fought Xuan Taiyu to the death?
The clues had long since been cut off, and Ling Han had no way to prove it, so he could only make such a deduction.
“It’s still more important to increase my strength.”
“As long as I possess enough strength, what else can I not know?”
“Cultivate!”
He continued to capture Celestial Qi, concoct alchemical pills, and refine Celestial Qi. His days were extremely monotonous and repetitive, but his cultivation level was steadily improving.
In the next few days, a great change suddenly took place in the universe.
During an invasion by the Netherworld, the Demon Wolf Imperial Clan suddenly defected. The Demon Wolf Imperial Clan Saint revived his Imperial Weapon, and actually attacked his allies.
Who would have thought that such a change would happen?

Thus, this dealt a huge blow to the Living Realm. Eleven Saints were killed with a single strike, and there were also a considerable number of Saints that were wounded when the might of the Imperial Weapon scraped past them. Though they immediately fled, they were caught up by the Skeleton Saint Tool, and were still unable to survive.
When the news spread out, the whole world was shocked.
What was going on?
Had the Demon Wolf Imperial Clan gone mad?

However, this was only the beginning. Subsequently, the Black Sunflower Imperial Clan also put on a good show of stabbing their allies in the back, causing a massive blow to the Living Realm’s allied troops.
Immediately afterward, the Fire Cloud Imperial Clan also embarked on this path, falling out with the Living Realm and killing a great many Saints in one go.

This caused the Living Realm Alliance Army to feel anxious, and they were filled with suspicion towards each other. No one knew if another Imperial Clan would betray them, and they themselves would not become a victim.
In this way, the alliance was practically useless.
The Netherworld army penetrated deeply, and encountered almost no decent resistance.

If it had to be said that the betrayal of these three Imperial Clans had caused a massive blow to the higher-ups of the Living Realm, then what happened next would have even more far-reaching consequences.
The Buddhist Race actually declared that defecting to the Netherworld was the right path, telling the believers to drop their weapons and they could immediately become Buddhas.
It should be known that the Buddhist Race’s spiritual control was number one in the world.
Thus, all the galaxies that were affected by the Buddhist Raceall put down the weapons in their hands, welcoming the invasion of the Netherworld with open arms.

If there was any force that had the greatest influence, it would definitely be the Buddhist Race. The Buddhist Race existed in the four Heavenly Realms, and they spared no effort in spreading their teachings and nurturing their believers.
Now that the Buddhist Race had reaped the fruits of their labour, it was a fruitful harvest.
And for the Living Realm, this loss was much, much too great.
How many territories had been lost, and how many people had been killed?
Because this shocking news came one after another, even Ling Han couldn’t sit still and went to find out the situation.

Ji Wuming brought the connection device with him, and projected all the information he had seen on the Galaxy Network. Ling Han, Brother Monkey, the empress, and the others were all there. As they understood the situation, they were frowning deeply.
“Previously, I forgot to ask Old Master Qian who these rulers of the Twelve Lands of Death are.”
“By the looks of it now, there’s at least the Buddhist Race’s Great Emperor, Demon Wolf Emperor, Ancestral King Fire Clouds, Sea Emperor, and Black Sunflower Demon Emperor.”

The Buddhist Race, the Wolf Tribe, the Fire Cloud Imperial Clan and the Black Sunflower Imperial Clan had just betrayed them, which was equivalent to admitting their identity. And why did these four Imperial Clans rebel… the reason was too simple. The clan’s Great Emperor had not died, so would the juniors dare to disobey orders?
As for the Sea Emperor, his identity was called out by Qian Yanghao.𝒇𝙧𝙚𝓮𝙬𝙚𝓫𝒏𝓸𝓿𝓮𝒍.𝓬𝙤𝓶
“There’s also the Golden Crow Emperor,” Ling Han said. This was Lu Xun’s father, and he continued, “There’s also the Void Emperor. This is the backer of the Battle God Palace.”
“Additionally, He Luo, Feng Miaoling, and Yang Yihuan should also have a ruler of a Land of Death behind them. It’s just that we can’t match them yet. Which Great Emperor is it?”
The large black dog counted with his fingers, “There are a total of ten rulers of the Lands of Death ow.”
There were still two missing!
In other words, if these two Great Emperors had also left behind a base in the Living Realm, that meant that there were still two landmines that had not been detonated.
“Ah!” Ji Wuming suddenly screamed, blood seeping from all his apertures.

chapters.title: Chapter 4646: Collapse of the Living Realm
paragraphs: Chapter 4646: Collapse of the Living Realm
What was going on?
Ji Wuming was also a Spirit Transformation True Lord now. Although he couldn’t be regarded as an elite, he definitely wasn’t weak either.
Bleeding from all seven apertures for no reason?
He was not cultivating, so how could he possibly go mad?
At this moment, no one knew what to do.
Ji Wuming screamed endlessly, as if he was enduring indescribable pain. Then, as if he had gone mad, he began to attack Ling Han and the others.
Boom, he unleashed his full battle prowess, holding nothing back.
Ling Han frowned. He stretched out a hand and pressed down, suppressing Ji Wuming.
But even so, the mystical power in his body was still surging endlessly, as if his whole body was about to explode.
What was going on? Why had it suddenly become like this?
At the same time, tragic cries rose and fell, coming from various places. At the same time, there were also sounds of battle. Hong long long long, the entire planet suddenly became incredibly lively.

Ling Han didn’t need to go out. His powerful divine sense was enough to enshroud the entire Four Origin Planet. He could “see” very clearly. There were too many people who screamed as if they had seen a ghost like Ji Wuming, bleeding from all their apertures.
It was as if they had all gone mad, and attacked those around them at all costs, as if they were great enemies.
Ling Han was suddenly shocked. Hadn’t they just said that out of the Twelve Lands of Death, there were still two clans that they had yet to find the corresponding Great Emperor?
He then recalled that there was an unwritten rule in the Imperial Clans, and that was they would not use the Galaxy Network connection device.
Why didn’t they use such a convenient thing?
Previously, Ling Han hadn’t understood, but now, after linking all the clues together, he suddenly came to a realization.
Hiss… could it be that the Great Emperor of the Chang Clan was also one of the masters of the Twelve Lands of Death?
Thinking of this, Ling Han suddenly moved, and plucked the Galaxy Network connection device that Ji Wuming was wearing.
Instantly, Ji Wuming wilted. Though he was no longer screaming or making a fuss, it could be seen that it was as if his vitality had been severed, and his injuries were extremely, extremely severe.

And this was still because Ling Han had discovered it in the nick of time, and taken away the Galaxy Network connection device that he was wearing. Otherwise, Ji Wuming might have been directly killed.
“This is—” The large black dog and the others were also shocked. This problem actually came from the Galaxy Network connection device?
Who would have thought!
“The Great Emperor of the Chang Clan is actually also one of the rulers of the Twelve Lands of Death!” However, with how smart they were, they immediately came to a realization.
“Hurry!”
Ling Han and the others moved separately, either plucking the Galaxy Network connection devices of those crazy people, or directly shattering them.

Pa, pa, pa! One after another, those who had gone mad collapsed. Ling Han and the others all had battle prowess of Saint-level, so how could they be matched by these disciples of Holy Lands or ordinary people?

Thankfully, because of Ling Han’s insistence, the people who had come out of Genesis World didn’t wear the Galaxy Network connection device. Even if they did, they would usually put it aside and only use it occasionally.
However, even if Ling Han and the others reacted fast enough and moved fast enough, one-tenth of the disciples had died, and there were countless who were severely injured.
Losses, heavy losses!
And this was only a single Four Origin Planet.
What about the entire universe?
It could be said that aside from the Imperial Clans, the majority of forces had suffered heavy blows, and their losses were incredibly great.
Who would’ve thought that the Galaxy Network connection device would have such destructive power?
As for the details of the matter, they would have to wait until Ji Wuming woke up to ask.
Now, the Galaxy Network definitely could no longer be connected. This meant that everyone had become blind and deaf, completely losing their understanding of the universe outside their own planet.
This was because everyone usually relied too much on the Galaxy Network. Now that a problem had arisen with the Galaxy Network, everyone was at a loss.
What could they do?
Without the connection with the Galaxy Network, the entire Living Realm was instantly in a state of disunity.
What on earth was going on?
Why had this happened to the Galaxy Network connection device?
Where was the Netherworld? Where had their armies reached?
All of this unknown.

And the unknown was a kind of fear in the first place. Presently, everyone in every corner of the universe was in a state of anxiety. Everyone was wondering if their planet was the only place that had not been conquered by the Netherworld.
In a precarious state of mind, it also caused some people to lose control of their emotions, and begin to cause great damage.

This attack from the Chang Clan could be considered fatal. In an instant, it had pushed the level of civilization of the universe down a dozen over levels. It was as if they had returned to the primitive ages, where everyone worried for their own safety.
On the Four Origin Planet. Ling Han and the others were discussing a strategy.
“This attack from the Chang Clan is really too fatal.”
“Everyone is too reliant on the Galaxy Network, and once it’s broken, they’re like headless flies.”
“We don’t know what’s going on in the universe right now, so everyone’s afraid for themselves.”
“Can Netherworld’s invasion still be stopped?”
Everyone exchanged looks, unable to come up with any countermeasures.
How many years had the Chang Clan operated for?
After millions and millions of years, the Galaxy Network was already deeply ingrained in people’s hearts. As long as one stepped onto the Celestial Path, who wouldn’t have a connection device?
Now, these people had basically all gone mad and died.
How many living beings had the entire universe lost all of a sudden?
“As expected of the Great Emperor’s handiwork!” Though everyone was defiant and furious, they could not help but feel impressed.
Empress Qingzhu had started to lay out her plans a very, very long time ago, and how could the Lords of Death not have done the same?
Now that they made a move, it was a move to slit the throat in a single strike.
The Galaxy Network and Buddhist Race were the two most influential and far-reaching beings. In the end, they were both the doings of the Lords of Death.
This was the power of Great Emperors!
Two days later, Ji Wuming woke up, and was also completely conscious.

Ling Han and the others asked what had happened on that day, and Ji Wuming said that he had suddenly been invaded by an incredibly powerful willpower. He felt that all he could see was the most terrifying enemy, and that he had to fight to the death at all costs.
Ling Han immediately recalled that the “Tool Spirit” existed on the Galaxy Network.
Was this… the willpower left behind by the Great Emperor?
Hence, when this kind of willpower invaded, no one would be spared.
Sigh!
Faced with the Great Emperor’s millions and millions of years of schemes, Ling Han could only admit defeat.
Just like how the arrangements that Empress Qingzhu had set up were not something that other Great Emperors could damage, the methods of these Lords of Death were also the same.
Thus, even if the generations of Great Emperors had seen some clues, they only told their descendants not to use the Galaxy Network connection device.
“Now… it’s getting more and more urgent.”
Ling Han set everything aside, and began to concentrate on capturing Celestial Qi and concocting alchemical pills. Strength, what was important was strength!
Several years later, he reached the peak stage of 10 Stars.
Fine, he would aim for Eleven Stars.
Similarly, Ling Han inscribed the eleventh seal on the pinnacle pillar with the power of belief as pen, and seventy seven-star Regulations as ink.
Boom!
After he completed the fourth seal, a change took place.
Turbulent waves rose up in his body, and his cultivation level soared explosively.
However, this time, there was no heaven’s calamity descending.
Eleven Stars!
Ling Han came out of seclusion. There was no time for him to waste now. He didn’t even want to celebrate.
He began to capture Celestial Qi and concoct alchemical pills again, and was very busy.
As for the situation of the entire Living Realm… it was extremely terrible.

The Galaxy Network had already been severed, so it was impossible for them to receive any more information. Fortunately, Saints were fast enough, and Brother Monkey and the others took turns to investigate the current situation.

sentences.text: Chapter 4646: Collapse of the Living Realm
What was going on?
Ji Wuming was also a Spirit Transformation True Lord now.
Although he couldn’t be regarded as an elite, he definitely wasn’t weak either.
Bleeding from all seven apertures for no reason?
He was not cultivating, so how could he possibly go mad?
At this moment, no one knew what to do.
Ji Wuming screamed endlessly, as if he was enduring indescribable pain.
Then, as if he had gone mad, he began to attack Ling Han and the others.
Boom, he unleashed his full battle prowess, holding nothing back.
Ling Han frowned.
He stretched out a hand and pressed down, suppressing Ji Wuming.
But even so, the mystical power in his body was still surging endlessly, as if his whole body was about to explode.
What was going on?
Why had it suddenly become like this?
At the same time, tragic cries rose and fell, coming from various places.
At the same time, there were also sounds of battle.
Hong long long long, the entire planet suddenly became incredibly lively.
Ling Han didn’t need to go out.
His powerful divine sense was enough to enshroud the entire Four Origin Planet.
He could “see” very clearly.
There were too many people who screamed as if they had seen a ghost like Ji Wuming, bleeding from all their apertures.
It was as if they had all gone mad, and attacked those around them at all costs, as if they were great enemies.
Ling Han was suddenly shocked.
Hadn’t they just said that out of the Twelve Lands of Death, there were still two clans that they had yet to find the corresponding Great Emperor?
He then recalled that there was an unwritten rule in the Imperial Clans, and that was they would not use the Galaxy Network connection device.
Why didn’t they use such a convenient thing?
Previously, Ling Han hadn’t understood, but now, after linking all the clues together, he suddenly came to a realization.
Hiss… could it be that the Great Emperor of the Chang Clan was also one of the masters of the Twelve Lands of Death?
Thinking of this, Ling Han suddenly moved, and plucked the Galaxy Network connection device that Ji Wuming was wearing.
Instantly, Ji Wuming wilted.
Though he was no longer screaming or making a fuss, it could be seen that it was as if his vitality had been severed, and his injuries were extremely, extremely severe.
And this was still because Ling Han had discovered it in the nick of time, and taken away the Galaxy Network connection device that he was wearing.
Otherwise, Ji Wuming might have been directly killed.
“This is—” The large black dog and the others were also shocked.
This problem actually came from the Galaxy Network connection device?
Who would have thought!
“The Great Emperor of the Chang Clan is actually also one of the rulers of the Twelve Lands of Death!” However, with how smart they were, they immediately came to a realization.
“Hurry!”
Ling Han and the others moved separately, either plucking the Galaxy Network connection devices of those crazy people, or directly shattering them.
Pa, pa, pa!
One after another, those who had gone mad collapsed.
Ling Han and the others all had battle prowess of Saint-level, so how could they be matched by these disciples of Holy Lands or ordinary people?
Thankfully, because of Ling Han’s insistence, the people who had come out of Genesis World didn’t wear the Galaxy Network connection device.
Even if they did, they would usually put it aside and only use it occasionally.
However, even if Ling Han and the others reacted fast enough and moved fast enough, one-tenth of the disciples had died, and there were countless who were severely injured.
Losses, heavy losses!
And this was only a single Four Origin Planet.
What about the entire universe?
It could be said that aside from the Imperial Clans, the majority of forces had suffered heavy blows, and their losses were incredibly great.
Who would’ve thought that the Galaxy Network connection device would have such destructive power?
As for the details of the matter, they would have to wait until Ji Wuming woke up to ask.
Now, the Galaxy Network definitely could no longer be connected.
This meant that everyone had become blind and deaf, completely losing their understanding of the universe outside their own planet.
This was because everyone usually relied too much on the Galaxy Network.
Now that a problem had arisen with the Galaxy Network, everyone was at a loss.
What could they do?
Without the connection with the Galaxy Network, the entire Living Realm was instantly in a state of disunity.
What on earth was going on?
Why had this happened to the Galaxy Network connection device?
Where was the Netherworld?
Where had their armies reached?
All of this unknown.
And the unknown was a kind of fear in the first place.
Presently, everyone in every corner of the universe was in a state of anxiety.
Everyone was wondering if their planet was the only place that had not been conquered by the Netherworld.
In a precarious state of mind, it also caused some people to lose control of their emotions, and begin to cause great damage.
This attack from the Chang Clan could be considered fatal.
In an instant, it had pushed the level of civilization of the universe down a dozen over levels.
It was as if they had returned to the primitive ages, where everyone worried for their own safety.
On the Four Origin Planet.
Ling Han and the others were discussing a strategy.
“This attack from the Chang Clan is really too fatal.”
“Everyone is too reliant on the Galaxy Network, and once it’s broken, they’re like headless flies.”
“We don’t know what’s going on in the universe right now, so everyone’s afraid for themselves.”
“Can Netherworld’s invasion still be stopped?”
Everyone exchanged looks, unable to come up with any countermeasures.
How many years had the Chang Clan operated for?
After millions and millions of years, the Galaxy Network was already deeply ingrained in people’s hearts.
As long as one stepped onto the Celestial Path, who wouldn’t have a connection device?
Now, these people had basically all gone mad and died.
How many living beings had the entire universe lost all of a sudden?
“As expected of the Great Emperor’s handiwork!” Though everyone was defiant and furious, they could not help but feel impressed.
Empress Qingzhu had started to lay out her plans a very, very long time ago, and how could the Lords of Death not have done the same?
Now that they made a move, it was a move to slit the throat in a single strike.
The Galaxy Network and Buddhist Race were the two most influential and far-reaching beings.
In the end, they were both the doings of the Lords of Death.
This was the power of Great Emperors!
Two days later, Ji Wuming woke up, and was also completely conscious.
Ling Han and the others asked what had happened on that day, and Ji Wuming said that he had suddenly been invaded by an incredibly powerful willpower.
He felt that all he could see was the most terrifying enemy, and that he had to fight to the death at all costs.
Ling Han immediately recalled that the “Tool Spirit” existed on the Galaxy Network.
Was this… the willpower left behind by the Great Emperor?
Hence, when this kind of willpower invaded, no one would be spared.
Sigh!
