chapters.title: Chapter 4647: Ambush
paragraphs: Chapter 4647: Ambush

The few Imperial Clans had defected, and added with the fact that the Galaxy Network had been broken, the entire Living Realm had become a pile of scattered sand. Thus, they were completely unable to form a decent resistance.
Now, wherever the Netherworld’s blade pointed, that place could only fall.

The Imperial Clans and Holy Lands had already moved their whole planets to relocate. However, moving a planet would require at least Saint-level power. This meant that 99% of the planets could only remain where they were, resist with all their might, and then fall.
The entire Living Realm was already a scene of doomsday. Endless Yin Qi seeped out, covering heaven and earth, turning the Living Realm into a purgatory.

What was even more terrifying was the fact that the Regulations of the Living Realm and Netherworld were different, and a fierce conflict had taken place, causing the entire universe to be in an extremely unstable state.
If this continued, it was very likely that there would come a day when a great storm would sweep through the entire universe, destroying everything.
Though Ling Han was anxious, he couldn’t do anything about it.

At present, he only had the battle prowess of 10 Stars of Saint-level. At most, he only had the battle prowess of 11 Stars. There was no need for a Lord of Death to move at all. Merely the boundless ocean of Saintly corpses would be enough to engulf him.
Saintly corpses weren’t like Yin souls, which were completely restrained by Destructive Energy.
Yi, had the Spirit Diagram of Destructive Energy been obtained by Xuan Taiyu from the edge of the universe?

Though they very much wanted to change the current situation, the only thing Ling Han and the others could do now, aside from increasing their cultivation level, was to set up formations for the various planets, and push these planets towards the edge of the universe.

Though the Netherworld’s battle prowess was invincible, the invasion of the Yin souls would be limited by the speed of assimilating the Living Realm, which meant that it would be easy for them to conquer a galaxy, but to transform this galaxy into the environment of the Netherworld, they would need a considerable amount of time.
Without the environment of the Netherworld, Yin souls were too fragile. Those with a lower cultivation level couldn’t even stand direct sunlight.
Hence, with the formations activating, though the movement speed of the planets was slow, it was still enough to surpass the rate of expansion of the Netherworld.
This left a spark of hope in the Living Realm. One day, when all the planets returned, they could still rebuild their home, and prosper again.

However, Ling Han was all alone, after all. No matter how busy he was, setting up formations and creating formation foundations would still need time. Though the number of planets he could help was astonishing, with how vast the universe was, this could only be considered a drop in the ocean.
However, Ling Han’s kindness won him the hearts of the people.
—If he had already become a Saint at this moment, he would definitely be able to sense that the power of belief had become slightly stronger.
Saving people in times of danger naturally reaped the purest of belief.
Ling Han didn’t think too much about it. He simply wanted to help others.
If one could not do afford to, the best thing he could do was take care of himself. If one could afford it, he should lend a helping hand to others.
Within the range of his abilities, he did not mind making sacrifices for the world.

Ling Han would also battle against Yin souls. At present, the Netherworld army was powerful, and was practically unstoppable. However, as the battle lines were seriously drawn out, it also meant that their defenses were weak.
—There were only so many Skeleton Saint Tools, so how could they guard every single place?
Ling Han and the other Saints led teams respectively, leading Ji Wuming, Ling Xi and the others into battle. If they killed Yin souls, they would be able to receive rewards from heaven and earth.

It should be known that now that a large number of planets had fallen, natural treasures were naturally hard to find. Thus, if one wanted to rapidly increase his cultivation level, killing Yin souls to obtain the treasures from heaven and earth was an extremely good way.
They definitely wouldn’t linger in battle, switching locations with every strike. Moreover, they attacked randomly, so the Netherworld didn’t know how to stop them at all.
All of a sudden, another forty years passed.
In this period of time, Ling Han’s cultivation level had also rushed from Eleven Stars to Twelve Stars, surpassing Thirteen Stars, and arrived at Fourteen Stars.
The Seven Star Regulations Regulations that he had grasped had already reached as many as 96.
It could be imagined that when he stepped into 15 Stars, that would be the true end.
99 Regulations, the limit.
On this day, Ling Han led a team and continued to kill Yin souls.
Although this wasn’t a huge blow to the Netherworld, it was still better than doing nothing.
They arrived at the Qi Imperial Planet. This had once belonged to a Holy Land, but now, all the living creatures had been possessed by Yin souls, turning into walking corpses.

Every body possessed by a Yin soul would exude slivers of Yin Qi. Once there was too much Yin Qi, it would have an effect on the heaven and earth, causing the Living Realm to transform into the Netherworld.
Thus, Ling Han and the others killing these walking corpses was actually quite meaningful.
However, when they tore a rip into space and arrived here, Ling Han felt a sense of unease.
“There’s an ambush!” He immediately sensed that there was a powerful Saint-level aura here.
“Ling Han, I’ve finally caught you!” A young man appeared with a large number of Saintly corpses. It was Lu Xun of the Golden Crow Imperial Clan!
Ling Han frowned, tore a rip into space again, and said, “You guys go first, I’ll bring up the rear!”
“In your dreams!” Lu Xun immediately charged over.

Ling Han didn’t bring the Imperial Weapon and left it on the Four Origin Planet. He had already taught the Nine Mountains Saint how to control it, and the old man was in charge of overseeing the headquarters. He didn’t want it that when they came out to hunt, their home base was destroyed.
However, aside from the Clear Bamboo Sword, he also had the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.
The Pseudo-Imperial Weapon was unleashed, continuously enlarging, enveloping Ling Han and the others.
Boom!
The attacks shot over, but they only caused the tower to tremble greatly, and were unable to blast their way in.𝙛𝒓𝓮𝙚𝔀𝒆𝒃𝓷𝒐𝓿𝙚𝓵.𝙘𝒐𝒎
Of course, due to the powerful tremors, the inside of the tower was also surging with energy.
But what cultivation level was Ling Han at now?
Fourteen-star Venerate Tier!
His battle prowess had already surpassed ten stars of Saint-level, and was astonishingly powerful.
He moved to disperse it, eliminating all the energy turbulence in the tower, to ensure the stability of the torn space and ensure everyone’s safety.
When the last person also entered, Ling Han revealed a smile, and turned around.
He was in no rush to leave.
As long as the Lord of Death didn’t unleash his power, he wouldn’t need to be afraid of even the Skeleton Saint Tool. If he couldn’t defeat it, he could simply flee.
Now, let him go on a killing spree.
Xiu, he put away the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.
“En?” Seeing that Ling Han had no intention of leaving, Lu Xun couldn’t help but reveal a hint of surprise.
“I have to say, your courage is outstanding.”
Ling Han laughed loudly, and said, “Do I need to be concerned about you country bumpkins?”
Lu Xunxun couldn’t help but look furious. This was looking down on him too much.
“Ling Han, where is your confidence coming from?” he asked calmly. “Look at this world. Is there still any place for you in this world?”
Ling Han looked down arrogantly at the skies, and said, “I’m standing right here now. Let’s see if I can still stand?”
“Haha!” Lu Xun sneered, then charged over.
Boom! With a single strike, 12 eight-star Regulations appeared.
He was now a Four-Star Saint.
Ling Han was unafraid, and greeted the attack with a raised fist.
“You’re courting death!” Lu Xun said in disdain, launching an explosive attack.
Peng!
The two of them exchanged a blow, and endless Regulations exploded, actually sending the Saintly corpses that were rushing over from behind them flying. Cracks even appeared on the foremost corpses.
“What?!” Lu Xun exclaimed in disbelief.
He was a Four-Star Saint, and his battle prowess was as high as 12 stars. Yet, Ling Han was actually capable of matching him?
Hiss!

chapters.title: Chapter 4648: Jealousy
paragraphs: Chapter 4648: Jealousy
Ling Han’s whole person seemed to be a miracle.

Thus, he continued to create one after another impossibilities. If it was anyone else, being able to create one of these miracles was already a rare feat in history, but it was just the norm for Ling Han.
A mere Venerate, yet possessed battle prowess of twelve stars of Saint Tier.
Hehe, would anyone believe him if he told them?
What happened to the barrier to the cultivation level?
It was said that the higher one’s cultivation level, the more terrifying the suppression of cultivation level would be. Why was it the other way around when it came to Ling Han?
As Venerate, he was completely capable of being treated as a Saint, and it was a high-level Saint at that.
“That seed!” Lu Xun gritted his teeth. He was certain that the reason why Ling Han was so freakish was definitely because of that seed.
It should be known that that had come from the Primitive Abyss!
—This was what the Lords of Death called the great fissure at the edge of the universe.
That place contained rare treasures that were rarely seen in the world, because this involved the secrets of heaven and earth!
The entire universe had been born from there. Though cosmic matter was no longer gushing out, just how awesome was it to be able to nurture a universe?
Thus, the reason why Ling Han was so freakish was definitely because of that seed.
“Hand it over!” he shouted loudly.
Of course, he didn’t think that Ling Han would submit. Thus, there was only one way to seize it.
Kill Ling Han.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
He unleashed his full battle prowess, and innumerable Saintly corpses also rushed over like a tidal wave. The black mass practically blotted out the sky and covered the earth.
Ling Han was completely unafraid.
“Come!” His fighting spirit surged like a tide, and he used the Han Fists. The 96 Seven Star Regulations intertwined, endlessly increasing his battle prowess.
The two of them battled fiercely, and the aftermath reverberated, sending Saintly corpses flying one after another.
However, there were far too many Saint corpses here, and even though a large number of them had been sent flying, there were even more that had pounced over.

Ling Han activated Phoenix Wings Divine Flight and spread his flaming wings. He easily broke free from the encirclement, and as the flaming wings flapped, the corpses of the Saints were also sent flying.
At this moment, Ling Han displayed a demeanor of near-invincibility.
He was clearly a Venerate, yet was practically capable of sweeping aside all Saints.
“Damn it!” Seeing how fierce Ling Han was, Lu Xunxun was incredibly jealous.
He was the son of a Great Emperor, so logically speaking, what could he not obtain? Who did he need to be jealous of?
There was only one, and that was the treasure that had been obtained from the Primitive Abyss.
To say nothing of him, even Great Emperors would be envious.
Just think, for the sake of this seed, Empress Qingzhu had even died from severe wounds, unable to live a second life.
From this, it could be seen just how terrifying the Primitive Abyss was. Even a Great Emperor could possibly die if he entered.
“Give it to me! Give it to me! Give it to me!” Lu Xun hurriedly chased after him. His figure swayed, and he actually turned into a three-legged golden crow!
He was not a human, but rather a member of the Demon Race.
The Golden Crow Great Emperor!
That’s right, he was from the Golden Crow Race.
This golden crow was truly massive. Its wingspan was as long as 30,000 meters, and its speed was also extraordinarily fast. It was actually just that little bit inferior to Ling Han.

After all, this was also a bird race, what more when the Golden Crow Race had once produced a Great Emperor. Even if it was inferior to the Divine Beasts that were favoured by heaven and earth, it was definitely not much inferior either.
Most importantly, Ling Han wasn’t a phoenix, so he definitely couldn’t unleash the full might of Phoenix Wings Divine Flight.
Endless Saintly corpses sealed off the surroundings. Even if they were no match for Ling Han, the might of Saintly power could still hinder Ling Han’s advance.
Thus, Lu Xun was approaching.
Shua, he made his move.
A claw stretched out, flickering with endless metallic luster, comparable to Saintly Material!

Ling Han smirked coldly, and also enlarged his body, turning into a giant that was as tall as 30,000 meters. His Dao Manifestation supported the skies, and then shot out a punch at Lu Xun. Destructive Energy wrapped around his fist, spreading out an aura that would make even Saints shiver.
“En?” Lu Xun was shocked, and instinctively felt wary. He hurriedly withdrew his claws.
Ling Han’s furious fists continued to attack until the end. Boom, the Destructive Energy turned into a streak of light that continued to charge towards Lu Xun.
This was too fast!

Lu Xun was instantly hit. There was nothing that Destructive Energy could not destroy, and even Saint-level power could not completely disperse it. Instantly, he screamed in pain, and his figure shrank drastically.
He returned to human form, and saw that the fingers on his left hand were slowly disappearing!

Lu Xun made a prompt decision. Using his right palm like a saber, he slashed down on his left hand, forcefully slicing off three fingers. Only then did he manage to stop the spreading of Destructive Energy.
He looked at Ling Han in shock. What kind of freakish high-level energy was this?
Saints could regrow severed limbs, and this was completely no problem for him as long as he expended a bit of his life force.
However, even though his severed fingers had grown out, Lu Xunxun was still filled with wariness.
Just now, he had already retreated in time, but he had still not managed to dodge that attack.
What was even more terrifying was the fact that he had clearly formed a shield with Regulations, but it had little effect on that mysterious high-level energy.
—He could disperse a portion of it, but the effects were too poor.𝚏𝕣𝕖𝚎𝚠𝚎𝚋𝚗𝐨𝐯𝕖𝕝.𝕔𝐨𝕞
He didn’t dare to take any more risks. With a wave of his hand, the Saintly corpses behind him surged out like floodwaters.

As for Saintly corpses? In any case, they were already completely dead. Furthermore, even if they were shattered into bits, as long as they were placed back into the Land of Death, and pieced together, they could still be taken out and used again.
Come on then!
Ling Han’s heroic spirit soared, with Destructive Energy entwined around his fists. He began to cause great destruction.
He refused to believe that the Saintly corpses that had been destroyed by Destructive Energy could be reformed, because Destructive Energy caused complete destruction.
Peng! Peng! Peng!
Ling Han was like a divine dragon, wreaking havoc among the Saintly corpses. A piece of the Saintly Corpse that he had struck would be completely missing, or the whole corpse would disappear.
If it were any other Saint, they would only be able to shatter the Saintly corpse. After all, this was the corpse of a Saint. It was too powerful, and was not much inferior to Saintly Material.
It could be damaged, or even shattered, but it definitely could not be completely destroyed.
The exception was Destructive Energy!
Ling Han attacked madly. Every time he destroyed a Saintly corpse, he would be able to decrease the battle prowess of the Netherworld by one Saint.
However, there were really too many Saintly corpses here, and his power was not without limits.
Under such a high-intensity battle, his spiritual power was especially expended, and gradually, he could no longer bear the burden of the channelling of Destructive Energy.
It was about time to leave.
Ling Han let out a battle cry, and Phoenix Wings Divine Flight unleashed. He began to break out of the siege.
“You still want to flee?” Lu Xun said in a baleful voice. If he left so calmly after causing so much damage, what face would he have left?
Did the Imperial Son not care about his pride?
He didn’t hesitate to use the holy flame, transforming it into an arrow that shot toward Ling Han.
The holy flame would decrease with every use, and could not be recovered.
However, its might was also great. Boom, when the arrow shot over, even a planet could be easily destroyed.
It was too fast. Even Phoenix Wings Divine Flight was no match for it, what more when Ling Han was still surrounded by Saintly corpses.
Ling Han cracked a smile, and with a thought, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower appeared in front of him.
Peng! The arrow of holy flame struck the tower, yet it only caused the tower to shudder slightly.
‘Holy f*ck!’

Lu Xun almost spat out a mouthful of blood. He had not hesitated to expend the holy flame. At first, he could at least detain Ling Han, and grind him to death with the Saintly corpses. He had not thought that it would be so easily dispersed.
How could he not throw up blood?

What happened to the barrier to the cultivation level?

As Venerate, he was completely capable of being treated as a Saint, and it was a high-level Saint at that.

It should be known that that had come from the Primitive Abyss!

That place contained rare treasures that were rarely seen in the world, because this involved the secrets of heaven and earth!
The entire universe had been born from there.

chapters.title: Chapter 4649: Pinnacle of Fourth Extreme
paragraphs: Chapter 4649: Pinnacle of Fourth Extreme
Ling Han smiled and said, “Should we continue this battle?”
Lu Xun glared angrily at Ling Han. He was clearly facing a Venerate, yet he felt a strong sense of helplessness.
If they fought, he would not be able to win. If he pursued, he would not be able to catch up.

He had still been too arrogant. He had predicted that Ling Han would possibly appear here, but had not brought any helpers with him. In the end, even though Ling Han had been caught, he was completely unable to capture or kill him.
—Why did he not invite others? He naturally had his own motives.
That was the seed from the Primitive Abyss. If he killed Ling Han together with others, then who would this seed belong to?
“You’re not playing anymore? Then I won’t accompany you.” Ling Han waved his hand, planning to tear a rip into space and leave.

“Ling Han!” Lu Xu shouted loudly. When Ling Han paused, he continued, “You can escape this time, and perhaps you can escape the next time, but in the end, you won’t be able to escape your destined fate!”
“Oh?” Ling Han smiled faintly, “There is a saying of ‘destiny’?”
“Humph, in the face of an irresistible situation, your fate has long since been decided!” Lu Xun declared proudly.

Indeed, there was a Great Emperor standing behind him, and there were a total of 12 Lords of Death behind him. At that time, they had even killed a true Great Emperor, what more when it was a mere Venerate.
Even if Ling Han became a Saint, so what? Even if he advanced to become Pseudo-Emperor, so what?
Without becoming a Great Emperor, how could he be qualified to challenge Great Emperors?
Moreover, there were 12 of them.
Ling Han shook his head and said, “To those who want to improve themselves endlessly, fate is in their own hands. Only people like you would think that fate is destined.”
“Humph, Qian Yanghao should have told you what kind of hopeless existence you have to face, right?” Lu Xun called out again.

“That’s why it’s so much more fun!” Ling Han laughed loudly. It was said that the Great Emperor was invincible, but because Great Emperors would never have the chance to encounter another, aside from in the ancient times, no one knew the gap in strength between different Great Emperors.𝘧𝓇𝑒𝑒𝑤ℯ𝑏𝓃𝘰𝑣ℯ𝘭.𝘤ℴ𝘮
Now, he would be fortunate enough to exchange blows with twelve supreme elites that had each ruled over an era. To him, that was not despair, but excitement, and anticipation.
F*ck, what kind of monster was this?
Lu Xun was rendered speechless. He already knew that the opponents he had to face were 12 Great Emperors, yet he could still smile with such confidence. This was truly rendering him speechless.
Ling Han smiled, and took a step forwards. Instantly, his figure disappeared into the Void.
Lu Xun didn’t give chase. He could come and go as he pleased in the Living Realm, but Yin souls could not. In fact, even the Saintly corpses would be restricted to a certain extent.
“In the end, you are just a clown.”
“The wheel of time has already begun. If you try to stop it like a mantis trying to stop a chariot, you will only be crushed into dust.”
Lu Xun said coldly. Was there anyone stronger than a Great Emperor in this world?
There was none!
Thus, the combined forces of the 12 Lords of Death were invincible. It was definitely not something that any one could stand against.
Stars passed, and Ling Han returned to Four Origin Planet.
He harvested Celestial Qi every day, and concocted alchemical pills. He was already getting closer and closer to the peak stage of Fourteen Stars.
Brother Monkey and the others kept bringing back news.

Ling Han and the others weren’t the only ones fighting against the Yin souls. Ding Shu and the other Genesis World rulers, Baili Haojie and the sons of Great Emperors were also mobilized to attack the Yin souls.

Though they were pitifully few in number, a single spark was enough to start a prairie fire, what more when all of them were Saints. Each of them had the strength to destroy planets, so their destructive power against Yin souls was naturally great.
Thus, with this kind of impediment, the progress of the Netherworld was naturally halted.
Three years ago, Baili Haojie and Shi Gang battled fiercely, destroying seven galaxies!

Shi Gang was the personal disciple of the Buddhist Race’s Great Emperor, and just like those ancient prodigies, he had been sealed by the Primordial Source Clay. After millions and millions of years, he had come to this era.
A year and a half ago, Luo Yang and Wu Xingtong battled in space.
Seven months ago, Heaven Crushing battled Feng Miaoling and destroyed a sun, forming a black hole in the Void that devoured who knew how many Yin souls.
The ancient Imperial Sons and the Genesis World’s masters were all exuding their own brilliance, each of them showing the potential to become Emperor.

The competition for the position of Great Emperor in this era was undoubtedly the most intense in history. If the heaven and earth could release their restrictions, it was very possible that they would usher in a golden age like the ancient times — multiple Great Emperors would appear in the universe at the same time.

Ling Han was not idle either. He continued to attack. He encountered Di Wuji, Yang Yihuan and the others respectively, and began a great battle. However, after reaching Saint Tier, it was really too difficult to kill his opponents.
Thus, though the battle had been decided, neither side would be able to kill the other.
To kill a Saint if a Pseudo-Emperor did not appear?
It was practically impossible.

Ling Han quickly charged up to 15 Stars. This was extremely difficult, because there were already 14 seals on the four pinnacle pillars, forming a powerful resistance to prevent the formation of the 15th seal.
He had failed a total of 81 times, and this time, he had finally succeeded, advancing into Fifteen Stars.

Thankfully, he had killed enough Yin souls over these years. With the rewards of heaven and earth, his life force had been strengthened to a certain extent. Otherwise, with so many failures, he may have destroyed even his own foundations.
However, he was finally a fifteen-star Venerate.
Then, if he cultivated this cultivation level to the end, he would truly have reached the consummate level of this cultivation level. He would be able to light up the holy flame, and become a Saint.
Once he became a Saint… hehe!
Ling Han continued to capture Celestial Qi and concoct alchemical pills, and continued to kill Yin souls to increase his strength.
The universe was bustling with noise and excitement. All the prodigies displayed their graceful bearing to their heart’s content, establishing their outstanding reputations.
However, they were not invincible.

The son of the Great Emperor of the Crimson Rainbow Imperial Clan was ambushed. Twelve Skeleton Saint Tools sealed off the space, causing this ancient Imperial Son to battle to the last drop of his blood. Helplessly, he died with grudges.
When the news spread out, the whole world was shocked.
A Saint-level being, and the son of a Great Emperor at that, had died!
This was undoubtedly a massive blow. Was the strength of the Netherworld truly unstoppable?

Ding Shu, Shi Tianlu, and the others had clearly become more cautious in their attacks. Furthermore, the frequency of their attacks had also decreased considerably. They were all people who had hopes of becoming Emperor, so they naturally did not want all their efforts to go to waste at this moment.
After all, as long as they cultivated normally, it was only a matter of time before they reached the level of Nine-Star Saint.
And once they became Pseudo-Emperor, they would be able to move unhindered in the universe as long as a Great Emperor did not appear.
Now, everyone was aiming for the position of Pseudo-Emperor. Whoever was the first to beocme Pseudo-Emperor, that was undoubtedly taking the lead in the path to becoming Emperor.
In the battle for Pseudo-Emperor, everyone excluded Ling Han.
—Though Ling Han was strong, his cultivation level was too low, and he was not just a little bit weaker than the king tiers of the younger generation.
But at this time, Ling Han had also successfully cultivated to the peak stage of Fifteen Stars.
Consummate level of Fourth Extreme!
He could ignite the holy flame and attempt to break through to Saint Tier.
Ling Han immediately began his seclusion, making the final preparations.
After all, this was becoming a Saint.
A whole half year later, he finally began to let that seed sprout, to ignite the holy flame.

chapters.title: Chapter 4650: Great appetite
paragraphs: Chapter 4650: Great appetite
It was very, very simple to light up the holy flame.
That was to capture the eight-star Regulation, turn it into a spark, and then ignite the four pinnacle pillars. After they were burnt to nothing, the holy flame would no longer be extinguished.
However, a Venerate could only channel Seven Star Regulations. If he didn’t become a Saint, how would he be able to capture the Eight Star Regulations?

Thus, only a very limited number of prodigies could ignite the holy flame with their own power. As for others, they could only rely on the power of belief to transform this power into the eight-star Regulation and ignite the holy flame.
Using one’s own power to ignite the holy flame was naturally much stronger, because the holy flame had been ignited with genuine eight-star Regulations.
However, Ling Han’s situation was different.

He had obtained the Seed of the Holy Flame. This was something that Empress Qingzhu had paid a heavy price for. She had obtained it from the large fissure at the edge of the universe, and he could become the strongest Great Emperor!
“The problem is, the Empress didn’t tell me how to let this seed germinate!”
Ling Han grumbled in his mind. After all, it had been a long time since he last complained. He couldn’t help himself.
Of course… it was none other than Regulations and power.
Ling Han channeled Regulations first, but did not dare to use too much force, fearing that he would damage this seed. That would really be too much of a gamble.
Let’s try one.
Ling Han pressed a Seven Star Regulation onto it, but the Seed of the Holy Flame did not react at all.
Alright, two flashes… there was still no reaction.
Three, four, five!
Ling Han continuously increased the number of Regulations, but there was no reaction.
After reaching 30 streaks, he didn’t increase them one by one. Instead, he increased them ten by ten. However, even after reaching 90 streaks, the Seed of the Holy Flame still didn’t react at all.
“Just how big is your appetite?”
Ling Han used all the Seven Star Regulations. This time, the Seed of the Holy Flame finally reacted, glowing slightly.
There was a chance!

Meanwhile, Ling Han gritted his teeth. This was 99 Seven Star Regulations. Though he did not have Regulations intertwined together, close to a hundred of them was comparable to an Eight Star Regulation.
As it turned out, the Seed of the Holy Flame needed eight-star Regulations to sprout?
That was awesome enough.

Ling Han didn’t find this strange. After all, the powerful Saints all used their grasp of Regulations to ignite the holy flame. In other words, these people had more or less grasped some eight-star Regulations when they had reached the end of Fourth Extreme.

It could be a sliver, or two slivers. Thus, since the Seed of the Holy Flame could allow one to become the strongest Emperor, it was absolutely normal that it would need the Eight Star Regulations to sprout.
Furthermore… the 99 streaks of Seven Star Regulations could only cause it to glow slightly, and it was still unable to truly sprout.
“You’re awesome!”
“Let’s try this.”
Ling Han intertwined Regulations, and this was terrifying. Ten Seven Star Regulations could match an Eight Star Regulation.
The ten streaks pressed down, and the Seed of the Holy Flame lit up a bit more, but it was still very weak.
“Amazing!”
Ling Han intertwined 20 Seven Star Regulations. As expected, the Seed of the Holy Flame lit up a little more, but it still appeared dim.
“Again!”
“Again!”
“Again!”
Ling Han continued to increase the stakes, and the Seed of the Holy Flame also became brighter and brighter, as if it was about to burn.
F***, could it be that he would not be accelerating the germination of the Seed of the Holy Flame, and was directly igniting it?
This was actually a fire seed, and not something like a tree seed as he understood it?
Forget it, add, add, add, add.
When Ling Han intertwined all 99 Seven Star Regulations, the Seed of the Holy Flame also reached its brightness limit. It was practically blinding.
However, it neither burned, nor sprouted.
Yi, what was going on here?
Ling Han attempted to inject mystical power into it. Instantly, he felt a terrifying suction force, continuously sucking away his mystical power.
It really was a glutton. Merely Regulations were not enough to satisfy it. Mystical power could not be lacking either.
Good.
Ling Han released the restrictions, and allowed the Seed of the Holy Flame to absorb his mystical power.
However, though this seed was small, it was like a bottomless pit. Mystical power continued to fill it up, but it was never satiated.
This speed was too fast. Three days had passed, and the mystical power in Ling Han’s body was completely exhausted.
This was something that had never happened before.
When Ling Han battled with others, even if his opponent was stronger than him, he could still rely on his powerful defense and heaven-defying mystical power reserves to exhaust his opponent to death.
Why was it the other way around here?

Ling Han also activated the power of the living beings in the dimensions in his body. However, it was still useless. The Seed of the Holy Flame accepted all of them. It didn’t matter whether they were Regulations, mystical power, or power of belief.
However, it neither burned nor sprouted. It was just playing dead.
Another day later, Ling Han was at his wit’s end.
He was just a tiny bit away from being sucked dry.
He could not continue, or he would definitely die first.

Ling Han sat down and started to recover his power. However, his reserves of mystical power were astonishing, so it would naturally take a long time for him to recover completely. He wouldn’t be able to recover without two months.

Ordinarily, the fact that he could grasp the equivalent of twelve eight-star Regulations at Fourth Extreme was already an extremely awesome feat, because there were even some weaker nine-star Saints that had only grasped this number of eight-star Regulations.
Thus, Ling Han definitely wouldn’t believe that there weren’t enough Regulations.
Then, the problem lay in power.
Ling Han tried to probe that seed with his soul.
Yi, at first, this seed was tightly wrapped, and there was no way to spy on the secrets within at all, but now, the doors were wide open for him.
Ling Han saw that the seed was glowing, and the seed wall was covered with vein-like patterns of Regulations.
This also proved that the number of Regulations that the Seed of the Holy Flame needed was already enough.
Looking inside the seed again, the mystical power he had injected into it had turned into liquid, and sank at the bottom of the seed. There was only a small puddle.
Hiss!
Ling Han inhaled sharply. Then, how many times would it take to fill up the entire seed?
At least 10,000 times.
Calculating again, it would take about two months to replenish mystical power once, so ten thousand times would be twenty thousand months, which was as long as over a thousand and six hundred years.
Ling Han was rendered speechless. It actually took so long?
“Can it be sped up?”
He tried to get Brother Monkey, the empress and the others to input mystical power into him, but it was ineffective. The seed rejected this.
He tried other methods, and discovered that the energy naturally formed by heaven and earth was not repelled by the seed.
In theory, this could be sped up.
The problem was that Ling Han was already a fifteen-star Venerate, and his power had even advanced into Saint Tier. What heaven and earth power could compare to his reserves of mystical power?
“Where can I find such a massive amount of energy?”

Ling Han was troubled. Perhaps there was in the great fissure at the edge of the universe, but with his present strength, it was possible that he would not be able to make it there in ten thousand years. In that case, he might as well slowly cultivate here.
At this moment, there was nothing else he could do. He could only cultivate while thinking of another way.
Gathering their thoughts together, everyone began to think of a solution for Ling Han.
Two months later, Brother Monkey returned and told Ling Han a very useful piece of information.
In the Buddhist Land outside the 33 Heavens, there was a Pond of Life. This was where the Buddhist Race had gathered the power of faith of all life for so many years.𝒻𝓇𝑒𝘦𝘸𝑒𝒷𝓃ℴ𝑣𝘦𝑙.𝒸ℴ𝘮
